AX_Common_APebbleinthePond.name: A Pebble in the Pond
AX_Common_APebbleinthePond.effect: Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
AX_Common_APebbleinthePond.flavor: A single pebble can cause quite a ripple.

AX_Common_AbandonedDepot.name: Abandoned Depot
AX_Common_AbandonedDepot.effect: {J} Draw a card.  When I'm sacrificed — Draw a card. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.
AX_Common_AbandonedDepot.flavor: "There's no doubt about it... These ruins are the work of people from the City of Scholars." - Abiram

AX_Common_AbySapCourier.name: Aby, Sap Courier
AX_Common_AbySapCourier.effect: $<SCOUT_1> {1}. {J} You may <AUGMENT> target card in play or in Reserve. (If it has counters, it gains 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)
AX_Common_AbySapCourier.flavor: This wheel is the result of hours of mechanical training.

AX_Common_AdaLovelace.name: Ada Lovelace
AX_Common_AdaLovelace.effect: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve. If it's a Permanent, draw a card.
AX_Common_AdaLovelace.flavor: "Imagination is the discovering faculty. It is that which penetrates the unseen worlds around us."

AX_Common_AerolithQuarry.name: Aerolith Quarry
AX_Common_AerolithQuarry.effect: At Noon — If your opponent is first player, create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
AX_Common_AerolithQuarry.flavor: "It took great feats of ingenuity to mine for resources at such altitude." - Isaree

AX_Common_AerolithReef.name: Aerolith Reef
AX_Common_AerolithReef.effect: {J} You may send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.
AX_Common_AerolithReef.flavor: Reaching the pillar is no easy journey, as the clouds conceal countless reefs and other dangers.

AX_Common_AmeliaEarhart.name: Amelia Earhart
AX_Common_AmeliaEarhart.flavor: "The most effective way to do it, is to do it."

AX_Common_ArmoredJammer.name: Armored Jammer
AX_Common_ArmoredJammer.flavor: "In a jam? Sorry, mate. Maybe a side-effect of our scrambling..."

AX_Common_Athena.name: Athena
AX_Common_Athena.effect: {R} If you control two or more Landmarks, I lose <FLEETING_CHAR>.
AX_Common_Athena.flavor: "I’ve lifted the mist from off your eyes that’s blurred them up to now."

AX_Common_Avalanche.name: Avalanche
AX_Common_Avalanche.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve any number of target Characters with total {M} of 4 or less.
AX_Common_Avalanche.flavor: None of the snowflakes feel personally guilty for the avalanche.

AX_Common_AxiomExhibit.name: Axiom Exhibit
AX_Common_AxiomExhibit.effect: {T} : Target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost. Then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
AX_Common_AxiomExhibit.flavor: "Let's show the Reka the brilliance of Axiom ingenuity!"

AX_Common_AxiomMachinist.name: Axiom Machinist
AX_Common_AxiomMachinist.effect: {H} You may ready target Permanent in play or target card in Reserve.
AX_Common_AxiomMachinist.flavor: From Kelon to Sap to Manaseed, the Axiom never stop experimenting with alternative energy sources.

AX_Common_AxiomPuppeteer.name: Axiom Puppeteer
AX_Common_AxiomPuppeteer.effect: {H} You may sacrifice a Permanent to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)
AX_Common_AxiomPuppeteer.flavor: "In rock-paper-scissors, I always win by a knockout."

AX_Common_AxiomReprocessor.name: Axiom Reprocessor
AX_Common_AxiomReprocessor.flavor: Nothing is created, nothing is lost, everything is transformed.

AX_Common_AxiomSalvager.name: Axiom Salvager
AX_Common_AxiomSalvager.flavor: The Axiom's limited resources pushed them to reuse whatever they could.

AX_Common_AxiomScrambler.name: Axiom Scrambler
AX_Common_AxiomScrambler.flavor: Pushing back the Tumult sometimes prevents other Alterers from materializing their Eidolons. Regrettable, but necessary.

AX_Common_AxiomSignet.name: Axiom Signet
AX_Common_AxiomSignet.effect: Choose one:  • Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  • Target Permanent you control activates its {j} abilities.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.

AX_Common_BessieColeman.name: Bessie Coleman
AX_Common_BessieColeman.effect: When you sacrifice a Permanent — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.
AX_Common_BessieColeman.flavor: "I was destined to fly. I was born to fly." - Bessie

AX_Common_Boom.name: Boom!
AX_Common_Boom.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Sacrifice a Character. If you do, discard target Character or Permanent.
AX_Common_Boom.flavor: "Catastrophic failure? I prefer the term 'learning opportunity'."

AX_Common_Brassbug.name: Brassbug
AX_Common_Brassbug.effect: (If I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)

AX_Common_BrassbugDropship.name: Brassbug Dropship
AX_Common_BrassbugDropship.effect: When I'm sacrificed — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in each of your Expeditions. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)
AX_Common_BrassbugDropship.flavor: "Those little pests are tough. Even three miles up, they still manage to follow us." - Subhash

AX_Common_BrassbugHive.name: Brassbug Hive
AX_Common_BrassbugHive.effect: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  At Noon — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_BrassbugHive.flavor: What could possibly go wrong with an adorable little self-replicating autonomous robot?

AX_Common_BrassbugHub.name: Brassbug Hub
AX_Common_BrassbugHub.effect: {J} I gain three Kelon counters.  At Noon — You may pay {1} and spend one of my Kelon counters to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_BrassbugHub.flavor: Few people visit the depths of the Foundry, and even fewer can explain how the Brassbugs came to be.

AX_Common_BrassbugNursery.name: Brassbug Nursery
AX_Common_BrassbugNursery.effect: {J} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")  {T}, {1}, Sacrifice a Permanent: create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_BrassbugNursery.flavor: Even far from their Hive, the Brassbugs have developed a way to continue reproducing.

AX_Common_BugOutBag.name: Bug-Out Bag
AX_Common_BugOutBag.effect: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in my Expedition.
AX_Common_BugOutBag.flavor: They forgot to pack the Eat Me energy bars.

AX_Common_Bugfix.name: Bugfix
AX_Common_Bugfix.effect: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_Bugfix.flavor: It's not Kelon, but this Sap will make you feel better, I swear.

AX_Common_Coppelia.name: Coppélia
AX_Common_Coppelia.effect: When I go to Reserve from your hand — You may play me for free and I gain $<ASLEEP>.
AX_Common_Coppelia.flavor: Because of her artificial nature, she served as a model for the Faction's first Automata prototypes.

AX_Common_CorruptedPaju.name: Corrupted Paju
AX_Common_CorruptedPaju.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless your hand is empty.  {R} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
AX_Common_CorruptedPaju.flavor: "Why did you survive, Treyst… but I died?"

AX_Common_DaringPorter.name: Daring Porter
AX_Common_DaringPorter.effect: {R} <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
AX_Common_DaringPorter.flavor: Someone has to shoulder the heavy burden of responsibility.

AX_Common_DellaBolt.name: Della & Bolt
AX_Common_DellaBolt.effect: {T} : Ready target Permanent in play or target card in Reserve. This costs {2} more to target a Permanent in play with Hand Cost {5} or more.
AX_Common_DellaBolt.flavor: Living creatures are the most beautiful mechanisms of all.

AX_Common_DemolitionExpert.name: Demolition Expert
AX_Common_DemolitionExpert.effect: {H} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")  {R} You may sacrifice a Permanent.
AX_Common_DemolitionExpert.flavor: Mining aerolith is dangerous, but it's well worth the risk.

AX_Common_DesignerDrone.name: Designer Drone
AX_Common_DesignerDrone.support: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.
AX_Common_DesignerDrone.flavor: Designed by designers to help them design.

AX_Common_Detonation.name: Detonation
AX_Common_Detonation.effect: $<FLEETING>.  You may sacrifice a Permanent to reduce my cost by {1}.  Send target Character to Reserve.
AX_Common_Detonation.flavor: Aerolith's instability can turn any bump into an explosive reaction.

AX_Common_DrFrankenstein.name: Dr. Frankenstein
AX_Common_DrFrankenstein.effect: {R} You may activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.
AX_Common_DrFrankenstein.flavor: We sometimes seek companionship in the strangest of life forms.

AX_Common_DredgerDrone.name: Dredger Drone
AX_Common_DredgerDrone.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to <RESUPPLY_INF>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)
AX_Common_DredgerDrone.support: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.
AX_Common_DredgerDrone.flavor: The more you dig, the better your chances of finding something unique.

AX_Common_Drillmole.name: Drillmole
AX_Common_Drillmole.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)
AX_Common_Drillmole.support: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.

AX_Common_EmergencyBurst.name: Emergency Burst
AX_Common_EmergencyBurst.effect: <FLEETING>.  Play me for {1} less if there are no other cards in your hand.  Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, Hand Cost if not.)
AX_Common_EmergencyBurst.flavor: If Aerolith can defy gravity, it can also deny evil!

AX_Common_EnhancedPrototype.name: Enhanced Prototype
AX_Common_EnhancedPrototype.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to ready two Mana Orbs.
AX_Common_EnhancedPrototype.support: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.
AX_Common_EnhancedPrototype.flavor: It's no longer flawed, but there's still room for improvement.

AX_Common_FabLabUnit.name: Fab Lab Unit
AX_Common_FabLabUnit.effect: {T} : The next Character played from your hand in my Expedition this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.
AX_Common_FabLabUnit.flavor: All the power of the Foundry distilled into this miracle of technology.

AX_Common_FailedDemo.name: Failed Demo
AX_Common_FailedDemo.effect: <FLEETING>.  Exhaust ({T}) a card in your Reserve. If you do, send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or Hand Cost if not.)
AX_Common_FailedDemo.flavor: Not a failure; just another step towards success.

AX_Common_FarFetch20.name: FarFetch 2.0
AX_Common_FarFetch20.effect: {J} You may sacrifice a Permanent. If you do, target Character switches Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)
AX_Common_FarFetch20.flavor: "I'm glad I got my hooks into this new version!" - Paju

AX_Common_FlawedPrototype.name: Flawed Prototype
AX_Common_FlawedPrototype.effect: {J} Sacrifice another Robot or Permanent. If you can't, sacrifice me.
AX_Common_FlawedPrototype.flavor: "If we could just find a substitute for the missing parts, we could make it work."

AX_Common_FoundryArmorer.name: Foundry Armorer
AX_Common_FoundryArmorer.effect: {R} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_FoundryArmorer.flavor: No Brassbug would survive in the Tumult without armor.

AX_Common_FoundryEngineer.name: Foundry Engineer
AX_Common_FoundryEngineer.effect: {R} The next Permanent you play this Afternoon costs {1} less.
AX_Common_FoundryEngineer.flavor: Behind every Axiom masterwork, there are Foundry Engineers.

AX_Common_FoundryMechanic.name: Foundry Mechanic
AX_Common_FoundryMechanic.support: {D} : The next Permanent you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Common_FoundryMechanic.flavor: You can't choose when and where a quick fix will be needed.

AX_Common_FrankensteinsCreature.name: Frankenstein's Creature
AX_Common_FrankensteinsCreature.effect: {R} You may target a Permanent you control with Base Cost {2} or less. It activates its {j} abilities.
AX_Common_FrankensteinsCreature.flavor: It's by shunning differences that true monsters are born.

AX_Common_FrozenDelivery.name: Frozen Delivery
AX_Common_FrozenDelivery.effect: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  $<RESUPPLY>.
AX_Common_FrozenDelivery.flavor: Precious supplies. If only the lid wasn't frozen shut...

AX_Common_FrozenReprocessor.name: Frozen Reprocessor
AX_Common_FrozenReprocessor.effect: At Noon — <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  You may keep one more card in Reserve during Night if it's exhausted.
AX_Common_FrozenReprocessor.flavor: Nothing is created, nothing is lost... even to the frost.

AX_Common_Ganesha.name: Ganesha
AX_Common_Ganesha.effect: {J} For each Permanent you control, you may activate its {j} abilities.
AX_Common_Ganesha.flavor: Knowledge and wisdom must walk side by side.

AX_Common_Gavroche.name: Gavroche
AX_Common_Gavroche.effect: {R} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
AX_Common_Gavroche.flavor: He fills his basket and retorts by thumbing his nose.

AX_Common_Gibil.name: Gibil
AX_Common_Gibil.effect: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_Gibil.support: {D} : Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Common_Gibil.flavor: Symphonies begin with two notes, fires with a couple of sparks, and masterpieces with two drops of metal.

AX_Common_Hooked.name: Hooked
AX_Common_Hooked.effect: Target Character switches Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)

AX_Common_HopomyThumb.name: Hop-o'-my-Thumb
AX_Common_HopomyThumb.effect: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
AX_Common_HopomyThumb.flavor: It's not easy to lead the way…

AX_Common_Icarus.name: Icarus
AX_Common_Icarus.effect: $<SCOUT_1> {1}.  {J} Ready all cards in your Reserve.
AX_Common_Icarus.flavor: This time, I hope the Sap wax will hold.

AX_Common_IceboundHollow.name: Icebound Hollow
AX_Common_IceboundHollow.effect: When a card goes from your Hand or deck to Reserve — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then ready your cards in Reserve.
AX_Common_IceboundHollow.flavor: In the caves and crevices, it wails and calls to us.

AX_Common_InariSpiritofIndustry.name: Inari, Spirit of Industry
AX_Common_InariSpiritofIndustry.effect: When you pass — If your hand is empty, draw a card.
AX_Common_InariSpiritofIndustry.flavor: Everything contains a need to grow, be it a grain of rice or human being.

AX_Common_IraFairAttendee.name: Ira, Fair Attendee
AX_Common_IraFairAttendee.flavor: "One day, son, you'll show off your own creations here." — Della

AX_Common_IsareePebble.name: Isaree & Pebble
AX_Common_IsareePebble.effect: At Noon — If you are first player, create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
AX_Common_IsareePebble.flavor: Science's role is to serve the people, not the other way around

AX_Common_JianAssemblyOverseer.name: Jian, Assembly Overseer
AX_Common_JianAssemblyOverseer.flavor: "This material does not seem to be affected by gravity. By harnessing the properties of this Aerolith, we could create flying ships and cities, and fly close to the clouds..."

AX_Common_KelonBurst.name: Kelon Burst
AX_Common_KelonBurst.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {4} or less.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or less.
AX_Common_KelonBurst.flavor: There's an enduring legend in the Suspira quarries: the existence of another type of Kelon.

AX_Common_KelonCylinder.name: Kelon Cylinder
AX_Common_KelonCylinder.effect: {T} : I gain two Kelon counters.  {T}, Spend one of my Kelon counters: the next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost $<BB>.
AX_Common_KelonCylinder.flavor: This little battery is Axiom's trump card. The Kelon produces phenomenal energy for which engineers find new applications every day.

AX_Common_KelonElemental.name: Kelon Elemental
AX_Common_KelonElemental.effect: {H} Put a card from your hand in Reserve.
AX_Common_KelonElemental.flavor: In true Axiom fashion, Kelon Elementals like to put everything to the taste.

AX_Common_KelonicGenerator.name: Kelonic Generator
AX_Common_KelonicGenerator.flavor: "Suspira's mines will soon run dry. Your precious Kelon will run dry."

AX_Common_KelonicHeater.name: Kelonic Heater
AX_Common_KelonicHeater.effect: {J} $<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.  You may play exhausted Characters from your Reserve in my Expedition.
AX_Common_KelonicHeater.flavor: A bit of warmth goes a long way in brightening a cold day.

AX_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
AX_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Common_LeonardodaVinci.name: Leonardo da Vinci
AX_Common_LeonardodaVinci.effect: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control to $<RESUPPLY_INF>.
AX_Common_LeonardodaVinci.flavor: "The noblest pleasure is the joy of understanding." — Leonardo da Vinci

AX_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
AX_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less.

AX_Common_LordKelvin.name: Lord Kelvin
AX_Common_LordKelvin.effect: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
AX_Common_LordKelvin.flavor: "When you are face to face with a difficulty, you are up against a discovery."

AX_Common_LucanHungryLeviathan.name: Lucan, Hungry Leviathan
AX_Common_LucanHungryLeviathan.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  {J} You may discard any number of cards from your Reserve to give me that many boosts.
AX_Common_LucanHungryLeviathan.flavor: It bursts out of the clouds to devour our metal shuttles.

AX_Common_MakeitWork.name: Make it Work
AX_Common_MakeitWork.effect: {J} Put a card from your hand in Reserve.  When you pass — If your hand is empty, complete me.
AX_Common_MakeitWork.flavor: "Come on, almost there, you've got this!"

AX_Common_MarieCurie.name: Marie Curie
AX_Common_MarieCurie.flavor: "It is important to make a dream of life and of a dream reality."

AX_Common_MasterLapidary.name: Master Lapidary
AX_Common_MasterLapidary.flavor: Cutting Aerolith requires a deft and delicate touch.

AX_Common_MechanicalTraining.name: Mechanical Training
AX_Common_MechanicalTraining.effect: Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.
AX_Common_MechanicalTraining.flavor: To learn to create, first learn to fix.

AX_Common_Medusa.name: Medusa
AX_Common_Medusa.effect: {R} You may discard target Character. If you do, create an <AEROLITH> token in its controller's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
AX_Common_Medusa.flavor: They made her a monster simply for defending herself.

AX_Common_NikolaTesla.name: Nikola Tesla
AX_Common_NikolaTesla.effect: {R} I gain 1 boost if you control an exhausted Permanent or if there's an exhausted card in your Reserve.
AX_Common_NikolaTesla.flavor: "With this new invention, we can generate a force field to protect the city!"

AX_Common_Ogun.name: Ogun
AX_Common_Ogun.flavor: With every blow of his hammer, Ogun forges the Axiom's destiny.

AX_Common_PajuAxiomPilot.name: Paju, Axiom Pilot
AX_Common_PajuAxiomPilot.support: {D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Common_PajuAxiomPilot.flavor: "Look, Paju. Wandering unknown skies was our dream, and now we've achieved it." - Treyst

AX_Common_RekaBioengineer.name: Reka Bioengineer
AX_Common_RekaBioengineer.effect: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) a card in your Reserve to create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
AX_Common_RekaBioengineer.flavor: In the wild rush to find new uses for Manaseeds, it seems the sky's the limit…

AX_Common_RekaMagnate.name: Reka Magnate
AX_Common_RekaMagnate.effect: {R} Choose one:  • <SABOTAGE>.  • Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
AX_Common_RekaMagnate.flavor: "A disruptive smoothie to knock the competition off balance!"

AX_Common_RekaRecycler.name: Reka Recycler
AX_Common_RekaRecycler.effect: {H} You may discard two cards from your Reserve to draw a card.
AX_Common_RekaRecycler.flavor: In with the old, and out comes the new!

AX_Common_RekaScavenger.name: Reka Scavenger
AX_Common_RekaScavenger.effect: When you pass — If there's at most one card in your hand, I gain 1 boost.
AX_Common_RekaScavenger.flavor: "I need to bring this back to Isaree as soon as possible!"

AX_Common_RekaWelder.name: Reka Welder
AX_Common_RekaWelder.effect: You play Permanents for {1} less, down to a minimum of {1}. (Other effects may reduce it further.)
AX_Common_RekaWelder.flavor: It's at times like these that we need to stick together.

AX_Common_RestockingStation.name: Restocking Station
AX_Common_RestockingStation.effect: {J} I gain 2 Kelon counters.  {T}, Spend 1 of my Kelon counters: target Character loses <FLEETING>.
AX_Common_RestockingStation.flavor: "Kelon powers our engines, aerolith gives us access to the skies. What heights will we reach with the other two Primordiae?" - Basem

AX_Common_RocketPuffin.name: Rocket Puffin
AX_Common_RocketPuffin.effect: {J} You may ready an exhausted card in Reserve.
AX_Common_RocketPuffin.flavor: Blasting off at the speed of light!

AX_Common_SapExtractor.name: Sap Extractor
AX_Common_SapExtractor.effect: At Noon — You may <AUGMENT> target card in play or in Reserve. (If it has counters, it gains 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)
AX_Common_SapExtractor.flavor: The Sap courses through the whole city like blood in a mortal's veins.

AX_Common_SapOverflow.name: Sap Overflow
AX_Common_SapOverflow.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Discard target Character in play or in Reserve.
AX_Common_SapOverflow.flavor: With every dig, the Sap becomes riskier to harvest.

AX_Common_SapSniffer.name: Sap Sniffer
AX_Common_SapSniffer.effect: {R} You may <AUGMENT> target card in play or in Reserve. (If it has counters, it gains 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)
AX_Common_SapSniffer.flavor: Indigenous to the ruins, these little creatures can smell Sap from a mile away.

AX_Common_ScienceFair.name: Science Fair
AX_Common_ScienceFair.effect: {T} : Put a card from your hand in Reserve. If you do, draw a card.
AX_Common_ScienceFair.flavor: At this convention, the Reka show off their scientific superiority.

AX_Common_ShiramunTechMonk.name: Shiramun, Tech Monk
AX_Common_ShiramunTechMonk.effect: {H} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Discard up to one card from a Reserve.)
AX_Common_ShiramunTechMonk.flavor: Building walls, to keep the monsters at bay.

AX_Common_ShortageSupervisor.name: Shortage Supervisor
AX_Common_ShortageSupervisor.effect: {R} If your hand is empty, I gain 1 boost.
AX_Common_ShortageSupervisor.flavor: With the appropriate tech, Sap can exhibit energetic properties sufficient to replace Kelon.

AX_Common_SierraOddball.name: Sierra & Oddball
AX_Common_SierraOddball.effect: When you play a Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or more — You may exhaust me ({T}) to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_SierraOddball.flavor: I don't know if there's a better reward than seeing something you've built come to life.

AX_Common_SneakySalamander.name: Sneaky Salamander
AX_Common_SneakySalamander.effect: {H} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve.
AX_Common_SneakySalamander.flavor: Perfect for slipping under the radar.

AX_Common_StigmaofStagnation.name: Stigma of Stagnation
AX_Common_StigmaofStagnation.flavor: Fear of change leads to stagnation.

AX_Common_SubhashMarmo.name: Subhash & Marmo
AX_Common_SubhashMarmo.effect: At Noon — You may pay {1} and put a card from your hand in Reserve to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_SubhashMarmo.flavor: There are still endless possibilities, even in a world of finite resources. In the end, it all comes down to how you choose to spend 'em.

AX_Common_TechLabUnit.name: Tech Lab Unit
AX_Common_TechLabUnit.effect: {J} $<RESUPPLY>.  Your Reserve limit is increased by one.

AX_Common_TechnologicalEncounter.name: Technological Encounter
AX_Common_TechnologicalEncounter.effect: $<COOLDOWN>.  Draw a card, then create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
AX_Common_TechnologicalEncounter.flavor: "The fruit of our research will lead our peoples to new heights."

AX_Common_TheConsortium.name: The Consortium
AX_Common_TheConsortium.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  {T} : Target Character in Reserve gains 2 boosts.
AX_Common_TheConsortium.flavor: The epicenter of Reka research, focused on perpetual growth.

AX_Common_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.name: The Foundry, Axiom Bastion
AX_Common_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.effect: {T} : The next Character you play from your hand this turn activates its {r} abilities (as if it had been played from Reserve).
AX_Common_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.flavor: Embedded in the cliff wall, it overlooks the city and reminds everyone who looks up at it that nothing is unreachable if you put your mind to it.

AX_Common_TheGrems.name: The Grems
AX_Common_TheGrems.effect: {R} Choose up to one:  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.  • Sacrifice a Permanent. If you do, create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Common_TheGrems.flavor: It's not demolition, but basic recycling. Or so they say.

AX_Common_TheLittleMatchGirl.name: The Little Match Girl
AX_Common_TheLittleMatchGirl.effect: {R} If your hand is empty, draw a card.
AX_Common_TheLittleMatchGirl.flavor: When you're alone in the cold, even the tiniest light can feel like salvation.

AX_Common_TheMachineintheIce.name: The Machine in the Ice
AX_Common_TheMachineintheIce.effect: When I go to Reserve from anywhere — Exhaust me ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  {H} Send me to Reserve.
AX_Common_TheMachineintheIce.flavor: A relic left by those who came before.

AX_Common_TheRefinery.name: The Refinery
AX_Common_TheRefinery.effect: When a card leaves your Reserve during the Afternoon — I gain 1 Sap counter.  {T}, Spend 3 of my Sap counters: Characters in your Reserve gain 1 boost.
AX_Common_TheRefinery.flavor: The use of Sap will alter the course of science as we know it.

AX_Common_TheShell.name: The Shell
AX_Common_TheShell.effect: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to draw a card.

AX_Common_ThomasEdison.name: Thomas Edison
AX_Common_ThomasEdison.effect: {J} You may discard a Character from your Reserve. If you do, I activate one of its {r} abilities as if it was mine.
AX_Common_ThomasEdison.flavor: "Thanks to MY new invention, the city is safe!"

AX_Common_ThreeLittlePigs.name: Three Little Pigs
AX_Common_ThreeLittlePigs.effect: {J} If you control two or more Landmarks, I gain 1 boost$<BB>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
AX_Common_ThreeLittlePigs.flavor: Together they can build more than just a stone house.

AX_Common_TikTok.name: Tik-Tok
AX_Common_TikTok.effect: {H} Exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control or a card in your Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Common_TinkerBell.name: Tinker Bell
AX_Common_TinkerBell.flavor: Ting! Ting-a-ling! There's something magical in mischievous tinkering...

AX_Common_TotingArmadillo.name: Toting Armadillo
AX_Common_TotingArmadillo.effect: {H} Pay {1} less for the next Permanent you play this Afternoon, down to a minimum of {1}. (Other effects may reduce it further.)
AX_Common_TotingArmadillo.flavor: Its shell has inspired the shields’ design.

AX_Common_TreystRossum.name: Treyst & Rossum
AX_Common_TreystRossum.effect: When a card leaves your Reserve during the Afternoon — if I have less than five Scrap counters, I gain a Scrap counter.  If I have five or more Scrap counters, I gain \"{T} : Draw a card, then put a card from your hand in Reserve.\"
AX_Common_TreystRossum.flavor: An energy system is a piece of subtle machinery to be optimized for better output.

AX_Common_VaikeEnergyPioneer.name: Vaike, Energy Pioneer
AX_Common_VaikeEnergyPioneer.effect: You may play exhausted cards from your Reserve.
AX_Common_VaikeEnergyPioneer.flavor: Energy and persistence conquer all things.

AX_Common_VendingBot.name: Vending Bot
AX_Common_VendingBot.effect: {R} <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Common_Vishvakarma.name: Vishvakarma
AX_Common_Vishvakarma.effect: {J} The next Permanent you play this Afternoon costs {4} less.
AX_Common_Vishvakarma.flavor: Each construction is a poem, and building is an act of eloquence.

AX_Exalted_DeploytheShields.name: Deploy the Shields!
AX_Exalted_DeploytheShields.effect: {J} If there are no tokens in your Landmarks, create an <AEROLITH> token there.  When you pass — If three cards or more are in your Landmarks, complete me.
AX_Exalted_DeploytheShields.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When you sacrifice a Permanent — Target non-<BOOSTED> Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost.
AX_Exalted_DeploytheShields.flavor: "Our task is simple: block the Nightmare's path!" — Isaree

AX_Exalted_PlagueofAvarice.name: Plague of Avarice
AX_Exalted_PlagueofAvarice.effect: {H} Each Permanent you control activates its {j} abilities.  When you pass — Sacrifice a Permanent.
AX_Exalted_PlagueofAvarice.flavor: The pursuit of progress is like an insatiable hunger.

AX_Exalted_SphuraRekaHexarch.name: Sphura, Reka Hexarch
AX_Exalted_SphuraRekaHexarch.effect: Play me for {1} less if you control an exhausted Permanent.  Play me for {1} less if there's an exhausted card in your Reserve.  {J} If there are four or more exhausted cards among Permanents you control and cards in your Reserve, ready up to two of them.
AX_Exalted_SphuraRekaHexarch.flavor: "The Juice is more than just energy; it's our lifeblood!"

AX_Rare_APebbleinthePond.name: A Pebble in the Pond
AX_Rare_APebbleinthePond.effect: #Play me for {1} less if there are no tokens in your Landmarks.#  Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_APebbleinthePond.flavor: A single pebble can cause quite a ripple.

AX_Rare_AbandonedDepot.name: Abandoned Depot
AX_Rare_AbandonedDepot.effect: {J} Draw a card.  When I'm sacrificed — #<RESUPPLY>.# (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.
AX_Rare_AbandonedDepot.flavor: "There's no doubt about it... These ruins are the work of people from the City of Scholars." - Abiram

AX_Rare_AbySapCourier.name: Aby, Sap Courier
AX_Rare_AbySapCourier.effect: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  {J} <AUGMENT_IMP> #any number# of target cards in play or in Reserve. (If they have counters, they gain 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)
AX_Rare_AbySapCourier.flavor: This wheel is the result of hours of mechanical training.

AX_Rare_AdaLovelace.name: Ada Lovelace
AX_Rare_AdaLovelace.effect: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve #to draw a card#.
AX_Rare_AdaLovelace.flavor: "Imagination is the discovering faculty. It is that which penetrates the unseen worlds around us."

AX_Rare_AegisTemplar.name: Aegis Templar
AX_Rare_AegisTemplar.effect: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create a #<BRASSBUG> Robot# token in my Expedition.
AX_Rare_AegisTemplar.flavor: The Templars always ensure that the area is safe.

AX_Rare_AerolithQuarry.name: Aerolith Quarry
AX_Rare_AerolithQuarry.effect: At Noon — If your opponent is first player, create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.  #When you sacrifice a Permanent — You may exhaust me ({T}) to give target Character 1 boost.#
AX_Rare_AerolithQuarry.flavor: "It took great feats of ingenuity to mine for resources at such altitude." - Isaree

AX_Rare_AerolithReef.name: Aerolith Reef
AX_Rare_AerolithReef.effect: {J} You may send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.  #When I'm sacrificed — <RESUPPLY>.  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.#
AX_Rare_AerolithReef.flavor: Reaching the pillar is no easy journey, as the clouds conceal countless reefs and other dangers.

AX_Rare_AleloEerieLeviathan.name: Alelo, Eerie Leviathan
AX_Rare_AleloEerieLeviathan.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  I'm also considered an #Expedition Permanent,# even when not in play. (Play me as a Character, but it counts as playing a Permanent for other abilities.)
AX_Rare_AleloEerieLeviathan.flavor: We followed in its wake, believing it was a magical current.

AX_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.name: Amahle, Asgarthan Outcast
AX_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.effect: {J} You may discard a card from your Reserve to draw a card.
AX_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.flavor: The old world is dying, and the new world struggles to be born: now is the time of monsters.

AX_Rare_AmeliaEarhart.name: Amelia Earhart
AX_Rare_AmeliaEarhart.flavor: "The most effective way to do it, is to do it."

AX_Rare_Anansi.name: Anansi
AX_Rare_Anansi.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost for each card in your Reserve.
AX_Rare_Anansi.flavor: In the end, he had accumulated pretty well all the wisdom that was available. He put it in a gourd and made a stopper for it.

AX_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.name: Arcolano Milk
AX_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.effect: When a Character joins my Expedition — It gains 1 boost and <FLEETING_CHAR>.
AX_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.flavor: Nobody knows where this "milk" actually comes from.

AX_Rare_ArmoredJammer.name: Armored Jammer
AX_Rare_ArmoredJammer.flavor: "In a jam? Sorry, mate. Maybe a side-effect of our scrambling..."

AX_Rare_Athena.name: Athena
AX_Rare_Athena.effect: #{H} If you control two or more Landmarks, I gain 2 boosts.#  {R} If you control two or more Landmarks, I lose <FLEETING_CHAR>.
AX_Rare_Athena.flavor: "I’ve lifted the mist from off your eyes that’s blurred them up to now."

AX_Rare_Avalanche.name: Avalanche
AX_Rare_Avalanche.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve any number of target Characters with #total {M} of 5 or less#.
AX_Rare_Avalanche.flavor: None of the snowflakes feel personally guilty for the avalanche.

AX_Rare_AxiomExhibit.name: Axiom Exhibit
AX_Rare_AxiomExhibit.effect: {T} : Target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost. Then exhaust it ({T}).  #{T} : Target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost. Then ready it.#
AX_Rare_AxiomExhibit.flavor: "Let's show the Reka the brilliance of Axiom ingenuity!"

AX_Rare_AxiomMachinist.name: Axiom Machinist
AX_Rare_AxiomMachinist.effect: #{J}# You may ready target Permanent in play or target card in Reserve.
AX_Rare_AxiomMachinist.flavor: From Kelon to Sap to Manaseed, the Axiom never stop experimenting with alternative energy sources.

AX_Rare_AxiomPuppeteer.name: Axiom Puppeteer
AX_Rare_AxiomPuppeteer.effect: {H} You may sacrifice a Permanent to <SABOTAGE_INF>.  #When you sacrifice a Permanent — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.#
AX_Rare_AxiomPuppeteer.flavor: "In rock-paper-scissors, I always win by a knockout."

AX_Rare_AxiomReprocessor.name: Axiom Reprocessor
AX_Rare_AxiomReprocessor.flavor: Nothing is created, nothing is lost, everything is transformed.

AX_Rare_AxiomSalvager.name: Axiom Salvager
AX_Rare_AxiomSalvager.flavor: The Axiom's limited resources pushed them to reuse whatever they could.

AX_Rare_AxiomScrambler.name: Axiom Scrambler
AX_Rare_AxiomScrambler.flavor: Pushing back the Tumult sometimes prevents other Alterers from materializing their Eidolons. Regrettable, but necessary.

AX_Rare_AxiomSignet.name: Axiom Signet
AX_Rare_AxiomSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  • Target Permanent you control activates its {j} abilities.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.

AX_Rare_BLISSDrummer.name: BLISS Drummer
AX_Rare_BLISSDrummer.effect: If I'm <BOOSTED>, #Robots# cost {1} less to play from your Reserve, with a minimum of {1}.
AX_Rare_BLISSDrummer.support: {I} #At Noon — Choose one:#  • I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 3.#  • #{T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.#
AX_Rare_BLISSDrummer.flavor: "Throw your hands up in the air for everyone who's hauling out those amazing relics from the City of Scholars!" — Tamati

AX_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.name: BLISS Keytarist
AX_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.effect: At Dusk — If I'm <BOOSTED>, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a #Robot# or #Permanent#, draw it. Otherwise, discard it.
AX_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.support: {I} #At Noon — Choose one:# • I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 3.# • #{T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.#
AX_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.flavor: "Make some noise for all the brave folks pulling Sap up from the depths!" — Orbec

AX_Rare_Baku.name: Baku
AX_Rare_Baku.effect: {H} Target opponent discards a card from their hand.
AX_Rare_Baku.flavor: "I’ve seen it myself! 'Baku! Baku!', it says, eating up ghosts as though they were candies."

AX_Rare_Beowulf.name: Beowulf
AX_Rare_Beowulf.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone — You may play a #Permanent# with #Base Cost {3} or less# for free. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
AX_Rare_Beowulf.flavor: "Each of us must suffer death; let he who is able cover himself in glory (before the end)!" - Beowulf

AX_Rare_BessieColeman.name: Bessie Coleman
AX_Rare_BessieColeman.effect: When you sacrifice a Permanent — If I have #less than 2 boosts,# I gain 1 boost.
AX_Rare_BessieColeman.flavor: "I was destined to fly. I was born to fly." - Bessie

AX_Rare_Blizzard.name: Blizzard
AX_Rare_Blizzard.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve each Character from target Expedition, then exhaust them ({T}).
AX_Rare_Blizzard.flavor: The icy winds wrecked the army, despite months of preparation.

AX_Rare_Bluecap.name: Bluecap
AX_Rare_Bluecap.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_Bluecap.flavor: To avoid sudden jolts, invest in stone.

AX_Rare_Boom.name: Boom!
AX_Rare_Boom.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Sacrifice a Character #or Permanent#. If you do, discard target Character or Permanent.
AX_Rare_Boom.flavor: "Catastrophic failure? I prefer the term 'learning opportunity'."

AX_Rare_BrassbugDropship.name: Brassbug Dropship
AX_Rare_BrassbugDropship.effect: When I'm sacrificed — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in each of your Expeditions. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)
AX_Rare_BrassbugDropship.flavor: "Those little pests are tough. Even three miles up, they still manage to follow us." - Subhash

AX_Rare_BrassbugHive.name: Brassbug Hive
AX_Rare_BrassbugHive.effect: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  At Noon — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  #When a Robot joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.#
AX_Rare_BrassbugHive.flavor: What could possibly go wrong with an adorable little self-replicating autonomous robot?

AX_Rare_BrassbugHub.name: Brassbug Hub
AX_Rare_BrassbugHub.effect: {J} I gain three Kelon counters.  At Noon — You may pay {1} and spend one of my Kelon counters to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Rare_BrassbugHub.flavor: Few people visit the depths of the Foundry, and even fewer can explain how the Brassbugs came to be.

AX_Rare_BrassbugNursery.name: Brassbug Nursery
AX_Rare_BrassbugNursery.effect: {T}, {1}, Sacrifice a Permanent: create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Rare_BrassbugNursery.flavor: Even far from their Hive, the Brassbugs have developed a way to continue reproducing.

AX_Rare_BravosCloudhog.name: Bravos Cloudhog
AX_Rare_BravosCloudhog.effect: {R} <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a Character this way, I gain #2 boosts, otherwise I gain 1 boost.#
AX_Rare_BravosCloudhog.flavor: "Ladies and gentlemen, you are about to experience some turbulence."

AX_Rare_BravosExcavator.name: Bravos Excavator
AX_Rare_BravosExcavator.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone, for each of my boosts — You may #<AUGMENT> target card in play or in Reserve.# (If it has counters, it gains 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)
AX_Rare_BravosExcavator.flavor: The depths of the city are filled with archaeological marvels... along with plenty of Sap!

AX_Rare_BravosLookout.name: Bravos Lookout
AX_Rare_BravosLookout.support: #{D} : The next Character played from your hand this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.#
AX_Rare_BravosLookout.flavor: "I think I've found a good spot!"

AX_Rare_BravosRescuer.name: Bravos Rescuer
AX_Rare_BravosRescuer.support: {D} : Target Character loses <FLEETING>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_BravosRescuer.flavor: "Their ranks will be composed of seasoned argonauts, ready to face the perils of the unknown!"

AX_Rare_BravosTracer.name: Bravos Tracer
AX_Rare_BravosTracer.effect: {J} I gain <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If I would be sent to Reserve, discard me instead.)
AX_Rare_BravosTracer.flavor: "I only feel alive when I hear the wind whistling in my ears."

AX_Rare_BravosVanguard.name: Bravos Vanguard
AX_Rare_BravosVanguard.effect: {J} You may have another target Character lose <FLEETING_CHAR> #and gain 1 boost#.
AX_Rare_BravosVanguard.flavor: "We will be the arrow that pierces the veil of the unknown, the torch that banishes the mists of ignorance!"

AX_Rare_BugOutBag.name: Bug-Out Bag
AX_Rare_BugOutBag.effect: #{H}# Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in my Expedition.  #{R} <RESUPPLY>.#
AX_Rare_BugOutBag.flavor: They forgot to pack the Eat Me energy bars.

AX_Rare_Bugfix.name: Bugfix
AX_Rare_Bugfix.effect: <COOLDOWN>.  You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Rare_Bugfix.flavor: It's not Kelon, but this Sap will make you feel better, I swear.

AX_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.name: Carmela, Fast Striker
AX_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.effect: #{J}# If you control a #<COMPLETED_LOW># Feat, #I lose <FLEETING>.#
AX_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.support: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Feat you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}.#
AX_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.flavor: "I only feel alive when I'm on the very edge!"

AX_Rare_CatsCradle.name: Cat's Cradle
AX_Rare_CatsCradle.effect: Target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less# switches Expeditions, then gains <ANCHORED>.
AX_Rare_CatsCradle.flavor: "Time to let the cat out of the bag!"

AX_Rare_Coppelia.name: Coppélia
AX_Rare_Coppelia.effect: When I go to Reserve from your hand — You may play me for free and I gain $<ASLEEP>.
AX_Rare_Coppelia.flavor: Because of her artificial nature, she served as a model for the Faction's first Automata prototypes.

AX_Rare_CorruptedAoife.name: Corrupted Aoife
AX_Rare_CorruptedAoife.effect: #I can't be played# unless you control a Feat.  {R} You may target another Character. It loses <FLEETING> and gains 1 boost.
AX_Rare_CorruptedAoife.flavor: "Are you sure you want to add fuel to the fire?"

AX_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.name: Corrupted Esmeralda
AX_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.effect: I #can't be played# unless a {D} ability was activated this turn.  #{J}# <RESUPPLY>.
AX_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.support: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)#
AX_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.flavor: \"Are you sure you want to follow me into hell, Fen ?\"

AX_Rare_CorruptedPaju.name: Corrupted Paju
AX_Rare_CorruptedPaju.effect: #I can't be played# if there's another card in your hand.  #{J}# Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_CorruptedPaju.support: #{D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.#
AX_Rare_CorruptedPaju.flavor: "Why did you survive, Treyst… but I died?"

AX_Rare_CuppaSap.name: Cuppa Sap
AX_Rare_CuppaSap.effect: Target Character in Reserve gains 2 boosts.
AX_Rare_CuppaSap.flavor: Sap beverages may not be everyone's cup of tea, but they sure perk you up!

AX_Rare_DaringPorter.name: Daring Porter
AX_Rare_DaringPorter.effect: #{J}# <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
AX_Rare_DaringPorter.flavor: Someone has to shoulder the heavy burden of responsibility.

AX_Rare_DaughterofYggdrasil.name: Daughter of Yggdrasil
AX_Rare_DaughterofYggdrasil.flavor: The children of Yggdrasil now take care of the world trees.

AX_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.name: Deep-Cloud Instructor
AX_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.effect: #{J}# You may <RUSH> a Character. If played from your hand, it activates one of its {r} abilities.  {R} I gain #1 boost.#
AX_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.flavor: Without this suit, diving into the Tumult would be a death sentence.

AX_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.name: Delay the Collapse
AX_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.effect: {J} #Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.#  When you pass — If the total Hand Cost of cards in your Landmarks is {6} or more, complete me.
AX_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: Other cards in your Landmarks are <TOUGH_1>.
AX_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.flavor: "Hold out for as long as possible. That's all that matters."

AX_Rare_DemolitionExpert.name: Demolition Expert
AX_Rare_DemolitionExpert.effect: {H} Create an <AEROLITH> token in #target player's# Landmarks.  {R} You may sacrifice a Permanent #to give 1 boost to target Character.#
AX_Rare_DemolitionExpert.flavor: Mining aerolith is dangerous, but it's well worth the risk.

AX_Rare_DesignerDrone.name: Designer Drone
AX_Rare_DesignerDrone.effect: #{R} You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to reduce the cost of the next Permanent you play this Afternoon by {2}.#
AX_Rare_DesignerDrone.support: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.
AX_Rare_DesignerDrone.flavor: Designed by designers to help them design.

AX_Rare_Detonation.name: Detonation
AX_Rare_Detonation.effect: <FLEETING>.  You may sacrifice a Permanent to reduce my cost #by {2}.#  Send to Reserve target Character #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#
AX_Rare_Detonation.flavor: Aerolith's instability can turn any bump into an explosive reaction.

AX_Rare_DrFrankenstein.name: Dr. Frankenstein
AX_Rare_DrFrankenstein.effect: {R} You may activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.
AX_Rare_DrFrankenstein.flavor: We sometimes seek companionship in the strangest of life forms.

AX_Rare_DredgerDrone.name: Dredger Drone
AX_Rare_DredgerDrone.effect: {R} You may spend #1 counter# from #a card you control or in your Reserve# to <RESUPPLY_INF>.
AX_Rare_DredgerDrone.support: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.
AX_Rare_DredgerDrone.flavor: The more you dig, the better your chances of finding something unique.

AX_Rare_Drillmole.name: Drillmole
AX_Rare_Drillmole.effect: {R} You may spend #1 counter# from #a card you control or in your Reserve# to <SABOTAGE_INF>.
AX_Rare_Drillmole.support: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.

AX_Rare_EfrenPuppetMaster.name: Efrén, Puppet Master
AX_Rare_EfrenPuppetMaster.effect: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  {H} Roll a die:  • On a 4+, <SABOTAGE_LOW>.  • On a 1-3, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
AX_Rare_EfrenPuppetMaster.flavor: "I could never let the winding threads of fate separate me from my daughter." — Efrén

AX_Rare_EmergencyBurst.name: Emergency Burst
AX_Rare_EmergencyBurst.effect: <FLEETING>.  Play me for {1} less if there are no other cards in your hand.  #Discard# target Character #or Permanent# with Base Cost #{2} or less.#
AX_Rare_EmergencyBurst.flavor: If Aerolith can defy gravity, it can also deny evil!

AX_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.name: Enhanced Prototype
AX_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.effect: {R} You may spend #1 counter# from #a card you control or in your Reserve# to ready two Mana Orbs.
AX_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.support: {I} At Noon — Choose one:  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • {T} : I gain 2 boosts, up to a max of 3.
AX_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.flavor: It's no longer flawed, but there's still room for improvement.

AX_Rare_Evanescence.name: Evanescence
AX_Rare_Evanescence.effect: #Do the following X+1 times,# where X is my number of Arcane counters:  • Send to Reserve target Character with #Hand Cost {2} or less#, then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
AX_Rare_Evanescence.support: {I} #At Noon — Choose one:#  • I gain 1 Arcane counter, up to a max of 3.  • #{T} : I gain 2 Arcane counters, up to a max of 3.#
AX_Rare_Evanescence.flavor: In the depths of the City, something seems to be devouring memories and thoughts.

AX_Rare_FabLabUnit.name: Fab Lab Unit
AX_Rare_FabLabUnit.effect: {T} : The next Character played from your hand in my Expedition this turn activates one of its {r} abilities, #then gains 1 boost.#
AX_Rare_FabLabUnit.flavor: All the power of the Foundry distilled into this miracle of technology.

AX_Rare_FailedDemo.name: Failed Demo
AX_Rare_FailedDemo.effect: #<COOLDOWN>.#  Exhaust ({T}) a card in your Reserve. If you do, send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or Hand Cost if not.)
AX_Rare_FailedDemo.flavor: Not a failure; just another step towards success.

AX_Rare_FarFetch20.name: FarFetch 2.0
AX_Rare_FarFetch20.effect: {J} You may sacrifice a Permanent. If you do, target Character switches Expeditions.
AX_Rare_FarFetch20.flavor: "I'm glad I got my hooks into this new version!" - Paju

AX_Rare_FlawedPrototype.name: Flawed Prototype
AX_Rare_FlawedPrototype.effect: {J} Sacrifice another Robot or Permanent. #If its Hand Cost was {3} or more, I gain 3 boosts.# If you can't, sacrifice me.
AX_Rare_FlawedPrototype.flavor: "If we could just find a substitute for the missing parts, we could make it work."

AX_Rare_FlutterofMoths.name: Flutter of Moths
AX_Rare_FlutterofMoths.effect: I cost {1} less #for each exhausted card in Reserve.#  Create three <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens, distributed as you choose among any number of target Expeditions.

AX_Rare_FlyingDockyard.name: Flying Dockyard
AX_Rare_FlyingDockyard.effect: When you pass first — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_FlyingDockyard.flavor: "Cast off, and let the hunt begin!" - Sol

AX_Rare_FoundryArmorer.name: Foundry Armorer
AX_Rare_FoundryArmorer.effect: #{J}# Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Rare_FoundryArmorer.flavor: No Brassbug would survive in the Tumult without armor.

AX_Rare_FoundryEngineer.name: Foundry Engineer
AX_Rare_FoundryEngineer.effect: {R} The next Permanent you play this Afternoon costs #{2}# less.
AX_Rare_FoundryEngineer.flavor: Behind every Axiom masterwork, there are Foundry Engineers.

AX_Rare_FoundryMechanic.name: Foundry Mechanic
AX_Rare_FoundryMechanic.support: {D} : The next Permanent you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_FoundryMechanic.flavor: You can't choose when and where a quick fix will be needed.

AX_Rare_FrankensteinsCreature.name: Frankenstein's Creature
AX_Rare_FrankensteinsCreature.effect: {R} You may target a Permanent you control with Base Cost {2} or less. It activates its {j} abilities.
AX_Rare_FrankensteinsCreature.flavor: It's by shunning differences that true monsters are born.

AX_Rare_FrozenDelivery.name: Frozen Delivery
AX_Rare_FrozenDelivery.effect: #<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.# (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
AX_Rare_FrozenDelivery.flavor: Precious supplies. If only the lid wasn't frozen shut...

AX_Rare_FrozenReprocessor.name: Frozen Reprocessor
AX_Rare_FrozenReprocessor.effect: #{J} $<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.#  At Noon — <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.  You may keep one more card in Reserve during Night if it's exhausted.
AX_Rare_FrozenReprocessor.flavor: Nothing is created, nothing is lost... even to the frost.

AX_Rare_Ganesha.name: Ganesha
AX_Rare_Ganesha.effect: {J} For each Permanent you control, you may activate its {j} abilities.
AX_Rare_Ganesha.flavor: Knowledge and wisdom must walk side by side.

AX_Rare_Gavroche.name: Gavroche
AX_Rare_Gavroche.effect: {R} #You may sacrifice a Permanent to# create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_Gavroche.flavor: He fills his basket and retorts by thumbing his nose.

AX_Rare_Gibil.name: Gibil
AX_Rare_Gibil.effect: {J} #If you control two or more Permanents, create two <BRASSBUG> Robot tokens in target Expedition. Otherwise,# create only one.
AX_Rare_Gibil.support: {D} : Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_Gibil.flavor: Symphonies begin with two notes, fires with a couple of sparks, and masterpieces with two drops of metal.

AX_Rare_GrumpyImp.name: Grumpy Imp
AX_Rare_GrumpyImp.effect: When you #put a card from your hand in Reserve# — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.
AX_Rare_GrumpyImp.flavor: He will fight like the devil, despite his fear

AX_Rare_Harvest.name: Harvest
AX_Rare_Harvest.flavor: The thankful receiver bears a plentiful harvest.

AX_Rare_HavenBouncer.name: Haven Bouncer
AX_Rare_HavenBouncer.flavor: Only the bravest can enter Haven.

AX_Rare_HavenBravosBastion.name: Haven, Bravos Bastion
AX_Rare_HavenBravosBastion.effect: #{J} $<RESUPPLY>.#  #{T} The next Character you play from your Reserve this gains 1 boost#
AX_Rare_HavenBravosBastion.flavor: Haven isn't where legends are born... it's where they live forever.

AX_Rare_Hestia.name: Hestia
AX_Rare_Hestia.support: {I} When you play another Character — You may pay {1} to give it 1 boost.
AX_Rare_Hestia.flavor: One offering for one serving of stew. House rules.

AX_Rare_HextagChaser.name: Hextag Chaser
AX_Rare_HextagChaser.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. If #it's in your Reserve,# <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
AX_Rare_HextagChaser.flavor: The element of surprise adds extra spice to any tactic.

AX_Rare_Hooked.name: Hooked
AX_Rare_Hooked.effect: Target Character switches Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)  #Draw a card.#

AX_Rare_HopomyThumb.name: Hop-o'-my-Thumb
AX_Rare_HopomyThumb.effect: #{H}# You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_HopomyThumb.flavor: It's not easy to lead the way…

AX_Rare_Hound.name: Hound
AX_Rare_Hound.effect: {J} If my Expedition is behind, I gain 1 boost.
AX_Rare_Hound.flavor: Like a dog with a bone.

AX_Rare_HuffandPuff.name: Huff and Puff
AX_Rare_HuffandPuff.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Choose a Robot or Animal you control,# then target another Character with equal or lower {V} and send it to Reserve.
AX_Rare_HuffandPuff.flavor: "This time, I will blow you all down!"

AX_Rare_Icarus.name: Icarus
AX_Rare_Icarus.support: #{I} You may play exhausted cards from your Reserve.#
AX_Rare_Icarus.flavor: This time, I hope the Sap wax will hold.

AX_Rare_IceboundHollow.name: Icebound Hollow
AX_Rare_IceboundHollow.effect: When a card goes from your Hand or deck to Reserve — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then ready your cards in Reserve.
AX_Rare_IceboundHollow.flavor: In the caves and crevices, it wails and calls to us.

AX_Rare_IceboundPass.name: Icebound Pass
AX_Rare_IceboundPass.effect: When you exhaust a card in Reserve — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then draw a card.
AX_Rare_IceboundPass.flavor: We can hear it roar in the snowy passes.

AX_Rare_IceboundPeak.name: Icebound Peak
AX_Rare_IceboundPeak.effect: When a Character you control gains <FLEETING_CHAR> — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then each Character you control gains 1 boost.
AX_Rare_IceboundPeak.flavor: On the summit it waits, for freedom, for release.

AX_Rare_Inari.name: Inari
AX_Rare_Inari.support: #{D} : Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_Inari.flavor: Harmony may bloom from a single act of kindness, as a rice field may sprout from a single grain of rice.

AX_Rare_InariSpiritofIndustry.name: Inari, Spirit of Industry
AX_Rare_InariSpiritofIndustry.effect: When you pass — If your hand is empty, draw a card. #Otherwise, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.#
AX_Rare_InariSpiritofIndustry.flavor: Everything contains a need to grow, be it a grain of rice or human being.

AX_Rare_IraFairAttendee.name: Ira, Fair Attendee
AX_Rare_IraFairAttendee.effect: #{R} Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.#
AX_Rare_IraFairAttendee.flavor: "One day, son, you'll show off your own creations here." — Della

AX_Rare_JeannedArc.name: Jeanne d'Arc
AX_Rare_JeannedArc.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone — Create a #<BRASSBUG> Robot# token in each of your Expeditions.
AX_Rare_JeannedArc.flavor: She'll be followed long after she's gone.

AX_Rare_JianAssemblyOverseer.name: Jian, Assembly Overseer
AX_Rare_JianAssemblyOverseer.support: #{D} : Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_JianAssemblyOverseer.flavor: "This material does not seem to be affected by gravity. By harnessing the properties of this Aerolith, we could create flying ships and cities, and fly close to the clouds..."

AX_Rare_JuniorChef.name: Junior Chef
AX_Rare_JuniorChef.effect: #{R} If I have 2 or more boosts, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.#
AX_Rare_JuniorChef.support: {I} #At Noon — Choose one:#  • I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.  • #{T} : I gain 2 boosts#, up to a max of 3.
AX_Rare_JuniorChef.flavor: The Bravos are always the best with a blade, whether it's in a duel or in the kitchen.

AX_Rare_Kali.name: Kali
AX_Rare_Kali.effect: {H} You may put a #Permanent# from your hand in Reserve. If you don't, sacrifice #a Permanent.#

AX_Rare_Kedarm.name: Kedarm
AX_Rare_Kedarm.effect: #When I go to Reserve from the Expedition zone — You may return another target Character from your Reserve to your hand.#
AX_Rare_Kedarm.support: {D} : The next Character played from your hand this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.
AX_Rare_Kedarm.flavor: One of the many amazing Chimaeras that inhabit the Sea of Tumult.

AX_Rare_KelonBurst.name: Kelon Burst
AX_Rare_KelonBurst.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {4} or less.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or less.  #If you control two or more Landmarks, create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.#
AX_Rare_KelonBurst.flavor: There's an enduring legend in the Suspira quarries: the existence of another type of Kelon.

AX_Rare_KelonCylinder.name: Kelon Cylinder
AX_Rare_KelonCylinder.effect: #{J} Target Character gains 1 boost.#  {T} : I gain two Kelon counters.  {T}, Spend one of my Kelon counters: #target Character gains 1 boost.#
AX_Rare_KelonCylinder.flavor: This little battery is Axiom's trump card. The Kelon produces phenomenal energy for which engineers find new applications every day.

AX_Rare_KelonElemental.name: Kelon Elemental
AX_Rare_KelonElemental.effect: {H} #You may# put a card from your hand in Reserve.
AX_Rare_KelonElemental.flavor: In true Axiom fashion, Kelon Elementals like to put everything to the taste.

AX_Rare_KelonicGenerator.name: Kelonic Generator
AX_Rare_KelonicGenerator.flavor: "Suspira's mines will soon run dry. Your precious Kelon will run dry."

AX_Rare_KelonicHeater.name: Kelonic Heater
AX_Rare_KelonicHeater.effect: #{H}# $<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.  You may play exhausted Characters from your Reserve in my Expedition.
AX_Rare_KelonicHeater.flavor: A bit of warmth goes a long way in brightening a cold day.

AX_Rare_KrakensWrath.name: Kraken's Wrath
AX_Rare_KrakensWrath.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve up to #four# target Characters with a total Hand Cost #{6} or less#.
AX_Rare_KrakensWrath.flavor: The roaring waves crashed down over the charging armies, and countless soldiers vanished beneath the raging waters.

AX_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
AX_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: #{J}# Exhaust all cards in Reserve#, then ready your cards in Reserve#.

AX_Rare_LeonardodaVinci.name: Leonardo da Vinci
AX_Rare_LeonardodaVinci.effect: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control to #draw a card.#
AX_Rare_LeonardodaVinci.flavor: "The noblest pleasure is the joy of understanding." — Leonardo da Vinci

AX_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
AX_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less #and gains 1 boost.#

AX_Rare_LordKelvin.name: Lord Kelvin
AX_Rare_LordKelvin.effect: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
AX_Rare_LordKelvin.flavor: "When you are face to face with a difficulty, you are up against a discovery."

AX_Rare_LouisSullivan.name: Louis Sullivan
AX_Rare_LouisSullivan.effect: #{R}# If there are two or more cards in your Landmarks, draw a card.
AX_Rare_LouisSullivan.flavor: "Form ever follows function. This is the law." — Louis Sullivan

AX_Rare_LucanHungryLeviathan.name: Lucan, Hungry Leviathan
AX_Rare_LucanHungryLeviathan.effect: <GIGANTIC>, #<TOUGH_1>.# (Opponents must pay {1} to target me.)  {J} You may #sacrifice# any number of #Permanents# to give me that many boosts.
AX_Rare_LucanHungryLeviathan.flavor: It bursts out of the clouds to devour our metal shuttles.

AX_Rare_LyraChronicler.name: Lyra Chronicler
AX_Rare_LyraChronicler.support: #{D} : <RESUPPLY>.# (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_LyraChronicler.flavor: Eidolon or human, we are all shaped by stories. They're the building blocks of our identity.

AX_Rare_LyraFifer.name: Lyra Fifer
AX_Rare_LyraFifer.effect: {J} If a #{T}# ability #was activated this turn#, I gain 1 boost.
AX_Rare_LyraFifer.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)#
AX_Rare_LyraFifer.flavor: Don't they say that he who pays the piper calls the tune?

AX_Rare_LyraSignet.name: Lyra Signet
AX_Rare_LyraSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Up to two target Characters gain <FLEETING>.  • Draw a card, then roll a die. On a 4+, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.  • Target Character gains 1 boost per card in your Reserve.

AX_Rare_MagpengHoarder.name: Magpeng Hoarder
AX_Rare_MagpengHoarder.effect: {J} If you have two or more cards in Reserve, I gain 1 boost and $<FLEETING_CHAR>.
AX_Rare_MagpengHoarder.flavor: Why does it need all these? Might come in handy someday!

AX_Rare_MakeitWork.name: Make it Work
AX_Rare_MakeitWork.effect: {J} Put a card from your hand in Reserve.  When you pass — If your hand is empty, complete me.
AX_Rare_MakeitWork.flavor: "Come on, almost there, you've got this!"

AX_Rare_MarieCurie.name: Marie Curie
AX_Rare_MarieCurie.effect: #{H} You may sacrifice a Permanent. If you don't, I gain <FLEETING>.#
AX_Rare_MarieCurie.flavor: "It is important to make a dream of life and of a dream reality."

AX_Rare_MarketEncounter.name: Market Encounter
AX_Rare_MarketEncounter.effect: Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_MarketEncounter.support: {D} : The next Character played from your hand this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.
AX_Rare_MarketEncounter.flavor: "Your catch of the day deserves a Manaseed!"

AX_Rare_Martengale.name: Martengale
AX_Rare_Martengale.support: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_Martengale.flavor: Spotting a martengale is always a good omen.

AX_Rare_MasterLapidary.name: Master Lapidary
AX_Rare_MasterLapidary.effect: #{H} You may sacrifice a Permanent to ready a Mana Orb.#
AX_Rare_MasterLapidary.flavor: Cutting Aerolith requires a deft and delicate touch.

AX_Rare_MechanicalTraining.name: Mechanical Training
AX_Rare_MechanicalTraining.effect: Activate the {j} abilities of #up to two# target Permanents you control.
AX_Rare_MechanicalTraining.flavor: To learn to create, first learn to fix.

AX_Rare_Medusa.name: Medusa
AX_Rare_Medusa.effect: {R} You may discard target Character. If you do, create an <AEROLITH> token in #each player's# Landmarks.
AX_Rare_Medusa.flavor: They made her a monster simply for defending herself.

AX_Rare_Merlin.name: Merlin
AX_Rare_Merlin.flavor: "You and I both know it has never been about the sword."

AX_Rare_Mesektet.name: Mesektet
AX_Rare_Mesektet.effect: At Noon — Create a #<BRASSBUG> Robot# token in each of your Expeditions that's behind or tied.
AX_Rare_Mesektet.flavor: Repaired by the Axiom, the pride of the Aegis takes flight once again.

AX_Rare_MonolithRuneScribe.name: Monolith Rune-Scribe
AX_Rare_MonolithRuneScribe.flavor: The Ordis manifest their Alteration through the use of glyphs of power.

AX_Rare_MoonlightJellyfish.name: Moonlight Jellyfish
AX_Rare_MoonlightJellyfish.effect: #When a Robot joins your Expeditions — You may sacrifice me to give it 2 boosts.#  When I'm sacrificed, if I was not <FLEETING> — Put me in Reserve.
AX_Rare_MoonlightJellyfish.flavor: Theoretically, transdifferentiation can go on indefinitely, effectively rendering the jellyfish biologically immortal... and squishy.

AX_Rare_MothDecoy.name: Moth Decoy
AX_Rare_MothDecoy.effect: You may exhaust ({T}) a card from your Reserve to play me for {1} less.  Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
AX_Rare_MothDecoy.flavor: "You're not the only ones who can use substitution." — Moyo

AX_Rare_MothLarva.name: Moth Larva
AX_Rare_MothLarva.effect: #{J}# If there are two or more exhausted cards in Reserve, I gain 1 boost.
AX_Rare_MothLarva.support: #{D} : Exhaust target card in Reserve.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_MothLarva.flavor: At the start of their short life, the larvae are corporeal...

AX_Rare_MothcatcherWand.name: Mothcatcher Wand
AX_Rare_MothcatcherWand.effect: {J} Exhaust target card in Reserve.  {T}, {X} : Create X <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens in my Expedition. X can't be higher than the total number of exhausted cards in Reserve and #other exhausted Permanents you control.#
AX_Rare_MothcatcherWand.flavor: Moyo uses it to capture the essence of illusion.

AX_Rare_MountainNymph.name: Mountain Nymph
AX_Rare_MountainNymph.effect: #{J}# If I'm facing an Expedition in {M}, create an <AEROLITH> token in #target player's# Landmarks.
AX_Rare_MountainNymph.flavor: From a mere pebble, she creates a sparkling jewel.

AX_Rare_MunaDruid.name: Muna Druid
AX_Rare_MunaDruid.support: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_MunaDruid.flavor: "We are the sentinels of the Skein, always keeping a finger on the pulse of nature."

AX_Rare_NikauKaurisFather.name: Nikau, Kauri's Father
AX_Rare_NikauKaurisFather.effect: When #a Robot# joins #your other Expedition# — #It gains# 1 boost.
AX_Rare_NikauKaurisFather.flavor: "Kauri, remember that courage is the happy medium between fear and recklessness!" — Nikau

AX_Rare_NikolaTesla.name: Nikola Tesla
AX_Rare_NikolaTesla.effect: {R} I gain 1 boost #per# exhausted Permanent you control and #per# exhausted card in your Reserve, up to a max of 3 boosts on me.
AX_Rare_NikolaTesla.flavor: "With this new invention, we can generate a force field to protect the city!"

AX_Rare_NilamSpires.name: Nilam Spires
AX_Rare_NilamSpires.effect: When #another Permanent joins your Expeditions or Landmarks# — I gain 1 Arcane counter. Then, you may exhaust me ({T}) and #spend 3# of my Arcane counters to create a #<BRASSBUG> Robot# token in target Expedition.
AX_Rare_NilamSpires.flavor: Observing the Tumult requires taking a high-level perspective on it, and mastering it requires knowledge.

AX_Rare_Nisse.name: Nisse
AX_Rare_Nisse.effect: {H} Roll a die. On a:  • 4+, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.  • 1-3, <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
AX_Rare_Nisse.flavor: "You never know what you'll find in your stockings."

AX_Rare_Ogun.name: Ogun
AX_Rare_Ogun.effect: {J} #You may pay {2} to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.# Then, Robots you control gain 1 boost.
AX_Rare_Ogun.flavor: With every blow of his hammer, Ogun forges the Axiom's destiny.

AX_Rare_OpentheGates.name: Open the Gates
AX_Rare_OpentheGates.effect: Create #a <BRASSBUG> Robot# token in each of your Expeditions.
AX_Rare_OpentheGates.flavor: For the first time in centuries, the Solstice Gate has opened. For the first time in ages, humanity will discover what lies beyond the gates.

AX_Rare_OrdisTourist.name: Ordis Tourist
AX_Rare_OrdisTourist.effect: {J} I gain #1 boost per card in your Landmarks, up to a max of 3 boosts on me.#
AX_Rare_OrdisTourist.flavor: "The more I visit this city, the more I love it."

AX_Rare_OuroborosCroupier.name: Ouroboros Croupier
AX_Rare_OuroborosCroupier.effect: {H} Roll a die. On a 4+, draw a card. On a 1-3, $<RESUPPLY_LOW>.
AX_Rare_OuroborosCroupier.support: #{D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

AX_Rare_OuroborosInkcaster.name: Ouroboros Inkcaster
AX_Rare_OuroborosInkcaster.effect: When I go to Reserve from the Expedition zone — You may return another card from your Reserve to your hand.
AX_Rare_OuroborosInkcaster.flavor: When luck joins in the game, cleverness scores double.

AX_Rare_PajuAxiomPilot.name: Paju, Axiom Pilot
AX_Rare_PajuAxiomPilot.effect: #When a Robot or a token joins my Expedition — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost, then create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.#
AX_Rare_PajuAxiomPilot.support: {D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.
AX_Rare_PajuAxiomPilot.flavor: "Look, Paju. Wandering unknown skies was our dream, and now we've achieved it." - Treyst

AX_Rare_PhileasFogg.name: Phileas Fogg
AX_Rare_PhileasFogg.effect: {R} You may immediately pass. #If you do, I gain 1 boost.#
AX_Rare_PhileasFogg.flavor: "The chance which now seems lost may present itself at the last moment." - Jules Verne

AX_Rare_PriyaBravosSignaler.name: Priya, Bravos Signaler
AX_Rare_PriyaBravosSignaler.effect: #<TOUGH_1>.# (Opponents must pay {1} to target me.)  When my Expedition moves forward — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_PriyaBravosSignaler.flavor: "The goal is simple: to draw out Halua!" - Sol

AX_Rare_ProtecttheAssets.name: Protect the Assets
AX_Rare_ProtecttheAssets.effect: {J} Up to one target Character loses <FLEETING>.  At Noon — If there are two or more cards in your Reserve, complete me.
AX_Rare_ProtecttheAssets.flavor: "If you want them, you'll have to go through me first!" — Kebba

AX_Rare_PuffsChallenge.name: Puff's Challenge
AX_Rare_PuffsChallenge.effect: <FLEETING>.  If an opponent controls three or more Characters, I cost #{2} less.#  Send target Character to Reserve.
AX_Rare_PuffsChallenge.flavor: Wearing red might have been a mistake...

AX_Rare_PushBacktheNight.name: Push Back the Night
AX_Rare_PushBacktheNight.effect: {J} Draw a card, #then put a card from your hand in Reserve.#  At Noon — If six or more cards are in your discard pile, complete me.
AX_Rare_PushBacktheNight.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When #a card goes directly from your hand to Reserve# — You may exhaust me ({T}) to create a #<BRASSBUG> Robot# token in target Expedition.

AX_Rare_QorganExorcist.name: Qorgan Exorcist
AX_Rare_QorganExorcist.effect: #{J} If six or more cards are in your discard pile, I gain 1 boost.# Otherwise, discard the top card of your deck.
AX_Rare_QorganExorcist.flavor: Now we just need to cover Sam's back.

AX_Rare_RekaBioengineer.name: Reka Bioengineer
AX_Rare_RekaBioengineer.effect: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in #any player's# Reserve. If you do, create a <MANASEED> token in #that player's# Landmarks.
AX_Rare_RekaBioengineer.flavor: In the wild rush to find new uses for Manaseeds, it seems the sky's the limit…

AX_Rare_RekaFisherman.name: Reka Fisherman
AX_Rare_RekaFisherman.effect: #{R} Draw a card.#  {R} Create two <MANASEED> tokens in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_RekaFisherman.flavor: "Haha, check it out, it's already stuffed!"

AX_Rare_RekaMagnate.name: Reka Magnate
AX_Rare_RekaMagnate.effect: {R} Choose one, #or exhaust a Permanent you control to choose both:#  • <SABOTAGE>.  • Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_RekaMagnate.flavor: "A disruptive smoothie to knock the competition off balance!"

AX_Rare_RekaRecycler.name: Reka Recycler
AX_Rare_RekaRecycler.effect: {H} You may discard #one card# from your Reserve to draw a card.
AX_Rare_RekaRecycler.flavor: In with the old, and out comes the new!

AX_Rare_RekaScavenger.name: Reka Scavenger
AX_Rare_RekaScavenger.effect: When you pass — If your hand #is empty,# I gain #2 boosts.#
AX_Rare_RekaScavenger.flavor: "I need to bring this back to Isaree as soon as possible!"

AX_Rare_RekaWelder.name: Reka Welder
AX_Rare_RekaWelder.effect: You play Permanents for {1} less, down to a minimum of {1}.
AX_Rare_RekaWelder.flavor: It's at times like these that we need to stick together.

AX_Rare_RepotterOtter.name: Repotter Otter
AX_Rare_RepotterOtter.effect: {J} Each player may put a card from their Hand in Reserve.

AX_Rare_RestockingStation.name: Restocking Station
AX_Rare_RestockingStation.effect: {J} I gain #3 Kelon counters.#  {T}, Spend #any number# of my Kelon counters: #the same number# of target Characters lose <FLEETING>.
AX_Rare_RestockingStation.flavor: "Kelon powers our engines, aerolith gives us access to the skies. What heights will we reach with the other two Primordiae?" - Basem

AX_Rare_RidersMask.name: Rider's Mask
AX_Rare_RidersMask.effect: {T}, {1} : The next Character that joins my Expedition this turn gains 2 boosts. (Characters joining when you pass still join this turn.)
AX_Rare_RidersMask.flavor: An essential accessory for any Leviathan rider.

AX_Rare_RocketPuffin.name: Rocket Puffin
AX_Rare_RocketPuffin.effect: {J} You may ready an exhausted card in Reserve. #If you do, I gain 1 boost.#
AX_Rare_RocketPuffin.flavor: Blasting off at the speed of light!

AX_Rare_SapExtractor.name: Sap Extractor
AX_Rare_SapExtractor.effect: At Noon — <AUGMENT_IMP> #any number# of target cards in play or in Reserve. (If they have counters, they gain 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)
AX_Rare_SapExtractor.flavor: The Sap courses through the whole city like blood in a mortal's veins.

AX_Rare_SapOverflow.name: Sap Overflow
AX_Rare_SapOverflow.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Choose one:  • Spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to discard target Permanent.#  • Discard target Character in play or in Reserve.
AX_Rare_SapOverflow.flavor: With every dig, the Sap becomes riskier to harvest.

AX_Rare_SapSniffer.name: Sap Sniffer
AX_Rare_SapSniffer.effect: #{J}# You may <AUGMENT> target card in play or in Reserve. (If it has counters, it gains 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)
AX_Rare_SapSniffer.flavor: Indigenous to the ruins, these little creatures can smell Sap from a mile away.

AX_Rare_ScienceFair.name: Science Fair
AX_Rare_ScienceFair.effect: #{J} Exhaust me.#  {T} : Put a card from your hand in Reserve, #then exhaust it ({T}).# If you do, draw a card.
AX_Rare_ScienceFair.flavor: At this convention, the Reka show off their scientific superiority.

AX_Rare_ShiramunTechMonk.name: Shiramun, Tech Monk
AX_Rare_ShiramunTechMonk.effect: {H} You may #discard a card from your Reserve# to <SABOTAGE_INF>.
AX_Rare_ShiramunTechMonk.flavor: Building walls, to keep the monsters at bay.

AX_Rare_ShortageSupervisor.name: Shortage Supervisor
AX_Rare_ShortageSupervisor.effect: {R} If your hand is empty, #I gain 2 boosts, otherwise I gain 1 boost.#
AX_Rare_ShortageSupervisor.flavor: With the appropriate tech, Sap can exhibit energetic properties sufficient to replace Kelon.

AX_Rare_Skadi.name: Skadi
AX_Rare_Skadi.effect: {R} #If I'm in {M}, <SABOTAGE>. Otherwise,# you may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
AX_Rare_Skadi.flavor: Life is a slope. It's slow going up, and quick going down.

AX_Rare_SmokeThemOut.name: Smoke Them Out
AX_Rare_SmokeThemOut.effect: {J} #Draw a card, then put a card from your hand in Reserve.#  When #three {T} abilities# are activated on one of your turns — Complete me.
AX_Rare_SmokeThemOut.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: {T} : The next time a #{T} ability# is activated this turn, target Character #in play or in Reserve# gains 1 boost.
AX_Rare_SmokeThemOut.flavor: "Where there's smoke, there's fire… and we're proof of that!"

AX_Rare_SmolderingJinn.name: Smoldering Jinn
AX_Rare_SmolderingJinn.effect: {R} Put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
AX_Rare_SmolderingJinn.flavor: Fire is always smoldering in the idea of the ember.

AX_Rare_SneakySalamander.name: Sneaky Salamander
AX_Rare_SneakySalamander.effect: #{J}# You may put a card from your hand in Reserve.
AX_Rare_SneakySalamander.flavor: Perfect for slipping under the radar.

AX_Rare_StaffClerk.name: Staff Clerk
AX_Rare_StaffClerk.effect: When #you# play another card from Reserve — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.
AX_Rare_StaffClerk.flavor: Don't venture into the depths alone.

AX_Rare_StickyNoteSeals.name: Sticky Note Seals
AX_Rare_StickyNoteSeals.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {4} or more.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or more.
AX_Rare_StickyNoteSeals.flavor: Some lessons stick better than others.

AX_Rare_StigmaofFallacy.name: Stigma of Fallacy
AX_Rare_StigmaofFallacy.effect: #{J}# Do this once #for each# \"Stigma of Fallacy\" in your discard pile:  • Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
AX_Rare_StigmaofFallacy.flavor: Falsehoods behind the mask, hidden under the guise of truth…

AX_Rare_StigmaofStagnation.name: Stigma of Stagnation
AX_Rare_StigmaofStagnation.flavor: Fear of change leads to stagnation.

AX_Rare_StrategicDeployment.name: Strategic Deployment
AX_Rare_StrategicDeployment.effect: Choose one:  • Target up to two Expeditions and create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of them.  • Target Character with Base Cost {2} or less switches Expeditions.

AX_Rare_StudiousAcolyte.name: Studious Acolyte
