AX_Rare_StudiousAcolyte.effect: You may play #Permanents# for {1} less if their Base Cost is {4} or more. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
AX_Rare_StudiousAcolyte.flavor: Afanas' backing is beginning to bear fruit.

AX_Rare_SwiftJinn.name: Swift Jinn
AX_Rare_SwiftJinn.effect: $<SCOUT_3> {3}.  {J} You may put a card from your Reserve in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
AX_Rare_SwiftJinn.flavor: The quickest solution when you need extra firepower.

AX_Rare_Talos.name: Talos
AX_Rare_Talos.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  I'm <DEFENDER> #unless there are two or more cards in your Landmarks.#
AX_Rare_Talos.flavor: It was Talos's role to protect the statue from prying eyes.

AX_Rare_TeamMascot.name: Team Mascot
AX_Rare_TeamMascot.effect: {J} If there are #two or more# exhausted cards in Reserve, #up to two target Characters# each gain 1 boost.
AX_Rare_TeamMascot.flavor: She gets the substitutes fired up so they're ready to take the field.

AX_Rare_TeamworkTraining.name: Teamwork Training
AX_Rare_TeamworkTraining.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {X} or less, where X is the number of Characters you control.
AX_Rare_TeamworkTraining.flavor: Through their Hive Mind, Ordis turns the thoughts of the multitude into a unified will.

AX_Rare_TechLabUnit.name: Tech Lab Unit
AX_Rare_TechLabUnit.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  Your Reserve limit is increased by one.

AX_Rare_TechnicalBoots.name: Technical Boots
AX_Rare_TechnicalBoots.effect: #{R} $<RESUPPLY>.#  When my Expedition moves forward — Target Character in my Expedition loses <FLEETING_CHAR>.

AX_Rare_TechnologicalEncounter.name: Technological Encounter
AX_Rare_TechnologicalEncounter.effect: <COOLDOWN>.  Draw a card, then create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
AX_Rare_TechnologicalEncounter.flavor: "The fruit of our research will lead our peoples to new heights."

AX_Rare_TheConsortium.name: The Consortium
AX_Rare_TheConsortium.effect: #{T} : <RESUPPLY>. Then# you may target a Character in Reserve, it gains 2 boosts.
AX_Rare_TheConsortium.flavor: The epicenter of Reka research, focused on perpetual growth.

AX_Rare_TheConsulate.name: The Consulate
AX_Rare_TheConsulate.effect: {J} #<RESUPPLY>.#  {T} : Target an Expedition, then create one <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in it #per card in your Landmarks, up to three per activation.#
AX_Rare_TheConsulate.flavor: Here, far from the crowd, is where fruitful negotiations are held between Reka and Asgarthans.

AX_Rare_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.name: The Foundry, Axiom Bastion
AX_Rare_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.effect: #{J} Draw a card.#  {T} : The next Character you play from your hand this turn activates its {r} abilities (as if it had been played from Reserve).
AX_Rare_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.flavor: Embedded in the cliff wall, it overlooks the city and reminds everyone who looks up at it that nothing is unreachable if you put your mind to it.

AX_Rare_TheFrogPrince.name: The Frog Prince
AX_Rare_TheFrogPrince.support: #{D} : The next Permanent you play this turn costs {1} less.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
AX_Rare_TheFrogPrince.flavor: Thankfully, he doesn't seal his contracts with a kiss.

AX_Rare_TheGrems.name: The Grems
AX_Rare_TheGrems.effect: {R} Choose up to one:  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost #{5} or less.#  • Sacrifice a Permanent. If you do, create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
AX_Rare_TheGrems.flavor: It's not demolition, but basic recycling. Or so they say.

AX_Rare_TheLittleMatchGirl.name: The Little Match Girl
AX_Rare_TheLittleMatchGirl.effect: {R} If your hand is empty, draw a card. #If your Reserve is empty, draw a card.#
AX_Rare_TheLittleMatchGirl.flavor: When you're alone in the cold, even the tiniest light can feel like salvation.

AX_Rare_TheMachineintheIce.name: The Machine in the Ice
AX_Rare_TheMachineintheIce.effect: When I go to Reserve from anywhere — Exhaust me ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  {H} Send me to Reserve.
AX_Rare_TheMachineintheIce.flavor: A relic left by those who came before.

AX_Rare_TheNilamWitheredTree.name: The Nilam, Withered Tree
AX_Rare_TheNilamWitheredTree.effect: When you exhaust a card in Reserve — You may exhaust me ({T}) to create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.  {J} You may exhaust target card in Reserve.
AX_Rare_TheNilamWitheredTree.flavor: Long after it died, the Nilam still held life as the nesting grounds for the Mana Moths.

AX_Rare_TheOperaHouse.name: The Opera House
AX_Rare_TheOperaHouse.effect: {T} : Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Spell, draw it. #If it's a Permanent, put it in Reserve.# (Otherwise, leave it on top of your deck.)
AX_Rare_TheOperaHouse.flavor: The Arkaster Opera House is known as the Spark, for that's where stars are born.

AX_Rare_TheOuroborosLyraBastion.name: The Ouroboros, Lyra Bastion
AX_Rare_TheOuroborosLyraBastion.effect: #{J} <RESUPPLY>.#  If you would #<RESUPPLY_INF>, instead reveal the top two cards of your deck. Put one in Reserve, and discard the other.#
AX_Rare_TheOuroborosLyraBastion.flavor: The Expeditionary Corps' mobile outpost soars high, like a spinning wheel weaving the wind.

AX_Rare_TheRefinery.name: The Refinery
AX_Rare_TheRefinery.effect: When a card leaves your Reserve during the Afternoon — I gain 1 Sap counter.  {T}, Spend 3 of my Sap counters: #distribute 3 boosts among any Characters in Reserve#.
AX_Rare_TheRefinery.flavor: The use of Sap will alter the course of science as we know it.

AX_Rare_TheReunion.name: The Reunion
AX_Rare_TheReunion.effect: {T} : Choose up to the number of cards in your Landmarks:  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in a Companion Expedition.  • Create one in a Hero Expedition.  • Up to two target Characters gain 1 boost.  • #Draw a card.#
AX_Rare_TheReunion.flavor: "Two people separated by fate, now reunited once more! This reunion shall forever be carved in stone!"

AX_Rare_TheShell.name: The Shell
AX_Rare_TheShell.effect: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to draw a card.

AX_Rare_TheTortoise.name: The Tortoise
AX_Rare_TheTortoise.support: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (Discard me from Reserve to end your turn as if you had played a card.)
AX_Rare_TheTortoise.flavor: "I'll gladly give you the spot, there's no use getting in a stew."

AX_Rare_ThomasEdison.name: Thomas Edison
AX_Rare_ThomasEdison.effect: {J} You may discard #up to two# Characters from your Reserve. If you do, I activate #up to two# of their {r} abilities as if they were mine.
AX_Rare_ThomasEdison.flavor: "Thanks to MY new invention, the city is safe!"

AX_Rare_ThreeLittlePigs.name: Three Little Pigs
AX_Rare_ThreeLittlePigs.effect: {J} If you control two or more Landmarks, I gain #2 boosts$<BB>#. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
AX_Rare_ThreeLittlePigs.flavor: Together they can build more than just a stone house.

AX_Rare_TikTok.name: Tik-Tok
AX_Rare_TikTok.effect: {H} #Each player# exhausts ({T}) a Permanent they control or a card in their Reserve.

AX_Rare_TinkerBell.name: Tinker Bell
AX_Rare_TinkerBell.flavor: Ting! Ting-a-ling! There's something magical in mischievous tinkering...

AX_Rare_TotingArmadillo.name: Toting Armadillo
AX_Rare_TotingArmadillo.effect: {H} Pay {1} less for the next Permanent you play this Afternoon, down to a minimum of {1}.
AX_Rare_TotingArmadillo.flavor: Its shell has inspired the shields’ design.

AX_Rare_Undine.name: Undine
AX_Rare_Undine.support: {D} : The next Spell you play this turn loses <FLEETING>.
AX_Rare_Undine.flavor: When Yzmir alchemists call on the water spirit, the mischievous undine responds.

AX_Rare_VaikeEnergyPioneer.name: Vaike, Energy Pioneer
AX_Rare_VaikeEnergyPioneer.effect: You may play exhausted cards from your Reserve.  #{R} $<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.#
AX_Rare_VaikeEnergyPioneer.flavor: Energy and persistence conquer all things.

AX_Rare_Vishvakarma.name: Vishvakarma
AX_Rare_Vishvakarma.effect: {J} The next Permanent you play this Afternoon costs #{3} less#.
AX_Rare_Vishvakarma.flavor: Each construction is a poem, and building is an act of eloquence.

AX_Rare_WalrusScout.name: Walrus Scout
AX_Rare_WalrusScout.effect: #{R} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve.# (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

AX_Rare_WingedMonkey.name: Winged Monkey
AX_Rare_WingedMonkey.effect: {H} I gain 2 boosts, #then create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.#

AX_Rare_WingsuitJumper.name: Wingsuit Jumper
AX_Rare_WingsuitJumper.effect: {R} You may <RUSH> to draw a card. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
AX_Rare_WingsuitJumper.flavor: What's important is not the landing, but the fall.

AX_Rare_YzmirNurse.name: Yzmir Nurse
AX_Rare_YzmirNurse.effect: {H} You may sacrifice a #Robot# or #Permanent.# If you do, I gain 2 boosts.
AX_Rare_YzmirNurse.flavor: The Cloister's Nurses may be harsh, but they work wonders, according to those who survive.

AX_Rare_YzmirStargazer.name: Yzmir Stargazer
AX_Rare_YzmirStargazer.flavor: She won't read the future in the stars, she'll change it herself.

BR_Common_Achilles.name: Achilles
BR_Common_Achilles.flavor: "Many things lie between us—shadowy mountains and sounding sea."

BR_Common_Akhlut.name: Akhlut
BR_Common_Akhlut.effect: When I gain 1 or more boosts — You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  {R} I gain 1 boost.
BR_Common_Akhlut.flavor: They're deadly on land, and even deadlier in the water.

BR_Common_AltrunTeammate.name: Altrun Teammate
BR_Common_AltrunTeammate.effect: {J} You may <RUSH> to give me 1 boost. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
BR_Common_AltrunTeammate.flavor: Altrun is a running and obstacle-dodging discipline that comes in very handy on these islands.

BR_Common_Amarok.name: Amarok
BR_Common_Amarok.effect: If there are no Characters in the Expedition I'm played in, I cost {2} less.  When another Character joins my Expedition — Sacrifice it.
BR_Common_Amarok.flavor: The lone wolf guards its territory jealously.

BR_Common_AoifeFireAvatar.name: Aoife, Fire Avatar
BR_Common_AoifeFireAvatar.effect: $<SCOUT_2> {2}.  {J} You may have another target Character lose <FLEETING> and gain 1 boost.
BR_Common_AoifeFireAvatar.flavor: When the Firebird's spark ignites within you, that's when you become worthy of joining the Phoenixian Guard.

BR_Common_ArcolanoMilk.name: Arcolano Milk
BR_Common_ArcolanoMilk.effect: When a Character joins my Expedition — It gains 1 boost and <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
BR_Common_ArcolanoMilk.flavor: Nobody knows where this "milk" actually comes from.

BR_Common_Atlas.name: Atlas
BR_Common_Atlas.flavor: Not even the weight of the sky could make him buckle.

BR_Common_AtsadiSurge.name: Atsadi & Surge
BR_Common_AtsadiSurge.effect: I begin the game with five Heroism counters.  When you play a Character with Hand Cost greater than or equal to my number of Heroism counters — Draw a card and I gain a Heroism counter.
BR_Common_AtsadiSurge.flavor: Every challenge is a blessing that lets me rise even higher.

BR_Common_BasiraKaizaimon.name: Basira & Kaizaimon
BR_Common_BasiraKaizaimon.effect: When a Character you control gains 1 or more boosts — You may exhaust me ({T}) to have target Character gain 1 boost$<BB>.
BR_Common_BasiraKaizaimon.flavor: Only the worthy shall achieve true transcendence under my guidance.

BR_Common_Beowulf.name: Beowulf
BR_Common_Beowulf.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone — You may play a Character with Base Cost {2} or less for free. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
BR_Common_Beowulf.flavor: "Each of us must suffer death; let he who is able cover himself in glory (before the end)!" - Beowulf

BR_Common_BoldOutrider.name: Bold Outrider
BR_Common_BoldOutrider.flavor: "I've found a way! A gap just two klicks away, straight ahead!"

BR_Common_Booda.name: Booda
BR_Common_Booda.effect: (If I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)
BR_Common_Booda.flavor: A Hero can practice Alteration through their Companion, no matter the distance between them.

BR_Common_BravosBladedancer.name: Bravos Bladedancer
BR_Common_BravosBladedancer.flavor: "It seems Thoth has never seen me duel."

BR_Common_BravosCloudhog.name: Bravos Cloudhog
BR_Common_BravosCloudhog.effect: {R} <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a Character this way, I gain 1 boost.
BR_Common_BravosCloudhog.flavor: "Ladies and gentlemen, you are about to experience some turbulence."

BR_Common_BravosExcavator.name: Bravos Excavator
BR_Common_BravosExcavator.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone, for each of my boosts — Another target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost.
BR_Common_BravosExcavator.flavor: The depths of the city are filled with archaeological marvels... along with plenty of Sap!

BR_Common_BravosHarpooner.name: Bravos Harpooner
BR_Common_BravosHarpooner.effect: {H} You may <RUSH> to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Rush means playing another card immediately. If you do, discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)
BR_Common_BravosHarpooner.flavor: Without explosive charges, these harpoons wouldn't even make a dent in Halua's hide.

BR_Common_BravosLookout.name: Bravos Lookout
BR_Common_BravosLookout.flavor: "I think I've found a good spot!"

BR_Common_BravosPathfinder.name: Bravos Pathfinder
BR_Common_BravosPathfinder.flavor: "Stay on the path, they say. I make my own path!"

BR_Common_BravosPendekar.name: Bravos Pendekar
BR_Common_BravosPendekar.effect: At Night — If I have 2 or more boosts, $<SABOTAGE> after Rest.

BR_Common_BravosRescuer.name: Bravos Rescuer
BR_Common_BravosRescuer.support: {D} : Target Character loses <FLEETING>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Common_BravosRescuer.flavor: "Their ranks will be composed of seasoned argonauts, ready to face the perils of the unknown!"

BR_Common_BravosSignet.name: Bravos Signet
BR_Common_BravosSignet.effect: Choose one:  • Target Character gains 3 boosts.  • Return target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less to its owner's hand.  • Put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

BR_Common_BravosTracer.name: Bravos Tracer
BR_Common_BravosTracer.effect: {J} I gain <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If I would be sent to Reserve, discard me instead.)
BR_Common_BravosTracer.flavor: "I only feel alive when I hear the wind whistling in my ears."

BR_Common_BravosTrailblazer.name: Bravos Trailblazer
BR_Common_BravosTrailblazer.effect: {J} If you control a <FLEETING_CHAR> Character, I gain 1 boost.
BR_Common_BravosTrailblazer.flavor: "It will be a collective effort; it must be a joint endeavor!"

BR_Common_BravosVanguard.name: Bravos Vanguard
BR_Common_BravosVanguard.effect: {J} You may have another target Character lose <FLEETING_CHAR>.
BR_Common_BravosVanguard.flavor: "We will be the arrow that pierces the veil of the unknown, the torch that banishes the mists of ignorance!"

BR_Common_CarmelaFastStriker.name: Carmela, Fast Striker
BR_Common_CarmelaFastStriker.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless you control a Feat. (If I would be sent to Reserve, discard me instead.)
BR_Common_CarmelaFastStriker.flavor: "I only feel alive when I'm on the very edge!"

BR_Common_CatchoftheDay.name: Catch of the Day
BR_Common_CatchoftheDay.effect: Return target Character or Permanent controlled by another player to its owner's hand.  Then, create a <MANASEED> token in that player's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
BR_Common_CatchoftheDay.flavor: There's no slipping through the net this time.

BR_Common_Chiron.name: Chiron
BR_Common_Chiron.flavor: "And now, pray, mark all these things well in a wise heart."

BR_Common_CorruptedAoife.name: Corrupted Aoife
BR_Common_CorruptedAoife.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless you control a Feat.  {R} You may target another Character. It loses <FLEETING> and gains 1 boost.
BR_Common_CorruptedAoife.flavor: "Are you sure you want to add fuel to the fire?"

BR_Common_CuppaSap.name: Cuppa Sap
BR_Common_CuppaSap.effect: Target Character in Reserve gains 2 boosts.
BR_Common_CuppaSap.flavor: Sap beverages may not be everyone's cup of tea, but they sure perk you up!

BR_Common_DeepCloudInstructor.name: Deep-Cloud Instructor
BR_Common_DeepCloudInstructor.effect: {H} You may <RUSH> a Character. If played from your hand, it activates one of its {r} abilities. (Rush means playing it immediately.)  {R} I gain 2 boosts.
BR_Common_DeepCloudInstructor.flavor: Without this suit, diving into the Tumult would be a death sentence.

BR_Common_DepartedBrother.name: Departed Brother
BR_Common_DepartedBrother.effect: {R} You may pay {1} to draw a card.
BR_Common_DepartedBrother.flavor: "In my memory, you're there every time I cross paths with a Leviathan." — Sol

BR_Common_DevotedProtector.name: Devoted Protector
BR_Common_DevotedProtector.flavor: "Come on! If we give up, it's game over!" — Kebba

BR_Common_DuelofGrit.name: Duel of Grit
BR_Common_DuelofGrit.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost less than or equal to the Hand Cost of a Character you control.
BR_Common_DuelofGrit.flavor: Fiore was the first of the Seven Blades to clash with Atsadi.

BR_Common_EatMeEnergyBars.name: Eat Me Energy Bars
BR_Common_EatMeEnergyBars.effect: If there is only one Character in my Expedition, it is <GIGANTIC>. (It is considered present in each of your Expeditions.)

BR_Common_Eros.name: Eros
BR_Common_Eros.effect: {J} You may immediately play a Character for {3} less.
BR_Common_Eros.flavor: He's got more than one arrow in his quiver.

BR_Common_FireRabbit.name: Fire Rabbit
BR_Common_FireRabbit.effect: {H} You may have me gain <FLEETING_CHAR>. If you do, another target Character gains 1 boost.
BR_Common_FireRabbit.flavor: Hot bunny in your area wants to meet!

BR_Common_FlyingDockyard.name: Flying Dockyard
BR_Common_FlyingDockyard.effect: When you pass first — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
BR_Common_FlyingDockyard.flavor: "Cast off, and let the hunt begin!" - Sol

BR_Common_FlyingSquirrel.name: Flying Squirrel
BR_Common_FlyingSquirrel.flavor: The second big jump is where the fun really starts.

BR_Common_GalvanizetheTroops.name: Galvanize the Troops
BR_Common_GalvanizetheTroops.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>. Then, you may have target Character you control gain <FLEETING>.  When you pass — If you control two or more <FLEETING> Characters, complete me.
BR_Common_GalvanizetheTroops.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: At Noon — If you are first player, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
BR_Common_GalvanizetheTroops.flavor: "In the dead of night, we must shine the brightest!"

BR_Common_GerichtReveredDuelist.name: Gericht, Revered Duelist
BR_Common_GerichtReveredDuelist.effect: When I gain <FLEETING_CHAR> — I gain 1 boost.  I can gain <FLEETING_CHAR> even if I was already <FLEETING_CHAR>.
BR_Common_GerichtReveredDuelist.flavor: "What doesn't kill you makes you stronger."

BR_Common_Geyser.name: Geyser
BR_Common_Geyser.effect: Return target Character or Permanent to its owner's hand, then put me in your Mana Orbs (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

BR_Common_GretelRust.name: Gretel & Rust
BR_Common_GretelRust.effect: (Keep up to three cards in your Landmarks during Night.)  At Noon — If you control a Feat, create a Rust 0/0/0 token in your Companion Expedition.(It's a Companion with \"{j} I gain 1 boost per Completed Feat in your Landmarks\".)
BR_Common_GretelRust.flavor: "If you underestimate me, my victory will be all the sweeter."

BR_Common_GuidingOcelot.name: Guiding Ocelot
BR_Common_GuidingOcelot.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost.  When another Character joins your Expeditions — You may spend 1 of my boosts. If you do, it gains 1 boost.
BR_Common_GuidingOcelot.flavor: Who could be better at playing cat and mouse?

BR_Common_Halua.name: Halua
BR_Common_Halua.effect: If your Hero has 5 or more Quest counters, I am <GIGANTIC>. (A Gigantic Character is considered present in both Expeditions. When I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)
BR_Common_Halua.flavor: So close to the enemy that they become your friend...

BR_Common_HaluaRagingLeviathan.name: Halua, Raging Leviathan
BR_Common_HaluaRagingLeviathan.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  <TOUGH_1>. (Opponents must pay {1} to target me.)  At Dusk — Each Character gains <FLEETING>.

BR_Common_HavenBouncer.name: Haven Bouncer
BR_Common_HavenBouncer.flavor: Only the bravest can enter Haven.

BR_Common_HavenBravosBastion.name: Haven, Bravos Bastion
BR_Common_HavenBravosBastion.effect: Your Characters have: \" {R} I gain 1 boost$<BB>.\"
BR_Common_HavenBravosBastion.flavor: Haven isn't where legends are born... it's where they live forever.

BR_Common_HavenSeiringar.name: Haven Seiringar
BR_Common_HavenSeiringar.effect: When I leave the Expedition Zone, if I was <FLEETING_CHAR> — Draw a card.
BR_Common_HavenSeiringar.flavor: Those who have lived a lot have plenty to share.

BR_Common_HavenTrainee.name: Haven Trainee
BR_Common_HavenTrainee.flavor: "All right, lad, show me what you’ve learned."

BR_Common_HavenTrainer.name: Haven Trainer
BR_Common_HavenTrainer.effect: {H} You may <RUSH> (play another card immediately). If you would play a card from Reserve this way, you may pay its Hand Cost instead of its Reserve Cost.
BR_Common_HavenTrainer.flavor: "Yeah, you've still got a few things to learn…"

BR_Common_HavenWarrior.name: Haven Warrior
BR_Common_HavenWarrior.flavor: We've all lived through some things. But she's been through worse.

BR_Common_HelpfulDiver.name: Helpful Diver
BR_Common_HelpfulDiver.effect: {J} You may <RUSH>. If you don't, target opponent <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLIES>. (They put the top card of their deck in Reserve, then they exhaust it {T}. Rush means playing another card immediately.)

BR_Common_HelpingHand.name: Helping Hand
BR_Common_HelpingHand.effect: Target Character gains 1 boost$<BB> and loses <FLEETING_CHAR>.

BR_Common_Hestia.name: Hestia
BR_Common_Hestia.support: {I} When you play another Character — You may pay {1} to give it 1 boost.
BR_Common_Hestia.flavor: One offering for one serving of stew. House rules.

BR_Common_HuaMulan.name: Hua Mulan
BR_Common_HuaMulan.flavor: Her determination has yet to meet its match in this world.

BR_Common_IceboundPeak.name: Icebound Peak
BR_Common_IceboundPeak.effect: When a Character you control gains <FLEETING_CHAR> — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then each Character you control gains 1 boost.
BR_Common_IceboundPeak.flavor: On the summit it waits, for freedom, for release.

BR_Common_Intimidation.name: Intimidation
BR_Common_Intimidation.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Return target Character or Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or less to its owner's hand.
BR_Common_Intimidation.flavor: The terrible beast shrank and cowered before the might of the Bravos.

BR_Common_IsabelLetham.name: Isabel Letham
BR_Common_IsabelLetham.effect: {R} You may <RUSH> to <RESUPPLY_INF>. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
BR_Common_IsabelLetham.flavor: The lowest point of the wave is where she draws all her strength.

BR_Common_Issunboshi.name: Issun-bōshi
BR_Common_Issunboshi.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Common_Issunboshi.flavor: Small stature, big heart, immense adventures.

BR_Common_JumpingFrog.name: Jumping Frog
BR_Common_JumpingFrog.effect: When you pass first — I gain 1 boost.

BR_Common_JuniorChef.name: Junior Chef
BR_Common_JuniorChef.support: {I} When you play another Character — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.
BR_Common_JuniorChef.flavor: The Bravos are always the best with a blade, whether it's in a duel or in the kitchen.

BR_Common_KaibaraAsgarthanLeviathan.name: Kaibara, Asgarthan Leviathan
BR_Common_KaibaraAsgarthanLeviathan.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  $<TOUGH_X>, where X is the number of regions between your Hero and Companion. (If they are adjacent, X equals 0.)
BR_Common_KaibaraAsgarthanLeviathan.flavor: For hundreds of years, Kaibara has protected Asagartha.

BR_Common_Kappa.name: Kappa
BR_Common_Kappa.flavor: "Push through the pain. Giving up would hurt far more."

BR_Common_Kedarm.name: Kedarm
BR_Common_Kedarm.support: {D} : The next Character played from your hand this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.
BR_Common_Kedarm.flavor: One of the many amazing Chimaeras that inhabit the Sea of Tumult.

BR_Common_KojoBooda.name: Kojo & Booda
BR_Common_KojoBooda.effect: At Noon — if you are the first player, create a <BOODA> Companion token in your Companion Expedition.
BR_Common_KojoBooda.flavor: Faster, ever faster! Our fire rages highest when the race is afoot!

BR_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
BR_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

BR_Common_LernaeanHydra.name: Lernaean Hydra
BR_Common_LernaeanHydra.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost per Mana Orb in your Mana Zone.
BR_Common_LernaeanHydra.flavor: If you want to butt heads, it'll probably win...

BR_Common_LeviathanSpotter.name: Leviathan Spotter
BR_Common_LeviathanSpotter.effect: {R} You may reveal a Character with Hand Cost {4} or more from your hand. If you do, draw a card.
BR_Common_LeviathanSpotter.flavor: When the horn sounds, the hunters gather to track the Leviathan.

BR_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
BR_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less.

BR_Common_ManaChanneling.name: Mana Channeling
BR_Common_ManaChanneling.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
BR_Common_ManaChanneling.flavor: There's only one way to turn the tide: by becoming stronger.

BR_Common_ManaEruption.name: Mana Eruption
BR_Common_ManaEruption.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Discard one of your Mana Orbs. If you do, discard target Character or Permanent.
BR_Common_ManaEruption.flavor: Flames fly from his hand as he falls towards the monster, leaving a trail of glowing fire behind him...

BR_Common_ManaFlare.name: Mana Flare
BR_Common_ManaFlare.effect: <FLEETING>.  Immediately play a Character for {5} less. It gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
BR_Common_ManaFlare.flavor: He summons the mightiest beings just for the sake of an epic duel.

BR_Common_MarketEncounter.name: Market Encounter
BR_Common_MarketEncounter.effect: Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
BR_Common_MarketEncounter.support: {D} : The next Character played from your hand this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.
BR_Common_MarketEncounter.flavor: "Your catch of the day deserves a Manaseed!"

BR_Common_MightyJinn.name: Mighty Jinn
BR_Common_MightyJinn.effect: If I would leave the Expedition zone, you may put me in my owner's Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
BR_Common_MightyJinn.flavor: A single spark can start a wildfire.

BR_Common_Nephele.name: Nephele
BR_Common_Nephele.effect: {J} You may pass. If you don't, create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
BR_Common_Nephele.flavor: Even the brightest day of sunshine has its clouds.

BR_Common_ParliamentofAshes.name: Parliament of Ashes
BR_Common_ParliamentofAshes.effect: {J} $<RESUPPLY>.  Characters you control are <TOUGH_CHA_P_1>. (Opponents must pay {1} to target them.)
BR_Common_ParliamentofAshes.flavor: A place of eternal rest for the dead, and for Rune's Phoenix, the nest of its rebirth.

BR_Common_PastryChef.name: Pastry Chef
BR_Common_PastryChef.effect: {R} If I have 2 or more boosts, draw a card.
BR_Common_PastryChef.support: {I} When you play another Character — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.
BR_Common_PastryChef.flavor: Pioneers in more ways than one, the Bravos were the first to experiment with Sap in the culinary arts.

BR_Common_PhileasFogg.name: Phileas Fogg
BR_Common_PhileasFogg.effect: {R} You may immediately pass. (You end your Afternoon and don't take any more turns this Day.)
BR_Common_PhileasFogg.flavor: "The chance which now seems lost may present itself at the last moment." - Jules Verne

BR_Common_PhysicalTraining.name: Physical Training
BR_Common_PhysicalTraining.flavor: 100 crunches, 100 push-ups, 100 squats, a 10-km run and a desire to prove yourself. Just your typical morning of Bravos training.

BR_Common_PriyaBravosSignaler.name: Priya, Bravos Signaler
BR_Common_PriyaBravosSignaler.effect: When my Expedition moves forward — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
BR_Common_PriyaBravosSignaler.flavor: "The goal is simple: to draw out Halua!" - Sol

BR_Common_ProtecttheAssets.name: Protect the Assets
BR_Common_ProtecttheAssets.effect: {J} Up to one target Character loses <FLEETING>.  At Noon — If there are two or more cards in your Reserve, complete me.
BR_Common_ProtecttheAssets.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: Characters in your Reserve are <TOUGH_CHA_P_1>. (Opponents must pay {1} to target them.)
BR_Common_ProtecttheAssets.flavor: "If you want them, you'll have to go through me first!" — Kebba

BR_Common_Rage.name: Rage
BR_Common_Rage.effect: Target non-Fleeting Character gains 2 boosts and <FLEETING>. (If it would go to Reserve, it goes to discard instead.)
BR_Common_Rage.flavor: "If its fury does not wane, it will soon have a taste of my own!" - Sol

BR_Common_Raiju.name: Raijū
BR_Common_Raiju.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING>. (If I would be sent to Reserve, discard me instead.)
BR_Common_Raiju.flavor: It moves and strikes like lightning.

BR_Common_Ratatoskr.name: Ratatoskr
BR_Common_Ratatoskr.flavor: You’re nuts if you think you can keep up with this little one!

BR_Common_ReaptheMana.name: Reap the Mana
BR_Common_ReaptheMana.effect: {J} You may put a card from your Reserve in your Mana zone, exhausted.  When you pass — If there are twelve or more Mana Orbs in your Mana zone, complete me.
BR_Common_ReaptheMana.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: If one of your Expeditions would move forward during Dusk, you may exhaust me ({T}) to make it move forward one more region instead.
BR_Common_ReaptheMana.flavor: After Kojo, she's the second to have managed this feat.

BR_Common_RekaFisherman.name: Reka Fisherman
BR_Common_RekaFisherman.effect: {R} Create two <MANASEED> tokens in your Landmarks. (They are Permanents with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
BR_Common_RekaFisherman.flavor: "Haha, check it out, it's already stuffed!"

BR_Common_RekaFixer.name: Reka Fixer
BR_Common_RekaFixer.effect: {R} If you control a Feat, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)
BR_Common_RekaFixer.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.
BR_Common_RekaFixer.flavor: "It's not time to billet yet, but take the opportunity to stock up."

BR_Common_RekaPeddler.name: Reka Peddler
BR_Common_RekaPeddler.effect: {R} I lose <FLEETING>, then create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

BR_Common_RekaSkipper.name: Reka Skipper
BR_Common_RekaSkipper.effect: When my Expedition moves forward — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

BR_Common_RidersMask.name: Rider's Mask
BR_Common_RidersMask.effect: {T}, {1} : The next Character that joins my Expedition this turn gains 2 boosts. (Characters joining when you pass still join this turn.)
BR_Common_RidersMask.flavor: An essential accessory for any Leviathan rider.

BR_Common_Rust.name: Rust
BR_Common_Rust.effect: {j} I gain 1 boost per Completed Feat in your Landmarks.

BR_Common_Sekhmet.name: Sekhmet
BR_Common_Sekhmet.effect: {H} You may return target Character facing me with Base Cost {3} or less to its owner's hand. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)  {R} I gain 2 boosts.
BR_Common_Sekhmet.flavor: Now that's what you call taking the lion's share.

BR_Common_Shenlong.name: Shenlong
BR_Common_Shenlong.flavor: Be careful what you wish for. There are challenges that even the Bravos prefer to avoid.

BR_Common_Skadi.name: Skadi
BR_Common_Skadi.effect: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
BR_Common_Skadi.flavor: Life is a slope. It's slow going up, and quick going down.

BR_Common_SmolderingJinn.name: Smoldering Jinn
BR_Common_SmolderingJinn.effect: {R} Put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
BR_Common_SmolderingJinn.flavor: Fire is always smoldering in the idea of the ember.

BR_Common_SofiaFirstOutpost.name: Sofia, First Outpost
BR_Common_SofiaFirstOutpost.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  The Support abilities of cards in Reserve can give them 1 more counter than their maximum.("Up to a max. of X" restrictions become "up to a max of X+1".)

BR_Common_SolHalua.name: Sol & Halua
BR_Common_SolHalua.effect: When you pass first (stop taking turns before other players) — I gain 1 Quest counter. Then, if I have 3 or more Quest counters, create a <HALUA> token in your Companion Expedition. (It's a Leviathan Companion token with \"If your Hero has 5 or more Quest counters, I am Gigantic.\")
BR_Common_SolHalua.flavor: Hate is a spear pointed at one's own heart

BR_Common_SolsHunt.name: Sol's Hunt
BR_Common_SolsHunt.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send target Character to Reserve.  You may <RUSH> to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Rush means playing another card immediately. If you do, discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)
BR_Common_SolsHunt.flavor: "I'll stop it before it sows death far and wide!" - Sol

BR_Common_SpiritWielder.name: Spirit Wielder
BR_Common_SpiritWielder.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost per <BOOSTED> Character you control. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
BR_Common_SpiritWielder.flavor: Memories of a forgotten civilization linger in those ruins. We are not alone.

BR_Common_SpryScout.name: Spry Scout
BR_Common_SpryScout.effect: {R} If you control a Feat, I gain 1 boost.
BR_Common_SpryScout.flavor: "Contact in sector 3. Try to outflank on the other side!"

BR_Common_SternSentinel.name: Stern Sentinel
BR_Common_SternSentinel.effect: {H} <SABOTAGE> a card with Reserve Cost {2} or less. (You may discard one such card from any Reserve.)
BR_Common_SternSentinel.flavor: "Getting past me means going through hell—with no way back."

BR_Common_StigmaofCowardice.name: Stigma of Cowardice
BR_Common_StigmaofCowardice.effect: {J} Pass.  When an opponent passes — You may play a Character. (Paying its cost normally.)
BR_Common_StigmaofCowardice.flavor: Sometimes it's wiser to be afraid of your own shadow…

BR_Common_SunWukong.name: Sun Wukong
BR_Common_SunWukong.flavor: Ever the trickster, always the rebel.

BR_Common_SwiftJinn.name: Swift Jinn
BR_Common_SwiftJinn.effect: $<SCOUT_3> {3}.  {J} You may put a card from your Reserve in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
BR_Common_SwiftJinn.flavor: The quickest solution when you need extra firepower.

BR_Common_TalarianSkater.name: Talarian Skater
BR_Common_TalarianSkater.flavor: To explore the City, adventurers need daily deliveries from the surface.

BR_Common_TechnicalBoots.name: Technical Boots
BR_Common_TechnicalBoots.effect: When my Expedition moves forward — Target Character in my Expedition loses <FLEETING_CHAR>.

BR_Common_Tengu.name: Tengu
BR_Common_Tengu.flavor: "Calling the Tengu means submitting to anger and vanity, no?" - Basira

BR_Common_TheHare.name: The Hare
BR_Common_TheHare.effect: {H} If you are first player, target player becomes first player.

BR_Common_TheLastStand.name: The Last Stand
BR_Common_TheLastStand.effect: {J} Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less.  When you pass — If you control another Feat, complete me.
BR_Common_TheLastStand.flavor: "If we are to fall, let this be our last stand!"

BR_Common_TheMess.name: The Mess
BR_Common_TheMess.effect: When a Character leaves your Expeditions — I gain 1 Food counter.  {T}, Spend 3 of my Food counters: $<RESUPPLY_LOW>.
BR_Common_TheMess.flavor: Every evening, the Mess overflows with laughter and shouting as explorers share their daily exploits.

BR_Common_TheStew.name: The Stew
BR_Common_TheStew.effect: {J} Target Character gains 1 boost.  Characters in my Expedition are <SEASONED_CHA_P>. (They keep their boosts when they go to Reserve.)
BR_Common_TheStew.flavor: Can you guess the secret ingredient? It's seasoned with Sap.

BR_Common_Theseus.name: Theseus
BR_Common_Theseus.effect: $<SCOUT_3> {3}.  {J} Return target Character to its owner's hand.  {R} I gain 2 boosts.
BR_Common_Theseus.flavor: For the brave souls exploring the labyrinthine depths of the city, life often hangs by the thinnest of threads.

BR_Common_TinyJinn.name: Tiny Jinn
BR_Common_TinyJinn.effect: If I would leave the Expedition zone while I'm <BOOSTED>, put me in my owner's Mana zone instead (as an exhausted Mana Orb).  {R} I gain 1 boost.
BR_Common_TinyJinn.flavor: It may be a fire today — tomorrow it will be ashes.

BR_Common_TomoeGozen.name: Tomoe Gozen
BR_Common_TomoeGozen.effect: I can't be played if you have less than seven Mana Orbs.
BR_Common_TomoeGozen.flavor: For only the most gifted of Alterers could bring humanity's long-remembered legends to life.

BR_Common_WingsuitJumper.name: Wingsuit Jumper
BR_Common_WingsuitJumper.effect: {R} You may <RUSH> to draw a card. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
BR_Common_WingsuitJumper.flavor: What's important is not the landing, but the fall.

BR_Exalted_HoldtheLine.name: Hold the Line!
BR_Exalted_HoldtheLine.effect: {J} Target Character gains 2 boosts.  When you pass — If you control two or more <BOOSTED_CHA_P> Characters, complete me.
BR_Exalted_HoldtheLine.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When a Companion joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.

BR_Exalted_PlagueofArrogance.name: Plague of Arrogance
BR_Exalted_PlagueofArrogance.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  {J} Sacrifice a Feat to choose one, or sacrifice a <COMPLETED_LOW> Feat to choose two:  • <SABOTAGE>.  • Send target Character to Reserve.  • I gain 2 boosts.
BR_Exalted_PlagueofArrogance.flavor: The only thing more dangerous than ignorance is arrogance.

BR_Exalted_WanaxRekaHexarch.name: Wanax, Reka Hexarch
BR_Exalted_WanaxRekaHexarch.effect: Play me for {1} less per other card you played this turn.  {J} Pass. (Don't take any more turns this Day.)
BR_Exalted_WanaxRekaHexarch.flavor: "I'll show you how to work without a net!"

BR_Rare_Achilles.name: Achilles
BR_Rare_Achilles.flavor: "Many things lie between us—shadowy mountains and sounding sea."

BR_Rare_Aja.name: Aja
BR_Rare_Aja.effect: {H} Each player puts the top card of their deck in their Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
BR_Rare_Aja.flavor: She is the soul of the forest, the patron of herbal medicine. From herbs and roots, she mixes potent potions.

BR_Rare_Akhlut.name: Akhlut
BR_Rare_Akhlut.effect: When I gain 1 or more boosts — You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  #{J}# I gain 1 boost.
BR_Rare_Akhlut.flavor: They're deadly on land, and even deadlier in the water.

BR_Rare_AllIn.name: All In!
BR_Rare_AllIn.effect: Roll a die. Target Character gains X boosts, where X is the result.
BR_Rare_AllIn.flavor: There's a time to be cautious, and a time to bet it all!

BR_Rare_AltrunTeammate.name: Altrun Teammate
BR_Rare_AltrunTeammate.effect: {J} You may <RUSH> to give #target Character# 1 boost. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
BR_Rare_AltrunTeammate.flavor: Altrun is a running and obstacle-dodging discipline that comes in very handy on these islands.

BR_Rare_Amarok.name: Amarok
BR_Rare_Amarok.effect: If there are no Characters in the Expedition I'm played in, I cost {2} less.  When another Character joins my Expedition — Sacrifice it #and I gain 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_Amarok.flavor: The lone wolf guards its territory jealously.

BR_Rare_AoifeFireAvatar.name: Aoife, Fire Avatar
BR_Rare_AoifeFireAvatar.effect: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  {J} You may have another target Character lose <FLEETING> and gain 1 boost.
BR_Rare_AoifeFireAvatar.flavor: When the Firebird's spark ignites within you, that's when you become worthy of joining the Phoenixian Guard.

BR_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.name: Arcolano Milk
BR_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.effect: When a Character joins my Expedition — It gains #2 boosts# and <FLEETING_CHAR>.
BR_Rare_ArcolanoMilk.flavor: Nobody knows where this "milk" actually comes from.

BR_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.name: Aroro, Savior of Asgartha
BR_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.effect: {H} You may discard a #Character# from your Reserve. If you do, I gain #2 boosts#.
BR_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn costs {1} less.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.flavor: Alone, she was able to turn back the tide.

BR_Rare_Asmodeus.name: Asmodeus
BR_Rare_Asmodeus.effect: {J} Roll a die. On a 4+, I gain $<ANCHORED>. On a 1-3, I gain 3 boosts.

BR_Rare_Atlas.name: Atlas
BR_Rare_Atlas.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 2 boosts.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_Atlas.flavor: Not even the weight of the sky could make him buckle.

BR_Rare_AxiomSalvager.name: Axiom Salvager
BR_Rare_AxiomSalvager.flavor: The Axiom's limited resources pushed them to reuse whatever they could.

BR_Rare_BLISSFan.name: BLISS Fan
BR_Rare_BLISSFan.effect: When a Character in your Reserve gains 1 or more boosts — I gain 1 boost.
BR_Rare_BLISSFan.flavor: BLISS lets the fans who bring back the most Sap come up on stage with them.

BR_Rare_BaronCimetiere.name: Baron Cimetière
BR_Rare_BaronCimetiere.effect: #{J} If you control a <COMPLETED_LOW> Feat,# create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition. #Otherwise, I gain 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_BaronCimetiere.flavor: "Need someone to slam the gate in their faces?"

BR_Rare_Belasenka.name: Belasenka
BR_Rare_Belasenka.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. #Then, if there are two or more exhausted card in Reserve, I gain 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_Belasenka.flavor: The cold snap they ride, like a shivering tide.

BR_Rare_Benzaiten.name: Benzaiten
BR_Rare_Benzaiten.effect: {J} If my Expedition is behind, draw a card.
BR_Rare_Benzaiten.flavor: Good things come to those who wait.

BR_Rare_Beowulf.name: Beowulf
BR_Rare_Beowulf.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone — You may play a Character with #Base Cost {3} or less# for free. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
BR_Rare_Beowulf.flavor: "Each of us must suffer death; let he who is able cover himself in glory (before the end)!" - Beowulf

BR_Rare_BoldOutrider.name: Bold Outrider
BR_Rare_BoldOutrider.effect: #{J} You may immediately play a Feat for {1} less, down to a minimum of {1}.#
BR_Rare_BoldOutrider.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_BoldOutrider.flavor: "I've found a way! A gap just two klicks away, straight ahead!"

BR_Rare_BravosBladedancer.name: Bravos Bladedancer
BR_Rare_BravosBladedancer.effect: $<SEASONED_ME_FS>.  {J} I gain 1 boost.  #{R} If I have 4 boosts or less, I lose <FLEETING_CHAR>.#
BR_Rare_BravosBladedancer.flavor: "It seems Thoth has never seen me duel."

BR_Rare_BravosCloudhog.name: Bravos Cloudhog
BR_Rare_BravosCloudhog.effect: {R} <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a Character this way, I gain #2 boosts, otherwise I gain 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_BravosCloudhog.flavor: "Ladies and gentlemen, you are about to experience some turbulence."

BR_Rare_BravosExcavator.name: Bravos Excavator
BR_Rare_BravosExcavator.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone, for each of my boosts — Another target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost.
BR_Rare_BravosExcavator.support: #{I} When you play another Character — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.#
BR_Rare_BravosExcavator.flavor: The depths of the city are filled with archaeological marvels... along with plenty of Sap!

BR_Rare_BravosHarpooner.name: Bravos Harpooner
BR_Rare_BravosHarpooner.effect: #{J}# You may <RUSH> to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Rush means playing another card immediately. If you do, discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)
BR_Rare_BravosHarpooner.flavor: Without explosive charges, these harpoons wouldn't even make a dent in Halua's hide.

BR_Rare_BravosLookout.name: Bravos Lookout
BR_Rare_BravosLookout.support: #{D} : The next Character played from your hand this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.#
BR_Rare_BravosLookout.flavor: "I think I've found a good spot!"

BR_Rare_BravosPathfinder.name: Bravos Pathfinder
BR_Rare_BravosPathfinder.effect: #$<SEASONED_ME_FS>.#  #{H} You may pay {2} to have me gain 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_BravosPathfinder.flavor: "Stay on the path, they say. I make my own path!"

BR_Rare_BravosPendekar.name: Bravos Pendekar
BR_Rare_BravosPendekar.effect: #$<SEASONED>.#  At Night — If I have 2 or more boosts, <SABOTAGE> after Rest.

BR_Rare_BravosRescuer.name: Bravos Rescuer
BR_Rare_BravosRescuer.effect: #{J} You may target another <FLEETING_CHAR> Character. It gains 2 boosts.#
BR_Rare_BravosRescuer.support: {D} : Target Character loses <FLEETING>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_BravosRescuer.flavor: "Their ranks will be composed of seasoned argonauts, ready to face the perils of the unknown!"

BR_Rare_BravosSignet.name: Bravos Signet
BR_Rare_BravosSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Target Character gains 3 boosts.  • Return target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less to its owner's hand.  • Put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

BR_Rare_BravosTracer.name: Bravos Tracer
BR_Rare_BravosTracer.effect: {J} I gain <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If I would be sent to Reserve, discard me instead.)
BR_Rare_BravosTracer.flavor: "I only feel alive when I hear the wind whistling in my ears."

BR_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.name: Bravos Trailblazer
BR_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost #for each <FLEETING_CHAR> Character you control#.
BR_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.flavor: "It will be a collective effort; it must be a joint endeavor!"

BR_Rare_BravosVanguard.name: Bravos Vanguard
BR_Rare_BravosVanguard.effect: {J} You may have another target Character lose <FLEETING_CHAR> #and gain 1 boost#.
BR_Rare_BravosVanguard.flavor: "We will be the arrow that pierces the veil of the unknown, the torch that banishes the mists of ignorance!"

BR_Rare_BurrowingNoosh.name: Burrowing Noosh
BR_Rare_BurrowingNoosh.effect: #When an opponent draws one or more cards or <RESUPPLIES> — I gain 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_BurrowingNoosh.flavor: It takes years for roots to punch their way through the hardest stone, but for them it only takes a few hours.

BR_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.name: Carmela, Fast Striker
BR_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.effect: #{J}# If you control a #<COMPLETED_LOW># Feat, #I lose <FLEETING>.#
BR_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.support: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Feat you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}.#
BR_Rare_CarmelaFastStriker.flavor: "I only feel alive when I'm on the very edge!"

BR_Rare_CatchoftheDay.name: Catch of the Day
BR_Rare_CatchoftheDay.effect: Return target Character or Permanent controlled by another player to its owner's hand.  Then, create a <MANASEED> token in #your Landmarks.#
BR_Rare_CatchoftheDay.flavor: There's no slipping through the net this time.

BR_Rare_Chiron.name: Chiron
BR_Rare_Chiron.effect: {J} #Up to two target Characters# each gain 1 boost.
BR_Rare_Chiron.flavor: "And now, pray, mark all these things well in a wise heart."

BR_Rare_ColorfulCuckoo.name: Colorful Cuckoo
BR_Rare_ColorfulCuckoo.effect: {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — I gain 1 boost.  #When I go to your Reserve from the Expedition zone, if I had 2 or more boosts — You may put a card from your Reserve in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).#
BR_Rare_ColorfulCuckoo.flavor: Even the shyest become a bit less reserved when they hear its song.

BR_Rare_CorruptedAoife.name: Corrupted Aoife
BR_Rare_CorruptedAoife.effect: #I can't be played# unless you control a Feat.  {R} You may target another Character. It loses <FLEETING> and gains 1 boost.
BR_Rare_CorruptedAoife.flavor: "Are you sure you want to add fuel to the fire?"

BR_Rare_CorruptedToothFairy.name: Corrupted Tooth Fairy
BR_Rare_CorruptedToothFairy.effect: #I can't be played# unless six or more cards are in your discard pile.  {H} <SABOTAGE>.
BR_Rare_CorruptedToothFairy.flavor: Why muzzle the wolf when you can remove it's fangs ?

BR_Rare_CuddlyCorgi.name: Cuddly Corgi
BR_Rare_CuddlyCorgi.effect: When a Character you control gains #<FLEETING># — I gain 1 boost.
BR_Rare_CuddlyCorgi.flavor: She hunts mercilessly for treats and snuggles.

BR_Rare_CuppaSap.name: Cuppa Sap
BR_Rare_CuppaSap.effect: Target Character in Reserve gains #3 boosts.#
BR_Rare_CuppaSap.flavor: Sap beverages may not be everyone's cup of tea, but they sure perk you up!

BR_Rare_Daedalus.name: Daedalus
BR_Rare_Daedalus.effect: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  #{J}# Target another Character #in play# or in Reserve. Then, roll a die:  • On a 4+, we both gain 1 boost.  • On a 1-3, it gains 1 boost.
BR_Rare_Daedalus.flavor: No one is truly lost, for all are exactly where fate wants them to be.

BR_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.name: Deep-Cloud Instructor
BR_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.effect: #{J}# You may <RUSH> a Character. If played from your hand, it activates one of its {r} abilities.  {R} I gain #1 boost.#
BR_Rare_DeepCloudInstructor.flavor: Without this suit, diving into the Tumult would be a death sentence.

BR_Rare_DepartedBrother.name: Departed Brother
BR_Rare_DepartedBrother.effect: #When you pass first —# You may pay {1} to draw a card.
BR_Rare_DepartedBrother.flavor: "In my memory, you're there every time I cross paths with a Leviathan." — Sol

BR_Rare_DevotedProtector.name: Devoted Protector
BR_Rare_DevotedProtector.effect: #{R} If you control a Feat, I gain 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_DevotedProtector.flavor: "Come on! If we give up, it's game over!" — Kebba

BR_Rare_DioclesChariotRacer.name: Diocles, Chariot Racer
BR_Rare_DioclesChariotRacer.effect: #Pay {3} more# to play me in a starting region.  {J} My Expedition moves backwards one region.  When I leave the Expedition zone — My Expedition moves forward one region.
BR_Rare_DioclesChariotRacer.flavor: "Hop in, it's a guaranteed five-star experience!"

BR_Rare_DorothyGale.name: Dorothy Gale
BR_Rare_DorothyGale.effect: {H} You may send target Character to Reserve.
BR_Rare_DorothyGale.flavor: "I’ve a feeling we’re not in Kansas anymore."

BR_Rare_Dracaena.name: Dracaena
BR_Rare_Dracaena.effect: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  At Noon — I gain 1 boost.
BR_Rare_Dracaena.flavor: They're sometimes seen dozing close to a pond, soaking in the water and the sunlight...

BR_Rare_DuelofGrit.name: Duel of Grit
BR_Rare_DuelofGrit.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Discard# target Character with Hand Cost less than or equal to the Hand Cost of a Character you control.
BR_Rare_DuelofGrit.flavor: Fiore was the first of the Seven Blades to clash with Atsadi.

BR_Rare_EatMeEnergyBars.name: Eat Me Energy Bars
BR_Rare_EatMeEnergyBars.effect: #{J} I gain <FLEETING>.#  If there is only one Character in my Expedition, it is <GIGANTIC>. (It is considered present in each of your Expeditions.)

BR_Rare_EmergencyBurst.name: Emergency Burst
BR_Rare_EmergencyBurst.effect: <FLEETING>.  Play me for {1} less if there are no other cards in your hand.  #Discard# target Character #or Permanent# with Base Cost #{2} or less.#
BR_Rare_EmergencyBurst.flavor: If Aerolith can defy gravity, it can also deny evil!

BR_Rare_Encore.name: Encore
BR_Rare_Encore.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Target <FLEETING_CHAR> #or <BOOSTED># Character gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)

BR_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.name: Enhanced Prototype
BR_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.effect: {R} You may spend #1 counter# from #a card you control or in your Reserve# to ready two Mana Orbs.
BR_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.support: {I} #When you play another Character# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 3.
BR_Rare_EnhancedPrototype.flavor: It's no longer flawed, but there's still room for improvement.

BR_Rare_Eris.name: Eris
BR_Rare_Eris.effect: If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, roll a die. On a:  • 4+, it moves forward one more region instead.  #• 1, it doesn't move instead.#
BR_Rare_Eris.flavor: You win some, you lose some.

BR_Rare_Eros.name: Eros
BR_Rare_Eros.effect: {J} You may immediately play a Character for {3} less. #It gains 2 boosts.#
BR_Rare_Eros.flavor: He's got more than one arrow in his quiver.

BR_Rare_FabLabUnit.name: Fab Lab Unit
BR_Rare_FabLabUnit.effect: {T} : The next Character played from your hand in my Expedition this turn activates one of its {r} abilities.
BR_Rare_FabLabUnit.flavor: All the power of the Foundry distilled into this miracle of technology.

BR_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.name: Fiore dei Liberi
BR_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.effect: If I'm <BOOSTED>, I'm $<ETERNAL>.  {J} I gain 1 boost per other Character in my Expedition, then send them all to Reserve.  At Night — I lose 1 boost.
BR_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.flavor: "I am the sword, deadly against all weapons!" — Fiore

BR_Rare_FireRabbit.name: Fire Rabbit
BR_Rare_FireRabbit.effect: {H} You may have me gain <FLEETING_CHAR>. If you do, another target Character gains 1 boost.
BR_Rare_FireRabbit.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_FireRabbit.flavor: Hot bunny in your area wants to meet!

BR_Rare_FloralTent.name: Floral Tent
BR_Rare_FloralTent.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  If a #<BOOSTED> Character# would leave my Expedition during the Afternoon, #it loses all its boosts# instead.
BR_Rare_FloralTent.support: #{D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_FloralTent.flavor: A beautiful shelter from the raging elements outside.

BR_Rare_FlyingDockyard.name: Flying Dockyard
BR_Rare_FlyingDockyard.effect: When you pass first — #Target Character gains 1 boost,# then create an <AEROLITH> token in #target player's# Landmarks.
BR_Rare_FlyingDockyard.flavor: "Cast off, and let the hunt begin!" - Sol

BR_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.name: Flying Squirrel
BR_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.effect: {R} #If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 2 boosts,# otherwise I gain 1 boost. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
BR_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.flavor: The second big jump is where the fun really starts.

BR_Rare_FoundryArmorer.name: Foundry Armorer
BR_Rare_FoundryArmorer.effect: {R} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
BR_Rare_FoundryArmorer.flavor: No Brassbug would survive in the Tumult without armor.

BR_Rare_FrankensteinsCreature.name: Frankenstein's Creature
BR_Rare_FrankensteinsCreature.effect: {R} You may target #a Feat# you control. It activates its {j} abilities.
BR_Rare_FrankensteinsCreature.flavor: It's by shunning differences that true monsters are born.

BR_Rare_Freeze.name: Freeze
BR_Rare_Freeze.effect: $<COOLDOWN>.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}).

BR_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.name: Galvanize the Troops
BR_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>. Then, you may have target Character you control gain <FLEETING>.  When you pass — If you control two or more <FLEETING> Characters, complete me.
BR_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: At Noon — If you are first player, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. #Otherwise, target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.flavor: "In the dead of night, we must shine the brightest!"

BR_Rare_GatherthePack.name: Gather the Pack
BR_Rare_GatherthePack.effect: {J} Target Character with Base Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.  When you pass — If three or more #Characters# in your Expeditions have a different Base Cost, complete me.
BR_Rare_GatherthePack.flavor: A wolf's strength is in its pack.

BR_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.name: Gericht, Revered Duelist
BR_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.effect: #If I would gain <FLEETING_CHAR>, I gain 1 boost instead#.
BR_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.flavor: "What doesn't kill you makes you stronger."

BR_Rare_Geyser.name: Geyser
BR_Rare_Geyser.effect: Return target Character or Permanent to its owner's hand, then #you may# put me in your Mana Orbs (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

BR_Rare_GuidingOcelot.name: Guiding Ocelot
BR_Rare_GuidingOcelot.effect: {J} I gain #2 boosts.#  When another Character joins your Expeditions — You may spend 1 boost #from a Character you control# to give it 1 boost.
BR_Rare_GuidingOcelot.flavor: Who could be better at playing cat and mouse?

BR_Rare_HavenBouncer.name: Haven Bouncer
BR_Rare_HavenBouncer.flavor: Only the bravest can enter Haven.

BR_Rare_HavenBravosBastion.name: Haven, Bravos Bastion
BR_Rare_HavenBravosBastion.effect: #{J} $<RESUPPLY>.#  Your Characters have: \" {R} I gain 1 boost.\"
BR_Rare_HavenBravosBastion.flavor: Haven isn't where legends are born... it's where they live forever.

BR_Rare_HavenSeiringar.name: Haven Seiringar
BR_Rare_HavenSeiringar.effect: When I leave the Expedition Zone, if I was <FLEETING_CHAR> — Draw a card.  #{R} I gain 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_HavenSeiringar.flavor: Those who have lived a lot have plenty to share.

BR_Rare_HavenTrainee.name: Haven Trainee
BR_Rare_HavenTrainee.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_HavenTrainee.flavor: "All right, lad, show me what you’ve learned."

BR_Rare_HavenTrainer.name: Haven Trainer
BR_Rare_HavenTrainer.effect: #{J}# You may <RUSH>. If you would play a card from Reserve this way, you may pay its Hand Cost instead of its Reserve Cost.
BR_Rare_HavenTrainer.flavor: "Yeah, you've still got a few things to learn…"

BR_Rare_HavenWarrior.name: Haven Warrior
BR_Rare_HavenWarrior.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_HavenWarrior.flavor: We've all lived through some things. But she's been through worse.

BR_Rare_HelpfulDiver.name: Helpful Diver
BR_Rare_HelpfulDiver.effect: {J} You may <RUSH>. If you don't, target opponent <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLIES>. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)

BR_Rare_HelpingHand.name: Helping Hand
BR_Rare_HelpingHand.effect: #$<FLEETING>.#  Target Character gains #2 boosts# and loses <FLEETING_CHAR>.

BR_Rare_HerdingPuli.name: Herding Puli
BR_Rare_HerdingPuli.effect: {J} Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in the Expedition facing me. It gains #<ASLEEP>.#
BR_Rare_HerdingPuli.flavor: "Come on, Bobble, watch over them. Bring them to daddy!"

BR_Rare_Hesperide.name: Hesperide
BR_Rare_Hesperide.effect: {H} You may return target Permanent to its owner's hand. #If you do, create a <MANASEED> token in its controller's Landmarks.#
BR_Rare_Hesperide.flavor: "No matter what they say, the Naos is suffering, just like the Nilam before it!"

BR_Rare_Hestia.name: Hestia
BR_Rare_Hestia.support: {I} When you play another Character — You may pay {1} to give it 1 boost.
BR_Rare_Hestia.flavor: One offering for one serving of stew. House rules.

BR_Rare_HuaMulan.name: Hua Mulan
BR_Rare_HuaMulan.flavor: Her determination has yet to meet its match in this world.

BR_Rare_IceboundPeak.name: Icebound Peak
BR_Rare_IceboundPeak.effect: When a Character you control gains <FLEETING_CHAR> — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then each Character you control gains 1 boost.
BR_Rare_IceboundPeak.flavor: On the summit it waits, for freedom, for release.

BR_Rare_InariSpiritofIndustry.name: Inari, Spirit of Industry
BR_Rare_InariSpiritofIndustry.effect: When you pass — If your hand is empty, draw a card. #Otherwise, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.#
BR_Rare_InariSpiritofIndustry.flavor: Everything contains a need to grow, be it a grain of rice or human being.

BR_Rare_Intimidation.name: Intimidation
BR_Rare_Intimidation.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Return target Character or Permanent with Hand Cost #{5} or less# to its owner's hand.
BR_Rare_Intimidation.flavor: The terrible beast shrank and cowered before the might of the Bravos.

BR_Rare_IraFairAttendee.name: Ira, Fair Attendee
BR_Rare_IraFairAttendee.effect: #{R} Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.#
BR_Rare_IraFairAttendee.flavor: "One day, son, you'll show off your own creations here." — Della

BR_Rare_IsabelLetham.name: Isabel Letham
BR_Rare_IsabelLetham.flavor: The lowest point of the wave is where she draws all her strength.

BR_Rare_Issunboshi.name: Issun-bōshi
BR_Rare_Issunboshi.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_Issunboshi.flavor: Small stature, big heart, immense adventures.

BR_Rare_JoiningFates.name: Joining Fates
BR_Rare_JoiningFates.effect: <FLEETING>.  You may immediately play a Character for {7} less in your Companion Expedition. It gains <ANCHORED>.

BR_Rare_JumpingFrog.name: Jumping Frog
