BR_Rare_SuhaQorganOperative.name: Suha, Qorgan Operative
BR_Rare_SuhaQorganOperative.effect: {H} I gain #2 boosts.#  #When I go to Reserve from the Expedition zone — <SABOTAGE>.#
BR_Rare_SuhaQorganOperative.flavor: By accepting the Qorgan's offer, Suha got to see what was down the rabbit hole.

BR_Rare_SunWukong.name: Sun Wukong
BR_Rare_SunWukong.flavor: Ever the trickster, always the rebel.

BR_Rare_Sustenance.name: Sustenance
BR_Rare_Sustenance.effect: <FLEETING>.  Draw a card.  Each player puts the top card of their deck in their Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
BR_Rare_Sustenance.flavor: Anything goes when there are empty bellies to be filled.

BR_Rare_SwiftJinn.name: Swift Jinn
BR_Rare_SwiftJinn.effect: $<SCOUT_3> {3}.  {J} You may put a card from your Reserve in your Mana zone as a #ready# Mana Orb.
BR_Rare_SwiftJinn.flavor: The quickest solution when you need extra firepower.

BR_Rare_TalarianSkater.name: Talarian Skater
BR_Rare_TalarianSkater.effect: $<SCOUT_1> {1}.  {J} Target Character in play #or in Reserve# gains 1 boost.
BR_Rare_TalarianSkater.flavor: To explore the City, adventurers need daily deliveries from the surface.

BR_Rare_Tane.name: Tāne
BR_Rare_Tane.effect: #<TOUGH_1>.# (Opponents must pay {1} to target me.)  {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  {J} Each Animal #and Adventurer# in your Reserve gains 1 boost.
BR_Rare_Tane.flavor: Firmly rooted like a tree, yet free like the birds, he embodies nature's strength.

BR_Rare_TechnicalBoots.name: Technical Boots
BR_Rare_TechnicalBoots.effect: #{R} $<RESUPPLY>.#  When my Expedition moves forward — Target Character in my Expedition loses <FLEETING_CHAR>.

BR_Rare_Tengu.name: Tengu
BR_Rare_Tengu.effect: #{J} You may <RUSH>. If you do, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.# (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
BR_Rare_Tengu.flavor: "Calling the Tengu means submitting to anger and vanity, no?" - Basira

BR_Rare_TheCouncil.name: The Council
BR_Rare_TheCouncil.effect: The {j}, {h} and {r} abilities of Characters facing me can't activate.
BR_Rare_TheCouncil.flavor: The idea of facing the Council is deterrent enough for most would-be criminals in Asgartha.

BR_Rare_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.name: The Foundry, Axiom Bastion
BR_Rare_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.effect: {T} : The next Character you play from your hand this turn activates its {r} abilities (as if it had been played from Reserve).
BR_Rare_TheFoundryAxiomBastion.flavor: Embedded in the cliff wall, it overlooks the city and reminds everyone who looks up at it that nothing is unreachable if you put your mind to it.

BR_Rare_TheGrems.name: The Grems
BR_Rare_TheGrems.effect: {R} Choose up to one:  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.  • Sacrifice a Permanent. If you do, create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
BR_Rare_TheGrems.flavor: It's not demolition, but basic recycling. Or so they say.

BR_Rare_TheHare.name: The Hare
BR_Rare_TheHare.effect: {H} If you are first player, target player becomes first player.

BR_Rare_TheHatter.name: The Hatter
BR_Rare_TheHatter.support: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_TheHatter.flavor: "You can draw water out of a water-well, so I should think you could draw treacle out of a treacle-well — eh, stupid ?"

BR_Rare_TheHunger.name: The Hunger
BR_Rare_TheHunger.effect: {H} Discard all other cards in play or in Reserve.  When a card goes to the discard pile — I gain 1 boost.  #If I'm <FLEETING>, I am <GIGANTIC>.#
BR_Rare_TheHunger.flavor: The City has a soul, and it is famished.

BR_Rare_TheLastStand.name: The Last Stand
BR_Rare_TheLastStand.effect: {J} Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less.#  When you pass — If you control another Feat, complete me.
BR_Rare_TheLastStand.flavor: "If we are to fall, let this be our last stand!"

BR_Rare_TheLittleMatchGirl.name: The Little Match Girl
BR_Rare_TheLittleMatchGirl.effect: {R} If your hand is empty, draw a card.
BR_Rare_TheLittleMatchGirl.flavor: When you're alone in the cold, even the tiniest light can feel like salvation.

BR_Rare_TheMagicSleigh.name: The Magic Sleigh
BR_Rare_TheMagicSleigh.effect: #{J} I gain <FLEETING_CHAR>.#  If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, it moves twice instead.

BR_Rare_TheMess.name: The Mess
BR_Rare_TheMess.effect: When a #non-token# Character leaves your Expeditions — I gain 1 Food counter.  {T}, #Spend 4# of my Food counters: #draw a card.#
BR_Rare_TheMess.flavor: Every evening, the Mess overflows with laughter and shouting as explorers share their daily exploits.

BR_Rare_ThePainthouse.name: The Painthouse
BR_Rare_ThePainthouse.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  At Noon — If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, you may give 1 boost to target Character in Reserve.
BR_Rare_ThePainthouse.flavor: The paints of the Tisdhera still perfume the heights of the Wayfarer.

BR_Rare_TheShell.name: The Shell
BR_Rare_TheShell.effect: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to draw a card.

BR_Rare_TheSnowman.name: The Snowman
BR_Rare_TheSnowman.support: #{D} : <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_TheSnowman.flavor: Which will melt first: him, or your heart?

BR_Rare_TheSpindleMunaBastion.name: The Spindle, Muna Bastion
BR_Rare_TheSpindleMunaBastion.effect: Characters you control have $<TOUGH_2>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
BR_Rare_TheSpindleMunaBastion.flavor: Within the Spindle's trunk is the Bark Refuge, the sanctuary where the Muna converse with sentient plants.

BR_Rare_TheStew.name: The Stew
BR_Rare_TheStew.effect: {J}# You may pay {1}# to have target Character gain 1 boost #or lose <FLEETING>.#  Characters in my Expedition are <SEASONED_CHA_P>. (They keep their boosts when they go to Reserve.)
BR_Rare_TheStew.flavor: Can you guess the secret ingredient? It's seasoned with Sap.

BR_Rare_Theseus.name: Theseus
BR_Rare_Theseus.effect: #$<SCOUT_4> {4}.#  {J} Send target Character #to Reserve.#  {R} I gain #3 boosts.#
BR_Rare_Theseus.flavor: For the brave souls exploring the labyrinthine depths of the city, life often hangs by the thinnest of threads.

BR_Rare_ThomasEdison.name: Thomas Edison
BR_Rare_ThomasEdison.effect: {J} You may discard #up to two# Characters from your Reserve. If you do, I activate #up to two# of their {r} abilities as if they were mine.
BR_Rare_ThomasEdison.flavor: "Thanks to MY new invention, the city is safe!"

BR_Rare_ThreeLittlePigs.name: Three Little Pigs
BR_Rare_ThreeLittlePigs.effect: {J} If you control #one or more# Landmarks, I gain 1 boost.
BR_Rare_ThreeLittlePigs.flavor: Together they can build more than just a stone house.

BR_Rare_TimeOut.name: Time Out!
BR_Rare_TimeOut.effect: Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {4} or less, then exhaust it ({T}). (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)  Then, I gain <FLEETING> #unless there are two or more exhausted cards in Reserve.#
BR_Rare_TimeOut.flavor: Time to switch things up a bit.

BR_Rare_TinyJail.name: Tiny Jail
BR_Rare_TinyJail.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with no statistic over 3.

BR_Rare_TinyJinn.name: Tiny Jinn
BR_Rare_TinyJinn.effect: If I would leave the Expedition zone while I'm <BOOSTED>, put me in my owner's Mana zone instead (as an exhausted Mana Orb).  {R} I gain 1 boost.
BR_Rare_TinyJinn.flavor: It may be a fire today — tomorrow it will be ashes.

BR_Rare_TomoeGozen.name: Tomoe Gozen
BR_Rare_TomoeGozen.effect: I can't be played if you have less than #six Mana Orbs#.
BR_Rare_TomoeGozen.flavor: For only the most gifted of Alterers could bring humanity's long-remembered legends to life.

BR_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.name: Twinkle Twinkle
BR_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.effect: Target Character gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
BR_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.support: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
BR_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.flavor: Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky.

BR_Rare_Valemon.name: Valemon
BR_Rare_Valemon.effect: Unless you have eight or more Mana Orbs, I am $<DEFENDER>.  #If you have ten or more Mana Orbs, I am $<GIGANTIC>.#
BR_Rare_Valemon.flavor: Promise me to wait, and I will show you my real face.

BR_Rare_WildlifeMedic.name: Wildlife Medic
BR_Rare_WildlifeMedic.effect: {H} <RESUPPLY>. If you put #a Character# in Reserve this way, it gains 1 boost.
BR_Rare_WildlifeMedic.flavor: Basira’s husband has been called back to treat the wounded animals.

BR_Rare_WingsuitJumper.name: Wingsuit Jumper
BR_Rare_WingsuitJumper.effect: #{H}# You may <RUSH> to draw a card. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
BR_Rare_WingsuitJumper.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.#
BR_Rare_WingsuitJumper.flavor: What's important is not the landing, but the fall.

BR_Rare_WoollyWoollyField.name: Woolly Woolly Field
BR_Rare_WoollyWoollyField.effect: {T} : Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target opponent's Companion Expedition. The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.

BR_Rare_YannaQorganAgent.name: Yanna, Qorgan Agent
BR_Rare_YannaQorganAgent.effect: {J} You may have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. #If it's facing me, <SABOTAGE>.#
BR_Rare_YannaQorganAgent.flavor: Spies from the Qorgan infiltrate the Factions and steal their secrets.

BR_Rare_Yeti.name: Yeti
BR_Rare_Yeti.effect: {H} #You may have me# gain $<ASLEEP>.  When another Character joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.

BR_Rare_YzmirSignet.name: Yzmir Signet
BR_Rare_YzmirSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.  • <SABOTAGE>.  • Draw a card.

LY_Common_ACappellaTraining.name: A Cappella Training
LY_Common_ACappellaTraining.effect: Target Character gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
LY_Common_ACappellaTraining.flavor: Thank you for being my metronome!

LY_Common_AllIn.name: All In!
LY_Common_AllIn.effect: Roll a die. Target Character gains X boosts$<BB>, where X is the result.
LY_Common_AllIn.flavor: There's a time to be cautious, and a time to bet it all!

LY_Common_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.name: Amahle, Asgarthan Outcast
LY_Common_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.effect: {J} You may discard a card from your Reserve to draw a card.
LY_Common_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.flavor: The old world is dying, and the new world struggles to be born: now is the time of monsters.

LY_Common_Anansi.name: Anansi
LY_Common_Anansi.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost$<BB> for each card in your Reserve.
LY_Common_Anansi.flavor: In the end, he had accumulated pretty well all the wisdom that was available. He put it in a gourd and made a stopper for it.

LY_Common_Asmodeus.name: Asmodeus
LY_Common_Asmodeus.effect: {J} Roll a die. On a 4+, I gain $<ANCHORED>. On a 1-3, I gain 3 boosts$<BB>.

LY_Common_AuraqKibble.name: Auraq & Kibble
LY_Common_AuraqKibble.effect: When you play a Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain a Performance counter.  At Noon — You may spend five of my Performance counters to reveal the top card of your deck. You may play it for free or put it into your hand. (Don't activate any {h} abilities.)
LY_Common_AuraqKibble.flavor: True beauty lies outside of the conventional.

LY_Common_BLISSBassist.name: BLISS Bassist
LY_Common_BLISSBassist.support: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
LY_Common_BLISSBassist.flavor: "This one's for all the explorers out there and all the hard work they do. They're not just monkeyin' around!" — Boona

LY_Common_BLISSDrummer.name: BLISS Drummer
LY_Common_BLISSDrummer.effect: If I'm <BOOSTED>, other Characters cost {1} less to play from your Reserve, with a minimum of {1}.
LY_Common_BLISSDrummer.support: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
LY_Common_BLISSDrummer.flavor: "Throw your hands up in the air for everyone who's hauling out those amazing relics from the City of Scholars!" — Tamati

LY_Common_BLISSFan.name: BLISS Fan
LY_Common_BLISSFan.effect: When a Character in your Reserve gains 1 or more boosts — I gain 1 boost.
LY_Common_BLISSFan.flavor: BLISS lets the fans who bring back the most Sap come up on stage with them.

LY_Common_BLISSKeytarist.name: BLISS Keytarist
LY_Common_BLISSKeytarist.effect: At Dusk — If I'm <BOOSTED>, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Character with a base statistic of 0, draw it. Otherwise, discard it.
LY_Common_BLISSKeytarist.support: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
LY_Common_BLISSKeytarist.flavor: "Make some noise for all the brave folks pulling Sap up from the depths!" — Orbec

LY_Common_Bastet.name: Bastet
LY_Common_Bastet.effect: (An Anchored Character doesn't go to Reserve during Rest and loses Anchored.)
LY_Common_Bastet.support: {D} : The next Character with Base Cost {3} or less you play this turn gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Common_BestowingSloth.name: Bestowing Sloth
LY_Common_BestowingSloth.support: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (End your turn as if you had played a card.)
LY_Common_BestowingSloth.flavor: "I'm not lazy, I'm just conserving energy."

LY_Common_BreaktheIce.name: Break the Ice
LY_Common_BreaktheIce.effect: <FLEETING>.  I cost {2} less if you have three or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

LY_Common_CableCarStation.name: Cable-Car Station
LY_Common_CableCarStation.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>, then I gain 2 Move counters.  {T}, Spend 1 of my Move counters: One of your Expeditions moves backwards one region. If it does, your other Expedition moves forward one region.
LY_Common_CableCarStation.flavor: Reka cable-cars are the safest way to get around the city.

LY_Common_Carbunclo.name: Carbunclo
LY_Common_Carbunclo.effect: {H} If a card in your Expeditions or your Reserve has a {D} ability, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)
LY_Common_Carbunclo.flavor: Is that a ruby on its forehead or a burning lump of coal ?

LY_Common_CatsCradle.name: Cat's Cradle
LY_Common_CatsCradle.effect: Target Character with Base Cost {3} or less switches Expeditions, then gains <ANCHORED>. (Switch means joining the other Expedition of its controller.)
LY_Common_CatsCradle.flavor: "Time to let the cat out of the bag!"

LY_Common_CheshireCat.name: Cheshire Cat
LY_Common_CheshireCat.effect: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may have target Character switch Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition. I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Common_Cleanse.name: Cleanse
LY_Common_Cleanse.effect: <FLEETING>.  Roll a die. You may send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {X} or less, where X is the result. (Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)
LY_Common_Cleanse.flavor: "What do you think of my smoldering eyes?"

LY_Common_ClothCocoon.name: Cloth Cocoon
LY_Common_ClothCocoon.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Discard target <FLEETING_CHAR>, <ANCHORED> or <ASLEEP> Character.  • Discard target Permanent.

LY_Common_CorruptedEsmeralda.name: Corrupted Esmeralda
LY_Common_CorruptedEsmeralda.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless a {D} ability was activated this turn.  {H} <RESUPPLY>.
LY_Common_CorruptedEsmeralda.flavor: \"Are you sure you want to follow me into hell, Fen ?\"

LY_Common_Daedalus.name: Daedalus
LY_Common_Daedalus.effect: {H} Target a Character in Reserve. Then, roll a die:  • On a 4+, we both gain 1 boost.  • On a 1-3, it gains 1 boost.
LY_Common_Daedalus.flavor: No one is truly lost, for all are exactly where fate wants them to be.

LY_Common_Daikokuten.name: Daikokuten
LY_Common_Daikokuten.effect: {J} Target opponent may immediately play a Spell for free.
LY_Common_Daikokuten.flavor: If you never take a risk, you'll never be rewarded.

LY_Common_DioclesChariotRacer.name: Diocles, Chariot Racer
LY_Common_DioclesChariotRacer.effect: I can't be played in a starting region.  {J} My Expedition moves backwards one region.  When I leave the Expedition zone — My Expedition moves forward one region.
LY_Common_DioclesChariotRacer.flavor: "Hop in, it's a guaranteed five-star experience!"

LY_Common_DonJuan.name: Don Juan
LY_Common_DonJuan.effect: If I would go to Reserve from the Expedition zone, I gain <FLEETING> and defect instead. (I join the Expedition facing me, changing controllers. If I would go to any personal zone, I go to my owner's instead.)

LY_Common_EfrenPuppetMaster.name: Efrén, Puppet Master
LY_Common_EfrenPuppetMaster.effect: {H} Roll a die:  • On a 4+, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)  • On a 1-3, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)
LY_Common_EfrenPuppetMaster.flavor: "I could never let the winding threads of fate separate me from my daughter." — Efrén

LY_Common_Encore.name: Encore
LY_Common_Encore.effect: Target <FLEETING_CHAR> Character gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)

LY_Common_Eris.name: Eris
LY_Common_Eris.effect: If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, roll a die. On a 4+: it moves forward one more region instead.
LY_Common_Eris.flavor: You win some, you lose some.

LY_Common_Esmeralda.name: Esmeralda
LY_Common_Esmeralda.flavor: Eidolon or not, you are our Shepherdess. You lead and we follow.

LY_Common_FenCrowbar.name: Fen & Crowbar
LY_Common_FenCrowbar.effect: During Morning, draw only one card. Then, put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone instead of a card from your hand.  At Noon — $<RESUPPLY>.  Ignore my abilities during the first Day.
LY_Common_FenCrowbar.flavor: When you listen to the voice of the Wind, it always carries you where you're meant to be.

LY_Common_ForestNymph.name: Forest Nymph
LY_Common_ForestNymph.effect: {H} If I'm facing an Expedition in {V}, you may have target Character gain <FLEETING>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
LY_Common_ForestNymph.flavor: From an innocent seed, she creates wild forests.

LY_Common_FragrantMeerkat.name: Fragrant Meerkat
LY_Common_FragrantMeerkat.flavor: Do you smell a rat ? Nope, that's just me!

LY_Common_Hathor.name: Hathor
LY_Common_Hathor.support: {D} : Return another card from your Reserve to your hand. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_Hathor.flavor: Dance is the language of the soul.

LY_Common_Heimdall.name: Heimdall
LY_Common_Heimdall.effect: {H} You may have target Character switch Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)
LY_Common_Heimdall.flavor: Proud guardian of the Bifröst, he decides who gets to switch sides.

LY_Common_HostelNightkeeper.name: Hostel Nightkeeper
LY_Common_HostelNightkeeper.effect: {H} You may target a Character. If you do, it gains <ASLEEP>, then create a <MANASEED> token in its controller's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
LY_Common_HostelNightkeeper.flavor: "Floor -2, room 217. Welcome to the Underlook Hostel."

LY_Common_IceboundTundra.name: Icebound Tundra
LY_Common_IceboundTundra.effect: When you play a Character in a region type where its base statistic is 0 — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then return a card from your Reserve to your hand.
LY_Common_IceboundTundra.flavor: We can hear it, echoing in the vast expanses.

LY_Common_Joyride.name: Joyride
LY_Common_Joyride.effect: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Discard another card from your Reserve. If you do, target Character gains 2 boosts.
LY_Common_Joyride.flavor: Everything fun is life is either forbidden or completely crazy.

LY_Common_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.name: Koi, Playful Leviathan
LY_Common_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.flavor: Its gracious leap parted the clouds, revealing our path forward.

LY_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
LY_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

LY_Common_Lakshmi.name: Lakshmi
LY_Common_Lakshmi.effect: When you roll one or more dice — I gain 1 boost.
LY_Common_Lakshmi.flavor: Fortune smiles on those who give themselves over to it.

LY_Common_LakshmisOwl.name: Lakshmi's Owl
LY_Common_LakshmisOwl.effect: When you roll one or more dice — If I have no boosts, you may give me 1 boost and <FLEETING_CHAR> .
LY_Common_LakshmisOwl.flavor: Even in the blackest night, I can see light.

LY_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
LY_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less.

LY_Common_Loki.name: Loki
LY_Common_Loki.effect: {H} Each player discards their hand, then draws three cards.

LY_Common_LostintheRiptide.name: Lost in the Riptide
LY_Common_LostintheRiptide.effect: $<FLEETING>.  You may play me for {1} less. If you do, I can only target a Character in {O}.  Return target Character to the top of its owner's deck.
LY_Common_LostintheRiptide.flavor: This is why you're supposed to read the map...

LY_Common_LyraAerialist.name: Lyra Aerialist
LY_Common_LyraAerialist.flavor: The Cloth Dancers' great talent is to use every rough spot to adapt to their environment.

LY_Common_LyraChronicler.name: Lyra Chronicler
LY_Common_LyraChronicler.flavor: Eidolon or human, we are all shaped by stories. They're the building blocks of our identity.

LY_Common_LyraClothDancer.name: Lyra Cloth Dancer
LY_Common_LyraClothDancer.effect: {H} Up to one target Character gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
LY_Common_LyraClothDancer.flavor: Hope you're not afraid of heights!

LY_Common_LyraContortionist.name: Lyra Contortionist
LY_Common_LyraContortionist.support: {I} I don't count towards your Reserve limit.
LY_Common_LyraContortionist.flavor: The Lyra from the Tisdhera clan will bend over backwards for their community.

LY_Common_LyraDJ.name: Lyra DJ
LY_Common_LyraDJ.effect: You may play me for {2} less in an Expedition that's <IN_CONTACT>. (It's In Contact if there is another player's Expedition in its region.)
LY_Common_LyraDJ.flavor: There's something a bit unusual about this set…

LY_Common_LyraFestival.name: Lyra Festival
LY_Common_LyraFestival.effect: {J} Draw a card.  At Dusk, if you control a <FLEETING> Character, another <ANCHORED> Character and yet another <ASLEEP> Character — You win the game.
LY_Common_LyraFestival.flavor: When the time of the Kalann Mae comes, the Lyra all feel the call to a single place, where they will bring a masterpiece to life.

LY_Common_LyraFifer.name: Lyra Fifer
LY_Common_LyraFifer.effect: {J} If a card in your Expeditions or your Reserve has a {D} ability, I gain 1 boost $<BB>.
LY_Common_LyraFifer.flavor: Don't they say that he who pays the piper calls the tune?

LY_Common_LyraMapmaker.name: Lyra Mapmaker
LY_Common_LyraMapmaker.effect: {J} If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, I gain 1 boost.
LY_Common_LyraMapmaker.flavor: When the map covers the whole landscape, which one is more real?

LY_Common_LyraNavigator.name: Lyra Navigator
LY_Common_LyraNavigator.flavor: Like the Bravos, Lyras are drawn to freedom and the distant horizon.

LY_Common_LyraSignet.name: Lyra Signet
LY_Common_LyraSignet.effect: Choose one:  • Up to two target Characters gain <FLEETING>.  • Draw a card, then roll a die. On a 4+, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.  • Target Character gains 1 boost per card in your Reserve.

LY_Common_LyraSkald.name: Lyra Skald
LY_Common_LyraSkald.flavor: We're all stories, in the end.

LY_Common_LyraThespian.name: Lyra Thespian
LY_Common_LyraThespian.effect: {J} If you have three or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control, I gain 1 boost$<BB>.

LY_Common_MagpengHoarder.name: Magpeng Hoarder
LY_Common_MagpengHoarder.effect: {J} If you have two or more cards in Reserve, I gain 1 boost and $<FLEETING_CHAR>.
LY_Common_MagpengHoarder.flavor: Why does it need all these? Might come in handy someday!

LY_Common_ManintheMaze.name: Man in the Maze
LY_Common_ManintheMaze.effect: {H} Remove all boosts from Characters in play and in Reserve. Then, depending on the number of boosts removed this way:  • 1-4: I gain 2 boosts.  • 5-8: Play a card with Hand Cost {3} or less for free.  • 9+: My Expedition moves forward one region.
LY_Common_ManintheMaze.flavor: Life is a maze, but our purpose is not to escape it. The purpose of life is the maze itself.

LY_Common_MapmakersBoon.name: Mapmaker's Boon
LY_Common_MapmakersBoon.effect: If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, target Character gains 4 boosts. Otherwise, it gains 2 boosts.
LY_Common_MapmakersBoon.flavor: Each of us paints their own reality.

LY_Common_Martengale.name: Martengale
LY_Common_Martengale.support: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_Martengale.flavor: Spotting a martengale is always a good omen.

LY_Common_MerryReunion.name: Merry Reunion
LY_Common_MerryReunion.effect: $<RESUPPLY>. If you put a Character in Reserve this way, you may immediately play it for {2} less.

LY_Common_MiaPrimaBallerina.name: Mia, Prima Ballerina
LY_Common_MiaPrimaBallerina.support: {D} : Target Character gains <FLEETING>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_MiaPrimaBallerina.flavor: The former Matriarch of the Kasirga clan leads the dance, however macabre it may be.

LY_Common_MindApotheosis.name: Mind Apotheosis
LY_Common_MindApotheosis.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Reveal the top four cards of your Deck. Choose up to two Characters from these cards and put them in your Expeditions. They gain <FLEETING>. Discard the other cards. (Don't activate any {h} abilities.)
LY_Common_MindApotheosis.flavor: Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakes.

LY_Common_MountainGuide.name: Mountain Guide
LY_Common_MountainGuide.flavor: Who better than a groundhog to wind their way through these hanging rice fields?

LY_Common_MountainNymph.name: Mountain Nymph
LY_Common_MountainNymph.effect: {H} If I'm facing an Expedition in {M}, create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
LY_Common_MountainNymph.flavor: From a mere pebble, she creates a sparkling jewel.

LY_Common_NadirBubbles.name: Nadir & Bubbles
LY_Common_NadirBubbles.effect: I begin the game with one {V}, one {M} and one {O} Terrain Marker.  At Noon — You may place one of my Markers on target visible region. (It gains the terrain of the Marker and loses its other terrains until the Marker is removed.)

LY_Common_NevenkaBlotch.name: Nevenka & Blotch
LY_Common_NevenkaBlotch.effect: {T} : Target a Character you control, then roll a die. On a:  • 6+, it gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)  • 2-5, it gains 1 boost$<BB>.  • 1, send it to Reserve.
LY_Common_NevenkaBlotch.flavor: Chaos can bring disappointment, sure, but it's also where ye'll find the most wonderfullest hidden gems!

LY_Common_NightclubBouncer.name: Nightclub Bouncer
LY_Common_NightclubBouncer.effect: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
LY_Common_NightclubBouncer.flavor: "What part of 'dress code' do you not understand?"

LY_Common_Nisse.name: Nisse
LY_Common_Nisse.effect: {H} Roll a die. On a:  • 4+, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.  • 1-3, <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
LY_Common_Nisse.flavor: "You never know what you'll find in your stockings."

LY_Common_Nuit.name: Nuit
LY_Common_Nuit.effect: {H} If there are nine or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control and in your Reserve, each player passes. (Starting with you, they end their Afternoon and don't take any more turns this Day.)
LY_Common_Nuit.flavor: Gone is the sun, and again comes the night.

LY_Common_NyalaGiftedConjurer.name: Nyala, Gifted Conjurer
LY_Common_NyalaGiftedConjurer.effect: {J} Exchange target card from your Reserve with a card from your Hand.
LY_Common_NyalaGiftedConjurer.flavor: "Of course I'm cheating. That's what magic is all about."

LY_Common_NyalaNightReveler.name: Nyala, Night Reveler
LY_Common_NyalaNightReveler.effect: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may exchange a card from your Reserve with a card from your hand. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
LY_Common_NyalaNightReveler.flavor: "I can get in anywhere, VIP list or not."

LY_Common_OuroborosCroupier.name: Ouroboros Croupier
LY_Common_OuroborosCroupier.effect: {H} Roll a die. On a 4+, draw a card. On a 1-3, $<RESUPPLY_LOW>.

LY_Common_OuroborosInkcaster.name: Ouroboros Inkcaster
LY_Common_OuroborosInkcaster.effect: When I go to Reserve from the Expedition zone — You may return another card from your Reserve to your hand.
LY_Common_OuroborosInkcaster.flavor: When luck joins in the game, cleverness scores double.

LY_Common_OuroborosTrickster.name: Ouroboros Trickster
LY_Common_OuroborosTrickster.effect: {J} Roll a die. On a 4+, I gain 2 boosts. On a 1-3, I gain 1 boost$<BB>.
LY_Common_OuroborosTrickster.flavor: When luck joins in the game, cleverness scores double.

LY_Common_PaintPrison.name: Paint Prison
LY_Common_PaintPrison.effect: $<FLEETING>.  You may discard a card from your Reserve to reduce my cost by {2}.  Return target Character or Permanent to the top of its owner's deck.
LY_Common_PaintPrison.flavor: Your problem is a lack of perspective.

LY_Common_PaintitPink.name: Paint it Pink!
LY_Common_PaintitPink.effect: <FLEETING>.  Play me for {1} less if one or more of your Expeditions are <IN_CONTACT>. (If another player's Expedition is in their region.)  Return target Character or Permanent to the top of its owner's deck.

LY_Common_Pinocchio.name: Pinocchio
LY_Common_Pinocchio.flavor: After that, he'll sleep like a log, and that's no lie.

LY_Common_RekaBarmaid.name: Reka Barmaid
LY_Common_RekaBarmaid.effect: At Dusk — If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 1 boost. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
LY_Common_RekaBarmaid.flavor: "It's happy hour all the time here!"

LY_Common_RekaGuide.name: Reka Guide
LY_Common_RekaGuide.support: {D} : Return another Character from your Reserve to your hand. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_RekaGuide.flavor: "Let's wrap up today's visit with a taste of some local specialties."

LY_Common_RekaHeadset.name: Reka Headset
LY_Common_RekaHeadset.effect: My Expedition and its Characters are considered <IN_CONTACT>. (Even if there are no other Expeditions in my region.)  {T} : The next Character that joins my Expedition this turn gains 1 boost.
LY_Common_RekaHeadset.flavor: This way, we're all on the same wavelength.

LY_Common_RekaRopedancer.name: Reka Ropedancer
LY_Common_RekaRopedancer.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost and <ASLEEP>.

LY_Common_RekaThurifer.name: Reka Thurifer
LY_Common_RekaThurifer.support: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_RekaThurifer.flavor: Through drifting incense, we purge the darkness within.

LY_Common_RekaZipliner.name: Reka Zipliner
LY_Common_RekaZipliner.flavor: The shortest distance between two points is a straight line.

LY_Common_RidetheBifrost.name: Ride the Bifröst
LY_Common_RidetheBifrost.effect: $<FLEETING>.  All Characters you control switch Expeditions. (They leave their Expeditions and join their controller's other Expedition.)
LY_Common_RidetheBifrost.flavor: The Lyra never play by the rules.

LY_Common_RomanticEncounter.name: Romantic Encounter
LY_Common_RomanticEncounter.effect: Target opponent reveals the top four cards of their deck. You may play a Character from these cards for free and it gains <FLEETING>, then discard the rest. (Don't activate any {h} abilities.)
LY_Common_RomanticEncounter.flavor: "I've never felt this close to anyone."

LY_Common_SantaClaus.name: Santa Claus
LY_Common_SantaClaus.effect: {H} Starting with you, each player may immediately play a card with Hand Cost {3} or less for free.

LY_Common_SapDuende.name: Sap Duende
LY_Common_SapDuende.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Target two <BOOSTED_CHA_P> Characters in play or in Reserve and exchange their boosts.  Draw a card.
LY_Common_SapDuende.flavor: When the rhythm picks up, the strings release the Sap covering them.

LY_Common_SeaNymph.name: Sea Nymph
LY_Common_SeaNymph.effect: {H} If I'm facing an Expedition in {O}, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)
LY_Common_SeaNymph.flavor: From a thin trickle of water, she creates raging tides.

LY_Common_SilentNight.name: Silent Night
LY_Common_SilentNight.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target a Character, then roll a die. On a:  • 4+, it gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)  • 1-3, it gains <ASLEEP>. (Ignore its statistics during Dusk. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
LY_Common_SilentNight.flavor: All is calm, all is bright.

LY_Common_SleightofHand.name: Sleight of Hand
LY_Common_SleightofHand.effect: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Exchange target Character in your Reserve with a card from your Hand.
LY_Common_SleightofHand.flavor: "An old trick well done is far better than a new trick with no effect." - Houdini

LY_Common_SmokeThemOut.name: Smoke Them Out
LY_Common_SmokeThemOut.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  When two {D} abilities are activated on one of your turns — Complete me.
LY_Common_SmokeThemOut.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: {T} : The next time a {D} ability is activated this turn, target Character gains 1 boost.
LY_Common_SmokeThemOut.flavor: "Where there's smoke, there's fire… and we're proof of that!"

LY_Common_SmokingSkunk.name: Smoking Skunk
LY_Common_SmokingSkunk.support: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_SmokingSkunk.flavor: With certain opponents, you can litterally smell the danger.

LY_Common_SnowballCommando.name: Snowball Commando
LY_Common_SnowballCommando.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in an opponent's Reserve, then roll a die. When you roll a 1-3 this way — That opponent targets a card in your Reserve. Exhaust it. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

LY_Common_StickyShroom.name: Sticky Shroom
LY_Common_StickyShroom.flavor: He's a fun guy, but he can get into some sticky situations.

LY_Common_StigmaofHavoc.name: Stigma of Havoc
LY_Common_StigmaofHavoc.effect: {H} Each player discards their Reserve, <RESUPPLIES>, then <RESUPPLIES> again.
LY_Common_StigmaofHavoc.support: {D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Common_TheHatter.name: The Hatter
LY_Common_TheHatter.support: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_TheHatter.flavor: "You can draw water out of a water-well, so I should think you could draw treacle out of a treacle-well — eh, stupid ?"

LY_Common_TheMagicSleigh.name: The Magic Sleigh
LY_Common_TheMagicSleigh.effect: If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, it moves twice instead.

LY_Common_TheOperaHouse.name: The Opera House
LY_Common_TheOperaHouse.effect: {T} : Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Spell, draw it. (Otherwise, leave it on top of your deck.)
LY_Common_TheOperaHouse.flavor: The Arkaster Opera House is known as the Spark, for that's where stars are born.

LY_Common_TheOuroborosLyraBastion.name: The Ouroboros, Lyra Bastion
LY_Common_TheOuroborosLyraBastion.effect: If you would roll one or more dice, instead roll that many dice plus one and ignore the roll of your choice.
LY_Common_TheOuroborosLyraBastion.flavor: The Expeditionary Corps' mobile outpost soars high, like a spinning wheel weaving the wind.

LY_Common_ThePainthouse.name: The Painthouse
LY_Common_ThePainthouse.effect: {J} $<RESUPPLY>.  At Noon — If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, you may give 1 boost to target Character in Reserve.
LY_Common_ThePainthouse.flavor: The paints of the Tisdhera still perfume the heights of the Wayfarer.

LY_Common_TheSandman.name: The Sandman
LY_Common_TheSandman.effect: {H} Up to one target Character gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
LY_Common_TheSandman.flavor: "Sand gives you a taste of what life is all about. Come morning, the castles you have built will be gone with the tide."

LY_Common_TheSnowman.name: The Snowman
LY_Common_TheSnowman.flavor: Which will melt first: him, or your heart?

LY_Common_TheStage.name: The Stage
LY_Common_TheStage.effect: When you play a Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 Performance counter.  {T}, Spend 3 of my Performance counters: the next Character with a base statistic of 0 that you play this turn loses <FLEETING>.
LY_Common_TheStage.flavor: Day or night, the music of BLISS reinvigorates weary hearts and bodies.

LY_Common_TheWayfarer.name: The Wayfarer
LY_Common_TheWayfarer.effect: If you would roll one or more dice, also reveal the top card of your deck.  When you reveal a card this way — If its Hand Cost is equal to the die's result, draw it.
LY_Common_TheWayfarer.flavor: The Tisdhera Clan answers its Matriarch's call!

LY_Common_TheWesternWind.name: The Western Wind
LY_Common_TheWesternWind.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Target Expedition moves backwards one region. If it does, its controller moves their other Expedition forward one region.
LY_Common_TheWesternWind.flavor: It's no use going against the Wind.

LY_Common_TwinkleTwinkle.name: Twinkle Twinkle
LY_Common_TwinkleTwinkle.effect: Target Character gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
LY_Common_TwinkleTwinkle.support: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_TwinkleTwinkle.flavor: Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky.

LY_Common_UrbexSpecialist.name: Urbex Specialist
LY_Common_UrbexSpecialist.effect: If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, my {V}, {M} and {O} are equal to my highest statistic. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
LY_Common_UrbexSpecialist.flavor: Exploration is always fun with the right company!

LY_Common_WillotheWisp.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
LY_Common_WillotheWisp.effect: If an Expedition facing me is in {O}, it can’t move forward during Dusk, except due to {O}.
LY_Common_WillotheWisp.support: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Common_WillotheWisp.flavor: "Nine fathom deep he had followed us - From the land of mist and snow."

LY_Common_WinterOutfits.name: Winter Outfits
LY_Common_WinterOutfits.effect: Characters in my Expedition have their {V}, {M}, and {O} equal to their highest statistic.
LY_Common_WinterOutfits.flavor: There's no such thing as bad weather, only bad clothing.

LY_Common_XMarkstheSpot.name: X Marks the Spot
LY_Common_XMarkstheSpot.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Roll a die. Send target Character to the Xth position of its owner's deck, where X is the result.

LY_Common_YeongGiEmber.name: Yeong-Gi & Ember
LY_Common_YeongGiEmber.effect: {T} : Roll a die, then spend any number of my Luck counters to increase the result by that much. On a:  • 4+, You may target a Character in your Expeditions. It activates its {D} ability.  • 1-3: I gain a Luck counter.

LY_Exalted_GiveFateaTwist.name: Give Fate a Twist!
LY_Exalted_GiveFateaTwist.effect: {J} Roll a die. On a 1: Play another turn.  When you roll a 6+ on a die — Complete me.
LY_Exalted_GiveFateaTwist.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: If you would roll a die, you may exhaust me ({T}) to add 1 to its result. (Choose after you see the result.)
LY_Exalted_GiveFateaTwist.flavor: Even fate appreciates a helping hand!

LY_Exalted_PhoibosRekaHexarch.name: Phoibos, Reka Hexarch
LY_Exalted_PhoibosRekaHexarch.effect: {H} Target opponent reveals a random card from their hand. If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may immediately play it for free and it gains <FLEETING>. If you don't, discard it.
LY_Exalted_PhoibosRekaHexarch.flavor: "I'm never more comfortable than when I'm in the spotlight."

LY_Exalted_PlagueofDespair.name: Plague of Despair
LY_Exalted_PlagueofDespair.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  When you roll a 6+ on a die — I gain 1 boost.  When you roll a 1 on a die — Send me to Reserve.
LY_Exalted_PlagueofDespair.flavor: "The soul does not give itself up to despair until it has exhausted all illusions." – Victor Hugo

LY_Rare_ACappellaTraining.name: A Cappella Training
LY_Rare_ACappellaTraining.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Target Character gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)  #Draw a card.#
LY_Rare_ACappellaTraining.flavor: Thank you for being my metronome!

LY_Rare_AetherShard.name: Aether Shard
LY_Rare_AetherShard.effect: #{J} Draw a card.#  At Noon — Draw a card.
LY_Rare_AetherShard.flavor: No mere trinket, but a fragment of purest dream.

LY_Rare_Alice.name: Alice
LY_Rare_Alice.support: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Rare_AllIn.name: All In!
LY_Rare_AllIn.effect: Roll a die. #You may discard a card from your Reserve to increase the result by 2.# Target Character gains X boosts, where X is the final result.
LY_Rare_AllIn.flavor: There's a time to be cautious, and a time to bet it all!

LY_Rare_AloeVera.name: Aloe Vera
LY_Rare_AloeVera.effect: #{J} You may pay {1} to have me gain $<ANCHORED>.#  At Noon — $<RESUPPLY>.

LY_Rare_AltrunTeammate.name: Altrun Teammate
LY_Rare_AltrunTeammate.effect: {J} You may <RUSH> to give #target Character# 1 boost. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
LY_Rare_AltrunTeammate.flavor: Altrun is a running and obstacle-dodging discipline that comes in very handy on these islands.

LY_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.name: Amahle, Asgarthan Outcast
LY_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.effect: {J} You may discard #any number of cards# from your Reserve to #draw that many cards#.
LY_Rare_AmahleAsgarthanOutcast.flavor: The old world is dying, and the new world struggles to be born: now is the time of monsters.

LY_Rare_Anansi.name: Anansi
LY_Rare_Anansi.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost for each card #in each player's Reserve#.
LY_Rare_Anansi.flavor: In the end, he had accumulated pretty well all the wisdom that was available. He put it in a gourd and made a stopper for it.

LY_Rare_Arawn.name: Arawn
LY_Rare_Arawn.flavor: The Wild Hunt comes to free the restless spirits.

LY_Rare_Asmodeus.name: Asmodeus
LY_Rare_Asmodeus.effect: {J} Roll a die. On a 4+, I gain $<ANCHORED>. On a 1-3, I gain 3 boosts$<BB>.

LY_Rare_Avalanche.name: Avalanche
LY_Rare_Avalanche.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve any number of target Characters with total {M} of 4 or less.
LY_Rare_Avalanche.flavor: None of the snowflakes feel personally guilty for the avalanche.

LY_Rare_BLISSBassist.name: BLISS Bassist
LY_Rare_BLISSBassist.effect: #If I'm <BOOSTED>, the {V}, {M}, and {O} of other Characters you control are equal to their highest statistic.#
LY_Rare_BLISSBassist.support: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
LY_Rare_BLISSBassist.flavor: "This one's for all the explorers out there and all the hard work they do. They're not just monkeyin' around!" — Boona

LY_Rare_BLISSDrummer.name: BLISS Drummer
LY_Rare_BLISSDrummer.effect: If I'm <BOOSTED>, other #Artists# cost {1} less to play from your Reserve, with a minimum of {1}.
LY_Rare_BLISSDrummer.support: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
LY_Rare_BLISSDrummer.flavor: "Throw your hands up in the air for everyone who's hauling out those amazing relics from the City of Scholars!" — Tamati

LY_Rare_BLISSFan.name: BLISS Fan
LY_Rare_BLISSFan.effect: When a Character in your Reserve gains 1 or more boosts — #Target Character# gains 1 boost.
LY_Rare_BLISSFan.flavor: BLISS lets the fans who bring back the most Sap come up on stage with them.

LY_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.name: BLISS Keytarist
LY_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.effect: At Dusk — If I'm <BOOSTED>, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an #Artist# or #Song#, draw it. Otherwise, discard it.
LY_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.support: {I} When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0 — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
LY_Rare_BLISSKeytarist.flavor: "Make some noise for all the brave folks pulling Sap up from the depths!" — Orbec

LY_Rare_Bastet.name: Bastet
LY_Rare_Bastet.support: {D} : The next Character with Base Cost {3} or less you play this turn gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

LY_Rare_BestowingSloth.name: Bestowing Sloth
LY_Rare_BestowingSloth.flavor: "I'm not lazy, I'm just conserving energy."

LY_Rare_BoldOutrider.name: Bold Outrider
LY_Rare_BoldOutrider.effect: #{J} You may immediately play a Feat for {1} less, down to a minimum of {1}.#
LY_Rare_BoldOutrider.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.#
LY_Rare_BoldOutrider.flavor: "I've found a way! A gap just two klicks away, straight ahead!"

LY_Rare_Brainwash.name: Brainwash
LY_Rare_Brainwash.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target a Character in any Reserve with Reserve Cost {2} or less. Play it for free. (Put it in one of your Expeditions.)
LY_Rare_Brainwash.flavor: Like a worm in an apple, Silk squirmed into the Eidolon's mind to convert him to its Faction's interests.

LY_Rare_BraveCub.name: Brave Cub
LY_Rare_BraveCub.effect: #{H} You may discard target non-Companion token.#
LY_Rare_BraveCub.flavor: "Graaawr! The whole pack will stand with humankind, for the wolf is feared by all!"

LY_Rare_BravosHarpooner.name: Bravos Harpooner
LY_Rare_BravosHarpooner.effect: #{J}# You may <RUSH> to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
LY_Rare_BravosHarpooner.flavor: Without explosive charges, these harpoons wouldn't even make a dent in Halua's hide.

LY_Rare_BravosPathfinder.name: Bravos Pathfinder
LY_Rare_BravosPathfinder.flavor: "Stay on the path, they say. I make my own path!"

LY_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.name: Bravos Trailblazer
LY_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost #for each <FLEETING_CHAR> Character you control#.
LY_Rare_BravosTrailblazer.flavor: "It will be a collective effort; it must be a joint endeavor!"

LY_Rare_BreaktheIce.name: Break the Ice
LY_Rare_BreaktheIce.effect: #$<COOLDOWN>#.  I cost {2} less if you have three or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}).

LY_Rare_CableCarStation.name: Cable-Car Station
LY_Rare_CableCarStation.effect: {J} #Draw a card,# then I gain 2 Move counters.  {T}, Spend 1 of my Move counters: One of your Expeditions moves backwards one region. If it does, your other Expedition moves forward one region.
LY_Rare_CableCarStation.flavor: Reka cable-cars are the safest way to get around the city.

LY_Rare_Carbunclo.name: Carbunclo
LY_Rare_Carbunclo.effect: #{J}# If a card in your Expeditions or your Reserve has a {D} ability, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)
LY_Rare_Carbunclo.flavor: Is that a ruby on its forehead or a burning lump of coal ?

LY_Rare_CatsCradle.name: Cat's Cradle
LY_Rare_CatsCradle.effect: Target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less# switches Expeditions, then gains <ANCHORED>.
LY_Rare_CatsCradle.flavor: "Time to let the cat out of the bag!"

LY_Rare_Cernunnos.name: Cernunnos
LY_Rare_Cernunnos.flavor: You can feel it in the trees, deep beneath their roots – the very heartbeat of nature.

LY_Rare_CheshireCat.name: Cheshire Cat
LY_Rare_CheshireCat.effect: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may have target Character switch Expeditions. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Rare_Cleanse.name: Cleanse
LY_Rare_Cleanse.effect: Roll a die. #On a 1-3, I gain <FLEETING>.# Then, you may send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {X} or less, where X is the result. (Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)
LY_Rare_Cleanse.flavor: "What do you think of my smoldering eyes?"

LY_Rare_ConiferalConeman.name: Coniferal Coneman
LY_Rare_ConiferalConeman.flavor: "Dosukoi! Let’s put it in the ground!"

LY_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.name: Corrupted Esmeralda
LY_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.effect: I #can't be played# unless a {D} ability was activated this turn.  #{J}# <RESUPPLY>.
LY_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.support: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)#
LY_Rare_CorruptedEsmeralda.flavor: \"Are you sure you want to follow me into hell, Fen ?\"

LY_Rare_CorruptedPaju.name: Corrupted Paju
LY_Rare_CorruptedPaju.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless your hand is empty.  #{J}# Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
LY_Rare_CorruptedPaju.support: #{D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.#
LY_Rare_CorruptedPaju.flavor: "Why did you survive, Treyst… but I died?"

LY_Rare_CountingSheep.name: Counting Sheep
LY_Rare_CountingSheep.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target two Expeditions and create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in each one. Then, each Character with Hand Cost {1} or less gains <ASLEEP>.
LY_Rare_CountingSheep.flavor: The deepest sleep is woven from the wool of sweet dreams.

LY_Rare_Daedalus.name: Daedalus
LY_Rare_Daedalus.effect: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  #{J}# Target another Character #in play# or in Reserve. Then, roll a die:  • On a 4+, we both gain 1 boost.  • On a 1-3, it gains 1 boost.
LY_Rare_Daedalus.flavor: No one is truly lost, for all are exactly where fate wants them to be.

LY_Rare_Daikokuten.name: Daikokuten
LY_Rare_Daikokuten.effect: {J} Target opponent may immediately play a #card with Base Cost {4} or more# for free. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
LY_Rare_Daikokuten.flavor: If you never take a risk, you'll never be rewarded.

LY_Rare_Dapeng.name: Dapeng
LY_Rare_Dapeng.flavor: With Turuun on its back, it carries a branch of the Spindle Tree in its beak.

LY_Rare_Dawon.name: Dawon
LY_Rare_Dawon.effect: {H} You may target another Character with {V} less than or equal to mine. It gains <ANCHORED>.
LY_Rare_Dawon.flavor: "Come to me, Dawon, that I might summon the spirit of Durga!" — Parvati

LY_Rare_Defect.name: Defect
LY_Rare_Defect.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target Character #with Hand Cost {4} or less# defects. (It joins the Expedition facing it, changing controllers.)
LY_Rare_Defect.flavor: Changing sides isn't always a matter of choice.

LY_Rare_DioclesChariotRacer.name: Diocles, Chariot Racer
LY_Rare_DioclesChariotRacer.effect: #Pay {3} more# to play me in a starting region.  {J} My Expedition moves backwards one region.  When I leave the Expedition zone — My Expedition moves forward one region.
LY_Rare_DioclesChariotRacer.flavor: "Hop in, it's a guaranteed five-star experience!"

LY_Rare_DonJuan.name: Don Juan
LY_Rare_DonJuan.effect: If I would go to Reserve from the Expedition zone, I gain <FLEETING> and defect instead. (I join the Expedition facing me, changing controllers.)

LY_Rare_Doppelganger.name: Doppelgänger
LY_Rare_Doppelganger.effect: #$<SEASONED>.#  #{H}# Target a Character facing me. I gain its subtypes and X boosts, where X equals its highest statistic. (I lose these subtypes when I leave the Expedition zone.)

LY_Rare_DrFrankenstein.name: Dr. Frankenstein
LY_Rare_DrFrankenstein.effect: {R} You may activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.
LY_Rare_DrFrankenstein.flavor: We sometimes seek companionship in the strangest of life forms.

LY_Rare_DredgerDrone.name: Dredger Drone
LY_Rare_DredgerDrone.effect: {R} You may spend #1 counter# from #a card you control or in your Reserve# to <RESUPPLY_INF>.
LY_Rare_DredgerDrone.support: {I} #When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0# — I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 2.#
LY_Rare_DredgerDrone.flavor: The more you dig, the better your chances of finding something unique.

LY_Rare_DuelofGrit.name: Duel of Grit
LY_Rare_DuelofGrit.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Discard# target Character with Hand Cost less than or equal to the Hand Cost of a Character you control.
LY_Rare_DuelofGrit.flavor: Fiore was the first of the Seven Blades to clash with Atsadi.

LY_Rare_EatMeEnergyBars.name: Eat Me Energy Bars
LY_Rare_EatMeEnergyBars.effect: #{J} I gain <FLEETING>.#  If there is only one Character in my Expedition, it is <GIGANTIC>. (It is considered present in each of your Expeditions.)

LY_Rare_EfrenPuppetMaster.name: Efrén, Puppet Master
LY_Rare_EfrenPuppetMaster.effect: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  {H} Roll a die:  • On a 4+, <SABOTAGE_LOW>.  • On a 1-3, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
LY_Rare_EfrenPuppetMaster.flavor: "I could never let the winding threads of fate separate me from my daughter." — Efrén

LY_Rare_Encore.name: Encore
LY_Rare_Encore.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Target <FLEETING_CHAR> #or <BOOSTED># Character gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)

LY_Rare_Eris.name: Eris
LY_Rare_Eris.effect: If my Expedition would move forward during Dusk, roll a die. On a:  • 4+, it moves forward one more region instead.  #• 1, it doesn't move instead.#
LY_Rare_Eris.flavor: You win some, you lose some.

LY_Rare_Esmeralda.name: Esmeralda
LY_Rare_Esmeralda.flavor: Eidolon or not, you are our Shepherdess. You lead and we follow.

LY_Rare_FailedDemo.name: Failed Demo
LY_Rare_FailedDemo.effect: <FLEETING>.  Exhaust ({T}) a card in your Reserve. If you do, send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or Hand Cost if not.)
LY_Rare_FailedDemo.flavor: Not a failure; just another step towards success.

LY_Rare_Finisher.name: Finisher
LY_Rare_Finisher.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose up to three, #you may choose the same option multiple times:#  • Discard target Character.  • Discard target Permanent.  • <SABOTAGE>.

LY_Rare_Flamel.name: Flamel
LY_Rare_Flamel.effect: {H} You may return a Spell from your Reserve to your hand.
LY_Rare_Flamel.support: {D} : The next Spell you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Rare_Flamel.flavor: Rubedo is the final stage of alchemy, where one's substance is reborn like a phoenix before returning to the world.

LY_Rare_FloreCaringGardener.name: Flore, Caring Gardener
LY_Rare_FloreCaringGardener.support: {I} At Noon — Another target Character in play or in Reserve gains 1 boost.
LY_Rare_FloreCaringGardener.flavor: Every day that goes by without a Drillmole showing up is a blessing.

LY_Rare_FloreFumingGardener.name: Flore, Fuming Gardener
LY_Rare_FloreFumingGardener.effect: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) target Permanent in play. #Then you may exhaust# target card in Reserve.
LY_Rare_FloreFumingGardener.flavor: "The Naos has been drained from intensive use!"

LY_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.name: Flying Squirrel
LY_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.effect: {R} #If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 2 boosts,# otherwise I gain 1 boost. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
LY_Rare_FlyingSquirrel.flavor: The second big jump is where the fun really starts.

LY_Rare_ForestNymph.name: Forest Nymph
LY_Rare_ForestNymph.effect: {H} If I'm facing an Expedition in {V}, you may have target Character gain <FLEETING>.  #{R} You may move a {V} Terrain Marker from any region to my region.#
LY_Rare_ForestNymph.flavor: From an innocent seed, she creates wild forests.

LY_Rare_FoulFaker.name: Foul Faker
LY_Rare_FoulFaker.effect: #{J}# If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

LY_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.name: Fragrant Meerkat
LY_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.effect: #If you would roll a die, you may add 1 to its result.# (Choose after you see the result.)
LY_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.flavor: Do you smell a rat ? Nope, that's just me!

LY_Rare_Galatea.name: Galatea
LY_Rare_Galatea.effect: If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I'm <DEFENDER_FS>. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)  {J} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 2 boosts.
LY_Rare_Galatea.flavor: If a sculptor merely frees the form from the stone, then it never belonged to him in the first place.

LY_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.name: Galvanize the Troops
LY_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>. Then, you may have target Character you control gain <FLEETING>.  When you pass — If you control two or more <FLEETING> Characters, complete me.
LY_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: At Noon — If you are first player, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. #Otherwise, target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost.#
LY_Rare_GalvanizetheTroops.flavor: "In the dead of night, we must shine the brightest!"

LY_Rare_Gavroche.name: Gavroche
LY_Rare_Gavroche.effect: {R} #You may discard a card from your Reserve to# create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
LY_Rare_Gavroche.flavor: He fills his basket and retorts by thumbing his nose.

LY_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.name: Gericht, Revered Duelist
LY_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.effect: #If I would gain <FLEETING_CHAR>, I gain 1 boost instead#.
LY_Rare_GerichtReveredDuelist.flavor: "What doesn't kill you makes you stronger."

LY_Rare_Hathor.name: Hathor
LY_Rare_Hathor.support: {D} : Return another card from your Reserve to your hand. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Rare_Hathor.flavor: Dance is the language of the soul.

LY_Rare_HavenSeiringar.name: Haven Seiringar
LY_Rare_HavenSeiringar.effect: When I leave the Expedition Zone, if I was <FLEETING_CHAR> — Draw a card.  #{R} I gain 1 boost.#
LY_Rare_HavenSeiringar.flavor: Those who have lived a lot have plenty to share.

LY_Rare_Heimdall.name: Heimdall
LY_Rare_Heimdall.effect: {H} You may have target Character #or Expedition Permanent# switch Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)
LY_Rare_Heimdall.flavor: Proud guardian of the Bifröst, he decides who gets to switch sides.

LY_Rare_Hooked.name: Hooked
LY_Rare_Hooked.effect: Target Character switches Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)

LY_Rare_HostelNightkeeper.name: Hostel Nightkeeper
LY_Rare_HostelNightkeeper.effect: {H} You may target a Character, it gains <ASLEEP>. #If you control it,# create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
LY_Rare_HostelNightkeeper.flavor: "Floor -2, room 217. Welcome to the Underlook Hostel."

LY_Rare_Hydracaena.name: Hydracaena
LY_Rare_Hydracaena.effect: $<ETERNAL>.  {J} I gain 4 boosts.  At Noon — I gain 4 boosts.
LY_Rare_Hydracaena.flavor: When they reach adult size, it's clear that the Dracaenas have really thrived on all that rest and relaxation.

LY_Rare_Hypothermia.name: Hypothermia
LY_Rare_Hypothermia.effect: Each player chooses a Character they control. It gains <ASLEEP>. (You choose first. Ignore the statistics of Asleep Characters during Dusk. At Rest, they don't go to Reserve and lose Asleep.)
LY_Rare_Hypothermia.flavor: Fall asleep in the cold, and you might never wake up.

LY_Rare_IceboundTaiga.name: Icebound Taiga
LY_Rare_IceboundTaiga.effect: When you play a Character in {V} — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then it gains <ANCHORED>.
LY_Rare_IceboundTaiga.flavor: We can sense it in the woodland silences, like a tremor.

LY_Rare_IceboundTundra.name: Icebound Tundra
LY_Rare_IceboundTundra.effect: When you play a Character in a region type where its base statistic is 0 — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then return a card from your Reserve to your hand.
LY_Rare_IceboundTundra.flavor: We can hear it, echoing in the vast expanses.

LY_Rare_IsabelLetham.name: Isabel Letham
LY_Rare_IsabelLetham.flavor: The lowest point of the wave is where she draws all her strength.

LY_Rare_Janus.name: Janus
LY_Rare_Janus.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  When you discard a card from your hand #or your Reserve# — I gain 1 boost.
LY_Rare_Janus.flavor: "God of gates, it is time to close the Veil." — Sam

LY_Rare_Joyride.name: Joyride
LY_Rare_Joyride.effect: Discard another card from your Reserve. If you do, target Character gains 2 boosts.
LY_Rare_Joyride.flavor: Everything fun is life is either forbidden or completely crazy.

LY_Rare_JumpingFrog.name: Jumping Frog
LY_Rare_JumpingFrog.effect: When you pass first — #Target Character# gains 1 boost.

LY_Rare_KadigiranMageDancer.name: Kadigiran Mage-Dancer
LY_Rare_KadigiranMageDancer.effect: When you #roll one or more dice# — I gain 1 boost$<BB>.
LY_Rare_KadigiranMageDancer.flavor: "Don't just wait for magic to happen. Go out and make your own!"

LY_Rare_KaibaraAsgarthanLeviathan.name: Kaibara, Asgarthan Leviathan
LY_Rare_KaibaraAsgarthanLeviathan.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  $<TOUGH_X>, where X is the number of regions between your Hero and Companion. (If they are adjacent, X equals 0.)
LY_Rare_KaibaraAsgarthanLeviathan.flavor: For hundreds of years, Kaibara has protected Asagartha.

LY_Rare_Kappa.name: Kappa
LY_Rare_Kappa.flavor: "Push through the pain. Giving up would hurt far more."

LY_Rare_KarhuLordofBears.name: Karhu, Lord of Bears
LY_Rare_KarhuLordofBears.effect: {H} If you control another Animal #or an Artist,# draw a card.
LY_Rare_KarhuLordofBears.flavor: "Karhu, my old friend, wake from your slumber." — Rin

LY_Rare_Kodama.name: Kodama
LY_Rare_Kodama.support: #{D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Rare_Kodama.flavor: There's no greater blessing for a tree than to offer a home for a Kodama.

LY_Rare_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.name: Koi, Playful Leviathan
LY_Rare_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  #{H} If neither of my Expeditions is in {M}, draw a card.#
LY_Rare_KoiPlayfulLeviathan.flavor: Its gracious leap parted the clouds, revealing our path forward.

LY_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
LY_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} #Return a card from your Reserve to your hand, then# exhaust all cards in Reserve.

LY_Rare_Lakshmi.name: Lakshmi
LY_Rare_Lakshmi.effect: When you roll one or more dice — #If the result is 6+, draw a card.#
LY_Rare_Lakshmi.support: #{I} When you roll one or more dice — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.#
LY_Rare_Lakshmi.flavor: Fortune smiles on those who give themselves over to it.

LY_Rare_LakshmisOwl.name: Lakshmi's Owl
LY_Rare_LakshmisOwl.effect: When you roll one or more dice — If I have no boosts, #I gain 1 boost#. $<BB>
LY_Rare_LakshmisOwl.support: #{D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)#
LY_Rare_LakshmisOwl.flavor: Even in the blackest night, I can see light.

LY_Rare_LernaeanHydra.name: Lernaean Hydra
LY_Rare_LernaeanHydra.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost per Mana Orb in your Mana Zone.
LY_Rare_LernaeanHydra.flavor: If you want to butt heads, it'll probably win...

LY_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
LY_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less #and gains 1 boost.#

LY_Rare_Loki.name: Loki
LY_Rare_Loki.effect: {H} Each player discards their hand #and their Reserve#, then draws three cards.

LY_Rare_LostintheRiptide.name: Lost in the Riptide
LY_Rare_LostintheRiptide.effect: <FLEETING>.  Return target Character to the top of its owner's deck. #If it was in {O}, ready two Mana Orbs.#
LY_Rare_LostintheRiptide.flavor: This is why you're supposed to read the map...

LY_Rare_LostintheWoods.name: Lost in the Woods
LY_Rare_LostintheWoods.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send target Character to Reserve. #If it wasn't in {V}, its controller draws a card.#  • Discard target Permanent.
LY_Rare_LostintheWoods.flavor: They're not out of the woods yet.

LY_Rare_LucanHungryLeviathan.name: Lucan, Hungry Leviathan
LY_Rare_LucanHungryLeviathan.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  {J} You may discard any number of cards from your Reserve to give me that many boosts.
LY_Rare_LucanHungryLeviathan.flavor: It bursts out of the clouds to devour our metal shuttles.

LY_Rare_LyraAerialist.name: Lyra Aerialist
LY_Rare_LyraAerialist.effect: #If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, my {V}, {M}, and {O} are equal to my highest statistic.#
LY_Rare_LyraAerialist.flavor: The Cloth Dancers' great talent is to use every rough spot to adapt to their environment.

LY_Rare_LyraChronicler.name: Lyra Chronicler
LY_Rare_LyraChronicler.support: #{D} : <RESUPPLY>.# (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Rare_LyraChronicler.flavor: Eidolon or human, we are all shaped by stories. They're the building blocks of our identity.

LY_Rare_LyraClothDancer.name: Lyra Cloth Dancer
LY_Rare_LyraClothDancer.effect: {H} #Each Character controlled by target player# gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
LY_Rare_LyraClothDancer.flavor: Hope you're not afraid of heights!

LY_Rare_LyraContortionist.name: Lyra Contortionist
LY_Rare_LyraContortionist.support: {I} I don't count towards your Reserve limit.
LY_Rare_LyraContortionist.flavor: The Lyra from the Tisdhera clan will bend over backwards for their community.

LY_Rare_LyraDJ.name: Lyra DJ
LY_Rare_LyraDJ.effect: You may play me for {2} less in an Expedition that's <IN_CONTACT>. (It's In Contact if there is another player's Expedition in its region.)  #{J} If each of your Expeditions is <IN_CONTACT>, draw a card.#
LY_Rare_LyraDJ.flavor: There's something a bit unusual about this set…

LY_Rare_LyraFestival.name: Lyra Festival
LY_Rare_LyraFestival.effect: #{J} Target Character gains <FLEETING>, <ANCHORED> or <ASLEEP>.#  At Dusk, if you control a <FLEETING> Character, another <ANCHORED> Character and yet another <ASLEEP> Character — You win the game.
LY_Rare_LyraFestival.flavor: When the time of the Kalann Mae comes, the Lyra all feel the call to a single place, where they will bring a masterpiece to life.

LY_Rare_LyraFifer.name: Lyra Fifer
LY_Rare_LyraFifer.effect: {J} If a {D} ability #was activated this turn#, I gain 1 boost.
LY_Rare_LyraFifer.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)#
LY_Rare_LyraFifer.flavor: Don't they say that he who pays the piper calls the tune?

LY_Rare_LyraMapmaker.name: Lyra Mapmaker
LY_Rare_LyraMapmaker.effect: #{H} If five or more single-terrain regions are visible, target Character gains <ASLEEP>.#  {J} If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, I gain 1 boost.
LY_Rare_LyraMapmaker.flavor: When the map covers the whole landscape, which one is more real?

LY_Rare_LyraNavigator.name: Lyra Navigator
LY_Rare_LyraNavigator.support: #{D} : <RESUPPLY>.# (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Rare_LyraNavigator.flavor: Like the Bravos, Lyras are drawn to freedom and the distant horizon.

LY_Rare_LyraSignet.name: Lyra Signet
LY_Rare_LyraSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Up to two target Characters gain <FLEETING>.  • Draw a card, then roll a die. On a 4+, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.  • Target Character gains 1 boost per card in your Reserve.

LY_Rare_LyraSkald.name: Lyra Skald
LY_Rare_LyraSkald.effect: #{H} You may discard a card from your Reserve to $<RESUPPLY_INF>.#
LY_Rare_LyraSkald.support: #{D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Rare_LyraSkald.flavor: We're all stories, in the end.

LY_Rare_LyraThespian.name: Lyra Thespian
LY_Rare_LyraThespian.effect: {J} If you have three or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control, I gain #2 boosts#.

LY_Rare_MagicBeans.name: Magic Beans
LY_Rare_MagicBeans.effect: {J} Target Character in my Expedition gains 1 boost.  My region #and the region of the Expedition facing me# are {V} #and lose their other types.#

LY_Rare_MagicalTraining.name: Magical Training
LY_Rare_MagicalTraining.flavor: Without practice, the gift of Alteration will come to nothing.

LY_Rare_MagpengHoarder.name: Magpeng Hoarder
LY_Rare_MagpengHoarder.effect: {J} If you have two or more cards in Reserve, I gain #2 boosts# and $<FLEETING_CHAR>.
LY_Rare_MagpengHoarder.flavor: Why does it need all these? Might come in handy someday!

LY_Rare_ManintheMaze.name: Man in the Maze
LY_Rare_ManintheMaze.effect: {H} Remove all boosts from Characters in play and in Reserve. Then, depending on the number of boosts removed this way:  • #1+#: I gain 2 boosts.  • #5+#: Play a card with Hand Cost {3} or less for free.  • #9+#: My Expedition moves forward one region.
LY_Rare_ManintheMaze.flavor: Life is a maze, but our purpose is not to escape it. The purpose of life is the maze itself.

LY_Rare_MapmakersBoon.name: Mapmaker's Boon
LY_Rare_MapmakersBoon.effect: If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, target Character gains 4 boosts. Otherwise, it gains 2 boosts.
LY_Rare_MapmakersBoon.flavor: Each of us paints their own reality.

LY_Rare_Martengale.name: Martengale
LY_Rare_Martengale.effect: #If you would roll a die, you may add 1 to its result.# (Choose after you see the result.)
LY_Rare_Martengale.support: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Rare_Martengale.flavor: Spotting a martengale is always a good omen.

LY_Rare_Melusine.name: Melusine
LY_Rare_Melusine.effect: {H} If I'm in a #single-terrain region,# <SABOTAGE_LOW>. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.

LY_Rare_MerryReunion.name: Merry Reunion
LY_Rare_MerryReunion.effect: #<COOLDOWN>.# (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  <RESUPPLY>. If you put a Character in Reserve this way, you may then #put it in your hand.#

LY_Rare_Metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
LY_Rare_Metamorphosis.effect: <FLEETING>.  Discard target Character #with Hand Cost {5} or less#, then create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in its Expedition.
LY_Rare_Metamorphosis.flavor: Every reality contains its share of illusions.

LY_Rare_MiaPrimaBallerina.name: Mia, Prima Ballerina
LY_Rare_MiaPrimaBallerina.effect: #When you pass - You may activate my {D} ability. If you do, I gain <FLEETING>.#
LY_Rare_MiaPrimaBallerina.flavor: The former Matriarch of the Kasirga clan leads the dance, however macabre it may be.

LY_Rare_MightyJinn.name: Mighty Jinn

LY_Rare_TheUndergrowth.name: The Undergrowth
LY_Rare_TheUndergrowth.effect: {T} : The next Character you play in {V} this turn gains 1 boost.

LY_Rare_TheWayfarer.name: The Wayfarer
LY_Rare_TheWayfarer.effect: If you would roll one or more dice, also reveal the top card of your deck.  When you reveal a card this way — If its Hand Cost is equal to the die's result, #you may exhaust me ({T}) to play it for free.# (Don't activate any {h} abilities.)
LY_Rare_TheWayfarer.flavor: The Tisdhera Clan answers its Matriarch's call!

LY_Rare_TheWellofTears.name: The Well of Tears
LY_Rare_TheWellofTears.effect: When you play a #card# with Base Cost {4} or more — You may give target Character 1 boost. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
LY_Rare_TheWellofTears.flavor: A crack in the heart of the Kadigir...

LY_Rare_TheWesternWind.name: The Western Wind
LY_Rare_TheWesternWind.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target Expedition #you control# moves backwards one region. If it does, move your other Expedition forward one region.
LY_Rare_TheWesternWind.flavor: It's no use going against the Wind.

LY_Rare_TinkerBell.name: Tinker Bell
LY_Rare_TinkerBell.flavor: Ting! Ting-a-ling! There's something magical in mischievous tinkering...

LY_Rare_TomoeGozen.name: Tomoe Gozen
LY_Rare_TomoeGozen.effect: I can't be played if you have less than #six Mana Orbs#.
LY_Rare_TomoeGozen.flavor: For only the most gifted of Alterers could bring humanity's long-remembered legends to life.

LY_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.name: Twinkle Twinkle
LY_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.effect: #$<FLEETING>.#  #All Characters in target Expedition# gain <ASLEEP>. (This only affects one player's Characters. During Dusk, ignore their statistics. During Rest, they don't go to Reserve and they lose Asleep.)
LY_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.support: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Rare_TwinkleTwinkle.flavor: Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky.

LY_Rare_UnfairEncounter.name: Unfair Encounter
LY_Rare_UnfairEncounter.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target a Landmark Permanent with Hand Cost {2} or less. #Its controller <RESUPPLIES>,# then you take control of it. (It joins your Landmarks.)

LY_Rare_UrbexSpecialist.name: Urbex Specialist
LY_Rare_UrbexSpecialist.effect: If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, my {V}, {M} and {O} are equal to my highest statistic. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)  #{J} If I'm not <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 1 boost.#
LY_Rare_UrbexSpecialist.flavor: Exploration is always fun with the right company!

LY_Rare_WillotheWisp.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
LY_Rare_WillotheWisp.effect: If an Expedition facing me is in {O}, it can’t move forward during Dusk, except due to {O}.
LY_Rare_WillotheWisp.support: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
LY_Rare_WillotheWisp.flavor: "Nine fathom deep he had followed us - From the land of mist and snow."

LY_Rare_WinterNova.name: Winter Nova
LY_Rare_WinterNova.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose three. #You may pick the same option multiple times:#  • Exhaust up to two cards in Reserve.  • Create two <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens in target Expedition.  • Discard target Permanent.  • Target player sacrifices a Character.
LY_Rare_WinterNova.flavor: A forgotten power waits to be awakened.

LY_Rare_WinterOutfits.name: Winter Outfits
LY_Rare_WinterOutfits.effect: #{R} I lose <FLEETING>.#  Characters in my Expedition have their {V}, {M}, and {O} equal to their highest statistic.
LY_Rare_WinterOutfits.flavor: There's no such thing as bad weather, only bad clothing.

LY_Rare_XMarkstheSpot.name: X Marks the Spot
LY_Rare_XMarkstheSpot.effect: <FLEETING>.  Roll a die. Send target Character to the Xth position of its owner's deck, where X is the result. #If X is higher than the Hand Cost of the target, ready one mana Orb.#

LY_Rare_YongSuVerdantWeaver.name: Yong-Su, Verdant Weaver
LY_Rare_YongSuVerdantWeaver.effect: {J} #If you have three or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control,# I gain 2 boosts.

LY_Rare_YzmirEngraver.name: Yzmir Engraver
LY_Rare_YzmirEngraver.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to #discard target Character or Permanent# with Hand Cost {2} or less.
LY_Rare_YzmirEngraver.support: {I} #When you play another Character with a base statistic of 0# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
LY_Rare_YzmirEngraver.flavor: By mixing Sap into the ink, the power of the Sigils is augmented tenfold.

MU_Common_Aja.name: Aja
MU_Common_Aja.effect: {H} Each player puts the top card of their deck in their Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
MU_Common_Aja.flavor: She is the soul of the forest, the patron of herbal medicine. From herbs and roots, she mixes potent potions.

MU_Common_Arawn.name: Arawn
MU_Common_Arawn.flavor: The Wild Hunt comes to free the restless spirits.

MU_Common_ArjunSpike.name: Arjun & Spike
MU_Common_ArjunSpike.effect: {T}, Discard a card from your Reserve: the next Character you play this turn with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)
MU_Common_ArjunSpike.flavor: When you care for the earth, it let roots grow strong and resilient.

MU_Common_ArmoredBird.name: Armored Bird
MU_Common_ArmoredBird.flavor: He raised a shield of feathers. Lances and harpoons shattered against his steely wings.

MU_Common_BeautySleep.name: Beauty Sleep
MU_Common_BeautySleep.effect: Target Character gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
MU_Common_BeautySleep.flavor: Yet beware of splinters of flax.

MU_Common_BountifulMeadow.name: Bountiful Meadow
MU_Common_BountifulMeadow.effect: {T} : The next Plant you play this turn costs {1} less.
MU_Common_BountifulMeadow.flavor: There's no greater joy than seeing all that is green thrive and grow.

MU_Common_BraveCub.name: Brave Cub
MU_Common_BraveCub.flavor: "Graaawr! The whole pack will stand with humankind, for the wolf is feared by all!"

MU_Common_Bumblebeet.name: Bumblebeet
MU_Common_Bumblebeet.support: {I} At Noon — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
MU_Common_Bumblebeet.flavor: On the surface, pollination by bumblebeets is a key tool in growing Muna crops.

MU_Common_BurrowingNoosh.name: Burrowing Noosh
MU_Common_BurrowingNoosh.flavor: It takes years for roots to punch their way through the hardest stone, but for them it only takes a few hours.

MU_Common_Cernunnos.name: Cernunnos
MU_Common_Cernunnos.flavor: You can feel it in the trees, deep beneath their roots – the very heartbeat of nature.

MU_Common_CharitableReka.name: Charitable Reka
MU_Common_CharitableReka.flavor: Opulence is a state of grace that forever teeters on the precipice.

MU_Common_ColorfulCuckoo.name: Colorful Cuckoo
MU_Common_ColorfulCuckoo.effect: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — I gain 1 boost.
MU_Common_ColorfulCuckoo.flavor: Even the shyest become a bit less reserved when they hear its song.

MU_Common_ConiferalConeman.name: Coniferal Coneman
MU_Common_ConiferalConeman.flavor: "Dosukoi! Let’s put it in the ground!"

MU_Common_CorruptedWoollyback.name: Corrupted Woollyback
MU_Common_CorruptedWoollyback.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless there's an Animal in an opponent's Expedition.
MU_Common_CorruptedWoollyback.flavor: There's a black sheep in the family.

MU_Common_CountingSheep.name: Counting Sheep
MU_Common_CountingSheep.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target two Expeditions and create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in each one. Then, each Character with Hand Cost {1} or less gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore their statistics. During Rest, they don't go to Reserve and lose Asleep.)
MU_Common_CountingSheep.flavor: The deepest sleep is woven from the wool of sweet dreams.

MU_Common_CuddlyCorgi.name: Cuddly Corgi
MU_Common_CuddlyCorgi.effect: When a Character you control gains <ANCHORED> — I gain 1 boost.
MU_Common_CuddlyCorgi.flavor: She hunts mercilessly for treats and snuggles.

MU_Common_Dapeng.name: Dapeng
MU_Common_Dapeng.support: {D} : Each player draws a card. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Common_Dapeng.flavor: With Turuun on its back, it carries a branch of the Spindle Tree in its beak.

MU_Common_DaughterofNaos.name: Daughter of Naos
MU_Common_DaughterofNaos.effect: If I'm <ANCHORED_FS>, I'm <DEFENDER_FS>. (My Expedition can't move forward during Dusk.)  {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.
MU_Common_DaughterofNaos.flavor: The torture of the Naos must cease.

MU_Common_DaughterofYggdrasil.name: Daughter of Yggdrasil
MU_Common_DaughterofYggdrasil.flavor: The children of Yggdrasil now take care of the world trees.

MU_Common_Dawon.name: Dawon
