MU_Common_Dawon.effect: {H} You may target another Character with {V} less than or equal to mine. It gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)
MU_Common_Dawon.flavor: "Come to me, Dawon, that I might summon the spirit of Durga!" — Parvati

MU_Common_Dracaena.name: Dracaena
MU_Common_Dracaena.effect: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  At Noon — I gain 1 boost.
MU_Common_Dracaena.flavor: They're sometimes seen dozing close to a pond, soaking in the water and the sunlight...

MU_Common_DrowsyDodo.name: Drowsy Dodo
MU_Common_DrowsyDodo.effect: {J} I gain <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore my statistics. During Rest, I don't go to Reserve and I lose Asleep.)  When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — You may have me lose <ASLEEP>.
MU_Common_DrowsyDodo.flavor: After all that work, it's time for the dodo to go night-night.

MU_Common_EruEmissaryoftheWild.name: Eru, Emissary of the Wild
MU_Common_EruEmissaryoftheWild.flavor: "Surrounded by all of his animal friends, my teacher never felt alone, even living as a hermit." - Kauri

MU_Common_FairFox.name: Fair Fox
MU_Common_FairFox.effect: {H} Target opponent <RESUPPLIES>. (They put the top card of their deck in Reserve.)
MU_Common_FairFox.flavor: Should we practice our passing now?

MU_Common_FloralTent.name: Floral Tent
MU_Common_FloralTent.effect: {J} $<RESUPPLY>.  If an <ANCHORED> Character would leave my Expedition during the Afternoon, it loses <ANCHORED> instead.
MU_Common_FloralTent.flavor: A beautiful shelter from the raging elements outside.

MU_Common_FloreCaringGardener.name: Flore, Caring Gardener
MU_Common_FloreCaringGardener.support: {I} At Noon — Another target Character in play or in Reserve gains 1 boost.
MU_Common_FloreCaringGardener.flavor: Every day that goes by without a Drillmole showing up is a blessing.

MU_Common_FloreFumingGardener.name: Flore, Fuming Gardener
MU_Common_FloreFumingGardener.effect: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) target Permanent in play or target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
MU_Common_FloreFumingGardener.flavor: "The Naos has been drained from intensive use!"

MU_Common_GatherthePack.name: Gather the Pack
MU_Common_GatherthePack.effect: {J} Target Character with Base Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)  When you pass — If three or more Animals in your Expeditions have a different Base Cost, complete me.
MU_Common_GatherthePack.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: <ANCHORED_CHA_P> Characters in your Expeditions are <TOUGH_CHA_P_1>. (Opponents must pay {1} to target them.)
MU_Common_GatherthePack.flavor: A wolf's strength is in its pack.

MU_Common_GranBwa.name: Gran Bwa
MU_Common_GranBwa.effect: {J} You may have target opponent draw a card. If you do, I gain $<ANCHORED>.
MU_Common_GranBwa.support: {I} At Noon — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
MU_Common_GranBwa.flavor: Make an offering of Sap and spiced rum, and Gran Bwa will bless your orchard.

MU_Common_Harvest.name: Harvest
MU_Common_Harvest.flavor: The thankful receiver bears a plentiful harvest.

MU_Common_HelpfulPelican.name: Helpful Pelican
MU_Common_HelpfulPelican.flavor: It's not unusual to see these pelicans ferrying small local creatures from one island to the next.

MU_Common_HerdingPuli.name: Herding Puli
MU_Common_HerdingPuli.effect: {J} Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in the Expedition facing me. It gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)
MU_Common_HerdingPuli.flavor: "Come on, Bobble, watch over them. Bring them to daddy!"

MU_Common_Hesperide.name: Hesperide
MU_Common_Hesperide.effect: {H} You may pay {2} to return target Permanent to its owner's hand.
MU_Common_Hesperide.flavor: "No matter what they say, the Naos is suffering, just like the Nilam before it!"

MU_Common_HuffandPuff.name: Huff and Puff
MU_Common_HuffandPuff.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Target Character you control gains 1 boost. Then, target another Character with equal or lower {V} and send it to Reserve.
MU_Common_HuffandPuff.flavor: "This time, I will blow you all down!"

MU_Common_Hydracaena.name: Hydracaena
MU_Common_Hydracaena.effect: $<ETERNAL>.  {J} I gain 4 boosts.  At Noon — I gain 4 boosts.
MU_Common_Hydracaena.flavor: When they reach adult size, it's clear that the Dracaenas have really thrived on all that rest and relaxation.

MU_Common_IceboundTaiga.name: Icebound Taiga
MU_Common_IceboundTaiga.effect: When you play a Character in {V} — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then it gains <ANCHORED>.
MU_Common_IceboundTaiga.flavor: We can sense it in the woodland silences, like a tremor.

MU_Common_Inari.name: Inari
MU_Common_Inari.flavor: Harmony may bloom from a single act of kindness, as a rice field may sprout from a single grain of rice.

MU_Common_JackFrost.name: Jack Frost
MU_Common_JackFrost.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
MU_Common_JackFrost.flavor: Another holiday... Just the icing on the cake!

MU_Common_JoiningFates.name: Joining Fates
MU_Common_JoiningFates.effect: <FLEETING>.  You may immediately play a Character for {7} less in your Companion Expedition. It gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)

MU_Common_KarhuLordofBears.name: Karhu, Lord of Bears
MU_Common_KarhuLordofBears.effect: {H} If you control another Animal, draw a card.
MU_Common_KarhuLordofBears.flavor: "Karhu, my old friend, wake from your slumber." — Rin

MU_Common_KauriPuff.name: Kauri & Puff
MU_Common_KauriPuff.effect: At Noon — If you are first player, create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target opponent's Companion Expedition, then draw a card.
MU_Common_KauriPuff.flavor: The language of nature has no use for words

MU_Common_KaurisIntervention.name: Kauri's Intervention
MU_Common_KaurisIntervention.effect: $<FLEETING>.  This Day, Characters with Hand Cost {4} or more you control are <TOUGH_CHA_P_5>. (Opponents must pay {5} to target them.)

MU_Common_Kitsune.name: Kitsune
MU_Common_Kitsune.flavor: "Want to play a game of headman-hunter-fox with me? I promise not to cheat!"

MU_Common_Kodama.name: Kodama
MU_Common_Kodama.flavor: There's no greater blessing for a tree than to offer a home for a Kodama.

MU_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
MU_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

MU_Common_Leshy.name: Leshy
MU_Common_Leshy.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost for each Expedition in {V}.
MU_Common_Leshy.flavor: "I am strong, and you are in my woods!"

MU_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
MU_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less.

MU_Common_LostintheWoods.name: Lost in the Woods
MU_Common_LostintheWoods.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send target Character in {V} to Reserve.  • Discard target Permanent.
MU_Common_LostintheWoods.flavor: They're not out of the woods yet.

MU_Common_LuminousSwarm.name: Luminous Swarm
MU_Common_LuminousSwarm.effect: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  At Noon — Target Character in play or in Reserve gains 1 boost.
MU_Common_LuminousSwarm.flavor: They buzz about at night and spread their nectar when the sun is at its height.

MU_Common_MagicBeans.name: Magic Beans
MU_Common_MagicBeans.effect: {J} Target Character in my Expedition gains 1 boost.  My region is {V} in addition to its other types.

MU_Common_ManaReaping.name: Mana Reaping
MU_Common_ManaReaping.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Put target Character or Permanent in its owner's Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
MU_Common_ManaReaping.flavor: Everything is energy and that's all there is to it.

MU_Common_MeditationTraining.name: Meditation Training
MU_Common_MeditationTraining.effect: Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)
MU_Common_MeditationTraining.flavor: Don't think you are, know you are.

MU_Common_MightySimbi.name: Mighty Simbi
MU_Common_MightySimbi.effect: When my Expedition moves forward due to {V} — You may sacrifice me to draw a card.
MU_Common_MightySimbi.flavor: A single seed can start a forest.

MU_Common_MigratoryCrane.name: Migratory Crane
MU_Common_MigratoryCrane.effect: When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — You may have me switch Expeditions. (I leave my Expedition and join your other Expedition.)
MU_Common_MigratoryCrane.flavor: When the cranes start their migration, that's the signal that it's time to seek out new horizons.

MU_Common_MunaBotanist.name: Muna Botanist
MU_Common_MunaBotanist.effect: {H} Target opponent <RESUPPLIES>.  {H} You may target another Character with Base Cost {3} or less, it gains <ANCHORED>. (Its Base Cost is its Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or its Hand Cost if not.)
MU_Common_MunaBotanist.flavor: If the Juice gives life, then it must take it from somewhere.

MU_Common_MunaCaregiver.name: Muna Caregiver
MU_Common_MunaCaregiver.support: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Common_MunaCaregiver.flavor: "We don’t inherit the earth from our ancestors, we borrow it from our children."

MU_Common_MunaDruid.name: Muna Druid
MU_Common_MunaDruid.support: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Common_MunaDruid.flavor: "We are the sentinels of the Skein, always keeping a finger on the pulse of nature."

MU_Common_MunaSignet.name: Muna Signet
MU_Common_MunaSignet.effect: Choose one:  • Target three Expeditions and create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in each one.  • Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.  • Place a {V} Terrain Marker on target visible region. (It is {V} and loses its other terrains until the Marker is removed.)

MU_Common_NewtonsLaw.name: Newton's Law
MU_Common_NewtonsLaw.effect: <FLEETING>.  Create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks.  Then, send to Reserve target Character they control with Base Cost {3} or less. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)

MU_Common_NikauKaurisFather.name: Nikau, Kauri's Father
MU_Common_NikauKaurisFather.effect: When an Animal joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
MU_Common_NikauKaurisFather.flavor: "Kauri, remember that courage is the happy medium between fear and recklessness!" — Nikau

MU_Common_Nurture.name: Nurture
MU_Common_Nurture.effect: Up to two target Characters each gain 1 boost$<BB>.
MU_Common_Nurture.flavor: When the sun shines, we'll shine together.

MU_Common_Pan.name: Pan
MU_Common_Pan.effect: {H} <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a card this way, create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in the Companion Expedition of its owner. (Sabotage means to discard up to one card from any Reserve.)
MU_Common_Pan.flavor: He's definitely the black sheep around here!

MU_Common_Parvati.name: Parvati
MU_Common_Parvati.effect: {H} Target Character gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)
MU_Common_Parvati.flavor: Only in harmony can the world thrive.

MU_Common_Persephone.name: Persephone
MU_Common_Persephone.effect: My region is {V} in addition to its other types.
MU_Common_Persephone.flavor: After every winter must come spring.

MU_Common_PicnicArea.name: Picnic Area
MU_Common_PicnicArea.effect: {J} Each player <RESUPPLIES>.  When you make a <GIFT> — You may exhaust me ({T}) to have target Character gain 1 boost. (A Gift is when on your turn, an opponent draws a card, Resupplies or receives a token.)

MU_Common_PuffsChallenge.name: Puff's Challenge
MU_Common_PuffsChallenge.effect: $<FLEETING>.  If an opponent controls three or more Characters, I cost {1} less.  Send target Character to Reserve.
MU_Common_PuffsChallenge.flavor: Wearing red might have been a mistake...

MU_Common_RabbitFarmer.name: Rabbit Farmer
MU_Common_RabbitFarmer.effect: When you make a <GIFT> — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost. (A Gift is when on your turn, an opponent draws a card, Resupplies or receives a token.)
MU_Common_RabbitFarmer.flavor: The pleasure of giving, the joy of receiving.

MU_Common_Raksha.name: Raksha
MU_Common_Raksha.effect: {J} You may target another Character with {V} less than or equal to mine. It gains 1 boost.
MU_Common_Raksha.flavor: "The little one is mine! He shall live to run with the pack and to hunt with the pack!"

MU_Common_RekaAgronomist.name: Reka Agronomist
MU_Common_RekaAgronomist.effect: {H} Create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
MU_Common_RekaAgronomist.flavor: "By crossing the fruits of the two world trees, we could obtain a fertile specimen."

MU_Common_RekaGatherer.name: Reka Gatherer
MU_Common_RekaGatherer.support: {D} : Create a <MANASEED> token in each player's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
MU_Common_RekaGatherer.flavor: There always comes a time to reap what we sow.

MU_Common_RekaTradesman.name: Reka Tradesman
MU_Common_RekaTradesman.effect: {R} <RESUPPLY>, then create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")

MU_Common_RepotterOtter.name: Repotter Otter
MU_Common_RepotterOtter.effect: {J} Each player may put a card from their Hand in Reserve.

MU_Common_Requiem.name: Requiem
MU_Common_Requiem.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Discard target <FLEETING> Character with Hand Cost {4} or less.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or less.
MU_Common_Requiem.flavor: Preserving harmony. Maintaining balance. Sometimes one thing must die so that another may live.

MU_Common_ResentfulRobin.name: Resentful Robin
MU_Common_ResentfulRobin.effect: {J} If I'm facing a Character, I gain 1 boost.
MU_Common_ResentfulRobin.flavor: Despite their small size, Rhodopean robins will defend their territory with beak and claw.

MU_Common_RinOrchid.name: Rin & Orchid
MU_Common_RinOrchid.effect: When one of your Expeditions moves forward due to {V} — Draw a card, then put a card from your hand in Reserve.
MU_Common_RinOrchid.flavor: The forest always gives back, when you know where to look.

MU_Common_RunningwiththeWolves.name: Running with the Wolves
MU_Common_RunningwiththeWolves.effect: <FLEETING>.  Reveal the top five cards of your deck. Choose Animals from them with total Hand Cost {7} or less and play them for free. (Don't activate their {h} abilities.) Discard the rest.
MU_Common_RunningwiththeWolves.flavor: If you run with the wolves, you'd best learn to howl!

MU_Common_SapDispersal.name: Sap Dispersal
MU_Common_SapDispersal.effect: Characters in your Reserve gain 1 boost.

MU_Common_SaskiaSlyNaturalist.name: Saskia, Sly Naturalist
MU_Common_SaskiaSlyNaturalist.effect: {J} You may target another Character in {V}. It gains 2 boosts.
MU_Common_SaskiaSlyNaturalist.flavor: Parasitic or symbiotic, life will always find a way to blossom... like this algae.

MU_Common_SnoozerShroom.name: Snoozer Shroom
MU_Common_SnoozerShroom.support: {D} : Target Character you control with Hand Cost {4} or less gains <ASLEEP>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

MU_Common_SonofNaos.name: Son of Naos
MU_Common_SonofNaos.flavor: Can such entities be found near all world trees?

MU_Common_SonofYggdrasil.name: Son of Yggdrasil
MU_Common_SonofYggdrasil.flavor: World trees like the Spindle may have grown from the seeds of the Cosmic Ash.

MU_Common_SoulEncounter.name: Soul Encounter
MU_Common_SoulEncounter.effect: Distribute 4 boosts among any target Characters in play or in Reserve.
MU_Common_SoulEncounter.flavor: "Let us offer the Musubi to the Reka, so that new Exalts might be born!"

MU_Common_Sow.name: Sow
MU_Common_Sow.effect: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Target Character gains 1 boost.
MU_Common_Sow.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Common_Sow.flavor: The wise gardener prepares ahead of spring.

MU_Common_SpindleHarvesters.name: Spindle Harvesters
MU_Common_SpindleHarvesters.flavor: Some say the harvesters are the caretakers of the world-trees.

MU_Common_StigmaofBelligerence.name: Stigma of Belligerence
MU_Common_StigmaofBelligerence.effect: {H} If I'm facing one or more Characters, target one of them and we both gain <ANCHORED>.

MU_Common_Sustenance.name: Sustenance
MU_Common_Sustenance.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Draw a card.  Each player puts the top card of their deck in their Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
MU_Common_Sustenance.flavor: Anything goes when there are empty bellies to be filled.

MU_Common_Tane.name: Tāne
MU_Common_Tane.effect: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  {J} Each Animal in your Reserve gains 1 boost.
MU_Common_Tane.flavor: Firmly rooted like a tree, yet free like the birds, he embodies nature's strength.

MU_Common_TeijaNauraa.name: Teija & Nauraa
MU_Common_TeijaNauraa.effect: The first Character you play each Afternoon gains 1 boost$<BB>.
MU_Common_TeijaNauraa.flavor: Nature must be nurtured to fully express its generosity.

MU_Common_TheBeastofGevaudan.name: The Beast of Gévaudan
MU_Common_TheBeastofGevaudan.effect: {H} You may target another Character with {V} less than or equal to mine. It switches Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)
MU_Common_TheBeastofGevaudan.flavor: "When the wolf is at the door, the sheep are in danger."

MU_Common_TheBigBadWolf.name: The Big Bad Wolf
MU_Common_TheBigBadWolf.effect: {H} <SABOTAGE> a Character with {V} less than or equal to mine. (You may discard one such card from any Reserve.)

MU_Common_TheEmbassy.name: The Embassy
MU_Common_TheEmbassy.effect: {T}, Target opponent <RESUPPLIES>: The next Character you play this turn with Base Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Reserve Cost if played from Reserve, or Hand Cost if not.)
MU_Common_TheEmbassy.flavor: The Reka let the Muna build a natural embassy in the city.

MU_Common_TheFarm.name: The Farm
MU_Common_TheFarm.effect: At Noon — I gain 1 Food counter per Character you control.  {T}, Spend 2 of my Food counters: $<RESUPPLY_LOW>.
MU_Common_TheFarm.flavor: The Mess requires a farm that can consistently provide for its day-to-day needs.

MU_Common_TheLittleMouse.name: The Little Mouse
MU_Common_TheLittleMouse.effect: {H} <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a card this way, its owner <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLIES>. (They put the top card of their deck in Reserve, then they exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
MU_Common_TheLittleMouse.flavor: It fights tooth-for-tooth with the fairy.

MU_Common_TheMinotaur.name: The Minotaur
MU_Common_TheMinotaur.effect: $<SCOUT_3> {3}.  {J} Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)
MU_Common_TheMinotaur.flavor: As strong as an old oak with roots branching out beneath the ground.

MU_Common_TheNaos.name: The Naos
MU_Common_TheNaos.effect: $<TOUGH_1>.  At Noon — Draw a card, then create two <MANASEED> tokens in your Landmarks. (They are Permanents with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
MU_Common_TheNaos.flavor: Patiently, the Reka waited for their new world tree to grow.

MU_Common_TheSnowMaiden.name: The Snow Maiden
MU_Common_TheSnowMaiden.effect: {H} Target opponent may <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY_INF>. (They put the top card of their deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
MU_Common_TheSnowMaiden.flavor: Thus, as the snow falls under the sky's clear frost. She has awoken - Snegurochka is once again!

MU_Common_TheSpindleMunaBastion.name: The Spindle, Muna Bastion
MU_Common_TheSpindleMunaBastion.flavor: Within the Spindle's trunk is the Bark Refuge, the sanctuary where the Muna converse with sentient plants.

MU_Common_TheUndergrowth.name: The Undergrowth
MU_Common_TheUndergrowth.effect: {T} : The next Character you play in {V} this turn gains 1 boost.

MU_Common_TuruunBenih.name: Turuun & Benih
MU_Common_TuruunBenih.effect: When you make a <GIFT> — You may exhaust me ({T}) to also receive it. (A Gift is when on your turn, an opponent draws a card, Resupplies or receives a token.)  Ignore my ability during the first Day.
MU_Common_TuruunBenih.flavor: Bringing a fruit of the Spindle Tree to the Reka is a way for me to recapture my youth.

MU_Common_Verdantback.name: Verdantback
MU_Common_Verdantback.effect: I am $<DEFENDER> unless you control two or more other Plants.
MU_Common_Verdantback.flavor: Slow and steady wins the race.

MU_Common_WhiteFang.name: White Fang
MU_Common_WhiteFang.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.
MU_Common_WhiteFang.flavor: "The unknown was one of the chief elements that went into the making of fear." — Jack London

MU_Common_WildlifeMedic.name: Wildlife Medic
MU_Common_WildlifeMedic.effect: {H} <RESUPPLY>. If you put an Animal in Reserve this way, it gains 1 boost.
MU_Common_WildlifeMedic.flavor: Basira’s husband has been called back to treat the wounded animals.

MU_Common_WoollyWoollyField.name: Woolly Woolly Field
MU_Common_WoollyWoollyField.effect: {T} : Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target opponent's Companion Expedition. The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.

MU_Common_Woollyback.name: Woollyback
MU_Common_Woollyback.effect: (When I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)
MU_Common_Woollyback.flavor: The warmth of wool and the softness of cotton candy, now together on four legs.

MU_Common_Wyvern.name: Wyvern
MU_Common_Wyvern.effect: {H} You may send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {1} or less.
MU_Common_Wyvern.flavor: With their fluffy texture and cotton-candy flavor, woollybacks are wyverns' favorite prey.

MU_Common_Yeti.name: Yeti
MU_Common_Yeti.effect: {H} I gain $<ASLEEP>.  When another Character joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.

MU_Common_YongSuVerdantWeaver.name: Yong-Su, Verdant Weaver
MU_Common_YongSuVerdantWeaver.effect: {J} If you control two or more Plants, I gain 2 boosts$<BB>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)

MU_Common_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.name: Zaratan, Social Leviathan
MU_Common_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  {J} I gain 1 boost per Character in the Expeditions facing me.
MU_Common_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.flavor: We were sailing among the islands when one of them came to meet us.

MU_Exalted_PlagueofPrejudice.name: Plague of Prejudice
MU_Exalted_PlagueofPrejudice.effect: {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  {H} Send to Reserve each other Character with {V} less than or equal to mine.
MU_Exalted_PlagueofPrejudice.flavor: Injustice is fertile ground for evil.

MU_Exalted_PloutosRekaHexarch.name: Ploutos, Reka Hexarch
MU_Exalted_PloutosRekaHexarch.effect: {J} Target player <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLIES>.  When you make a <GIFT> — Target Character gains <ANCHORED>.
MU_Exalted_PloutosRekaHexarch.flavor: "My worker bees will increase our harvests!"

MU_Exalted_SoundtheHowl.name: Sound the Howl!
MU_Exalted_SoundtheHowl.effect: {J} Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target Expedition. It gains <ANCHORED>.  When you pass — If three or more Animals in your Expeditions have a different {V} stat, complete me.
MU_Exalted_SoundtheHowl.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: {T} : The next Animal you play this turn gains 1 boost.
MU_Exalted_SoundtheHowl.flavor: "The wolf does not wait for the hunt to come to him."

MU_Rare_ACappellaTraining.name: A Cappella Training
MU_Rare_ACappellaTraining.effect: Target Character gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
MU_Rare_ACappellaTraining.flavor: Thank you for being my metronome!

MU_Rare_Aja.name: Aja
MU_Rare_Aja.effect: #{J}# Each player puts the top card of their deck in their Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
MU_Rare_Aja.support: #{D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_Aja.flavor: She is the soul of the forest, the patron of herbal medicine. From herbs and roots, she mixes potent potions.

MU_Rare_Akhlut.name: Akhlut
MU_Rare_Akhlut.effect: When I gain 1 or more boosts — You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  {R} I gain 1 boost.
MU_Rare_Akhlut.flavor: They're deadly on land, and even deadlier in the water.

MU_Rare_AloeVera.name: Aloe Vera
MU_Rare_AloeVera.effect: #{J} You may pay {1} to have me gain $<ANCHORED>.#  At Noon — $<RESUPPLY>.

MU_Rare_AoifeFireAvatar.name: Aoife, Fire Avatar
MU_Rare_AoifeFireAvatar.effect: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  {J} You may have another target Character lose <FLEETING> and gain 1 boost.
MU_Rare_AoifeFireAvatar.flavor: When the Firebird's spark ignites within you, that's when you become worthy of joining the Phoenixian Guard.

MU_Rare_Arawn.name: Arawn
MU_Rare_Arawn.flavor: The Wild Hunt comes to free the restless spirits.

MU_Rare_Ariadne.name: Ariadne
MU_Rare_Ariadne.effect: When an opponent plays a Character — If there are no Characters in the Expedition facing me, that Character switches Expeditions.
MU_Rare_Ariadne.flavor: "Follow the thread, and you'll find me." — Ariadne

MU_Rare_ArmoredBird.name: Armored Bird
MU_Rare_ArmoredBird.effect: I am $<DEFENDER> #unless I'm facing two or more Characters.#
MU_Rare_ArmoredBird.flavor: He raised a shield of feathers. Lances and harpoons shattered against his steely wings.

MU_Rare_AscendedTrooper.name: Ascended Trooper
MU_Rare_AscendedTrooper.effect: #{J}# If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, I gain 1 boost. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.
MU_Rare_AscendedTrooper.flavor: After months of expeditions, Aedyt felt she had finally spread her wings.

MU_Rare_AxiomReprocessor.name: Axiom Reprocessor
MU_Rare_AxiomReprocessor.flavor: Nothing is created, nothing is lost, everything is transformed.

MU_Rare_AxiomScrambler.name: Axiom Scrambler
MU_Rare_AxiomScrambler.flavor: Pushing back the Tumult sometimes prevents other Alterers from materializing their Eidolons. Regrettable, but necessary.

MU_Rare_AyxasRepentedTyrant.name: Ayxas, Repented Tyrant
MU_Rare_AyxasRepentedTyrant.effect: {H} You may create a #<WOOLLYBACK> Animal# token in an opponent's Expedition to <SABOTAGE_LOW>.
MU_Rare_AyxasRepentedTyrant.flavor: "I warned you of the danger you were heading into." — Ayxas

MU_Rare_Bait.name: Bait
MU_Rare_Bait.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Up to three# target token Characters defect. (They each join the Expedition facing theirs, changing controllers.)
MU_Rare_Bait.flavor: They always say the grass is greener on the other side...

MU_Rare_BeautySleep.name: Beauty Sleep
MU_Rare_BeautySleep.effect: Target Character gains <ASLEEP>. #You may give it 2 boosts.# (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
MU_Rare_BeautySleep.flavor: Yet beware of splinters of flax.

MU_Rare_BestowingSloth.name: Bestowing Sloth
MU_Rare_BestowingSloth.flavor: "I'm not lazy, I'm just conserving energy."

MU_Rare_BountifulMeadow.name: Bountiful Meadow
MU_Rare_BountifulMeadow.effect: #{J} You may pay {1} to $<RESUPPLY_INF>.#  {T} : The next Plant you play this turn costs {1} less.
MU_Rare_BountifulMeadow.flavor: There's no greater joy than seeing all that is green thrive and grow.

MU_Rare_BraveCub.name: Brave Cub
MU_Rare_BraveCub.effect: #{H} You may discard target non-Companion token.#
MU_Rare_BraveCub.flavor: "Graaawr! The whole pack will stand with humankind, for the wolf is feared by all!"

MU_Rare_BravosPendekar.name: Bravos Pendekar
MU_Rare_BravosPendekar.effect: At Night — If I have 2 or more boosts, <SABOTAGE> after Rest.

MU_Rare_Bumblebeet.name: Bumblebeet
MU_Rare_Bumblebeet.support: {I} At Noon — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
MU_Rare_Bumblebeet.flavor: On the surface, pollination by bumblebeets is a key tool in growing Muna crops.

MU_Rare_BurrowingNoosh.name: Burrowing Noosh
MU_Rare_BurrowingNoosh.effect: #When an opponent draws one or more cards or <RESUPPLIES> — I gain 1 boost.#
MU_Rare_BurrowingNoosh.flavor: It takes years for roots to punch their way through the hardest stone, but for them it only takes a few hours.

MU_Rare_Caladrius.name: Caladrius
MU_Rare_Caladrius.effect: {H} You may send to Reserve target Character with #Hand Cost {1}# or less.
MU_Rare_Caladrius.flavor: With a simple glance, it reveals your destination.

MU_Rare_CatchoftheDay.name: Catch of the Day
MU_Rare_CatchoftheDay.effect: Return target Character or Permanent controlled by another player to its owner's hand.  Then, create a <MANASEED> token in that player's Landmarks.
MU_Rare_CatchoftheDay.flavor: There's no slipping through the net this time.

MU_Rare_Cernunnos.name: Cernunnos
MU_Rare_Cernunnos.flavor: You can feel it in the trees, deep beneath their roots – the very heartbeat of nature.

MU_Rare_Charge.name: Charge!
MU_Rare_Charge.flavor: Facing terrible odds and an unfathomably huge Leviathan, the Ordis legion charged nonetheless.

MU_Rare_CharitableReka.name: Charitable Reka
MU_Rare_CharitableReka.effect: #{J} Create a <MANASEED> token in each player's Landmarks.#
MU_Rare_CharitableReka.flavor: Opulence is a state of grace that forever teeters on the precipice.

MU_Rare_Chiron.name: Chiron
MU_Rare_Chiron.effect: {J} #Up to two target Characters# each gain 1 boost.
MU_Rare_Chiron.flavor: "And now, pray, mark all these things well in a wise heart."

MU_Rare_Cleanse.name: Cleanse
MU_Rare_Cleanse.effect: Roll a die. #On a 1-3, I gain <FLEETING>.# Then, you may send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {X} or less, where X is the result. (Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)
MU_Rare_Cleanse.flavor: "What do you think of my smoldering eyes?"

MU_Rare_ClothCocoon.name: Cloth Cocoon
MU_Rare_ClothCocoon.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Discard target <FLEETING_CHAR>, <ANCHORED> or <ASLEEP> Character.  • Discard target Permanent.

MU_Rare_ColorfulCuckoo.name: Colorful Cuckoo
MU_Rare_ColorfulCuckoo.effect: {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — I gain 1 boost.  #When I go to your Reserve from the Expedition zone, if I had 2 or more boosts — You may put a card from your Reserve in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).#
MU_Rare_ColorfulCuckoo.flavor: Even the shyest become a bit less reserved when they hear its song.

MU_Rare_ConiferalConeman.name: Coniferal Coneman
MU_Rare_ConiferalConeman.flavor: "Dosukoi! Let’s put it in the ground!"

MU_Rare_Coppelia.name: Coppélia
MU_Rare_Coppelia.effect: When I go to Reserve from your hand — You may play me for free and I gain $<ASLEEP>.
MU_Rare_Coppelia.flavor: Because of her artificial nature, she served as a model for the Faction's first Automata prototypes.

MU_Rare_CorruptedGargoyle.name: Corrupted Gargoyle
MU_Rare_CorruptedGargoyle.effect: #I can't be played# unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  #{J}# Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.
MU_Rare_CorruptedGargoyle.flavor: They have always instilled fear. As a group, they instill terror.

MU_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.name: Corrupted Jeanne
MU_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.effect: #I can't be played# unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create a #<WOOLLYBACK> Animal# token in each of your Expeditions.
MU_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.support: #{D} : Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target Expedition.#
MU_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.flavor: "I know they will all be driven out, except for those who die." — Jeanne

MU_Rare_CorruptedWoollyback.name: Corrupted Woollyback
MU_Rare_CorruptedWoollyback.effect: #I can't be played# unless there's an Animal in an opponent's Expedition.  #When I leave the Expedition zone — Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in my Expedition.#
MU_Rare_CorruptedWoollyback.flavor: There's a black sheep in the family.

MU_Rare_CountingSheep.name: Counting Sheep
MU_Rare_CountingSheep.effect: <FLEETING>.  Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token #in each Expedition.# Then, each Character with Hand Cost {1} or less gains <ASLEEP>.
MU_Rare_CountingSheep.flavor: The deepest sleep is woven from the wool of sweet dreams.

MU_Rare_CuddlyCorgi.name: Cuddly Corgi
MU_Rare_CuddlyCorgi.effect: When a Character you control gains <ANCHORED> — #That Character# gains 1 boost.
MU_Rare_CuddlyCorgi.flavor: She hunts mercilessly for treats and snuggles.

MU_Rare_Daikokuten.name: Daikokuten
MU_Rare_Daikokuten.effect: {J} Target opponent may immediately play a #card with Base Cost {4} or more# for free. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
MU_Rare_Daikokuten.flavor: If you never take a risk, you'll never be rewarded.

MU_Rare_Dapeng.name: Dapeng
MU_Rare_Dapeng.flavor: With Turuun on its back, it carries a branch of the Spindle Tree in its beak.

MU_Rare_DaughterofNaos.name: Daughter of Naos
MU_Rare_DaughterofNaos.effect: If I'm <ANCHORED_FS>, I'm <DEFENDER_FS>.  {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  #When you make a <GIFT> — If I have less than 2 boosts, I gain 1 boost.#
MU_Rare_DaughterofNaos.flavor: The torture of the Naos must cease.

MU_Rare_DaughterofYggdrasil.name: Daughter of Yggdrasil
MU_Rare_DaughterofYggdrasil.flavor: The children of Yggdrasil now take care of the world trees.

MU_Rare_Dawon.name: Dawon
MU_Rare_Dawon.effect: {H} You may target another Character with {V} less than or equal to mine. It gains <ANCHORED>.
MU_Rare_Dawon.flavor: "Come to me, Dawon, that I might summon the spirit of Durga!" — Parvati

MU_Rare_Demeter.name: Demeter
MU_Rare_Demeter.effect: #{J} Target Character gains <ANCHORED>.#  If I'm in {V}, I am $<ETERNAL_FS>.

MU_Rare_DepartedBrother.name: Departed Brother
MU_Rare_DepartedBrother.effect: #When you pass first —# You may pay {1} to draw a card.
MU_Rare_DepartedBrother.flavor: "In my memory, you're there every time I cross paths with a Leviathan." — Sol

MU_Rare_DonJuan.name: Don Juan
MU_Rare_DonJuan.effect: If I would go to Reserve from the Expedition zone, I gain <FLEETING> and defect instead. (I join the Expedition facing me, changing controllers.)

MU_Rare_DongDaShen.name: Dong Da Shen
MU_Rare_DongDaShen.effect: #At Noon — #You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

MU_Rare_Dracaena.name: Dracaena
MU_Rare_Dracaena.effect: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  At Noon — I gain #2 boosts#.
MU_Rare_Dracaena.flavor: They're sometimes seen dozing close to a pond, soaking in the water and the sunlight...

MU_Rare_DrowsyDodo.name: Drowsy Dodo
MU_Rare_DrowsyDodo.effect: {J} I gain <ASLEEP>.  When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — #I gain 1 boost.#
MU_Rare_DrowsyDodo.flavor: After all that work, it's time for the dodo to go night-night.

MU_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.name: Ebenezer Scrooge
MU_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.effect: #Cards played from Reserve cost {1} less, with a minimum cost of {1}.#
MU_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.support: {D} : Target Character you control with Hand Cost {4} or less gains <ASLEEP>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.flavor: Darkness is cheap, and that's why Scrooge liked it.

MU_Rare_Eros.name: Eros
MU_Rare_Eros.effect: {J} You may immediately play a Character for {3} less. #It gains <ANCHORED>#.
MU_Rare_Eros.flavor: He's got more than one arrow in his quiver.

MU_Rare_EruEmissaryoftheWild.name: Eru, Emissary of the Wild
MU_Rare_EruEmissaryoftheWild.effect: #{H} You may have target Character facing me gain <ANCHORED>. If you do, I gain $<ANCHORED>.#
MU_Rare_EruEmissaryoftheWild.flavor: "Surrounded by all of his animal friends, my teacher never felt alone, even living as a hermit." - Kauri

MU_Rare_Esmeralda.name: Esmeralda
MU_Rare_Esmeralda.flavor: Eidolon or not, you are our Shepherdess. You lead and we follow.

MU_Rare_FairFox.name: Fair Fox
MU_Rare_FairFox.effect: {H} #You may pay {1} to discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {2} or less.# If you do, its controller <RESUPPLIES>.
MU_Rare_FairFox.flavor: Should we practice our passing now?

MU_Rare_FlawedPrototype.name: Flawed Prototype
MU_Rare_FlawedPrototype.effect: {J} Sacrifice a #Plant# or Permanent. If you can't, sacrifice me.
MU_Rare_FlawedPrototype.flavor: "If we could just find a substitute for the missing parts, we could make it work."

MU_Rare_FloralTent.name: Floral Tent
MU_Rare_FloralTent.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  If an <ANCHORED> Character would leave my Expedition during the Afternoon, it loses <ANCHORED> instead.
MU_Rare_FloralTent.support: #{D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_FloralTent.flavor: A beautiful shelter from the raging elements outside.

MU_Rare_FloreCaringGardener.name: Flore, Caring Gardener
MU_Rare_FloreCaringGardener.support: {I} At Noon — Another target Character in play or in Reserve gains 1 boost.
MU_Rare_FloreCaringGardener.flavor: Every day that goes by without a Drillmole showing up is a blessing.

MU_Rare_FloreFumingGardener.name: Flore, Fuming Gardener
MU_Rare_FloreFumingGardener.effect: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) target Permanent in play. #Then you may exhaust# target card in Reserve.
MU_Rare_FloreFumingGardener.flavor: "The Naos has been drained from intensive use!"

MU_Rare_ForestNymph.name: Forest Nymph
MU_Rare_ForestNymph.effect: #{J}# If I'm facing an Expedition in {V}, you may have target Character gain <FLEETING>.
MU_Rare_ForestNymph.flavor: From an innocent seed, she creates wild forests.

MU_Rare_FrozenDelivery.name: Frozen Delivery
MU_Rare_FrozenDelivery.effect: #<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.# (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
MU_Rare_FrozenDelivery.flavor: Precious supplies. If only the lid wasn't frozen shut...

MU_Rare_FrozenReprocessor.name: Frozen Reprocessor
MU_Rare_FrozenReprocessor.effect: #{J} $<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.#  At Noon — <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.  You may keep one more card in Reserve during Night if it's exhausted.
MU_Rare_FrozenReprocessor.flavor: Nothing is created, nothing is lost... even to the frost.

MU_Rare_Ganesha.name: Ganesha
MU_Rare_Ganesha.effect: {J} For each #other Character# you control, you may activate its {j} abilities.
MU_Rare_Ganesha.flavor: Knowledge and wisdom must walk side by side.

MU_Rare_Gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
MU_Rare_Gargoyle.flavor: At the slightest sign of intrusion, these stone lookouts come to life and sound the alarm.

MU_Rare_GatherthePack.name: Gather the Pack
MU_Rare_GatherthePack.effect: {J} Target Character with Base Cost #{4} or less# gains <ANCHORED>.  When you pass — If three or more Animals in your Expeditions have a different Base Cost, complete me.
MU_Rare_GatherthePack.flavor: A wolf's strength is in its pack.

MU_Rare_GranBwa.name: Gran Bwa
MU_Rare_GranBwa.effect: {J} You may have target opponent draw a card. If you do, I gain <ANCHORED>.  #When an opponent draws one or more cards or <RESUPPLIES> — I gain 1 boost.#
MU_Rare_GranBwa.support: {I} At Noon — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
MU_Rare_GranBwa.flavor: Make an offering of Sap and spiced rum, and Gran Bwa will bless your orchard.

MU_Rare_GuidingOcelot.name: Guiding Ocelot
MU_Rare_GuidingOcelot.effect: {J} I gain #2 boosts.#  When another Character joins your Expeditions — You may spend 1 boost #from a Character you control# to give it 1 boost.
MU_Rare_GuidingOcelot.flavor: Who could be better at playing cat and mouse?

MU_Rare_HarryHoudini.name: Harry Houdini
MU_Rare_HarryHoudini.effect: {H} Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in an opponent's Expedition, then draw a card.
MU_Rare_HarryHoudini.flavor: The secret of illusion lies in misdirection.

MU_Rare_Harvest.name: Harvest
MU_Rare_Harvest.flavor: The thankful receiver bears a plentiful harvest.

MU_Rare_HelpfulDiver.name: Helpful Diver
MU_Rare_HelpfulDiver.effect: {J} You may <RUSH>. If you don't, target opponent <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLIES>. (Rush means playing another card immediately.)

MU_Rare_HelpfulPelican.name: Helpful Pelican
MU_Rare_HelpfulPelican.effect: #When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — If I'm facing only one Character, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.#
MU_Rare_HelpfulPelican.flavor: It's not unusual to see these pelicans ferrying small local creatures from one island to the next.

MU_Rare_HerdingPuli.name: Herding Puli
MU_Rare_HerdingPuli.effect: {J} Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in the Expedition facing me. It gains #<ASLEEP>.#
MU_Rare_HerdingPuli.flavor: "Come on, Bobble, watch over them. Bring them to daddy!"

MU_Rare_Hesperide.name: Hesperide
MU_Rare_Hesperide.effect: {H} You may return target Permanent to its owner's hand. #If you do, create a <MANASEED> token in its controller's Landmarks.#
MU_Rare_Hesperide.flavor: "No matter what they say, the Naos is suffering, just like the Nilam before it!"

MU_Rare_HostelNightkeeper.name: Hostel Nightkeeper
MU_Rare_HostelNightkeeper.effect: {H} You may target a Character. If you do, it gains <ASLEEP>, then create a <MANASEED> token in its controller's Landmarks.
MU_Rare_HostelNightkeeper.flavor: "Floor -2, room 217. Welcome to the Underlook Hostel."

MU_Rare_HuffandPuff.name: Huff and Puff
MU_Rare_HuffandPuff.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Choose an Animal you control,# then target another Character with equal or lower {V} and send it to Reserve.
MU_Rare_HuffandPuff.flavor: "This time, I will blow you all down!"

MU_Rare_Hydracaena.name: Hydracaena
MU_Rare_Hydracaena.effect: $<ETERNAL>.  #$<TOUGH_X>, where X is the number of plants you control.#  {J} I gain 4 boosts.  At Noon — I gain 4 boosts.
MU_Rare_Hydracaena.flavor: When they reach adult size, it's clear that the Dracaenas have really thrived on all that rest and relaxation.

MU_Rare_IceboundHollow.name: Icebound Hollow
MU_Rare_IceboundHollow.effect: When a card goes from your Hand or deck to Reserve — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then ready your cards in Reserve.
MU_Rare_IceboundHollow.flavor: In the caves and crevices, it wails and calls to us.

MU_Rare_IceboundTaiga.name: Icebound Taiga
MU_Rare_IceboundTaiga.effect: When you play a Character in {V} — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then it gains <ANCHORED>.
MU_Rare_IceboundTaiga.flavor: We can sense it in the woodland silences, like a tremor.

MU_Rare_Inari.name: Inari
MU_Rare_Inari.flavor: Harmony may bloom from a single act of kindness, as a rice field may sprout from a single grain of rice.

MU_Rare_Issunboshi.name: Issun-bōshi
MU_Rare_Issunboshi.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_Issunboshi.flavor: Small stature, big heart, immense adventures.

MU_Rare_JackFrost.name: Jack Frost
MU_Rare_JackFrost.effect: #{J}# You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
MU_Rare_JackFrost.flavor: Another holiday... Just the icing on the cake!

MU_Rare_JoiningFates.name: Joining Fates
MU_Rare_JoiningFates.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Target player# may immediately play a Character #for free# in their Companion Expedition. It gains <ANCHORED>.

MU_Rare_KakobaLegionCommander.name: Kakoba, Legion Commander
MU_Rare_KakobaLegionCommander.effect: {J} If you control three or more other Characters, I gain #3 boosts#.
MU_Rare_KakobaLegionCommander.flavor: The general who became a scholar; the scholar who became a senator.

MU_Rare_KarhuLordofBears.name: Karhu, Lord of Bears
MU_Rare_KarhuLordofBears.effect: #When you pass —# If you control another Animal, draw a card.
MU_Rare_KarhuLordofBears.flavor: "Karhu, my old friend, wake from your slumber." — Rin

MU_Rare_KaurisIntervention.name: Kauri's Intervention
MU_Rare_KaurisIntervention.effect: #Target a player.# This Day, Characters with Hand Cost #{3} or more that they control# are <TOUGH_CHA_P_5>.

MU_Rare_KelonElemental.name: Kelon Elemental
MU_Rare_KelonElemental.effect: {H} #You may# put a card from your hand in Reserve.
MU_Rare_KelonElemental.flavor: In true Axiom fashion, Kelon Elementals like to put everything to the taste.

MU_Rare_Kitsune.name: Kitsune
MU_Rare_Kitsune.effect: {H} Each player #<RESUPPLY_INF>.# (Put the top card of their deck in Reserve.)
MU_Rare_Kitsune.flavor: "Want to play a game of headman-hunter-fox with me? I promise not to cheat!"

MU_Rare_Kodama.name: Kodama
MU_Rare_Kodama.support: #{D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_Kodama.flavor: There's no greater blessing for a tree than to offer a home for a Kodama.

MU_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
MU_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve.  #{J} I gain <ANCHORED>.#

MU_Rare_LeoRelicExpert.name: Leo, Relic Expert
MU_Rare_LeoRelicExpert.effect: At Night — You may spend 1 counter from a card in your Reserve or Landmarks to <SABOTAGE_INF> after Rest.
MU_Rare_LeoRelicExpert.flavor: Certain ancient knowledge must not be allowed to fall into the wrong hands.

MU_Rare_Leshy.name: Leshy
MU_Rare_Leshy.effect: #$<GIGANTIC>.#  {J} I gain 1 boost for each Expedition in {V}.
MU_Rare_Leshy.flavor: "I am strong, and you are in my woods!"

MU_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
MU_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less #and gains 1 boost.#

MU_Rare_Loki.name: Loki
MU_Rare_Loki.effect: {H} Each player discards their hand, then draws three cards.

MU_Rare_LordKelvin.name: Lord Kelvin
MU_Rare_LordKelvin.effect: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
MU_Rare_LordKelvin.flavor: "When you are face to face with a difficulty, you are up against a discovery."

MU_Rare_LostintheWoods.name: Lost in the Woods
MU_Rare_LostintheWoods.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send target Character to Reserve. #If it wasn't in {V}, its controller draws a card.#  • Discard target Permanent.
MU_Rare_LostintheWoods.flavor: They're not out of the woods yet.

MU_Rare_LuminousSwarm.name: Luminous Swarm
MU_Rare_LuminousSwarm.effect: {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  At Noon — #Up to two# target Characters in play or in Reserve each gain 1 boost.
MU_Rare_LuminousSwarm.flavor: They buzz about at night and spread their nectar when the sun is at its height.

MU_Rare_LyraClothDancer.name: Lyra Cloth Dancer
MU_Rare_LyraClothDancer.effect: {H} Up to one target Character gains <FLEETING_CHAR>. (If it would be sent to Reserve, discard it instead.)
MU_Rare_LyraClothDancer.flavor: Hope you're not afraid of heights!

MU_Rare_LyraContortionist.name: Lyra Contortionist
MU_Rare_LyraContortionist.support: {I} I don't count towards your Reserve limit.
MU_Rare_LyraContortionist.flavor: The Lyra from the Tisdhera clan will bend over backwards for their community.

MU_Rare_LyraFestival.name: Lyra Festival
MU_Rare_LyraFestival.effect: {J} Draw a card.  At Dusk, if you control a <FLEETING> Character, another <ANCHORED> Character and yet another <ASLEEP> Character — You win the game.
MU_Rare_LyraFestival.flavor: When the time of the Kalann Mae comes, the Lyra all feel the call to a single place, where they will bring a masterpiece to life.

MU_Rare_LyraMapmaker.name: Lyra Mapmaker
MU_Rare_LyraMapmaker.effect: #{H} If five or more single-terrain regions are visible, target Character gains <ASLEEP>.#  {J} If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, I gain 1 boost.
MU_Rare_LyraMapmaker.flavor: When the map covers the whole landscape, which one is more real?

MU_Rare_LyraThespian.name: Lyra Thespian
MU_Rare_LyraThespian.effect: {J} If you control #two or more <BOOSTED_CHA_P> Characters#, I gain #2 boosts#.

MU_Rare_MagicBeans.name: Magic Beans
MU_Rare_MagicBeans.effect: {J} Target Character in my Expedition gains 1 boost.  My region #and the region of the Expedition facing me# are {V} #and lose their other types.#

MU_Rare_ManaChanneling.name: Mana Channeling
MU_Rare_ManaChanneling.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
MU_Rare_ManaChanneling.flavor: There's only one way to turn the tide: by becoming stronger.

MU_Rare_ManaEruption.name: Mana Eruption
MU_Rare_ManaEruption.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Discard one of your Mana Orbs. If you do, discard target Character or Permanent.
MU_Rare_ManaEruption.flavor: Flames fly from his hand as he falls towards the monster, leaving a trail of glowing fire behind him...

MU_Rare_ManaReaping.name: Mana Reaping
MU_Rare_ManaReaping.effect: Put target Character or Permanent in its owner's Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
MU_Rare_ManaReaping.flavor: Everything is energy and that's all there is to it.

MU_Rare_Mandjet.name: Mandjet
MU_Rare_Mandjet.flavor: Mandjet and Mesektet, the Ordis flagships, reunited at last.

MU_Rare_MapmakersBoon.name: Mapmaker's Boon
MU_Rare_MapmakersBoon.effect: If three or more single-terrain regions are visible, target Character gains 4 boosts. Otherwise, it gains 2 boosts.
MU_Rare_MapmakersBoon.flavor: Each of us paints their own reality.

MU_Rare_MechanicalTraining.name: Mechanical Training
MU_Rare_MechanicalTraining.effect: Activate the {j} abilities of target #Character# you control.
MU_Rare_MechanicalTraining.flavor: To learn to create, first learn to fix.

MU_Rare_MeditationTraining.name: Meditation Training
MU_Rare_MeditationTraining.effect: Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)
MU_Rare_MeditationTraining.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_MeditationTraining.flavor: Don't think you are, know you are.

MU_Rare_MightySimbi.name: Mighty Simbi
MU_Rare_MightySimbi.effect: When my Expedition moves forward due to {V} — You may #put me in my owner's Mana zone# (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
MU_Rare_MightySimbi.flavor: A single seed can start a forest.

MU_Rare_MigratoryCrane.name: Migratory Crane
MU_Rare_MigratoryCrane.effect: When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — You may have me switch Expeditions.
MU_Rare_MigratoryCrane.flavor: When the cranes start their migration, that's the signal that it's time to seek out new horizons.

MU_Rare_MiladydeWinter.name: Milady de Winter
MU_Rare_MiladydeWinter.effect: {H} Take control of target token Permanent, putting it in my Expedition if it's an Expedition Permanent.
MU_Rare_MiladydeWinter.flavor: There's something so delectable about nabbing someone else's assets.

MU_Rare_MoltingCrab.name: Molting Crab
MU_Rare_MoltingCrab.effect: {J} Draw a card, then discard a card from your hand.
MU_Rare_MoltingCrab.flavor: It's pincers grips the fabric of reality.

MU_Rare_Mowgli.name: Mowgli
MU_Rare_Mowgli.support: #{D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

MU_Rare_MunaBotanist.name: Muna Botanist
MU_Rare_MunaBotanist.effect: {H} Target opponent #<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLIES>.#  {H} You may target another Character with Base Cost {3} or less, it gains <ANCHORED>. (Its Base Cost is its Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or its Hand Cost if not.)
MU_Rare_MunaBotanist.flavor: If the Juice gives life, then it must take it from somewhere.

MU_Rare_MunaCaregiver.name: Muna Caregiver
MU_Rare_MunaCaregiver.support: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_MunaCaregiver.flavor: "We don’t inherit the earth from our ancestors, we borrow it from our children."

MU_Rare_MunaDruid.name: Muna Druid
MU_Rare_MunaDruid.effect: #{H} Up to one target Plant gains 2 boosts.#
MU_Rare_MunaDruid.support: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_MunaDruid.flavor: "We are the sentinels of the Skein, always keeping a finger on the pulse of nature."

MU_Rare_MunaSignet.name: Muna Signet
MU_Rare_MunaSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Target three Expeditions and create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in each one.  • Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.  • Place a {V} Terrain Marker on target visible region. (It is {V} and loses its other terrains until the Marker is removed.)

MU_Rare_Nephele.name: Nephele
MU_Rare_Nephele.effect: {J} You may pass. #If you do,# create a <MANASEED> token in #another target player's# Landmarks.
MU_Rare_Nephele.flavor: Even the brightest day of sunshine has its clouds.

MU_Rare_NewtonsLaw.name: Newton's Law
MU_Rare_NewtonsLaw.effect: <FLEETING>.  Create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks.  Then, #discard# target Character they control with Base Cost {3} or less. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)

MU_Rare_NikauKaurisFather.name: Nikau, Kauri's Father
MU_Rare_NikauKaurisFather.effect: When an Animal joins #your other Expedition# — #It gains# 1 boost.
MU_Rare_NikauKaurisFather.flavor: "Kauri, remember that courage is the happy medium between fear and recklessness!" — Nikau

MU_Rare_Nike.name: Nike
MU_Rare_Nike.flavor: When she spreads her wings, her victory shall resonate for all eternity.

MU_Rare_Nurture.name: Nurture
MU_Rare_Nurture.effect: Up to two target Characters each gain #2 boosts$<BB>#.
MU_Rare_Nurture.flavor: When the sun shines, we'll shine together.

MU_Rare_Ogun.name: Ogun
MU_Rare_Ogun.flavor: With every blow of his hammer, Ogun forges the Axiom's destiny.

MU_Rare_OrdisAccountant.name: Ordis Accountant
MU_Rare_OrdisAccountant.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. #You may give it 2 boosts.#
MU_Rare_OrdisAccountant.support: {I} #At Noon# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
MU_Rare_OrdisAccountant.flavor: He has an annoying tendency to overwhelm you with numbers.

MU_Rare_OrdisGatekeeper.name: Ordis Gatekeeper
MU_Rare_OrdisGatekeeper.effect: {J} #Target Character# in your other Expedition #gains 2 boosts#.
MU_Rare_OrdisGatekeeper.flavor: The Aegis Sentinel opened the door and stepped aside to let her through, acknowledging her with a nod as she passed.

MU_Rare_OrdisLiaison.name: Ordis Liaison
MU_Rare_OrdisLiaison.effect: {J} Each other Character you control gains 1 boost.

MU_Rare_OrdisMessenger.name: Ordis Messenger
MU_Rare_OrdisMessenger.effect: #{J}# If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, #create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.# Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.
MU_Rare_OrdisMessenger.flavor: To maintain their cohesion, the Ordis must call on the most reliable of couriers.

MU_Rare_OrdisSignet.name: Ordis Signet
MU_Rare_OrdisSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Target Character gains <ASLEEP>.  • Target Character in Expedition or in Reserve loses all its boosts.  • Each Character in target Expedition gains 1 boost.

MU_Rare_OutofaClearSky.name: Out of a Clear Sky
MU_Rare_OutofaClearSky.effect: <FLEETING>.  I cost #{2} less# if at least one of your Expeditions is Ascended.  Send target Character to Reserve.
MU_Rare_OutofaClearSky.flavor: A swarm of messages bursts forth in a rustling of paper.

MU_Rare_PaintPrison.name: Paint Prison
MU_Rare_PaintPrison.effect: $<FLEETING>.  You may discard a card from your Reserve to reduce my cost by {2}.  Return target Character or Permanent to the top of its owner's deck.
MU_Rare_PaintPrison.flavor: Your problem is a lack of perspective.

MU_Rare_Pan.name: Pan
MU_Rare_Pan.effect: {H} <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a card this way, create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in the Companion Expedition of its owner. #You may have it gain <ASLEEP>.#
MU_Rare_Pan.flavor: He's definitely the black sheep around here!

MU_Rare_PartialReferee.name: Partial Referee
MU_Rare_PartialReferee.effect: {H} Discard target Character #or Permanent.# If its Base Cost was {3} or more, its controller draws a card. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)

MU_Rare_Parvati.name: Parvati
MU_Rare_Parvati.effect: #{J}# Target Character gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)
MU_Rare_Parvati.flavor: Only in harmony can the world thrive.

MU_Rare_Pasiphae.name: Pasiphaë
MU_Rare_Pasiphae.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost per Character target opponent controls.
MU_Rare_Pasiphae.flavor: She won't let herself be bullied.

MU_Rare_Pegasus.name: Pegasus
MU_Rare_Pegasus.effect: #{J} Each of your Expeditions <ASCENDS>.#  When #both of your Expeditions# move forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION> — #You win the game.#
MU_Rare_Pegasus.flavor: Even one life saved is a victory for us!

MU_Rare_Persephone.name: Persephone
MU_Rare_Persephone.effect: My region #and the region of the Expedition facing me# are {V} #and lose their other types.#
MU_Rare_Persephone.flavor: After every winter must come spring.

MU_Rare_PhysicalTraining.name: Physical Training
MU_Rare_PhysicalTraining.flavor: 100 crunches, 100 push-ups, 100 squats, a 10-km run and a desire to prove yourself. Just your typical morning of Bravos training.

MU_Rare_PicnicArea.name: Picnic Area
MU_Rare_PicnicArea.effect: {J} Each player #draws a card.#  When you make a <GIFT> — You may exhaust me ({T}) to have target Character gain 1 boost.

MU_Rare_Pinocchio.name: Pinocchio
MU_Rare_Pinocchio.effect: #{R} If there are three or more base statistics of 0 among Characters you control, draw a card.#
MU_Rare_Pinocchio.flavor: After that, he'll sleep like a log, and that's no lie.

MU_Rare_PuffsChallenge.name: Puff's Challenge
MU_Rare_PuffsChallenge.effect: <FLEETING>.  If an opponent controls three or more Characters, I cost #{2} less.#  Send target Character to Reserve.
MU_Rare_PuffsChallenge.flavor: Wearing red might have been a mistake...

MU_Rare_Quetzalcoatl.name: Quetzalcóatl
MU_Rare_Quetzalcoatl.effect: When an opponent draws one or more cards or does <RESUPPLY_T> — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.
MU_Rare_Quetzalcoatl.flavor: A soul has yet to be found who is bold enough to contest his wisdom.

MU_Rare_RabbitFarmer.name: Rabbit Farmer
MU_Rare_RabbitFarmer.effect: When you make a <GIFT> — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.
MU_Rare_RabbitFarmer.flavor: The pleasure of giving, the joy of receiving.

MU_Rare_Raiju.name: Raijū
MU_Rare_Raiju.flavor: It moves and strikes like lightning.

MU_Rare_Raksha.name: Raksha
MU_Rare_Raksha.effect: {J} #Up to two# other target Characters with {V} less than or equal to mine each gain 1 boost.
MU_Rare_Raksha.flavor: "The little one is mine! He shall live to run with the pack and to hunt with the pack!"

MU_Rare_ReaptheMana.name: Reap the Mana
MU_Rare_ReaptheMana.effect: {J} You may put a card from your Reserve in your Mana zone, exhausted. #If you do, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.#  When you pass — If there are twelve or more Mana Orbs in your Mana zone, complete me.
MU_Rare_ReaptheMana.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: If one of your Expeditions would move forward during Dusk, you may exhaust me ({T}) to make it move forward one more region instead.
MU_Rare_ReaptheMana.flavor: After Kojo, she's the second to have managed this feat.

MU_Rare_RekaAgronomist.name: Reka Agronomist
MU_Rare_RekaAgronomist.effect: #{J}# Create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks.
MU_Rare_RekaAgronomist.flavor: "By crossing the fruits of the two world trees, we could obtain a fertile specimen."

MU_Rare_RekaGatherer.name: Reka Gatherer
MU_Rare_RekaGatherer.effect: #At Noon — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.#
MU_Rare_RekaGatherer.support: {D} : Create a <MANASEED> token in each player's Landmarks.
MU_Rare_RekaGatherer.flavor: There always comes a time to reap what we sow.

MU_Rare_RekaGuide.name: Reka Guide
MU_Rare_RekaGuide.support: {D} : Return another Character from your Reserve to your hand.
MU_Rare_RekaGuide.flavor: "Let's wrap up today's visit with a taste of some local specialties."

MU_Rare_RekaInvestor.name: Reka Investor
MU_Rare_RekaInvestor.effect: At Dusk — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.  #When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.#
MU_Rare_RekaInvestor.flavor: "Trust me, it will all trickle down for everyone's benefit."

MU_Rare_RekaPeddler.name: Reka Peddler
MU_Rare_RekaPeddler.effect: {R} #You may# create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks. #If you do,# I lose <FLEETING>.

MU_Rare_RekaTradesman.name: Reka Tradesman
MU_Rare_RekaTradesman.effect: {R} Put the top card of your deck #in your Mana zone# (as an exhausted Mana Orb), then create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks.

MU_Rare_RepotterOtter.name: Repotter Otter
MU_Rare_RepotterOtter.effect: {J} Each player may put a card from their Hand in Reserve #to draw a card#.

MU_Rare_Requiem.name: Requiem
MU_Rare_Requiem.effect: #<COOLDOWN>.# (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Choose one:  • Discard target <FLEETING> #or <ASLEEP># Character with Hand Cost {4} or less.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or less.
MU_Rare_Requiem.flavor: Preserving harmony. Maintaining balance. Sometimes one thing must die so that another may live.

MU_Rare_ResentfulRobin.name: Resentful Robin
MU_Rare_ResentfulRobin.effect: {J} If I'm facing a Character, I gain 1 boost.  #{R} My Expedition <ASCENDS>.#
MU_Rare_ResentfulRobin.flavor: Despite their small size, Rhodopean robins will defend their territory with beak and claw.

MU_Rare_RimeFrost.name: Rime Frost
MU_Rare_RimeFrost.effect: #Choose one:  • Discard target exhausted card from a Reserve.#  • Exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
MU_Rare_RimeFrost.flavor: A late frost delays the spring.

MU_Rare_RunningwiththeWolves.name: Running with the Wolves
MU_Rare_RunningwiththeWolves.effect: <FLEETING>.  Reveal the top five cards of your deck. Choose Animals from them with total Hand Cost {7} or less and play them for free #as if from hand.# Discard the rest.
MU_Rare_RunningwiththeWolves.flavor: If you run with the wolves, you'd best learn to howl!

MU_Rare_SantaClaus.name: Santa Claus
MU_Rare_SantaClaus.effect: {H} Starting with you, each player may immediately play a card with Hand Cost {3} or less for free.

MU_Rare_SapDispersal.name: Sap Dispersal
MU_Rare_SapDispersal.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  #Double the number of boosts# on each Character #you control# and in your Reserve.

MU_Rare_SapDuende.name: Sap Duende
MU_Rare_SapDuende.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target #two Characters# in play or in Reserve and exchange their boosts.  Draw a card.
MU_Rare_SapDuende.flavor: When the rhythm picks up, the strings release the Sap covering them.

MU_Rare_SaskiaSlyNaturalist.name: Saskia, Sly Naturalist
MU_Rare_SaskiaSlyNaturalist.effect: {J} Target #any number# of other Characters in {V}. They gain 2 boosts.
MU_Rare_SaskiaSlyNaturalist.flavor: Parasitic or symbiotic, life will always find a way to blossom... like this algae.

MU_Rare_Simurgh.name: Simurgh
MU_Rare_Simurgh.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  {J} If you have less cards in Reserve than target opponent, draw a card.
MU_Rare_Simurgh.flavor: Three feathers. Each time you burn one, it will grant you its help.

MU_Rare_SmokingSkunk.name: Smoking Skunk
MU_Rare_SmokingSkunk.support: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Character you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}.
MU_Rare_SmokingSkunk.flavor: With certain opponents, you can litterally smell the danger.

MU_Rare_SneezerShroom.name: Sneezer Shroom
MU_Rare_SneezerShroom.effect: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  #At Noon — I gain 1 boost$<BB>.#

MU_Rare_SnoozerShroom.name: Snoozer Shroom
MU_Rare_SnoozerShroom.effect: #{H} You may pay {2}. If you do, target Character in the Expedition facing me gains <ASLEEP>.#
MU_Rare_SnoozerShroom.support: {D} : Target Character you control with Hand Cost {4} or less gains <ASLEEP>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

MU_Rare_Soar.name: Soar
MU_Rare_Soar.effect: Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.  #You may give 1 boost to target Character in an Ascended Expedition.#
MU_Rare_Soar.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.
MU_Rare_Soar.flavor: A Zephyr feather gives the Ordis the ability to fly.

MU_Rare_SofiaFirstOutpost.name: Sofia, First Outpost
MU_Rare_SofiaFirstOutpost.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  The Support abilities of cards in Reserve can give them #counters beyond their maximum#. (Ignore "up to a max." restrictions.)

MU_Rare_SonofNaos.name: Son of Naos
MU_Rare_SonofNaos.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  {J} #You may# target an opponent, they draw a card.  #When you make a <GIFT> — I gain 1 boost.#
MU_Rare_SonofNaos.flavor: Can such entities be found near all world trees?

MU_Rare_SonofYggdrasil.name: Son of Yggdrasil
MU_Rare_SonofYggdrasil.support: #{D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_SonofYggdrasil.flavor: World trees like the Spindle may have grown from the seeds of the Cosmic Ash.

MU_Rare_SoulEncounter.name: Soul Encounter
MU_Rare_SoulEncounter.effect: #$<COOLDOWN>.#  Distribute 4 boosts among any target Characters in play or in Reserve.
MU_Rare_SoulEncounter.flavor: "Let us offer the Musubi to the Reka, so that new Exalts might be born!"

MU_Rare_SouvenirSeller.name: Souvenir Seller
MU_Rare_SouvenirSeller.effect: {J} You may give me 1 boost. If you do, target opponent <RESUPPLIES>. (They put the top card of their deck in Reserve.)

MU_Rare_Sow.name: Sow
MU_Rare_Sow.support: {D} : #Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_Sow.flavor: The wise gardener prepares ahead of spring.

MU_Rare_SpindleHarvesters.name: Spindle Harvesters
MU_Rare_SpindleHarvesters.effect: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  #At Noon — if I have 2 or more boosts, $<RESUPPLY>.#
MU_Rare_SpindleHarvesters.flavor: Some say the harvesters are the caretakers of the world-trees.

MU_Rare_SpiritWielder.name: Spirit Wielder
MU_Rare_SpiritWielder.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost per #<ANCHORED># Character you control.  #{R} I gain $<ANCHORED>.#
MU_Rare_SpiritWielder.flavor: Memories of a forgotten civilization linger in those ruins. We are not alone.

MU_Rare_StickyShroom.name: Sticky Shroom
MU_Rare_StickyShroom.effect: {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  #At Noon — If I'm in {V}, create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.#
MU_Rare_StickyShroom.flavor: He's a fun guy, but he can get into some sticky situations.

MU_Rare_StigmaofBanality.name: Stigma of Banality
MU_Rare_StigmaofBanality.effect: {H} You may discard target Character with Base Cost #{1} or less.# If you do, create a #<WOOLLYBACK> Animal# token in its Expedition.
MU_Rare_StigmaofBanality.flavor: To be afraid of being different is to destroy individuality.

MU_Rare_StigmaofBelligerence.name: Stigma of Belligerence
MU_Rare_StigmaofBelligerence.effect: #{J}# #Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in another Expedition.# Then, if I'm facing one or more Characters, target one of them and we both gain <ANCHORED>.

MU_Rare_StigmaofHavoc.name: Stigma of Havoc
MU_Rare_StigmaofHavoc.effect: {H} Each player discards their Reserve, then #<RESUPPLIES>.#  #{J} <RESUPPLY>.#
MU_Rare_StigmaofHavoc.support: {D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.

MU_Rare_SunWukong.name: Sun Wukong
MU_Rare_SunWukong.flavor: Ever the trickster, always the rebel.

MU_Rare_Sustenance.name: Sustenance
MU_Rare_Sustenance.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Each player# draws a card.  Put the top card of #your# deck in #your# Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).
MU_Rare_Sustenance.flavor: Anything goes when there are empty bellies to be filled.

MU_Rare_TalarianSkater.name: Talarian Skater
MU_Rare_TalarianSkater.effect: $<SCOUT_1> {1}.  {J} Target Character in play #or in Reserve# gains 1 boost.
MU_Rare_TalarianSkater.flavor: To explore the City, adventurers need daily deliveries from the surface.

MU_Rare_Tane.name: Tāne
MU_Rare_Tane.effect: #<TOUGH_1>.# (Opponents must pay {1} to target me.)  {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  {J} Each Animal #and Adventurer# in your Reserve gains 1 boost.
MU_Rare_Tane.flavor: Firmly rooted like a tree, yet free like the birds, he embodies nature's strength.

MU_Rare_TerrifiedGhost.name: Terrified Ghost
MU_Rare_TerrifiedGhost.flavor: A terror that even ghosts can feel...

MU_Rare_TheBeastofGevaudan.name: The Beast of Gévaudan
MU_Rare_TheBeastofGevaudan.effect: {H} You may target another Character with {V} less than or equal to mine. It switches Expeditions.
MU_Rare_TheBeastofGevaudan.flavor: "When the wolf is at the door, the sheep are in danger."

MU_Rare_TheBigBadWolf.name: The Big Bad Wolf
MU_Rare_TheBigBadWolf.effect: {H} <SABOTAGE> a Character with {V} less than or equal to mine.
MU_Rare_TheBigBadWolf.support: #{D} : The next Character with Base Cost {3} or less you play this turn gains <ANCHORED>.#

MU_Rare_TheEmbassy.name: The Embassy
MU_Rare_TheEmbassy.effect: #<ANCHORED_CHA_P> and <ASLEEP_CHA_P> Characters you control are <TOUGH_CHA_P_1>.#  {T}, Target opponent <RESUPPLIES>: The next Character you play this turn with Base Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Reserve Cost if played from Reserve, or Hand Cost if not.)
MU_Rare_TheEmbassy.flavor: The Reka let the Muna build a natural embassy in the city.

MU_Rare_TheFarm.name: The Farm
MU_Rare_TheFarm.effect: At Noon — I gain 1 Food counter per Character you control.  {T}, Spend 2 of my Food counters: <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
MU_Rare_TheFarm.flavor: The Mess requires a farm that can consistently provide for its day-to-day needs.

MU_Rare_TheInfirmary.name: The Infirmary
MU_Rare_TheInfirmary.effect: #{J} <RESUPPLY>.#  {T}, Exhaust a card in your Reserve: <AFTER_YOU>.
MU_Rare_TheInfirmary.flavor: "I told you it was a bad idea to drink all that Sap Cola…"

MU_Rare_TheLittleMouse.name: The Little Mouse
MU_Rare_TheLittleMouse.effect: #{J}# <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a card this way, its owner <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLIES>. (They put the top card of their deck in Reserve, then they exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
MU_Rare_TheLittleMouse.flavor: It fights tooth-for-tooth with the fairy.

MU_Rare_TheMachineintheIce.name: The Machine in the Ice
MU_Rare_TheMachineintheIce.effect: When I go to Reserve from anywhere — Exhaust me ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  {H} Send me to Reserve.
MU_Rare_TheMachineintheIce.flavor: A relic left by those who came before.

MU_Rare_TheMinotaur.name: The Minotaur
MU_Rare_TheMinotaur.support: #{I} At Noon — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.#
MU_Rare_TheMinotaur.flavor: As strong as an old oak with roots branching out beneath the ground.

MU_Rare_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.name: The Monolith, Ordis Bastion
MU_Rare_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.effect: When a #non-token# Character joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.
MU_Rare_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.flavor: A beacon of knowledge and order, a lighthouse towering high above the world.

MU_Rare_TheNaos.name: The Naos
MU_Rare_TheNaos.effect: <TOUGH_1>.  #{J} Target Expedition can't move forward this Day.#  At Noon — Draw a card, then create two <MANASEED> tokens in your Landmarks.
MU_Rare_TheNaos.flavor: Patiently, the Reka waited for their new world tree to grow.

MU_Rare_TheSnowMaiden.name: The Snow Maiden
MU_Rare_TheSnowMaiden.effect: {H} Target opponent may <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY_INF> #twice#. (They put the top card of their deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}.)
MU_Rare_TheSnowMaiden.flavor: Thus, as the snow falls under the sky's clear frost. She has awoken - Snegurochka is once again!

MU_Rare_TheSpindleMunaBastion.name: The Spindle, Muna Bastion
MU_Rare_TheSpindleMunaBastion.effect: Characters you control have $<TOUGH_2>.  #At Noon — Target Character you control gains 1 boost.#
MU_Rare_TheSpindleMunaBastion.flavor: Within the Spindle's trunk is the Bark Refuge, the sanctuary where the Muna converse with sentient plants.

MU_Rare_TheStew.name: The Stew
MU_Rare_TheStew.effect: {J} Target Character gains 1 boost.  Characters in my Expedition are <SEASONED_CHA_P>. (They keep their boosts when they go to Reserve.)
MU_Rare_TheStew.flavor: Can you guess the secret ingredient? It's seasoned with Sap.

MU_Rare_TheTownSquare.name: The Town Square
MU_Rare_TheTownSquare.effect: At Dusk — I gain 1 Morale counter per Character you control.  {T}, Spend 6 of my Morale counters: #Characters you control# gain 1 boost.
MU_Rare_TheTownSquare.flavor: In light of the Ordis' well-known organizational advantages, the Factions entrusted them with outpost logistics.

MU_Rare_TheUglyDuckling.name: The Ugly Duckling
MU_Rare_TheUglyDuckling.effect: #{J} You may pay {1}. If you do, I gain 1 boost and my Expedition <ASCENDS>.#
MU_Rare_TheUglyDuckling.flavor: This young recruit swans about while proudly showing off his insignia.

MU_Rare_TheUndergrowth.name: The Undergrowth
MU_Rare_TheUndergrowth.effect: {T} : The next Character you play in {V} this turn gains 1 boost.  #When an opponent draws one or more cards or <RESUPPLIES> — Ready me.#

MU_Rare_Theseus.name: Theseus
MU_Rare_Theseus.effect: $<SCOUT_3> {3}.  {J} Return target Character to its owner's hand.  {R} I gain 2 boosts.
MU_Rare_Theseus.flavor: For the brave souls exploring the labyrinthine depths of the city, life often hangs by the thinnest of threads.

MU_Rare_TinyJinn.name: Tiny Jinn
MU_Rare_TinyJinn.effect: If I would leave the Expedition zone while I'm <BOOSTED>, put me in my owner's Mana zone instead (as an exhausted Mana Orb).  {R} I gain 1 boost.
MU_Rare_TinyJinn.flavor: It may be a fire today — tomorrow it will be ashes.

MU_Rare_UrbexSpecialist.name: Urbex Specialist
MU_Rare_UrbexSpecialist.effect: If I'm #in {V},# my {V}, {M} and {O} are equal to my highest statistic.  #{J} If I'm not in {V}, I gain 1 boost.#
MU_Rare_UrbexSpecialist.flavor: Exploration is always fun with the right company!

MU_Rare_Verdantback.name: Verdantback
MU_Rare_Verdantback.effect: I am $<DEFENDER> unless you control two or more other Plants.
MU_Rare_Verdantback.flavor: Slow and steady wins the race.

MU_Rare_WalrusScout.name: Walrus Scout
MU_Rare_WalrusScout.effect: #{R} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve.# (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

MU_Rare_WhiteFang.name: White Fang
MU_Rare_WhiteFang.effect: #{H} Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in another target Expedition.#
MU_Rare_WhiteFang.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.
MU_Rare_WhiteFang.flavor: "The unknown was one of the chief elements that went into the making of fear." — Jack London

MU_Rare_WigwaggingKiwi.name: Wigwagging Kiwi
MU_Rare_WigwaggingKiwi.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost per other #Animal in your Expeditions, up to a max of 2 boosts on me.#

MU_Rare_WildlifeMedic.name: Wildlife Medic
MU_Rare_WildlifeMedic.effect: #{J}# <RESUPPLY>. If you put an Animal in Reserve this way, it gains 1 boost.
MU_Rare_WildlifeMedic.flavor: Basira’s husband has been called back to treat the wounded animals.

MU_Rare_WillotheWisp.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
MU_Rare_WillotheWisp.effect: If the Expedition facing me is in #{V}#, it can only move forward due to #{V}#.
MU_Rare_WillotheWisp.support: {D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
MU_Rare_WillotheWisp.flavor: "Nine fathom deep he had followed us - From the land of mist and snow."

MU_Rare_WinterOutfits.name: Winter Outfits
MU_Rare_WinterOutfits.effect: #{R} I lose <FLEETING>.#  Characters in my Expedition have their {V}, {M}, and {O} equal to their highest statistic.
MU_Rare_WinterOutfits.flavor: There's no such thing as bad weather, only bad clothing.

MU_Rare_WoollyWoollyField.name: Woolly Woolly Field
MU_Rare_WoollyWoollyField.effect: #{J} Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target opponent's Companion Expedition.#  {T} : Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target opponent's Companion Expedition. The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.

MU_Rare_Wyvern.name: Wyvern
MU_Rare_Wyvern.effect: {H} You may send to Reserve #up to two# target Characters with Hand Cost {1} or less.
MU_Rare_Wyvern.flavor: With their fluffy texture and cotton-candy flavor, woollybacks are wyverns' favorite prey.

MU_Rare_XMarkstheSpot.name: X Marks the Spot
MU_Rare_XMarkstheSpot.effect: <FLEETING>.  Roll a die. Send target Character to the Xth position of its owner's deck, where X is the result. #If X is higher than the Hand Cost of the target, ready one mana Orb.#

MU_Rare_Yeti.name: Yeti
MU_Rare_Yeti.effect: {H} #You may have me# gain $<ASLEEP>.  When another Character joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.

MU_Rare_YongSuVerdantWeaver.name: Yong-Su, Verdant Weaver
MU_Rare_YongSuVerdantWeaver.effect: {J} If you control two or more Plants, I gain 2 boosts$<BB>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)

MU_Rare_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.name: Zaratan, Social Leviathan
MU_Rare_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  #{J} Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target Expedition.#  {J} I gain 1 boost per Character in the Expeditions facing me.
MU_Rare_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.flavor: We were sailing among the islands when one of them came to meet us.

NE_Common_Aerolith.name: Aerolith
NE_Common_Aerolith.effect: When I'm sacrificed — <RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.
NE_Common_Aerolith.flavor: With aerolith, gravity no longer constrains how we build.

NE_Common_DragonShade.name: Dragon Shade
NE_Common_DragonShade.effect: (If I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)
NE_Common_DragonShade.flavor: It is a shadow, a phantom, always hissing, always whispering. It wants to be found. It wants to be unleashed.

NE_Common_Manaseed.name: Manaseed
NE_Common_Manaseed.effect: {T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.
NE_Common_Manaseed.flavor: The Reka draw all of their riches from its Juice.

OD_Common_AdamantReceptionist.name: Adamant Receptionist
OD_Common_AdamantReceptionist.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control to <SABOTAGE_INF>. (Discard up to one card from a Reserve.)
OD_Common_AdamantReceptionist.flavor: "You're not on the list. Please move along."

OD_Common_AegisTemplar.name: Aegis Templar
OD_Common_AegisTemplar.effect: $<SCOUT_1> {1}.  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.
OD_Common_AegisTemplar.flavor: The Templars always ensure that the area is safe.

OD_Common_AngryCrowd.name: Angry Crowd
OD_Common_AngryCrowd.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Discard target Character or Permanent, then create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
OD_Common_AngryCrowd.flavor: Anger is often the fruit of frustration.

OD_Common_Anubis.name: Anubis
OD_Common_Anubis.flavor: Only a heart as light as a feather can stand up to the judgment of Anubis.

OD_Common_Ariadne.name: Ariadne
OD_Common_Ariadne.effect: When an opponent plays a Character — If there are no Characters in the Expedition facing me, that Character switches Expeditions.
OD_Common_Ariadne.flavor: "Follow the thread, and you'll find me." — Ariadne

OD_Common_AscendedTrooper.name: Ascended Trooper
OD_Common_AscendedTrooper.effect: {H} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, I gain 1 boost. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)
OD_Common_AscendedTrooper.flavor: After months of expeditions, Aedyt felt she had finally spread her wings.
