OD_Common_AyxasRepentedTyrant.name: Ayxas, Repented Tyrant
OD_Common_AyxasRepentedTyrant.effect: {H} You may create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in an opponent's Expedition to <SABOTAGE_LOW>.
OD_Common_AyxasRepentedTyrant.flavor: "I warned you of the danger you were heading into." — Ayxas

OD_Common_Benzaiten.name: Benzaiten
OD_Common_Benzaiten.effect: {J} If my Expedition is behind, draw a card.
OD_Common_Benzaiten.flavor: Good things come to those who wait.

OD_Common_Bluecap.name: Bluecap
OD_Common_Bluecap.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"When I'm sacrificed — Resupply. {T}, {1}: Sacrifice me.\")
OD_Common_Bluecap.flavor: To avoid sudden jolts, invest in stone.

OD_Common_CelebrationDay.name: Celebration Day
OD_Common_CelebrationDay.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Target Expedition can't move forward this Day.
OD_Common_CelebrationDay.flavor: Today, and for centuries to come, we will celebrate victory over the Kraken and revel in freedom regained!

OD_Common_Charge.name: Charge!
OD_Common_Charge.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Characters you control gain 1 boost$<BB>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Common_Charge.flavor: Facing terrible odds and an unfathomably huge Leviathan, the Ordis legion charged nonetheless.

OD_Common_Conscription.name: Conscription
OD_Common_Conscription.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Target an Expedition. Create X <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in it, where X is the number of cards in target player's Reserve.

OD_Common_CorruptedGargoyle.name: Corrupted Gargoyle
OD_Common_CorruptedGargoyle.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  {H} Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.
OD_Common_CorruptedGargoyle.flavor: They have always instilled fear. As a group, they instill terror.

OD_Common_CorruptedJeanne.name: Corrupted Jeanne
OD_Common_CorruptedJeanne.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.
OD_Common_CorruptedJeanne.flavor: "I know they will all be driven out, except for those who die." — Jeanne

OD_Common_CovertheRetreat.name: Cover the Retreat
OD_Common_CovertheRetreat.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.  When you pass — If seven or more Characters are in your Expeditions, complete me.
OD_Common_CovertheRetreat.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When you create a token Character — You may exhaust me ({T}) to give it 1 boost.

OD_Common_DelaytheCollapse.name: Delay the Collapse
OD_Common_DelaytheCollapse.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  When you pass — If the total Hand Cost of cards in your Landmarks is {6} or more, complete me.
OD_Common_DelaytheCollapse.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: Other cards in your Landmarks are <TOUGH_1>. (Opponents must pay {1} to target them.)
OD_Common_DelaytheCollapse.flavor: "Hold out for as long as possible. That's all that matters."

OD_Common_DongDaShen.name: Dong Da Shen
OD_Common_DongDaShen.effect: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

OD_Common_Doppelganger.name: Doppelgänger
OD_Common_Doppelganger.effect: {J} Target a Character facing me. I gain its subtypes and X boosts, where X equals its highest statistic. (I lose these subtypes when I leave the Expedition zone.)

OD_Common_EbenezerScrooge.name: Ebenezer Scrooge
OD_Common_EbenezerScrooge.support: {D} : Target Character you control with Hand Cost {4} or less gains <ASLEEP>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Common_EbenezerScrooge.flavor: Darkness is cheap, and that's why Scrooge liked it.

OD_Common_FieldReinforcements.name: Field Reinforcements
OD_Common_FieldReinforcements.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose one. If each of your Expeditions is behind or tied, you may choose both:  • Draw a card.  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.
OD_Common_FieldReinforcements.flavor: Supply lines can sometimes be the difference between failure and success.

OD_Common_FioredeiLiberi.name: Fiore dei Liberi
OD_Common_FioredeiLiberi.effect: If I'm <BOOSTED>, I'm $<ETERNAL>.  {J} I gain 1 boost per other Character in my Expedition, then send them all to Reserve.  At Night — I lose 1 boost.
OD_Common_FioredeiLiberi.flavor: "I am the sword, deadly against all weapons!" — Fiore

OD_Common_Galatea.name: Galatea
OD_Common_Galatea.effect: If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I'm <DEFENDER_FS>. (My Expedition can't move forward during Dusk. I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)  {J} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 2 boosts.
OD_Common_Galatea.flavor: If a sculptor merely frees the form from the stone, then it never belonged to him in the first place.

OD_Common_Gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
OD_Common_Gargoyle.effect: {H} Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)
OD_Common_Gargoyle.flavor: At the slightest sign of intrusion, these stone lookouts come to life and sound the alarm.

OD_Common_GrandEndeavor.name: Grand Endeavor
OD_Common_GrandEndeavor.effect: At Noon — Target Expedition moves forward one region.
OD_Common_GrandEndeavor.flavor: The Ordis built a relay of lighthouses to light the way through the Tumult.

OD_Common_GulrangTocsin.name: Gulrang & Tocsin
OD_Common_GulrangTocsin.effect: When you create a token Character — It gains 1 boost.  If you have less than eight Mana Orbs, <BOOSTED_TKN_P> tokens you control are <DEFENDER>. (Their Expeditions can't advance during Dusk.)
OD_Common_GulrangTocsin.flavor: The Ordis way lies in patience and resilience.

OD_Common_HealthInspector.name: Health Inspector
OD_Common_HealthInspector.effect: Cards in your opponent's Reserve can't gain counters.
OD_Common_HealthInspector.flavor: Using untested ingredients is a recipe for disaster.

OD_Common_Hippogriff.name: Hippogriff
OD_Common_Hippogriff.effect: {H} My Expedition <ASCENDS>.  When I leave an <ASCENDED_S> Expedition — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in it.

OD_Common_Hound.name: Hound
OD_Common_Hound.effect: {J} If my Expedition is behind, I gain 1 boost.
OD_Common_Hound.flavor: Like a dog with a bone.

OD_Common_Hypothermia.name: Hypothermia
OD_Common_Hypothermia.effect: Each player chooses a Character they control. It gains <ASLEEP>. (You choose first. Ignore the statistics of Asleep Characters during Dusk. At Rest, they don't go to Reserve and lose Asleep.)
OD_Common_Hypothermia.flavor: Fall asleep in the cold, and you might never wake up.

OD_Common_IceboundLake.name: Icebound Lake
OD_Common_IceboundLake.effect: When you play a Character — If its Expedition is behind, I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then target Character gains <ASLEEP>.
OD_Common_IceboundLake.flavor: With a voice like thunder or crackling ice it howls.

OD_Common_Issitoq.name: Issitoq
OD_Common_Issitoq.effect: Your other Expedition and the Expedition facing it can't move forward.
OD_Common_Issitoq.support: {D} : Draw a card. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Common_Issitoq.flavor: No one can escape their gaze.

OD_Common_JeannedArc.name: Jeanne d'Arc
OD_Common_JeannedArc.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.
OD_Common_JeannedArc.flavor: She'll be followed long after she's gone.

OD_Common_KakobaLegionCommander.name: Kakoba, Legion Commander
OD_Common_KakobaLegionCommander.effect: {J} If you control three or more other Characters, I gain 2 boosts$<BB>. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Common_KakobaLegionCommander.flavor: The general who became a scholar; the scholar who became a senator.

OD_Common_Kikimora.name: Kikimora
OD_Common_Kikimora.support: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Permanent you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Common_Kikimora.flavor: Respect your household, and she will help you. But if you neglect it, beware!

OD_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
OD_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

OD_Common_LeoRelicExpert.name: Leo, Relic Expert
OD_Common_LeoRelicExpert.effect: At Night — You may spend 1 counter from a card in your Reserve or Landmarks to <SABOTAGE_INF> after Rest. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)
OD_Common_LeoRelicExpert.flavor: Certain ancient knowledge must not be allowed to fall into the wrong hands.

OD_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
OD_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less.

OD_Common_LicenseWithdrawal.name: License Withdrawal
OD_Common_LicenseWithdrawal.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Discard target <BOOSTED> Character.  • Discard target Permanent.

OD_Common_LouisSullivan.name: Louis Sullivan
OD_Common_LouisSullivan.effect: {H} If there are two or more cards in your Landmarks, draw a card.
OD_Common_LouisSullivan.flavor: "Form ever follows function. This is the law." — Louis Sullivan

OD_Common_Mandjet.name: Mandjet
OD_Common_Mandjet.effect: {T}: Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)
OD_Common_Mandjet.flavor: Mandjet and Mesektet, the Ordis flagships, reunited at last.

OD_Common_MatzHive.name: Matz & Hive
OD_Common_MatzHive.effect: (You may keep up to three cards in your Landmarks during Night.)  At Noon — If there are three or more cards in your Landmarks, you may sacrifice one. If you do, play for free a Landmark Permanent with a max Hand Cost of {2} more than the sacrificed card.
OD_Common_MatzHive.flavor: I am the beating heart of the swarm, the architect of the hive.

OD_Common_Melusine.name: Melusine
OD_Common_Melusine.effect: {H} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)

OD_Common_Mesektet.name: Mesektet
OD_Common_Mesektet.effect: At Noon — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions that's behind or tied.
OD_Common_Mesektet.flavor: Repaired by the Axiom, the pride of the Aegis takes flight once again.

OD_Common_MobileArmory.name: Mobile Armory
OD_Common_MobileArmory.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.

OD_Common_MonolithArchivist.name: Monolith Archivist
OD_Common_MonolithArchivist.flavor: "The form has been filled out incorrectly. Please make a new appointment tomorrow."

OD_Common_MonolithLegate.name: Monolith Legate
OD_Common_MonolithLegate.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — $<SABOTAGE> after Rest.
OD_Common_MonolithLegate.flavor: Your document has expired. Needless to say, that's not his problem.

OD_Common_MonolithRuneScribe.name: Monolith Rune-Scribe
OD_Common_MonolithRuneScribe.flavor: The Ordis manifest their Alteration through the use of glyphs of power.

OD_Common_Nike.name: Nike
OD_Common_Nike.effect: $<ETERNAL_FS>.  At Noon — Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)
OD_Common_Nike.flavor: When she spreads her wings, her victory shall resonate for all eternity.

OD_Common_NilsHolgersson.name: Nils Holgersson
OD_Common_NilsHolgersson.flavor: Come on, saddle up! We need to fly in tight formation to evacuate as many as possible!

OD_Common_OpentheGates.name: Open the Gates
OD_Common_OpentheGates.effect: Create two <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in each of your Expeditions.
OD_Common_OpentheGates.flavor: For the first time in centuries, the Solstice Gate has opened. For the first time in ages, humanity will discover what lies beyond the gates.

OD_Common_OrdisAccountant.name: Ordis Accountant
OD_Common_OrdisAccountant.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
OD_Common_OrdisAccountant.support: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
OD_Common_OrdisAccountant.flavor: He has an annoying tendency to overwhelm you with numbers.

OD_Common_OrdisAttorney.name: Ordis Attorney
OD_Common_OrdisAttorney.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Draw a card.

OD_Common_OrdisCadets.name: Ordis Cadets
OD_Common_OrdisCadets.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisCadets.flavor: Together they learn, and together they'll protect.

OD_Common_OrdisCarrier.name: Ordis Carrier
OD_Common_OrdisCarrier.effect: At Noon — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in your Companion Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisCarrier.flavor: The flow of Ordis Recruits seems to go on forever.

OD_Common_OrdisCrier.name: Ordis Crier
OD_Common_OrdisCrier.support: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
OD_Common_OrdisCrier.flavor: He's surprisingly happy for someone who cries all day.

OD_Common_OrdisDispatcher.name: Ordis Dispatcher
OD_Common_OrdisDispatcher.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to create one <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in your other Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisDispatcher.support: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
OD_Common_OrdisDispatcher.flavor: She's in charge of every assignment within the garrison.

OD_Common_OrdisGatekeeper.name: Ordis Gatekeeper
OD_Common_OrdisGatekeeper.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in your other Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisGatekeeper.flavor: The Aegis Sentinel opened the door and stepped aside to let her through, acknowledging her with a nod as she passed.

OD_Common_OrdisLiaison.name: Ordis Liaison
OD_Common_OrdisLiaison.effect: {J} Each other Character you control gains 1 boost.

OD_Common_OrdisMessenger.name: Ordis Messenger
OD_Common_OrdisMessenger.effect: {H} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)
OD_Common_OrdisMessenger.flavor: To maintain their cohesion, the Ordis must call on the most reliable of couriers.

OD_Common_OrdisNightwarden.name: Ordis Nightwarden
OD_Common_OrdisNightwarden.effect: When I gain <ASLEEP> — I gain 1 boost.
OD_Common_OrdisNightwarden.flavor: Work doesn't stop when the sun goes down.

OD_Common_OrdisOverseer.name: Ordis Overseer
OD_Common_OrdisOverseer.effect: {J} If my Expedition is behind, create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.
OD_Common_OrdisOverseer.support: {D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Common_OrdisOverseer.flavor: Proper resource allocation can help make up for lost ground.

OD_Common_OrdisRecruit.name: Ordis Recruit
OD_Common_OrdisRecruit.effect: (If I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)

OD_Common_OrdisSignet.name: Ordis Signet
OD_Common_OrdisSignet.effect: Choose one:  • Target Character gains <ASLEEP>.  • Target Character in Expedition or in Reserve loses all its boosts.  • Each Character in target Expedition gains 1 boost.

OD_Common_OrdisTourist.name: Ordis Tourist
OD_Common_OrdisTourist.effect: {J} If there are two or more cards in your Landmarks, I gain 1 boost.
OD_Common_OrdisTourist.flavor: "The more I visit this city, the more I love it."

OD_Common_OrdisTrooper.name: Ordis Trooper
OD_Common_OrdisTrooper.flavor: "Chin up and stand tall. You’re shieldbearers of the Aegis now!"

OD_Common_OrdisWarden.name: Ordis Warden
OD_Common_OrdisWarden.effect: {H} I gain $<ASLEEP>.  At Noon — Target player puts a card from their hand in Reserve.
OD_Common_OrdisWarden.flavor: You can't beat the clink for catching forty winks.

OD_Common_OutofaClearSky.name: Out of a Clear Sky
OD_Common_OutofaClearSky.effect: $<FLEETING>.  I cost {1} less if at least one of your Expeditions is Ascended.  Send target Character to Reserve.
OD_Common_OutofaClearSky.flavor: A swarm of messages bursts forth in a rustling of paper.

OD_Common_OutofaDarkSky.name: Out of a Dark Sky
OD_Common_OutofaDarkSky.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {3} or less. Then, if both of your Expeditions are <ASCENDED_S>, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
OD_Common_OutofaDarkSky.flavor: Requests for assistance pour in at the sound of beating wings.

OD_Common_Ozma.name: Ozma
OD_Common_Ozma.effect: {J} If you control three or more other Characters, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Common_Ozma.flavor: "Never give up. No one knows what’s going to happen next."

OD_Common_PaperEnvoy.name: Paper Envoy
OD_Common_PaperEnvoy.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless my Expedition is <ASCENDED_S>.
OD_Common_PaperEnvoy.flavor: "Give the order for all ships to retreat!"

OD_Common_PaperHerald.name: Paper Herald
OD_Common_PaperHerald.support: {D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Common_PaperHerald.flavor: Words mean more than what is set down on paper.

OD_Common_Pegasus.name: Pegasus
OD_Common_Pegasus.effect: When my Expedition would move forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION>, it moves forward one more region instead. (If it moved forward due to at least one matched stat.)
OD_Common_Pegasus.flavor: Even one life saved is a victory for us!

OD_Common_Quetzalcoatl.name: Quetzalcóatl
OD_Common_Quetzalcoatl.effect: When an opponent draws one or more cards or does <RESUPPLY_T> — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.
OD_Common_Quetzalcoatl.flavor: A soul has yet to be found who is bold enough to contest his wisdom.

OD_Common_RallyingCall.name: Rallying Call
OD_Common_RallyingCall.effect: Target Character gains 1 boost. If it is <ASLEEP>, it loses <ASLEEP>.
OD_Common_RallyingCall.flavor: The sound of the horn stirred them from their slumber as the white shadows emerged from the woods.

OD_Common_RekaCaterer.name: Reka Caterer
OD_Common_RekaCaterer.effect: {J} Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent token with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
OD_Common_RekaCaterer.flavor: "Happiness is always within reach, if you know how to savor it. Care for a smoothie?"

OD_Common_RekaInvestor.name: Reka Investor
OD_Common_RekaInvestor.effect: At Dusk — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
OD_Common_RekaInvestor.flavor: "Trust me, it will all trickle down for everyone's benefit."

OD_Common_RekaPatron.name: Reka Patron
OD_Common_RekaPatron.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana Orb.\")
OD_Common_RekaPatron.flavor: Art's value is in the eye of the beholder.

OD_Common_RobinHood.name: Robin Hood
OD_Common_RobinHood.effect: Characters your opponents play can't cost less than {2}. (If they would cost {1} or less, they cost {2} instead.)
OD_Common_RobinHood.flavor: Justice comes from a fair redistribution of wealth.

OD_Common_RunesTestament.name: Rune's Testament
OD_Common_RunesTestament.effect: If my Expedition would move forward, you may discard me instead to draw two cards.
OD_Common_RunesTestament.flavor: The first High King of Asgartha urges us to venture forth!

OD_Common_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.name: Sagitta, Soaring Leviathan
OD_Common_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.effect: I cost {1} less for each of your Ascended Expeditions.  $<GIGANTIC>.
OD_Common_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.flavor: We flew higher to escape the turbulence of its wings.

OD_Common_SeekerOwl.name: Seeker Owl
OD_Common_SeekerOwl.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone — My Expedition <ASCENDS>. (If I leave at Rest, it stays Ascended for the next Day.)
OD_Common_SeekerOwl.flavor: Its flight is silent and its talons sharp.

OD_Common_SigismarWingspan.name: Sigismar & Wingspan
OD_Common_SigismarWingspan.effect: At Noon — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in your Hero Expedition. Ignore my abilities during the first Day
OD_Common_SigismarWingspan.flavor: Follow me, friends! If we stand together, nothing can stop us!

OD_Common_Simurgh.name: Simurgh
OD_Common_Simurgh.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  {J} If you have less cards in Reserve than target opponent, draw a card.
OD_Common_Simurgh.flavor: Three feathers. Each time you burn one, it will grant you its help.

OD_Common_SkyboundOdyssey.name: Skybound Odyssey
OD_Common_SkyboundOdyssey.effect: Draw a card.  Both of your Expeditions <ASCEND>. (Until Rest, they can move forward even if matched in their regions' terrains by the opponent's Expeditions.)  Immediately play for free up to two Characters with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
OD_Common_SkyboundOdyssey.flavor: Like a beacon, the horizon calls us onward!

OD_Common_Soar.name: Soar
OD_Common_Soar.effect: Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)
OD_Common_Soar.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.
OD_Common_Soar.flavor: A Zephyr feather gives the Ordis the ability to fly.

OD_Common_SouvenirSeller.name: Souvenir Seller
OD_Common_SouvenirSeller.effect: {J} You may give me 1 boost. If you do, target opponent <RESUPPLIES>.

OD_Common_StaffClerk.name: Staff Clerk
OD_Common_StaffClerk.effect: When an opponent plays a card from Reserve — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.
OD_Common_StaffClerk.flavor: Don't venture into the depths alone.

OD_Common_StickyNoteSeals.name: Sticky Note Seals
OD_Common_StickyNoteSeals.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {4} or more.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or more.
OD_Common_StickyNoteSeals.flavor: Some lessons stick better than others.

OD_Common_StigmaofBanality.name: Stigma of Banality
OD_Common_StigmaofBanality.effect: {H} You may discard target Character with Base Cost {2} or less. If you do, create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in its Expedition. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)
OD_Common_StigmaofBanality.flavor: To be afraid of being different is to destroy individuality.

OD_Common_StrategicDeployment.name: Strategic Deployment
OD_Common_StrategicDeployment.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Target up to two Expeditions and create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of them.  • Target Character with Base Cost {2} or less switches Expeditions. (It joins its controller's other Expedition.)

OD_Common_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.name: Sunisa, Dedicated Ensign
OD_Common_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.effect: $<DEFENDER_FS>.  If my Expedition is behind, <DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent it from moving forward.
OD_Common_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.flavor: Forward or hold. There is no going back.

OD_Common_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.name: Sunisa, Ordis Bodyguard
OD_Common_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.effect: $<DEFENDER_FS>.  If there are two or more cards in your Landmarks, <DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent my Expedition from moving forward.
OD_Common_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.flavor: "Behind the smiles and jubilation, I sense a growing tension…"

OD_Common_Talos.name: Talos
OD_Common_Talos.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  <DEFENDER>. (My Expeditions can't move forward during Dusk.)
OD_Common_Talos.flavor: It was Talos's role to protect the statue from prying eyes.

OD_Common_TeamworkTraining.name: Teamwork Training
OD_Common_TeamworkTraining.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {X} or less, where X is the number of Characters you control.
OD_Common_TeamworkTraining.flavor: Through their Hive Mind, Ordis turns the thoughts of the multitude into a unified will.

OD_Common_TheConsulate.name: The Consulate
OD_Common_TheConsulate.effect: {J} Draw a card.  {T} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.
OD_Common_TheConsulate.flavor: Here, far from the crowd, is where fruitful negotiations are held between Reka and Asgarthans.

OD_Common_TheCouncil.name: The Council
OD_Common_TheCouncil.effect: The {j}, {h} and {r} abilities of Characters facing me can't activate.
OD_Common_TheCouncil.flavor: The idea of facing the Council is deterrent enough for most would-be criminals in Asgartha.

OD_Common_TheFrogPrince.name: The Frog Prince
OD_Common_TheFrogPrince.flavor: Thankfully, he doesn't seal his contracts with a kiss.

OD_Common_TheLectern.name: The Lectern
OD_Common_TheLectern.effect: {J} $<RESUPPLY>.  When I'm sacrificed — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> in a Hero Expedition. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)
OD_Common_TheLectern.flavor: Sol may have sounded the alarm, but her words seem to be falling on deaf ears.

OD_Common_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.name: The Monolith, Ordis Bastion
OD_Common_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.effect: When a Character joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost$<BB>.
OD_Common_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.flavor: A beacon of knowledge and order, a lighthouse towering high above the world.

OD_Common_TheOrigamium.name: The Origamium
OD_Common_TheOrigamium.effect: {J} Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)  When you play a Character — If it's in an Ascended Expedition, you may exhaust me ({T}) to give it 1 boost.

OD_Common_TheReunion.name: The Reunion
OD_Common_TheReunion.effect: {T} : Choose up to the number of cards in your Landmarks:  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in a Companion Expedition.  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> in a Hero Expedition.  • Up to two target Characters gain 1 boost.
OD_Common_TheReunion.flavor: "Two people separated by fate, now reunited once more! This reunion shall forever be carved in stone!"

OD_Common_TheTownSquare.name: The Town Square
OD_Common_TheTownSquare.effect: At Dusk — I gain 1 Morale counter per Character you control.  {T}, Spend 6 of my Morale counters: Characters in target Expedition gain 1 boost.
OD_Common_TheTownSquare.flavor: In light of the Ordis' well-known organizational advantages, the Factions entrusted them with outpost logistics.

OD_Common_TheUglyDuckling.name: The Ugly Duckling
OD_Common_TheUglyDuckling.support: {D} : Target Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)
OD_Common_TheUglyDuckling.flavor: This young recruit swans about while proudly showing off his insignia.

OD_Common_Thoth.name: Thoth
OD_Common_Thoth.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition after Rest.
OD_Common_Thoth.flavor: "The pen is mightier than the sword."

OD_Common_Thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
OD_Common_Thunderbird.effect: {H} My Expedition <ASCENDS>.  When my Expedition moves forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION> (if it moved forward due to at least one matched stat) — Draw a card.

OD_Common_TinyJail.name: Tiny Jail
OD_Common_TinyJail.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with no statistic over 3.

OD_Common_UnfairEncounter.name: Unfair Encounter
OD_Common_UnfairEncounter.effect: <FLEETING>.  Take control of target Landmark Permanent with Hand Cost {2} or less. (It joins your Landmarks.)

OD_Common_Valemon.name: Valemon
OD_Common_Valemon.effect: Unless you have eight or more Mana Orbs, I am $<DEFENDER>.
OD_Common_Valemon.flavor: Promise me to wait, and I will show you my real face.

OD_Common_WaruMack.name: Waru & Mack
OD_Common_WaruMack.effect: When you play a Bureaucrat — It gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
OD_Common_WaruMack.flavor: Bureaucracy is an art that requires careful planning.

OD_Common_WigwaggingKiwi.name: Wigwagging Kiwi
OD_Common_WigwaggingKiwi.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost per <ASCENDED_S> Expedition you control.

OD_Common_YannaQorganAgent.name: Yanna, Qorgan Agent
OD_Common_YannaQorganAgent.effect: {J} You may have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and loses Asleep.)
OD_Common_YannaQorganAgent.flavor: Spies from the Qorgan infiltrate the Factions and steal their secrets.

OD_Common_ZhenZephyr.name: Zhen & Zephyr
OD_Common_ZhenZephyr.effect: At Noon — If you are first player, your Hero Expedition <ASCENDS>. (Until Rest, it can move forward even if matched in its region's terrains by the opponent's Expedition.)  When one or more of your Ascended Expeditions moves forward — If there is no Character facing it, draw a card.
OD_Common_ZhenZephyr.flavor: Those who stand without honor will fall without wings

OD_Exalted_AstrapeRekaHexarch.name: Astrape, Reka Hexarch
OD_Exalted_AstrapeRekaHexarch.effect: {J} Create three <MANASEED> tokens in your Landmarks. Then, I gain 1 boost per card in your Landmarks.
OD_Exalted_AstrapeRekaHexarch.flavor: "I'm sure the Musubi ritual will help us understand your point of view."

OD_Exalted_EvacuatetheCity.name: Evacuate the City!
OD_Exalted_EvacuatetheCity.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your <ASCENDED_S> Expeditions.  When one of your Expeditions moves forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION> — Complete me.
OD_Exalted_EvacuatetheCity.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: At Noon — Your Companion Expedition <ASCENDS>, then create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in it.
OD_Exalted_EvacuatetheCity.flavor: "The city is doomed. Prioritize the people!"

OD_Exalted_PlagueofIntolerance.name: Plague of Intolerance
OD_Exalted_PlagueofIntolerance.effect: {H} Sacrifice a Character. Then, depending on the number of Characters in your Expeditions:  • 2+: Draw a card.  • 4+: I also gain 2 boosts.  • 6+: Each other Character in your Expeditions also gains 1 boost.
OD_Exalted_PlagueofIntolerance.flavor: Intolerance is a mask for fear.

OD_Rare_APebbleinthePond.name: A Pebble in the Pond
OD_Rare_APebbleinthePond.effect: #Play me for {1} less if there are no tokens in your Landmarks.#  Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
OD_Rare_APebbleinthePond.flavor: A single pebble can cause quite a ripple.

OD_Rare_AbySapCourier.name: Aby, Sap Courier
OD_Rare_AbySapCourier.effect: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  {J} <AUGMENT_IMP> #any number# of target cards in play or in Reserve. (If they have counters, they gain 1 more. This can't target Hero cards.)
OD_Rare_AbySapCourier.flavor: This wheel is the result of hours of mechanical training.

OD_Rare_Achilles.name: Achilles
OD_Rare_Achilles.flavor: "Many things lie between us—shadowy mountains and sounding sea."

OD_Rare_AdamantReceptionist.name: Adamant Receptionist
OD_Rare_AdamantReceptionist.effect: #{J}# You may exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control to <SABOTAGE_INF>. #If you don't, I gain 1 boost.#
OD_Rare_AdamantReceptionist.flavor: "You're not on the list. Please move along."

OD_Rare_AegisTemplar.name: Aegis Templar
OD_Rare_AegisTemplar.effect: #$<SCOUT_2> {2}.#  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create #two# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in my Expedition.
OD_Rare_AegisTemplar.flavor: The Templars always ensure that the area is safe.

OD_Rare_AerolithReef.name: Aerolith Reef
OD_Rare_AerolithReef.effect: {J} You may send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.  #When I'm sacrificed — <RESUPPLY>.  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.#
OD_Rare_AerolithReef.flavor: Reaching the pillar is no easy journey, as the clouds conceal countless reefs and other dangers.

OD_Rare_AmeliaEarhart.name: Amelia Earhart
OD_Rare_AmeliaEarhart.flavor: "The most effective way to do it, is to do it."

OD_Rare_AngryCrowd.name: Angry Crowd
OD_Rare_AngryCrowd.effect: <FLEETING>.  Discard target Character or Permanent. #If its Base Cost was {2} or less,# create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting. Otherwise, it's the Hand Cost.)
OD_Rare_AngryCrowd.flavor: Anger is often the fruit of frustration.

OD_Rare_Anubis.name: Anubis
OD_Rare_Anubis.flavor: Only a heart as light as a feather can stand up to the judgment of Anubis.

OD_Rare_Ariadne.name: Ariadne
OD_Rare_Ariadne.effect: When an opponent plays a Character — If there are no Characters in the Expedition facing me, that Character switches Expeditions.
OD_Rare_Ariadne.flavor: "Follow the thread, and you'll find me." — Ariadne

OD_Rare_ArmoredBird.name: Armored Bird
OD_Rare_ArmoredBird.effect: I am $<DEFENDER> #unless I'm facing two or more Characters.#
OD_Rare_ArmoredBird.flavor: He raised a shield of feathers. Lances and harpoons shattered against his steely wings.

OD_Rare_ArmoredJammer.name: Armored Jammer
OD_Rare_ArmoredJammer.flavor: "In a jam? Sorry, mate. Maybe a side-effect of our scrambling..."

OD_Rare_AscendedTrooper.name: Ascended Trooper
OD_Rare_AscendedTrooper.effect: #{J}# If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, I gain 1 boost. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.
OD_Rare_AscendedTrooper.flavor: After months of expeditions, Aedyt felt she had finally spread her wings.

OD_Rare_Athena.name: Athena
OD_Rare_Athena.effect: #{H} If you control two or more other Characters, I gain 2 boosts.#  {R} If you control two or more #other Characters#, I lose <FLEETING_CHAR>.
OD_Rare_Athena.flavor: "I’ve lifted the mist from off your eyes that’s blurred them up to now."

OD_Rare_Atlas.name: Atlas
OD_Rare_Atlas.flavor: Not even the weight of the sky could make him buckle.

OD_Rare_AxiomMachinist.name: Axiom Machinist
OD_Rare_AxiomMachinist.effect: #{J}# You may ready target Permanent in play or target card in Reserve.
OD_Rare_AxiomMachinist.flavor: From Kelon to Sap to Manaseed, the Axiom never stop experimenting with alternative energy sources.

OD_Rare_AxiomSignet.name: Axiom Signet
OD_Rare_AxiomSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  • Target Permanent you control activates its {j} abilities.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {3} or less.

OD_Rare_AyxasRepentedTyrant.name: Ayxas, Repented Tyrant
OD_Rare_AyxasRepentedTyrant.effect: {H} You may create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in an opponent's Expedition to <SABOTAGE_LOW>.
OD_Rare_AyxasRepentedTyrant.flavor: "I warned you of the danger you were heading into." — Ayxas

OD_Rare_BabaYaga.name: Baba Yaga
OD_Rare_BabaYaga.flavor: Help or harm? Only the card will tell.

OD_Rare_BabasIsba.name: Baba's Isba
OD_Rare_BabasIsba.effect: {J} Draw a card.  {T}, Sacrifice a Character: $<AFTER_YOU>.
OD_Rare_BabasIsba.flavor: Boney Legs, she's called, and her hut is one reason why.

OD_Rare_BanishingGate.name: Banishing Gate
OD_Rare_BanishingGate.flavor: Let me walk you to the door.

OD_Rare_Benzaiten.name: Benzaiten
OD_Rare_Benzaiten.effect: {J} If my Expedition is behind, draw a card. #Otherwise, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.#
OD_Rare_Benzaiten.flavor: Good things come to those who wait.

OD_Rare_Bluecap.name: Bluecap
OD_Rare_Bluecap.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks. #If both of your Expeditions failed to move forward, create two instead.#
OD_Rare_Bluecap.flavor: To avoid sudden jolts, invest in stone.

OD_Rare_BountifulMeadow.name: Bountiful Meadow
OD_Rare_BountifulMeadow.effect: {T} : The next #Bureaucrat# you play this turn costs {1} less.
OD_Rare_BountifulMeadow.flavor: There's no greater joy than seeing all that is green thrive and grow.

OD_Rare_BrassbugDropship.name: Brassbug Dropship
OD_Rare_BrassbugDropship.effect: When I'm sacrificed — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in each of your Expeditions. (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)
OD_Rare_BrassbugDropship.flavor: "Those little pests are tough. Even three miles up, they still manage to follow us." - Subhash

OD_Rare_BrassbugHub.name: Brassbug Hub
OD_Rare_BrassbugHub.effect: {J} I gain three Kelon counters.  At Noon — You may pay {1} and spend one of my Kelon counters to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
OD_Rare_BrassbugHub.flavor: Few people visit the depths of the Foundry, and even fewer can explain how the Brassbugs came to be.

OD_Rare_BrassbugNursery.name: Brassbug Nursery
OD_Rare_BrassbugNursery.effect: {J} Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.  {T}, {1}, Sacrifice a Permanent: create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
OD_Rare_BrassbugNursery.flavor: Even far from their Hive, the Brassbugs have developed a way to continue reproducing.

OD_Rare_BreaktheIce.name: Break the Ice
OD_Rare_BreaktheIce.effect: <FLEETING>.  I cost {2} less if #you control three or more Characters#.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

OD_Rare_BugOutBag.name: Bug-Out Bag
OD_Rare_BugOutBag.effect: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in my Expedition.  #{R} <RESUPPLY>.#
OD_Rare_BugOutBag.flavor: They forgot to pack the Eat Me energy bars.

OD_Rare_Bugfix.name: Bugfix
OD_Rare_Bugfix.effect: <COOLDOWN>.  You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
OD_Rare_Bugfix.flavor: It's not Kelon, but this Sap will make you feel better, I swear.

OD_Rare_Bumblebeet.name: Bumblebeet
OD_Rare_Bumblebeet.support: {I} #When another Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
OD_Rare_Bumblebeet.flavor: On the surface, pollination by bumblebeets is a key tool in growing Muna crops.

OD_Rare_CableCarStation.name: Cable-Car Station
OD_Rare_CableCarStation.effect: {J} #Draw a card,# then I gain 2 Move counters.  {T}, Spend 1 of my Move counters: One of your Expeditions moves backwards one region. If it does, your other Expedition moves forward one region.
OD_Rare_CableCarStation.flavor: Reka cable-cars are the safest way to get around the city.

OD_Rare_Carbunclo.name: Carbunclo
OD_Rare_Carbunclo.effect: #{J} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition#, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve.)
OD_Rare_Carbunclo.flavor: Is that a ruby on its forehead or a burning lump of coal ?

OD_Rare_CelebrationDay.name: Celebration Day
OD_Rare_CelebrationDay.flavor: Today, and for centuries to come, we will celebrate victory over the Kraken and revel in freedom regained!

OD_Rare_CelestialBlast.name: Celestial Blast
OD_Rare_CelestialBlast.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Discard up to two targets, Characters or Permanents.  #Draw a card.#
OD_Rare_CelestialBlast.flavor: The sky cracked open in a thunderous wave as the dream was unleashed upon the world.

OD_Rare_Charge.name: Charge!
OD_Rare_Charge.flavor: Facing terrible odds and an unfathomably huge Leviathan, the Ordis legion charged nonetheless.

OD_Rare_CharitableReka.name: Charitable Reka
OD_Rare_CharitableReka.effect: #{J} Create a <MANASEED> token in each player's Landmarks.#
OD_Rare_CharitableReka.flavor: Opulence is a state of grace that forever teeters on the precipice.

OD_Rare_Chrysalis.name: Chrysalis
OD_Rare_Chrysalis.effect: $<DEFENDER>.  When I leave the Expedition Zone — Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in my Expedition.
OD_Rare_Chrysalis.support: #{D} : Exhaust target card in Reserve.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_Chrysalis.flavor: ...They build their ice cocoon to turn ethereal.

OD_Rare_ConjuringSeal.name: Conjuring Seal
OD_Rare_ConjuringSeal.flavor: The Imagination shapes our reality just as our beliefs shaped the Æther.

OD_Rare_Conscription.name: Conscription
OD_Rare_Conscription.effect: #<COOLDOWN>.# (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Target an Expedition. Create X <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in it, where X is the number of cards in target player's Reserve.

OD_Rare_CorruptedBabaYaga.name: Corrupted Baba Yaga
OD_Rare_CorruptedBabaYaga.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless six or more cards are in your discard pile.  {H} Draw a card.
OD_Rare_CorruptedBabaYaga.flavor: "The Empyrean is flooded with Nightmare. It's spilling over." - Baba Yaga

OD_Rare_CorruptedGargoyle.name: Corrupted Gargoyle
OD_Rare_CorruptedGargoyle.effect: #I can't be played# unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  #{J}# Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.
OD_Rare_CorruptedGargoyle.flavor: They have always instilled fear. As a group, they instill terror.

OD_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.name: Corrupted Jeanne
OD_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.effect: #I can't be played# unless there's another Character in each of your Expeditions.  When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.
OD_Rare_CorruptedJeanne.support: #{D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.#

OD_Rare_CovertheRetreat.name: Cover the Retreat
OD_Rare_CovertheRetreat.effect: {J} Create two <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens #distributed among any Expeditions.#  When you pass — If #six# or more Characters are in your Expeditions, complete me.
OD_Rare_CovertheRetreat.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When you create a token Character — You may exhaust me ({T}) to give it 1 boost.

OD_Rare_DaughterofNaos.name: Daughter of Naos
OD_Rare_DaughterofNaos.flavor: The torture of the Naos must cease.

OD_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.name: Delay the Collapse
OD_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.effect: {J} #Create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.#  When you pass — If the total Hand Cost of cards in your Landmarks is {6} or more, complete me.
OD_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: Other cards in your Landmarks are <TOUGH_1>.
OD_Rare_DelaytheCollapse.flavor: "Hold out for as long as possible. That's all that matters."

OD_Rare_DesignerDrone.name: Designer Drone
OD_Rare_DesignerDrone.effect: #{R} You may spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to reduce the cost of the next Permanent you play this Afternoon by {2}.#
OD_Rare_DesignerDrone.support: {I} #When another Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 2.#
OD_Rare_DesignerDrone.flavor: Designed by designers to help them design.

OD_Rare_Detonation.name: Detonation
OD_Rare_Detonation.effect: <FLEETING>.  You may sacrifice a Permanent to reduce my cost #by {2}.#  Send to Reserve target Character #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#
OD_Rare_Detonation.flavor: Aerolith's instability can turn any bump into an explosive reaction.

OD_Rare_DevotedProtector.name: Devoted Protector
OD_Rare_DevotedProtector.effect: #{R} If you control a Feat, I gain 1 boost.#
OD_Rare_DevotedProtector.flavor: "Come on! If we give up, it's game over!" — Kebba

OD_Rare_DongDaShen.name: Dong Da Shen
OD_Rare_DongDaShen.effect: #At Noon — #You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

OD_Rare_Doppelganger.name: Doppelgänger
OD_Rare_Doppelganger.effect: #$<SEASONED>.#  #{H}# Target a Character facing me. I gain its subtypes and X boosts, where X equals its highest statistic. (I lose these subtypes when I leave the Expedition zone.)

OD_Rare_Drillmole.name: Drillmole
OD_Rare_Drillmole.effect: {R} You may spend #1 counter# from #a card you control or in your Reserve# to <SABOTAGE_INF>.
OD_Rare_Drillmole.support: {I} #When another Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 2.#

OD_Rare_DrowsyDodo.name: Drowsy Dodo
OD_Rare_DrowsyDodo.effect: {J} I gain <ASLEEP>.  When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — #I gain 1 boost.#
OD_Rare_DrowsyDodo.flavor: After all that work, it's time for the dodo to go night-night.

OD_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.name: Ebenezer Scrooge
OD_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.support: {D} : Target Character you control with Hand Cost {4} or less gains <ASLEEP>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_EbenezerScrooge.flavor: Darkness is cheap, and that's why Scrooge liked it.

OD_Rare_EruEmissaryoftheWild.name: Eru, Emissary of the Wild
OD_Rare_EruEmissaryoftheWild.effect: #{H} You may have target Character facing me gain <ANCHORED>. If you do, I gain $<ANCHORED>.#
OD_Rare_EruEmissaryoftheWild.flavor: "Surrounded by all of his animal friends, my teacher never felt alone, even living as a hermit." - Kauri

OD_Rare_FeastofThoughts.name: Feast of Thoughts
OD_Rare_FeastofThoughts.effect: Choose X+1, where X is my number of Arcane counters:  • Draw a card.  • Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.  • Remove 3 counters from target card in play or in Reserve.  • <SABOTAGE>.
OD_Rare_FeastofThoughts.support: {I} When #a Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 Arcane counter, up to a max of 3.
OD_Rare_FeastofThoughts.flavor: When the Remanence strikes, ideas burst out of one's mind like water from a dam.

OD_Rare_FieldReinforcements.name: Field Reinforcements
OD_Rare_FieldReinforcements.effect: #$<COOLDOWN>.#  Choose one. If each of your Expeditions is behind or tied, you may choose both:  • Draw a card.  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.
OD_Rare_FieldReinforcements.flavor: Supply lines can sometimes be the difference between failure and success.

OD_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.name: Fiore dei Liberi
OD_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.effect: If I'm <BOOSTED>, I'm $<ETERNAL>.  {J} I gain 1 boost per other Character in my Expedition, then send them all to Reserve.  At Night — I lose 1 boost.
OD_Rare_FioredeiLiberi.flavor: "I am the sword, deadly against all weapons!" — Fiore

OD_Rare_FireRabbit.name: Fire Rabbit
OD_Rare_FireRabbit.effect: {H} You may have me gain <FLEETING_CHAR>. If you do, another target Character gains 1 boost.
OD_Rare_FireRabbit.flavor: Hot bunny in your area wants to meet!

OD_Rare_FortheGreaterGood.name: For the Greater Good
OD_Rare_FortheGreaterGood.effect: <FLEETING>.  Discard a card from your hand. If you do, discard target card in play with Base Cost #{5} or less#.

OD_Rare_FoundryEngineer.name: Foundry Engineer
OD_Rare_FoundryEngineer.effect: {R} The next Permanent you play this Afternoon costs #{2}# less.
OD_Rare_FoundryEngineer.flavor: Behind every Axiom masterwork, there are Foundry Engineers.

OD_Rare_FoundryMechanic.name: Foundry Mechanic
OD_Rare_FoundryMechanic.support: {D} : The next Permanent you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_FoundryMechanic.flavor: You can't choose when and where a quick fix will be needed.

OD_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.name: Fragrant Meerkat
OD_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.effect: #If you would roll a die, you may add 1 to its result.# (Choose after you see the result.)
OD_Rare_FragrantMeerkat.flavor: Do you smell a rat ? Nope, that's just me!

OD_Rare_Galatea.name: Galatea
OD_Rare_Galatea.effect: I'm <DEFENDER_FS>.  #If my Expedition is <IN_CONTACT>, <DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent it from moving forward.# (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
OD_Rare_Galatea.flavor: If a sculptor merely frees the form from the stone, then it never belonged to him in the first place.

OD_Rare_Gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
OD_Rare_Gargoyle.flavor: At the slightest sign of intrusion, these stone lookouts come to life and sound the alarm.

OD_Rare_Geyser.name: Geyser
OD_Rare_Geyser.effect: Return target Character or Permanent to its owner's hand, then put me in your Mana Orbs (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

OD_Rare_Gibil.name: Gibil
OD_Rare_Gibil.effect: {J} #If you control two or more Permanents, create two <BRASSBUG> Robot tokens in target Expedition. Otherwise,# create only one.
OD_Rare_Gibil.support: {D} : Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_Gibil.flavor: Symphonies begin with two notes, fires with a couple of sparks, and masterpieces with two drops of metal.

OD_Rare_GiftofSelf.name: Gift of Self
OD_Rare_GiftofSelf.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Sacrifice a Character. If you do, draw two cards.
OD_Rare_GiftofSelf.flavor: Her being begins to disintegrate as she breaks all the Mana bridges linking the idea of who she is to physical matter.

OD_Rare_GranBwa.name: Gran Bwa
OD_Rare_GranBwa.effect: {J} You may have target opponent draw a card. If you do, I gain <ANCHORED>.  #When an opponent draws one or more cards or <RESUPPLIES> — I gain 1 boost.#
OD_Rare_GranBwa.support: {I} #When another Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
OD_Rare_GranBwa.flavor: Make an offering of Sap and spiced rum, and Gran Bwa will bless your orchard.

OD_Rare_GrandEndeavor.name: Grand Endeavor
OD_Rare_GrandEndeavor.effect: #$<TOUGH_2>.#  At Noon — Target Expedition moves forward one region.
OD_Rare_GrandEndeavor.flavor: The Ordis built a relay of lighthouses to light the way through the Tumult.

OD_Rare_HavenTrainee.name: Haven Trainee
OD_Rare_HavenTrainee.effect: {R} #Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions.#
OD_Rare_HavenTrainee.flavor: "All right, lad, show me what you’ve learned."

OD_Rare_HavenWarrior.name: Haven Warrior
OD_Rare_HavenWarrior.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_HavenWarrior.flavor: We've all lived through some things. But she's been through worse.

OD_Rare_HealthInspector.name: Health Inspector
OD_Rare_HealthInspector.effect: #Cards in play or in Reserve with counters# can't gain counters. (This doesn't affect Hero cards.)
OD_Rare_HealthInspector.flavor: Using untested ingredients is a recipe for disaster.

OD_Rare_Heimdall.name: Heimdall
OD_Rare_Heimdall.effect: {H} You may have target Character switch Expeditions. (It leaves its Expedition and joins its controller's other Expedition.)
OD_Rare_Heimdall.flavor: Proud guardian of the Bifröst, he decides who gets to switch sides.

OD_Rare_HelpfulPelican.name: Helpful Pelican
OD_Rare_HelpfulPelican.effect: #When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — If my Expedition is Ascended, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.#
OD_Rare_HelpfulPelican.flavor: It's not unusual to see these pelicans ferrying small local creatures from one island to the next.

OD_Rare_Hippogriff.name: Hippogriff
OD_Rare_Hippogriff.effect: #{J}# My Expedition <ASCENDS>.  When my Expedition #moves forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION># — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in that Expedition after Rest.

OD_Rare_HopomyThumb.name: Hop-o'-my-Thumb
OD_Rare_HopomyThumb.effect: #{H}# You may put a card from your hand in Reserve to create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
OD_Rare_HopomyThumb.flavor: It's not easy to lead the way…

OD_Rare_Hound.name: Hound
OD_Rare_Hound.effect: {J} If my Expedition is behind, I gain 1 boost.
OD_Rare_Hound.flavor: Like a dog with a bone.

OD_Rare_Hypothermia.name: Hypothermia
OD_Rare_Hypothermia.effect: Each player chooses a Character they control. It gains <ASLEEP>. (You choose first. Ignore the statistics of Asleep Characters during Dusk. At Rest, they don't go to Reserve and lose Asleep.)
OD_Rare_Hypothermia.flavor: Fall asleep in the cold, and you might never wake up.

OD_Rare_IceboundLake.name: Icebound Lake
OD_Rare_IceboundLake.effect: When you play a Character — If its Expedition is behind, I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then target Character gains <ASLEEP>.
OD_Rare_IceboundLake.flavor: With a voice like thunder or crackling ice it howls.

OD_Rare_InvestigatetheCorruption.name: Investigate the Corruption
OD_Rare_InvestigatetheCorruption.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Draw #three cards#, then discard a card from your hand.
OD_Rare_InvestigatetheCorruption.flavor: \"By understanding the evil, we can pull it out at the root.\" - Zaj

OD_Rare_Issitoq.name: Issitoq
OD_Rare_Issitoq.effect: Your other Expedition and the Expedition facing it can't move forward.
OD_Rare_Issitoq.support: {D} : Draw a card. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_Issitoq.flavor: No one can escape their gaze.

OD_Rare_JackFrost.name: Jack Frost
OD_Rare_JackFrost.effect: #{J}# You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
OD_Rare_JackFrost.flavor: Another holiday... Just the icing on the cake!

OD_Rare_JeannedArc.name: Jeanne d'Arc
OD_Rare_JeannedArc.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone — Create #two# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in each of your Expeditions.
OD_Rare_JeannedArc.flavor: She'll be followed long after she's gone.

OD_Rare_JianAssemblyOverseer.name: Jian, Assembly Overseer
OD_Rare_JianAssemblyOverseer.support: #{D} : Activate the {j} abilities of target Permanent you control.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_JianAssemblyOverseer.flavor: "This material does not seem to be affected by gravity. By harnessing the properties of this Aerolith, we could create flying ships and cities, and fly close to the clouds..."

OD_Rare_KadigiranAlchemist.name: Kadigiran Alchemist
OD_Rare_KadigiranAlchemist.flavor: Alchemy is not just a matter of turning lead to gold. It's about purifying yourself of imperfections to become your true self.

OD_Rare_KakobaLegionCommander.name: Kakoba, Legion Commander
OD_Rare_KakobaLegionCommander.effect: {J} If you control three or more other Characters, I gain #3 boosts$<BB>#. (Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Rare_KakobaLegionCommander.flavor: The general who became a scholar; the scholar who became a senator.

OD_Rare_KelonBurst.name: Kelon Burst
OD_Rare_KelonBurst.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {4} or less.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or less.
OD_Rare_KelonBurst.flavor: There's an enduring legend in the Suspira quarries: the existence of another type of Kelon.

OD_Rare_KelonicGenerator.name: Kelonic Generator
OD_Rare_KelonicGenerator.flavor: "Suspira's mines will soon run dry. Your precious Kelon will run dry."

OD_Rare_Kikimora.name: Kikimora
OD_Rare_Kikimora.effect: #When you play a Permanent — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.#
OD_Rare_Kikimora.support: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Permanent you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}.
OD_Rare_Kikimora.flavor: Respect your household, and she will help you. But if you neglect it, beware!

OD_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
OD_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. #Then, target an Expedition that's ahead. Each of its Characters gain <ASLEEP>.#

OD_Rare_KuwattheDissenter.name: Kuwat, the Dissenter
OD_Rare_KuwattheDissenter.effect: {J} Sacrifice a Character in my Expedition.
OD_Rare_KuwattheDissenter.flavor: "There are gates one should not open, there are seals one should not breach. And yet I will."

OD_Rare_LeoRelicExpert.name: Leo, Relic Expert
OD_Rare_LeoRelicExpert.flavor: Certain ancient knowledge must not be allowed to fall into the wrong hands.

OD_Rare_LeonardodaVinci.name: Leonardo da Vinci
OD_Rare_LeonardodaVinci.effect: {R} You may exhaust ({T}) a Permanent you control to #draw a card.#
OD_Rare_LeonardodaVinci.flavor: "The noblest pleasure is the joy of understanding." — Leonardo da Vinci

OD_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
OD_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less #and gains 1 boost.#

OD_Rare_LicenseWithdrawal.name: License Withdrawal
OD_Rare_LicenseWithdrawal.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Discard target <BOOSTED> Character #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#  • Discard target Permanent #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#

OD_Rare_LouisSullivan.name: Louis Sullivan
OD_Rare_LouisSullivan.effect: #{J}# If there are #three or more# cards in your Landmarks, draw a card.
OD_Rare_LouisSullivan.flavor: "Form ever follows function. This is the law." — Louis Sullivan

OD_Rare_LuminousSwarm.name: Luminous Swarm
OD_Rare_LuminousSwarm.effect: {J} I gain <ANCHORED>.  At Noon — Target Character in play or in Reserve gains 1 boost.
OD_Rare_LuminousSwarm.flavor: They buzz about at night and spread their nectar when the sun is at its height.

OD_Rare_Mandjet.name: Mandjet
OD_Rare_Mandjet.effect: {T}: Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.  #If one of your Ascended Expeditions would attempt to <ASCEND_INF> again, <RESUPPLY_LOW> instead.#
OD_Rare_Mandjet.flavor: Mandjet and Mesektet, the Ordis flagships, reunited at last.

OD_Rare_MasterLapidary.name: Master Lapidary
OD_Rare_MasterLapidary.effect: #{H} You may sacrifice a Permanent to ready a Mana Orb.#
OD_Rare_MasterLapidary.flavor: Cutting Aerolith requires a deft and delicate touch.

OD_Rare_Melusine.name: Melusine
OD_Rare_Melusine.effect: {H} If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.

OD_Rare_Mesektet.name: Mesektet
OD_Rare_Mesektet.effect: #{J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions that's behind or tied.#  At Noon — Create a <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of your Expeditions that's behind or tied.
OD_Rare_Mesektet.flavor: Repaired by the Axiom, the pride of the Aegis takes flight once again.

OD_Rare_MigratoryCrane.name: Migratory Crane
OD_Rare_MigratoryCrane.effect: When a Character joins the Expedition facing me — You may have me switch Expeditions.
OD_Rare_MigratoryCrane.flavor: When the cranes start their migration, that's the signal that it's time to seek out new horizons.

OD_Rare_MobileArmory.name: Mobile Armory
OD_Rare_MobileArmory.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.  #<DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent my Expedition from moving forward.#

OD_Rare_MonolithArchivist.name: Monolith Archivist
OD_Rare_MonolithArchivist.effect: #I am $<DEFENDER> unless you control two or more other Bureaucrats.#
OD_Rare_MonolithArchivist.flavor: "The form has been filled out incorrectly. Please make a new appointment tomorrow."

OD_Rare_MonolithLegate.name: Monolith Legate
OD_Rare_MonolithLegate.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — $<SABOTAGE> after Rest.
OD_Rare_MonolithLegate.support: #{D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_MonolithLegate.flavor: Your document has expired. Needless to say, that's not his problem.

OD_Rare_MonolithRuneScribe.name: Monolith Rune-Scribe
OD_Rare_MonolithRuneScribe.flavor: The Ordis manifest their Alteration through the use of glyphs of power.

OD_Rare_MothCollision.name: Moth Collision
OD_Rare_MothCollision.effect: <FLEETING>.  If you control a #Soldier#, I cost {1} less.  Discard target Character.
OD_Rare_MothCollision.flavor: When two moths meet, there's always a spark.

OD_Rare_MothLantern.name: Moth Lantern
OD_Rare_MothLantern.effect: When you sacrifice a non-Illusion Character — Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in my Expedition.  {J} Sacrifice a Character in my Expedition.
OD_Rare_MothLantern.flavor: In the tricks of its light, shed your skin to become an illusion.

OD_Rare_MothtoaFlame.name: Moth to a Flame
OD_Rare_MothtoaFlame.effect: $<COOLDOWN>.  Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token #in each of your Expeditions#.
OD_Rare_MothtoaFlame.flavor: During the scant hours of their brief existence, the Moths flutter about, carrying only the idea of themselves.

OD_Rare_MothtoaSpring.name: Moth to a Spring
OD_Rare_MothtoaSpring.effect: <FLEETING>.  Create #two# <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens, distributed among any Expeditions.  Draw a card.
OD_Rare_MothtoaSpring.flavor: A spring that will quench any thirst for magic.

OD_Rare_Nike.name: Nike
OD_Rare_Nike.effect: #If my Expedition is Ascended,# I am $<ETERNAL_FS>.
OD_Rare_Nike.flavor: When she spreads her wings, her victory shall resonate for all eternity.

OD_Rare_NikolaTesla.name: Nikola Tesla
OD_Rare_NikolaTesla.effect: {R} I gain 1 boost #per# exhausted Permanent you control and #per# exhausted card in your Reserve, up to a max of 3 boosts on me.
OD_Rare_NikolaTesla.flavor: "With this new invention, we can generate a force field to protect the city!"

OD_Rare_NilsHolgersson.name: Nils Holgersson
OD_Rare_NilsHolgersson.effect: #{H} You may target a Character with Base Cost {1} or less. It switches Expeditions.#
OD_Rare_NilsHolgersson.support: #{D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.#
OD_Rare_NilsHolgersson.flavor: Come on, saddle up! We need to fly in tight formation to evacuate as many as possible!

OD_Rare_Nurture.name: Nurture
OD_Rare_Nurture.effect: Up to two target Characters each gain 1 boost.
OD_Rare_Nurture.flavor: When the sun shines, we'll shine together.

OD_Rare_OpentheGates.name: Open the Gates
OD_Rare_OpentheGates.effect: Create #four# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens, #distributed as you choose among any number of target Expeditions#.
OD_Rare_OpentheGates.flavor: For the first time in centuries, the Solstice Gate has opened. For the first time in ages, humanity will discover what lies beyond the gates.

OD_Rare_OrdisAccountant.name: Ordis Accountant
OD_Rare_OrdisAccountant.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. #You may give it 2 boosts.#
OD_Rare_OrdisAccountant.support: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
OD_Rare_OrdisAccountant.flavor: He has an annoying tendency to overwhelm you with numbers.

OD_Rare_OrdisAttorney.name: Ordis Attorney
OD_Rare_OrdisAttorney.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Draw a card.

OD_Rare_OrdisCadets.name: Ordis Cadets
OD_Rare_OrdisCadets.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in #your other Expedition#.
OD_Rare_OrdisCadets.flavor: Together they learn, and together they'll protect.

OD_Rare_OrdisCarrier.name: Ordis Carrier
OD_Rare_OrdisCarrier.effect: At Noon — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in #each of your Expeditions#.
OD_Rare_OrdisCarrier.flavor: The flow of Ordis Recruits seems to go on forever.

OD_Rare_OrdisCrier.name: Ordis Crier
OD_Rare_OrdisCrier.effect: #{R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to ready two Mana Orbs.#
OD_Rare_OrdisCrier.support: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
OD_Rare_OrdisCrier.flavor: He's surprisingly happy for someone who cries all day.

OD_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.name: Ordis Dispatcher
OD_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to create #two# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in your other Expedition.
OD_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.support: {I} When another Character joins your Expeditions — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
OD_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.flavor: She's in charge of every assignment within the garrison.

OD_Rare_OrdisGatekeeper.name: Ordis Gatekeeper
OD_Rare_OrdisGatekeeper.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in #each of your# Expeditions.
OD_Rare_OrdisGatekeeper.flavor: The Aegis Sentinel opened the door and stepped aside to let her through, acknowledging her with a nod as she passed.

OD_Rare_OrdisLiaison.name: Ordis Liaison
OD_Rare_OrdisLiaison.effect: {J} Each Character #in target Expedition# gains 1 boost.

OD_Rare_OrdisMessenger.name: Ordis Messenger
OD_Rare_OrdisMessenger.effect: #{J}# If I'm in an Ascended Expedition, #create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.# Otherwise, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.
OD_Rare_OrdisMessenger.flavor: To maintain their cohesion, the Ordis must call on the most reliable of couriers.

OD_Rare_OrdisNightwarden.name: Ordis Nightwarden
OD_Rare_OrdisNightwarden.effect: If I would gain <ASLEEP>, #I gain $<ANCHORED> instead.#
OD_Rare_OrdisNightwarden.flavor: Work doesn't stop when the sun goes down.

OD_Rare_OrdisOverseer.name: Ordis Overseer
OD_Rare_OrdisOverseer.effect: {J} If my Expedition is behind, create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition #for each Bureaucrat you control#.
OD_Rare_OrdisOverseer.support: {D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_OrdisOverseer.flavor: Proper resource allocation can help make up for lost ground.

OD_Rare_OrdisSignet.name: Ordis Signet
OD_Rare_OrdisSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Target Character gains <ASLEEP>.  • Target Character in Expedition or in Reserve loses all its boosts.  • Each Character in target Expedition gains 1 boost.

OD_Rare_OrdisSpy.name: Ordis Spy
OD_Rare_OrdisSpy.effect: {H} $<SABOTAGE>.  #{R} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.#

OD_Rare_OrdisTourist.name: Ordis Tourist
OD_Rare_OrdisTourist.effect: {J} I gain #1 boost per card in your Landmarks, up to a max of 3 boosts on me.#
OD_Rare_OrdisTourist.flavor: "The more I visit this city, the more I love it."

OD_Rare_OrdisTrooper.name: Ordis Trooper
OD_Rare_OrdisTrooper.flavor: "Chin up and stand tall. You’re shieldbearers of the Aegis now!"

OD_Rare_OrdisWarden.name: Ordis Warden
OD_Rare_OrdisWarden.effect: {H} #You may have me# gain <ASLEEP>.  At Noon — Target player puts a card from their hand in Reserve.
OD_Rare_OrdisWarden.flavor: You can't beat the clink for catching forty winks.

OD_Rare_OutofaClearSky.name: Out of a Clear Sky
OD_Rare_OutofaClearSky.effect: <FLEETING>.  I cost #{1} less for each# of your Ascended Expeditions.  Send target Character to Reserve.
OD_Rare_OutofaClearSky.flavor: A swarm of messages bursts forth in a rustling of paper.

OD_Rare_OutofaDarkSky.name: Out of a Dark Sky
OD_Rare_OutofaDarkSky.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less.# Then, if both of your Expeditions are <ASCENDED_S>, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
OD_Rare_OutofaDarkSky.flavor: Requests for assistance pour in at the sound of beating wings.

OD_Rare_Ozma.name: Ozma
OD_Rare_Ozma.effect: {J} If you control three or more other Characters, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve. Cards in Reserve are not controlled.)
OD_Rare_Ozma.flavor: "Never give up. No one knows what’s going to happen next."

OD_Rare_PaintitPink.name: Paint it Pink!
OD_Rare_PaintitPink.effect: <FLEETING>.  Play me for {1} less #per Expedition# <IN_CONTACT> that you control. (They're In Contact if another player's Expedition is in their region.)  Return target Character or Permanent to the top of its owner's deck.

OD_Rare_Pan.name: Pan
OD_Rare_Pan.effect: {H} <SABOTAGE>. If you discarded a card this way, create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in the Companion Expedition of its owner. #You may have it gain <ASLEEP>.#
OD_Rare_Pan.flavor: He's definitely the black sheep around here!

OD_Rare_PaperEnvoy.name: Paper Envoy
OD_Rare_PaperEnvoy.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless #one of your Expeditions# is <ASCENDED_S>.
OD_Rare_PaperEnvoy.flavor: "Give the order for all ships to retreat!"

OD_Rare_PaperHerald.name: Paper Herald
OD_Rare_PaperHerald.support: {D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
OD_Rare_PaperHerald.flavor: Words mean more than what is set down on paper.

OD_Rare_Pegasus.name: Pegasus
OD_Rare_Pegasus.effect: #{J} Each of your Expeditions <ASCENDS>.#   When #both of your Expeditions# move forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION> — #You win the game.#
OD_Rare_Pegasus.flavor: Even one life saved is a victory for us!

OD_Rare_PicnicArea.name: Picnic Area
OD_Rare_PicnicArea.effect: {J} Each player #draws a card.#  When you make a <GIFT> — You may exhaust me ({T}) to have target Character gain 1 boost. (A Gift is when on your turn, an opponent draws a card, Resupplies or receives a token.)

OD_Rare_QorganInformant.name: Qorgan Informant
OD_Rare_QorganInformant.effect: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  {H} Remove up to 2 counters from target card in play or in Reserve. (This can't target Hero cards.)
OD_Rare_QorganInformant.flavor: Shhh. This stays between you and me.

OD_Rare_Quetzalcoatl.name: Quetzalcóatl
OD_Rare_Quetzalcoatl.effect: When an opponent draws one or more cards or does <RESUPPLY_T> — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.
OD_Rare_Quetzalcoatl.flavor: A soul has yet to be found who is bold enough to contest his wisdom.

OD_Rare_RallyingCall.name: Rallying Call
OD_Rare_RallyingCall.effect: Target Character gains 1 boost. If it is <ASLEEP>, #it gains <ANCHORED># and loses <ASLEEP>. (At Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and loses Anchored).
OD_Rare_RallyingCall.flavor: The sound of the horn stirred them from their slumber as the white shadows emerged from the woods.

OD_Rare_Ratatoskr.name: Ratatoskr
OD_Rare_Ratatoskr.effect: {R} #Create two <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in my Expedition.#
OD_Rare_Ratatoskr.flavor: You’re nuts if you think you can keep up with this little one!

OD_Rare_RekaCaterer.name: Reka Caterer
OD_Rare_RekaCaterer.effect: {J} Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
OD_Rare_RekaCaterer.support: #{D} : Create a <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.#
OD_Rare_RekaCaterer.flavor: "Happiness is always within reach, if you know how to savor it. Care for a smoothie?"

OD_Rare_RekaFixer.name: Reka Fixer
OD_Rare_RekaFixer.effect: {R} If you control a Feat, <RESUPPLY_LOW>. #If it's <COMPLETED_LOW>, draw a card instead.#
OD_Rare_RekaFixer.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.
OD_Rare_RekaFixer.flavor: "It's not time to billet yet, but take the opportunity to stock up."

OD_Rare_RekaHeadset.name: Reka Headset
OD_Rare_RekaHeadset.effect: My Expedition is considered #behind.# (Even if it's tied or ahead.)  {T} : The next Character that joins my Expedition this turn gains 1 boost.
OD_Rare_RekaHeadset.flavor: This way, we're all on the same wavelength.

OD_Rare_RekaInvestor.name: Reka Investor
OD_Rare_RekaInvestor.effect: At Dusk — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.  #When I leave the Expedition zone — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.#
OD_Rare_RekaInvestor.flavor: "Trust me, it will all trickle down for everyone's benefit."

OD_Rare_RekaPatron.name: Reka Patron
OD_Rare_RekaPatron.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
OD_Rare_RekaPatron.flavor: Art's value is in the eye of the beholder.

OD_Rare_RekaRopedancer.name: Reka Ropedancer
OD_Rare_RekaRopedancer.effect: #{J} Target Character with a {D} ability in play or in Reserve gains one boost.#
OD_Rare_RekaRopedancer.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost and <ASLEEP>.

OD_Rare_RekaSupporter.name: Reka Supporter
OD_Rare_RekaSupporter.effect: {H} Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana orb.\")
OD_Rare_RekaSupporter.flavor: The energy of the crowd is what drives the greatest victories.

OD_Rare_RekaTradesman.name: Reka Tradesman
OD_Rare_RekaTradesman.effect: {R} Put the top card of your deck #in your Mana zone# (as an exhausted Mana Orb), then create a <MANASEED> token in target opponent's Landmarks.

OD_Rare_RekaZipliner.name: Reka Zipliner
OD_Rare_RekaZipliner.effect: #{H} If I'm in {O}, create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.#
OD_Rare_RekaZipliner.flavor: The shortest distance between two points is a straight line.

OD_Rare_ResentfulRobin.name: Resentful Robin
OD_Rare_ResentfulRobin.effect: {J} If I'm facing a Character, I gain 1 boost.  #{R} My Expedition <ASCENDS>.#
OD_Rare_ResentfulRobin.flavor: Despite their small size, Rhodopean robins will defend their territory with beak and claw.

OD_Rare_RobinHood.name: Robin Hood
OD_Rare_RobinHood.effect: #Cards# your opponents play can't cost less than {2}. (If they would cost {1} or less, they cost {2} instead.)
OD_Rare_RobinHood.flavor: Justice comes from a fair redistribution of wealth.

OD_Rare_RunesTestament.name: Rune's Testament
OD_Rare_RunesTestament.effect: If my Expedition would move forward, you may discard me instead to #look at the top four cards of your deck. Put one in your hand and discard the others.#
OD_Rare_RunesTestament.flavor: The first High King of Asgartha urges us to venture forth!

OD_Rare_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.name: Sagitta, Soaring Leviathan
OD_Rare_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.effect: I cost #{2} less# if #one or more# of your Expeditions is Ascended.  $<GIGANTIC>.
OD_Rare_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.flavor: We flew higher to escape the turbulence of its wings.

OD_Rare_SapOverflow.name: Sap Overflow
OD_Rare_SapOverflow.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Choose one:  • Spend 1 counter from a card you control or in your Reserve to discard target Permanent.#  • Discard target Character in play or in Reserve.
OD_Rare_SapOverflow.flavor: With every dig, the Sap becomes riskier to harvest.

OD_Rare_SeekerOwl.name: Seeker Owl
OD_Rare_SeekerOwl.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone — #Each of your Expeditions# <ASCENDS>.
OD_Rare_SeekerOwl.flavor: Its flight is silent and its talons sharp.

OD_Rare_SilentNight.name: Silent Night
OD_Rare_SilentNight.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Roll a die, then# target a Character. On a:  • 4+, it gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)  • 1-3, it gains <ASLEEP>. (Ignore its statistics during Dusk. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
OD_Rare_SilentNight.flavor: All is calm, all is bright.

OD_Rare_Simurgh.name: Simurgh
OD_Rare_Simurgh.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  {J} If you have less cards in Reserve than target opponent, draw a card.
OD_Rare_Simurgh.support: #{I} All Reserve limits are reduced by one.#
OD_Rare_Simurgh.flavor: Three feathers. Each time you burn one, it will grant you its help.

OD_Rare_SkyboundOdyssey.name: Skybound Odyssey
OD_Rare_SkyboundOdyssey.effect: Draw a card.  Both of your Expeditions <ASCEND>.  Immediately play for free up to #three Characters# with Base Cost {3} or less. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
OD_Rare_SkyboundOdyssey.flavor: Like a beacon, the horizon calls us onward!

OD_Rare_SnoozerShroom.name: Snoozer Shroom
OD_Rare_SnoozerShroom.effect: #{H} You may pay {2}. If you do, target Character in the Expedition facing me gains <ASLEEP>.#
OD_Rare_SnoozerShroom.support: {D} : Target Character you control with Hand Cost {4} or less gains <ASLEEP>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

OD_Rare_Soar.name: Soar
OD_Rare_Soar.effect: Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.  #You may give 1 boost to target Character in an Ascended Expedition.#
OD_Rare_Soar.support: {D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.
OD_Rare_Soar.flavor: A Zephyr feather gives the Ordis the ability to fly.

OD_Rare_SouvenirSeller.name: Souvenir Seller
OD_Rare_SouvenirSeller.effect: {J} You may #create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.# If you do, target opponent <RESUPPLIES>.

OD_Rare_SpryScout.name: Spry Scout
OD_Rare_SpryScout.effect: {R} If you control a Feat, I gain 1 boost. #If it's <COMPLETED_LOW>, up to two target Characters each gain 1 boost instead.#
OD_Rare_SpryScout.flavor: "Contact in sector 3. Try to outflank on the other side!"

OD_Rare_StaffClerk.name: Staff Clerk
OD_Rare_StaffClerk.effect: When an opponent plays a card from Reserve — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in #target# Expedition.
OD_Rare_StaffClerk.flavor: Don't venture into the depths alone.

OD_Rare_StickyNoteSeals.name: Sticky Note Seals
OD_Rare_StickyNoteSeals.effect: Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {4} or more.  • Discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {4} or more.
OD_Rare_StickyNoteSeals.flavor: Some lessons stick better than others.

OD_Rare_StigmaofBanality.name: Stigma of Banality
OD_Rare_StigmaofBanality.effect: {H} You may discard target Character with Base Cost #{1} or less.# If you do, create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in its Expedition.
OD_Rare_StigmaofBanality.flavor: To be afraid of being different is to destroy individuality.

OD_Rare_StigmaofBelligerence.name: Stigma of Belligerence
OD_Rare_StigmaofBelligerence.effect: #{J}# #Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in another Expedition.# Then, if I'm facing one or more Characters, target one of them and we both gain <ANCHORED>.

OD_Rare_StrategicDeployment.name: Strategic Deployment
OD_Rare_StrategicDeployment.effect: Choose one:  • Target up to two Expeditions and create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in each of them.  • Target Character with Base Cost {2} or less switches Expeditions.

OD_Rare_StudiousRookie.name: Studious Rookie
OD_Rare_StudiousRookie.effect: When you play a #Permanent# with Base Cost {4} or more — #I gain 1 boost.# (It's the Reserve Cost if played from Reserve, or the Hand Cost if not.)
OD_Rare_StudiousRookie.flavor: Maleros should have been wary of the outsider.

OD_Rare_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.name: Sunisa, Dedicated Ensign
OD_Rare_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.effect: $<DEFENDER_FS>.  If my Expedition is behind, <DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent it from moving forward.   #{J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.#
OD_Rare_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.flavor: Forward or hold. There is no going back.

OD_Rare_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.name: Sunisa, Ordis Bodyguard
OD_Rare_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.effect: <DEFENDER_FS>.  If there are two or more cards in your Landmarks, <DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent my Expedition from moving forward.  #{J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.#
OD_Rare_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.flavor: "Behind the smiles and jubilation, I sense a growing tension…"

OD_Rare_SylasCrypticWarlock.name: Sylas, Cryptic Warlock
OD_Rare_SylasCrypticWarlock.effect: {H} Draw a card.  #{J} I gain 1 boost per card in your hand.#
OD_Rare_SylasCrypticWarlock.support: {I} When #another Character joins your Expeditions# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
OD_Rare_SylasCrypticWarlock.flavor: Knowledge is power, but secrets are paramount.

OD_Rare_Talos.name: Talos
OD_Rare_Talos.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  I'm <DEFENDER> #unless there are two or more cards in your Landmarks.#
OD_Rare_Talos.flavor: It was Talos's role to protect the statue from prying eyes.

OD_Rare_TeamworkTraining.name: Teamwork Training
OD_Rare_TeamworkTraining.effect: $<FLEETING>.  #Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.#  Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {X} or less, where X is the number of Characters you control.
OD_Rare_TeamworkTraining.flavor: Through their Hive Mind, Ordis turns the thoughts of the multitude into a unified will.

OD_Rare_Tengu.name: Tengu
OD_Rare_Tengu.effect: #{J} You may <RUSH>. If you do, my Expedition <ASCENDS>.# (Rush means playing another card immediately.)
OD_Rare_Tengu.flavor: "Calling the Tengu means submitting to anger and vanity, no?" - Basira

OD_Rare_TheConsortium.name: The Consortium
OD_Rare_TheConsortium.effect: {J} $<RESUPPLY>.  {T} : Target Character in Reserve gains 2 boosts.
OD_Rare_TheConsortium.flavor: The epicenter of Reka research, focused on perpetual growth.

OD_Rare_TheConsulate.name: The Consulate
OD_Rare_TheConsulate.effect: {J} #<RESUPPLY>.#  {T} : Target an Expedition, then create one <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in it #per card in your Landmarks, up to three per activation.#
OD_Rare_TheConsulate.flavor: Here, far from the crowd, is where fruitful negotiations are held between Reka and Asgarthans.

OD_Rare_TheCouncil.name: The Council
OD_Rare_TheCouncil.effect: The {j}, {h} and {r} abilities of Characters facing me can't activate.
OD_Rare_TheCouncil.flavor: The idea of facing the Council is deterrent enough for most would-be criminals in Asgartha.

OD_Rare_TheFarm.name: The Farm
OD_Rare_TheFarm.effect: At Noon — I gain 1 Food counter per Character you control.  {T}, Spend 2 of my Food counters: <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
OD_Rare_TheFarm.flavor: The Mess requires a farm that can consistently provide for its day-to-day needs.

OD_Rare_TheFrogPrince.name: The Frog Prince
OD_Rare_TheFrogPrince.flavor: Thankfully, he doesn't seal his contracts with a kiss.

OD_Rare_TheKraken.name: The Kraken
