OD_Rare_TheKraken.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  {J} Sacrifice two Characters.  All regions are {O} and lose their other types.
OD_Rare_TheKraken.flavor: The Kraken tears open the surface, sending plumes of water crashing down on the troops in an apocalyptic deluge.

OD_Rare_TheLastStand.name: The Last Stand
OD_Rare_TheLastStand.effect: {J} Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less.#  When you pass — If you control another Feat, complete me.
OD_Rare_TheLastStand.flavor: "If we are to fall, let this be our last stand!"

OD_Rare_TheLectern.name: The Lectern
OD_Rare_TheLectern.effect: {J} #If there's another card in your Landmarks, draw a card.# Otherwise, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.  When I'm sacrificed — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> in a Hero Expedition.
OD_Rare_TheLectern.flavor: Sol may have sounded the alarm, but her words seem to be falling on deaf ears.

OD_Rare_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.name: The Monolith, Ordis Bastion
OD_Rare_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.effect: When a #non-token# Character joins your Expeditions — It gains 1 boost.
OD_Rare_TheMonolithOrdisBastion.flavor: A beacon of knowledge and order, a lighthouse towering high above the world.

OD_Rare_TheNaos.name: The Naos
OD_Rare_TheNaos.effect: <TOUGH_1>.  #{J} Target Expedition can't move forward this Day.#  At Noon — Draw a card, then create two <MANASEED> tokens in your Landmarks.
OD_Rare_TheNaos.flavor: Patiently, the Reka waited for their new world tree to grow.

OD_Rare_TheOrigamium.name: The Origamium
OD_Rare_TheOrigamium.effect: {J} Target Expedition <ASCENDS>.  #{T}: #Target Character in an Ascended Expedition gains 1 boost.

OD_Rare_TheReunion.name: The Reunion
OD_Rare_TheReunion.effect: {T} : Choose up to the number of cards in your Landmarks:  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in a Companion Expedition.  • Create one in a Hero Expedition.  • Up to two target Characters gain 1 boost.  • #Draw a card.#
OD_Rare_TheReunion.flavor: "Two people separated by fate, now reunited once more! This reunion shall forever be carved in stone!"

OD_Rare_TheSandman.name: The Sandman
OD_Rare_TheSandman.effect: {H} Up to one target Character gains <ASLEEP>. #You may have it gain 2 boosts.# (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
OD_Rare_TheSandman.flavor: "Sand gives you a taste of what life is all about. Come morning, the castles you have built will be gone with the tide."

OD_Rare_TheSnowMaiden.name: The Snow Maiden
OD_Rare_TheSnowMaiden.effect: {H} Target opponent may <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY_INF>. (They put the top card of their deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}.)
OD_Rare_TheSnowMaiden.flavor: Thus, as the snow falls under the sky's clear frost. She has awoken - Snegurochka is once again!

OD_Rare_TheSnowQueen.name: The Snow Queen
OD_Rare_TheSnowQueen.effect: <ETERNAL_FS>.  #<TOUGH_FS_X>, where X is the number of exhausted cards in Reserve.  {J} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve.#  Exhausted Characters in Reserve remain exhausted during Morning.

OD_Rare_TheTownSquare.name: The Town Square
OD_Rare_TheTownSquare.effect: At Dusk — I gain 1 Morale counter per Character you control.  {T}, Spend 6 of my Morale counters: #Characters you control# gain 1 boost.
OD_Rare_TheTownSquare.flavor: In light of the Ordis' well-known organizational advantages, the Factions entrusted them with outpost logistics.

OD_Rare_TheUglyDuckling.name: The Ugly Duckling
OD_Rare_TheUglyDuckling.effect: #{J} You may pay {1}. If you do, I gain 1 boost and my Expedition <ASCENDS>.#
OD_Rare_TheUglyDuckling.flavor: This young recruit swans about while proudly showing off his insignia.

OD_Rare_TheWayfarer.name: The Wayfarer
OD_Rare_TheWayfarer.effect: #When you play a Bureaucrat — Roll a die# and reveal the top card of your deck.  When you reveal a card this way — If its Hand Cost is equal to the die's result, draw it.
OD_Rare_TheWayfarer.flavor: The Tisdhera Clan answers its Matriarch's call!

OD_Rare_TheWesternWind.name: The Western Wind
OD_Rare_TheWesternWind.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target Expedition #you control# moves backwards one region. If it does, move your other Expedition forward one region.
OD_Rare_TheWesternWind.flavor: It's no use going against the Wind.

OD_Rare_Thoth.name: Thoth
OD_Rare_Thoth.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create #two# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in target Expedition after Rest.
OD_Rare_Thoth.flavor: "The pen is mightier than the sword."

OD_Rare_Thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
OD_Rare_Thunderbird.effect: #{J}# My Expedition <ASCENDS>.  When my Expedition moves forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION> — Draw a card.

OD_Rare_TinyJail.name: Tiny Jail
OD_Rare_TinyJail.effect: #$<COOLDOWN>#.  Send to Reserve target Character with no statistic over 3.

OD_Rare_TotingArmadillo.name: Toting Armadillo
OD_Rare_TotingArmadillo.effect: {H} Pay #{1}# less for the next Permanent you play this Afternoon, down to a minimum of #{1}#
OD_Rare_TotingArmadillo.flavor: Its shell has inspired the shields’ design.

OD_Rare_UnfairEncounter.name: Unfair Encounter
OD_Rare_UnfairEncounter.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target a Landmark Permanent with Hand Cost {2} or less. #Its controller <RESUPPLIES>,# then you take control of it. (It joins your Landmarks.)

OD_Rare_Valemon.name: Valemon
OD_Rare_Valemon.effect: Unless you have eight or more Mana Orbs, I am $<DEFENDER>.  #If you have ten or more Mana Orbs, I am $<GIGANTIC>.#
OD_Rare_Valemon.flavor: Promise me to wait, and I will show you my real face.

OD_Rare_Verdantback.name: Verdantback
OD_Rare_Verdantback.effect: I am $<DEFENDER> unless you control two or more #Bureaucrats#.
OD_Rare_Verdantback.flavor: Slow and steady wins the race.

OD_Rare_Vishvakarma.name: Vishvakarma
OD_Rare_Vishvakarma.effect: {J} The next Permanent you play this Afternoon costs #{3} less#.
OD_Rare_Vishvakarma.flavor: Each construction is a poem, and building is an act of eloquence.

OD_Rare_WigwaggingKiwi.name: Wigwagging Kiwi
OD_Rare_WigwaggingKiwi.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost per <ASCENDED_S> Expedition you control.  #If one of your <ASCENDED_S> Expeditions would attempt to <ASCEND_INF> again, I also gain 1 boost.#

OD_Rare_YannaQorganAgent.name: Yanna, Qorgan Agent
OD_Rare_YannaQorganAgent.effect: {J} You may have target Character gain <ASLEEP>. #If it's facing me, <SABOTAGE>.#
OD_Rare_YannaQorganAgent.flavor: Spies from the Qorgan infiltrate the Factions and steal their secrets.

OD_Rare_YzmirMothbreeder.name: Yzmir Mothbreeder
OD_Rare_YzmirMothbreeder.effect: $<SCOUT_2> {2}.  {H} Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
OD_Rare_YzmirMothbreeder.flavor: Have you heard of the butterfly effect?

OD_Rare_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.name: Zaratan, Social Leviathan
OD_Rare_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  #{J} Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in target Expedition.#  {J} I gain 1 boost per Character in the Expeditions facing me.
OD_Rare_ZaratanSocialLeviathan.flavor: We were sailing among the islands when one of them came to meet us.

YZ_Common_AetherShard.name: Aether Shard
YZ_Common_AetherShard.flavor: No mere trinket, but a fragment of purest dream.

YZ_Common_AfanasSenka.name: Afanas & Senka
YZ_Common_AfanasSenka.effect: Spells you play with Hand Cost {1} or less are <FLEETING>. When you play a Spell — Target Character you control gains 1 boost$<BB>. (Do this after the spell resolves.)
YZ_Common_AfanasSenka.flavor: The world feeds on magic, and withers in its absence.

YZ_Common_AkeshaTaru.name: Akesha & Taru
YZ_Common_AkeshaTaru.effect: {T} : $<AFTER_YOU>. You can only activate this if you are the first player.
YZ_Common_AkeshaTaru.flavor: Whatever ordeals we may face, good manners and politeness are always in fashion!

YZ_Common_AleloEerieLeviathan.name: Alelo, Eerie Leviathan
YZ_Common_AleloEerieLeviathan.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  I'm also considered a Spell, even when not in play. (Play me as a Character, but it counts as playing a Spell for other abilities.)
YZ_Common_AleloEerieLeviathan.flavor: We followed in its wake, believing it was a magical current.

YZ_Common_Alice.name: Alice
YZ_Common_Alice.support: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

YZ_Common_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.name: Aroro, Savior of Asgartha
YZ_Common_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.effect: {H} You may discard a Spell from your Reserve. If you do, I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Common_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.flavor: Alone, she was able to turn back the tide.

YZ_Common_BabaYaga.name: Baba Yaga
YZ_Common_BabaYaga.flavor: Help or harm? Only the card will tell.

YZ_Common_BabasIsba.name: Baba's Isba
YZ_Common_BabasIsba.effect: {J} Draw a card.  {T}, Sacrifice a Character: $<AFTER_YOU>.
YZ_Common_BabasIsba.flavor: Boney Legs, she's called, and her hut is one reason why.

YZ_Common_Bait.name: Bait
YZ_Common_Bait.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Target token Character defects. (It joins the Expedition facing it, changing controllers.)
YZ_Common_Bait.flavor: They always say the grass is greener on the other side...

YZ_Common_Baku.name: Baku
YZ_Common_Baku.effect: {H} Target opponent discards a card from their hand.
YZ_Common_Baku.flavor: "I’ve seen it myself! 'Baku! Baku!', it says, eating up ghosts as though they were candies."

YZ_Common_BanishingGate.name: Banishing Gate
YZ_Common_BanishingGate.flavor: Let me walk you to the door.

YZ_Common_BaronCimetiere.name: Baron Cimetière
YZ_Common_BaronCimetiere.effect: {H} If six or more cards are in your discard pile, create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Common_BaronCimetiere.flavor: Need someone to slam the door in their faces?

YZ_Common_Belasenka.name: Belasenka
YZ_Common_Belasenka.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
YZ_Common_Belasenka.flavor: The cold snap they ride, like a shivering tide.

YZ_Common_Blizzard.name: Blizzard
YZ_Common_Blizzard.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve each Character from target Expedition, then exhaust them ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
YZ_Common_Blizzard.flavor: The icy winds wrecked the army, despite months of preparation.

YZ_Common_Brainwash.name: Brainwash
YZ_Common_Brainwash.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target a Character in any Reserve with Reserve Cost {2} or less. Play it for free. (Put it in one of your Expeditions. If it would move to your Discard or any other personal zone, it goes to its owner's instead.)
YZ_Common_Brainwash.flavor: Like a worm in an apple, Silk squirmed into the Eidolon's mind to convert him to its Faction's interests.

YZ_Common_Caladrius.name: Caladrius
YZ_Common_Caladrius.effect: {H} You may send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.
YZ_Common_Caladrius.flavor: With a simple glance, it reveals your destination.

YZ_Common_CelestialBlast.name: Celestial Blast
YZ_Common_CelestialBlast.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Discard up to two targets, Characters or Permanents.
YZ_Common_CelestialBlast.flavor: The sky cracked open in a thunderous wave as the dream was unleashed upon the world.

YZ_Common_Chrysalis.name: Chrysalis
YZ_Common_Chrysalis.effect: $<DEFENDER>.  When I leave the Expedition Zone — Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in my Expedition.
YZ_Common_Chrysalis.flavor: ...They build their ice cocoon to turn ethereal.

YZ_Common_ConjuringSeal.name: Conjuring Seal
YZ_Common_ConjuringSeal.flavor: The Imagination shapes our reality just as our beliefs shaped the Æther.

YZ_Common_CorruptedBabaYaga.name: Corrupted Baba Yaga
YZ_Common_CorruptedBabaYaga.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless six or more cards are in your discard pile.  {H} Draw a card.
YZ_Common_CorruptedBabaYaga.flavor: "The Empyrean is flooded with Nightmare. It's spilling over." - Baba Yaga

YZ_Common_CorruptedToothFairy.name: Corrupted Tooth Fairy
YZ_Common_CorruptedToothFairy.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless six or more cards are in your discard pile.  {H} <SABOTAGE>.
YZ_Common_CorruptedToothFairy.flavor: Why muzzle the wolf when you can remove it's fangs ?

YZ_Common_Defect.name: Defect
YZ_Common_Defect.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target Character defects. (It joins the Expedition facing it, changing controllers. If it would move to your Reserve or any other personal zone, it goes to its owner's instead.)
YZ_Common_Defect.flavor: Changing sides isn't always a matter of choice.

YZ_Common_DorothyGale.name: Dorothy Gale
YZ_Common_DorothyGale.effect: {H} You may send target Character to Reserve.
YZ_Common_DorothyGale.flavor: "I’ve a feeling we’re not in Kansas anymore."

YZ_Common_Evanescence.name: Evanescence
YZ_Common_Evanescence.effect: Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {X}+{2} or less, where X is my number of Arcane Counters, then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
YZ_Common_Evanescence.support: {I} When you play another Spell — I gain 1 Arcane counter, up to a max of 3.
YZ_Common_Evanescence.flavor: In the depths of the City, something seems to be devouring memories and thoughts.

YZ_Common_FeastofThoughts.name: Feast of Thoughts
YZ_Common_FeastofThoughts.effect: Choose X+1, where X is my number of Arcane counters:  • Draw a card.  • Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.  • Remove 3 counters from target card in play or in Reserve.  • <SABOTAGE>.
YZ_Common_FeastofThoughts.support: {I} When you play another Spell — I gain 1 Arcane counter, up to a max of 3.
YZ_Common_FeastofThoughts.flavor: When the Remanence strikes, ideas burst out of one's mind like water from a dam.

YZ_Common_Finisher.name: Finisher
YZ_Common_Finisher.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose up to three:  • Discard target Character.  • Discard target Permanent.  • <SABOTAGE>.

YZ_Common_Flamel.name: Flamel
YZ_Common_Flamel.effect: {H} You may return a Spell from your Reserve to your hand.
YZ_Common_Flamel.support: {D} : The next Spell you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Common_Flamel.flavor: Rubedo is the final stage of alchemy, where one's substance is reborn like a phoenix before returning to the world.

YZ_Common_FlutterofMoths.name: Flutter of Moths
YZ_Common_FlutterofMoths.effect: I cost {1} less if there are two or more exhausted cards in Reserve.  Create three <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens, distributed as you choose among any number of target Expeditions.

YZ_Common_FortheGreaterGood.name: For the Greater Good
YZ_Common_FortheGreaterGood.effect: <FLEETING>.  Discard a card from your hand. If you do, discard target card in play with Base Cost {3} or less. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, the Hand Cost otherwise.)

YZ_Common_FoulFaker.name: Foul Faker
YZ_Common_FoulFaker.effect: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (Discard up to one card from a Reserve. I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

YZ_Common_Freeze.name: Freeze
YZ_Common_Freeze.effect: $<COOLDOWN>.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

YZ_Common_GiftofSelf.name: Gift of Self
YZ_Common_GiftofSelf.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Sacrifice a Character. If you do, draw two cards.
YZ_Common_GiftofSelf.flavor: Her being begins to disintegrate as she breaks all the Mana bridges linking the idea of who she is to physical matter.

YZ_Common_GrumpyImp.name: Grumpy Imp
YZ_Common_GrumpyImp.effect: When you discard a card from your hand — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Common_GrumpyImp.flavor: He will fight like the devil, despite his fear.

YZ_Common_HarryHoudini.name: Harry Houdini
YZ_Common_HarryHoudini.effect: {H} Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in an opponent's Expedition, then draw a card.
YZ_Common_HarryHoudini.flavor: The secret of illusion lies in misdirection.

YZ_Common_HextagChaser.name: Hextag Chaser
YZ_Common_HextagChaser.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in any player's Reserve. If it was the only card in their Reserve, they <RESUPPLY_THEY_S>. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
YZ_Common_HextagChaser.flavor: The element of surprise adds extra spice to any tactic.

YZ_Common_IceboundPass.name: Icebound Pass
YZ_Common_IceboundPass.effect: When you exhaust a card in Reserve — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then draw a card.
YZ_Common_IceboundPass.flavor: We can hear it roar in the snowy passes.

YZ_Common_InvestigatetheCorruption.name: Investigate the Corruption
YZ_Common_InvestigatetheCorruption.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Draw two cards, then discard a card from your hand.
YZ_Common_InvestigatetheCorruption.flavor: \"By understanding the evil, we can pull it out at the root.\" - Zaj

YZ_Common_Janus.name: Janus
YZ_Common_Janus.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  When you discard a card from your hand — I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Common_Janus.flavor: "God of gates, it is time to close the Veil." — Sam

YZ_Common_KadigiranAlchemist.name: Kadigiran Alchemist
YZ_Common_KadigiranAlchemist.flavor: Alchemy is not just a matter of turning lead to gold. It's about purifying yourself of imperfections to become your true self.

YZ_Common_KadigiranMageDancer.name: Kadigiran Mage-Dancer
YZ_Common_KadigiranMageDancer.effect: When you play a Spell — I gain 1 boost$<BB>.
YZ_Common_KadigiranMageDancer.flavor: "Don't just wait for magic to happen. Go out and make your own!"

YZ_Common_Kali.name: Kali
YZ_Common_Kali.effect: {H} You may put a Spell from your hand in Reserve. If you don't, sacrifice me.

YZ_Common_KrakensWrath.name: Kraken's Wrath
YZ_Common_KrakensWrath.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve up to three target Characters with a total Hand Cost {5} or less.
YZ_Common_KrakensWrath.flavor: The roaring waves crashed down over the charging armies, and countless soldiers vanished beneath the raging waters.

YZ_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
YZ_Common_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} Exhaust all cards in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)

YZ_Common_KuwattheDissenter.name: Kuwat, the Dissenter
YZ_Common_KuwattheDissenter.effect: {J} Sacrifice a Character in my Expedition.
YZ_Common_KuwattheDissenter.flavor: "There are gates one should not open, there are seals one should not breach. And yet I will."

YZ_Common_LadyoftheLake.name: Lady of the Lake
YZ_Common_LadyoftheLake.flavor: "One day, I will show you the wonders of Avalon and the true might of the Fae realms."

YZ_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
YZ_Common_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less.

YZ_Common_LindiweMaw.name: Lindiwe & Maw
YZ_Common_LindiweMaw.effect: {T} : Create a [Maw 0/0/0] Companion token in your Companion Expedition with "When you sacrifice a Character — I gain 2 boosts". This action costs {1} more if you are not the first player.
YZ_Common_LindiweMaw.flavor: To master magic, one must be willing to sacrifice.

YZ_Common_MagicalTraining.name: Magical Training
YZ_Common_MagicalTraining.flavor: Without practice, the gift of Alteration will come to nothing.

YZ_Common_ManaMoth.name: Mana Moth
YZ_Common_ManaMoth.effect: (If I leave the Expedition zone, remove me from the game.)

YZ_Common_ManaSeamstress.name: Mana Seamstress
YZ_Common_ManaSeamstress.flavor: Stitching the fabric of reality back together to avoid another Confluence...

YZ_Common_Maw.name: Maw
YZ_Common_Maw.effect: When you sacrifice a Character — I gain 2 boosts.

YZ_Common_Merlin.name: Merlin
YZ_Common_Merlin.effect: $<SCOUT_4> {4}.  {H} You may send target Character to Reserve.
YZ_Common_Merlin.flavor: "You and I both know it has never been about the sword."

YZ_Common_Metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
YZ_Common_Metamorphosis.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Discard target Character, then create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in its Expedition.
YZ_Common_Metamorphosis.flavor: Every reality contains its share of illusions.

YZ_Common_MiladydeWinter.name: Milady de Winter
YZ_Common_MiladydeWinter.effect: {H} Take control of target token Permanent, putting it in my Expedition if it's an Expedition Permanent.
YZ_Common_MiladydeWinter.flavor: There's something so delectable about nabbing someone else's assets.

YZ_Common_MochizukiChiyome.name: Mochizuki Chiyome
YZ_Common_MochizukiChiyome.support: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Spell you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Common_MochizukiChiyome.flavor: The art of surprise is showing up where you're not expected.

YZ_Common_MoltingCrab.name: Molting Crab
YZ_Common_MoltingCrab.effect: {H} Draw a card, then discard a card from your hand.
YZ_Common_MoltingCrab.flavor: It's pincers grips the fabric of reality.

YZ_Common_MoonlightJellyfish.name: Moonlight Jellyfish
YZ_Common_MoonlightJellyfish.effect: When I'm sacrificed, if I was not <FLEETING> — Put me in Reserve.
YZ_Common_MoonlightJellyfish.flavor: Theoretically, transdifferentiation can go on indefinitely, effectively rendering the jellyfish biologically immortal... and squishy.

YZ_Common_MothCollision.name: Moth Collision
YZ_Common_MothCollision.effect: $<FLEETING>.  If you control an Illusion, I cost {1} less.  Discard target Character.
YZ_Common_MothCollision.flavor: When two moths meet, there's always a spark.

YZ_Common_MothDecoy.name: Moth Decoy
YZ_Common_MothDecoy.effect: You may exhaust ({T}) a card from your Reserve to play me for {1} less.  Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Common_MothDecoy.flavor: "You're not the only ones who can use substitution." — Moyo

YZ_Common_MothLantern.name: Moth Lantern
YZ_Common_MothLantern.effect: When you sacrifice a non-Illusion Character — Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in my Expedition.  {J} Sacrifice a Character in my Expedition.
YZ_Common_MothLantern.flavor: In the tricks of its light, shed your skin to become an illusion.

YZ_Common_MothLarva.name: Moth Larva
YZ_Common_MothLarva.effect: {H} If there are two or more exhausted cards in Reserve, I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Common_MothLarva.flavor: At the start of their short life, the larvae are corporeal...

YZ_Common_MothcatcherWand.name: Mothcatcher Wand
YZ_Common_MothcatcherWand.effect: {J} Exhaust target card in Reserve.  {T}, {X} : Create X <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens in my Expedition. X can't be higher than the number of exhausted cards in Reserve.
YZ_Common_MothcatcherWand.flavor: Moyo uses it to capture the essence of illusion.

YZ_Common_MothtoaFlame.name: Moth to a Flame
YZ_Common_MothtoaFlame.effect: <COOLDOWN>. (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Common_MothtoaFlame.flavor: During the scant hours of their brief existence, the Moths flutter about, carrying only the idea of themselves.

YZ_Common_MothtoaSpring.name: Moth to a Spring
YZ_Common_MothtoaSpring.effect: Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.  Draw a card.
YZ_Common_MothtoaSpring.flavor: A spring that will quench any thirst for magic.

YZ_Common_MoyoSilk.name: Moyo & Silk
YZ_Common_MoyoSilk.effect: When you play a Spell with Base Cost {4} or more — You may exhaust me ({T}) to create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in your Hero Expedition. If the Base Cost was {7} or more, also draw a card. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
YZ_Common_MoyoSilk.flavor: The idea of the butterfly resides within the caterpillar

YZ_Common_NilamSpires.name: Nilam Spires
YZ_Common_NilamSpires.effect: When you play a Spell — I gain 1 Arcane counter. Then, you may exhaust me ({T}) and spend 4 of my Arcane counters to create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Common_NilamSpires.flavor: Observing the Tumult requires taking a high-level perspective on it, and mastering it requires knowledge.

YZ_Common_OffYouGo.name: Off You Go!
YZ_Common_OffYouGo.effect: Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less.

YZ_Common_Pamola.name: Pamola
YZ_Common_Pamola.support: {D} : Exhaust target card in Reserve. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Common_Pamola.flavor: Pamola is always angry with those who climb to the summit.

YZ_Common_PartialReferee.name: Partial Referee
YZ_Common_PartialReferee.effect: {H} Discard target Character. If its Base Cost was {3} or more, its controller draws a card. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)

YZ_Common_Pasiphae.name: Pasiphaë
YZ_Common_Pasiphae.effect: {J} I gain <FLEETING>.  {J} I gain 1 boost per Character target opponent controls.
YZ_Common_Pasiphae.flavor: She won't let herself be bullied.

YZ_Common_PushBacktheNight.name: Push Back the Night
YZ_Common_PushBacktheNight.effect: {J} Draw a card.  At Noon — If six or more cards are in your discard pile, complete me.
YZ_Common_PushBacktheNight.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When a card is discarded from your hand — You may exhaust me ({T}) to create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.

YZ_Common_QorganExorcist.name: Qorgan Exorcist
YZ_Common_QorganExorcist.effect: {H} Discard the top card of your deck.
YZ_Common_QorganExorcist.flavor: Now we just need to cover Sam's back.

YZ_Common_QorganInformant.name: Qorgan Informant
YZ_Common_QorganInformant.effect: {H} Remove up to 2 counters from target card in play or in Reserve. (This can't target Hero cards.)
YZ_Common_QorganInformant.flavor: Shhh. This stays between you and me.

YZ_Common_QorganOccultist.name: Qorgan Occultist
YZ_Common_QorganOccultist.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless you discarded a card from your hand this turn. (Not this Day.)
YZ_Common_QorganOccultist.flavor: \"Be careful, the Nightare's darkness can taint any idea.\".

YZ_Common_QorganPhantom.name: Qorgan Phantom
YZ_Common_QorganPhantom.support: {D} : Draw a card, then discard a card from your hand. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Common_QorganPhantom.flavor: "Our role is to create a diversion so a small group can make it to the breach."

YZ_Common_RekaSupporter.name: Reka Supporter
YZ_Common_RekaSupporter.effect: {H} Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (It's a Permanent with \"{T}, Sacrifice me: Ready a Mana orb.\")
YZ_Common_RekaSupporter.flavor: The energy of the crowd is what drives the greatest victories.

YZ_Common_RimeFrost.name: Rime Frost
YZ_Common_RimeFrost.effect: Exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
YZ_Common_RimeFrost.flavor: A late frost delays the spring.

YZ_Common_Sakarabru.name: Sakarabru
YZ_Common_Sakarabru.effect: {H} Your opponent's Expedition facing me moves backwards one region.
YZ_Common_Sakarabru.flavor: When such a terrifying being appears in your path, taking a step back is only natural.

YZ_Common_SakarabrusFury.name: Sakarabru's Fury
YZ_Common_SakarabrusFury.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Target Expedition moves backwards one region.
YZ_Common_SakarabrusFury.flavor: With a single gesture, Sakarabru swept away days of progress.

YZ_Common_SamSpook.name: Sam & Spook
YZ_Common_SamSpook.effect: {T} : Draw a card, then discard a card from your hand. You can only activate this if you are first player. As soon as six cards or more are in your discard pile, I permanently gain: \"When you discard a card from your hand — Return it to your Reserve.\".
YZ_Common_SamSpook.flavor: "Finally! I think we're going to have some fun!"

YZ_Common_SapInfusion.name: Sap Infusion
YZ_Common_SapInfusion.effect: Target Character gains X+2 boosts, where X is my number of Arcane counters.
YZ_Common_SapInfusion.support: {I} When you play another Spell — I gain 1 Arcane counter, up to a max of 3.
YZ_Common_SapInfusion.flavor: There are a thousand ways to use the Sap. The Yzmir seek to exploit its full potential.

YZ_Common_ScholarsVault.name: Scholars' Vault
YZ_Common_ScholarsVault.effect: {J} <RESUPPLY>.  If there are one or more Spells in your Reserve, your Reserve limit is increased by one.
YZ_Common_ScholarsVault.flavor: Within its currents swim ancient knowledge and forgotten memories.

YZ_Common_ScribblingStarfish.name: Scribbling Starfish
YZ_Common_ScribblingStarfish.support: {I} When you play a Spell — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
YZ_Common_ScribblingStarfish.flavor: A good Sigil starts with a good sketch.

YZ_Common_Shiva.name: Shiva
YZ_Common_Shiva.effect: {H} You may discard target Permanent. If you don't, I gain 2 boosts.
YZ_Common_Shiva.flavor: Any creation begins with an act of destruction.

YZ_Common_SmallStepGiantLeap.name: Small Step, Giant Leap
YZ_Common_SmallStepGiantLeap.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Target Expedition moves forward one region.
YZ_Common_SmallStepGiantLeap.flavor: The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.

YZ_Common_SportsEncounter.name: Sports Encounter
YZ_Common_SportsEncounter.effect: Distribute 2 boosts among any target Characters in play.
YZ_Common_SportsEncounter.support: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (Discard me from Reserve to end your turn as if you had played a card.)
YZ_Common_SportsEncounter.flavor: "Your victory is a victory for both our peoples!"

YZ_Common_SpyCraft.name: Spy Craft
YZ_Common_SpyCraft.flavor: This message will self-destruct in five seconds.

YZ_Common_StigmaofFallacy.name: Stigma of Fallacy
YZ_Common_StigmaofFallacy.effect: {H} If there's a \"Stigma of Fallacy\" in your discard pile, create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Common_StigmaofFallacy.support: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (End your turn as if you had played a card.)
YZ_Common_StigmaofFallacy.flavor: Falsehoods behind the mask, hidden under the guise of truth…

YZ_Common_StudiousAcolyte.name: Studious Acolyte
YZ_Common_StudiousAcolyte.effect: You may play Spells for {1} less if their Base Cost is {4} or more. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
YZ_Common_StudiousAcolyte.flavor: Afanas' backing is beginning to bear fruit.

YZ_Common_StudiousDisciple.name: Studious Disciple
YZ_Common_StudiousDisciple.support: {D} : The next Spell you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Common_StudiousDisciple.flavor: So far behind, and still so much to learn!

YZ_Common_StudiousRookie.name: Studious Rookie
YZ_Common_StudiousRookie.effect: When you play a Spell with Base Cost {4} or more — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost. (It's the Reserve Cost if played from Reserve, or the Hand Cost if not.)
YZ_Common_StudiousRookie.flavor: Maleros should have been wary of the outsider.

YZ_Common_SuhaQorganOperative.name: Suha, Qorgan Operative
YZ_Common_SuhaQorganOperative.effect: {H} I gain 1 boost, then <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (Discard up to one target card from a Reserve.)
YZ_Common_SuhaQorganOperative.flavor: By accepting the Qorgan's offer, Suha got to see what was down the rabbit hole.

YZ_Common_SylasCrypticWarlock.name: Sylas, Cryptic Warlock
YZ_Common_SylasCrypticWarlock.support: {I} When you play a Spell — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
YZ_Common_SylasCrypticWarlock.flavor: Knowledge is power, but secrets are paramount.

YZ_Common_Tag.name: Tag!
YZ_Common_Tag.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target opponent sacrifices the Character they control with the highest Base Cost. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)

YZ_Common_TeamMascot.name: Team Mascot
YZ_Common_TeamMascot.effect: {J} If there's an exhausted card in Reserve, I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Common_TeamMascot.flavor: She gets the substitutes fired up so they're ready to take the field.

YZ_Common_TerrifiedGhost.name: Terrified Ghost
YZ_Common_TerrifiedGhost.flavor: A terror that even ghosts can feel...

YZ_Common_TheHunger.name: The Hunger
YZ_Common_TheHunger.effect: {H} Discard all other cards in play or in Reserve.  When a card goes to the discard pile — I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Common_TheHunger.flavor: The City has a soul, and it is famished.

YZ_Common_TheInfirmary.name: The Infirmary
YZ_Common_TheInfirmary.effect: {T}, Exhaust a card in your Reserve: $<AFTER_YOU>.
YZ_Common_TheInfirmary.flavor: "I told you it was a bad idea to drink all that Sap Cola…"

YZ_Common_TheKadigirYzmirBastion.name: The Kadigir, Yzmir Bastion
YZ_Common_TheKadigirYzmirBastion.effect: {T} : The next Spell you play this turn is free.
YZ_Common_TheKadigirYzmirBastion.flavor: What dark, phantasmagorical secrets hide within Asgartha's College of Magic? Only madmen and the Yzmirs know for sure...

YZ_Common_TheKraken.name: The Kraken
YZ_Common_TheKraken.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  {J} Sacrifice two Characters.  All regions are {E} and lose their other types.
YZ_Common_TheKraken.flavor: The Kraken tears open the surface, sending plumes of water crashing down on the troops in an apocalyptic deluge.

YZ_Common_TheNilamWitheredTree.name: The Nilam, Withered Tree
YZ_Common_TheNilamWitheredTree.effect: When you exhaust a card in Reserve — You may exhaust me ({T}) to create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.  {J} You may exhaust target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
YZ_Common_TheNilamWitheredTree.flavor: Long after it died, the Nilam still held life as the nesting grounds for the Mana Moths.

YZ_Common_TheSnowQueen.name: The Snow Queen
YZ_Common_TheSnowQueen.effect: $<ETERNAL_FS>.  Exhausted Characters in Reserve remain exhausted during Morning.

YZ_Common_TheTortoise.name: The Tortoise
YZ_Common_TheTortoise.support: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (Discard me from Reserve to end your turn as if you had played a card.)
YZ_Common_TheTortoise.flavor: "I'll gladly give you the spot, there's no use getting in a stew."

YZ_Common_TheWellofTears.name: The Well of Tears
YZ_Common_TheWellofTears.effect: When you play a Spell with Base Cost {4} or more — You may give target Character 1 boost. (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
YZ_Common_TheWellofTears.flavor: A crack in the heart of the Kadigir...

YZ_Common_TimeOut.name: Time Out!
YZ_Common_TimeOut.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost {4} or less, then exhaust it ({T}). (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)
YZ_Common_TimeOut.flavor: Time to switch things up a bit.

YZ_Common_Undine.name: Undine
YZ_Common_Undine.support: {D} : The next Spell you play this turn loses <FLEETING>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Common_Undine.flavor: When Yzmir alchemists call on the water spirit, the mischievous undine responds.

YZ_Common_WinterNova.name: Winter Nova
YZ_Common_WinterNova.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose three:  • Exhaust up to two cards in Reserve.  • Create two <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens in target Expedition.  • Discard target Permanent.  • Target player sacrifices a Character.
YZ_Common_WinterNova.flavor: A forgotten power waits to be awakened.

YZ_Common_YzmirEngraver.name: Yzmir Engraver
YZ_Common_YzmirEngraver.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.
YZ_Common_YzmirEngraver.support: {I} When you play a Spell — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
YZ_Common_YzmirEngraver.flavor: By mixing Sap into the ink, the power of the Sigils is augmented tenfold.

YZ_Common_YzmirMothbreeder.name: Yzmir Mothbreeder
YZ_Common_YzmirMothbreeder.effect: $<SCOUT_2> {2}.  {H} Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Common_YzmirMothbreeder.flavor: Have you heard of the butterfly effect?

YZ_Common_YzmirNurse.name: Yzmir Nurse
YZ_Common_YzmirNurse.effect: {H} You may sacrifice a Character. If you do, I gain 2 boosts.
YZ_Common_YzmirNurse.flavor: The Cloister's Nurses may be harsh, but they work wonders, according to those who survive.

YZ_Common_YzmirSignet.name: Yzmir Signet
YZ_Common_YzmirSignet.effect: Choose one:  • Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost {2} or less.  • <SABOTAGE>.  • Draw a card.

YZ_Common_YzmirStargazer.name: Yzmir Stargazer
YZ_Common_YzmirStargazer.flavor: She won't read the future in the stars, she'll change it herself.

YZ_Exalted_ClosetheBreach.name: Close the Breach!
YZ_Exalted_ClosetheBreach.effect: {J} Discard target Character with Base Cost {3} or less.  When you pass after your opponents — If you are first player, complete me.
YZ_Exalted_ClosetheBreach.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: {T}, {1} : Target Character you control gains 1 boost, then <AFTER_YOU>.
YZ_Exalted_ClosetheBreach.flavor: "Close the breach? I was just getting warmed up…"

YZ_Exalted_MalerosRekaHexarch.name: Maleros, Reka Hexarch
YZ_Exalted_MalerosRekaHexarch.effect: {H} Pay {7} less for the next Spell you play this Afternoon.
YZ_Exalted_MalerosRekaHexarch.flavor: "Congratulations. Forcing me to take the field is no small feat."

YZ_Exalted_PlagueofIgnorance.name: Plague of Ignorance
YZ_Exalted_PlagueofIgnorance.effect: {H} You may discard a card from your hand to send target Character to Reserve.
YZ_Exalted_PlagueofIgnorance.flavor: Ignorance is the crucible of evil.

YZ_Rare_AbandonedDepot.name: Abandoned Depot
YZ_Rare_AbandonedDepot.effect: {J} Draw a card.  When I'm sacrificed — #<RESUPPLY>.# (Excess Landmarks are sacrificed at the end of the Day.)  {T}, {1} : Sacrifice me.
YZ_Rare_AbandonedDepot.flavor: "There's no doubt about it... These ruins are the work of people from the City of Scholars." - Abiram

YZ_Rare_AdaLovelace.name: Ada Lovelace
YZ_Rare_AdaLovelace.effect: {R} You may put a card from your hand in Reserve. If it's a #Spell#, draw a card.
YZ_Rare_AdaLovelace.flavor: "Imagination is the discovering faculty. It is that which penetrates the unseen worlds around us."

YZ_Rare_AdamantReceptionist.name: Adamant Receptionist
YZ_Rare_AdamantReceptionist.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) a #card in your Reserve# to <SABOTAGE_INF>.
YZ_Rare_AdamantReceptionist.flavor: "You're not on the list. Please move along."

YZ_Rare_AerolithQuarry.name: Aerolith Quarry
YZ_Rare_AerolithQuarry.effect: At Noon — If your opponent is first player, create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.
YZ_Rare_AerolithQuarry.flavor: "It took great feats of ingenuity to mine for resources at such altitude." - Isaree

YZ_Rare_AetherShard.name: Aether Shard
YZ_Rare_AetherShard.effect: #{J} Draw a card.#  At Noon — Draw a card.
YZ_Rare_AetherShard.flavor: No mere trinket, but a fragment of purest dream.

YZ_Rare_AleloEerieLeviathan.name: Alelo, Eerie Leviathan
YZ_Rare_AleloEerieLeviathan.effect: <GIGANTIC>.  I'm also considered a Spell, even when not in play. (Play me as a Character, but it counts as playing a Spell for other abilities.)
YZ_Rare_AleloEerieLeviathan.flavor: We followed in its wake, believing it was a magical current.

YZ_Rare_Alice.name: Alice
YZ_Rare_Alice.support: {D} : <AFTER_YOU>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

YZ_Rare_Amarok.name: Amarok
YZ_Rare_Amarok.effect: If there are no Characters in the Expedition I'm played in, I cost {2} less.  When another Character joins my Expedition — Sacrifice it.
YZ_Rare_Amarok.flavor: The lone wolf guards its territory jealously.

YZ_Rare_AngryCrowd.name: Angry Crowd
YZ_Rare_AngryCrowd.effect: <FLEETING>.  Discard target Character or Permanent. #If its Base Cost was {2} or less,# create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if it's Fleeting. Otherwise, it's the Hand Cost.)
YZ_Rare_AngryCrowd.flavor: Anger is often the fruit of frustration.

YZ_Rare_Anubis.name: Anubis
YZ_Rare_Anubis.flavor: Only a heart as light as a feather can stand up to the judgment of Anubis.

YZ_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.name: Aroro, Savior of Asgartha
YZ_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.effect: {H} You may discard a Spell from your Reserve. If you do, I gain #2 boosts#.
YZ_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.support: #{D} : The next Spell you play this turn costs {1} less.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_AroroSaviorofAsgartha.flavor: Alone, she was able to turn back the tide.

YZ_Rare_AxiomExhibit.name: Axiom Exhibit
YZ_Rare_AxiomExhibit.effect: {T} : Target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost. Then exhaust it ({T}).  #{T} : Target Character in your Reserve gains 1 boost. Then ready it.#
YZ_Rare_AxiomExhibit.flavor: "Let's show the Reka the brilliance of Axiom ingenuity!"

YZ_Rare_AxiomPuppeteer.name: Axiom Puppeteer
YZ_Rare_AxiomPuppeteer.effect: {H} You may sacrifice a #Character# or Permanent to <SABOTAGE_INF>.
YZ_Rare_AxiomPuppeteer.flavor: "In rock-paper-scissors, I always win by a knockout."

YZ_Rare_BLISSBassist.name: BLISS Bassist
YZ_Rare_BLISSBassist.effect: #If I'm <BOOSTED>, the {V}, {M}, and {O} of other Characters you control are equal to their highest statistic.#
YZ_Rare_BLISSBassist.support: {I} When you play a #Spell# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
YZ_Rare_BLISSBassist.flavor: "This one's for all the explorers out there and all the hard work they do. They're not just monkeyin' around!" — Boona

YZ_Rare_BabaYaga.name: Baba Yaga
YZ_Rare_BabaYaga.flavor: Help or harm? Only the card will tell.

YZ_Rare_BabasIsba.name: Baba's Isba
YZ_Rare_BabasIsba.effect: {J} Draw a card.  {T}, Sacrifice a Character: $<AFTER_YOU>.
YZ_Rare_BabasIsba.flavor: Boney Legs, she's called, and her hut is one reason why.

YZ_Rare_Bait.name: Bait
YZ_Rare_Bait.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Up to three# target token Characters defect. (They each join the Expedition facing theirs, changing controllers.)
YZ_Rare_Bait.flavor: They always say the grass is greener on the other side...

YZ_Rare_Baku.name: Baku
YZ_Rare_Baku.effect: #{J}# Target opponent discards a card from their hand.
YZ_Rare_Baku.flavor: "I’ve seen it myself! 'Baku! Baku!', it says, eating up ghosts as though they were candies."

YZ_Rare_BanishingGate.name: Banishing Gate
YZ_Rare_BanishingGate.flavor: Let me walk you to the door.

YZ_Rare_BaronCimetiere.name: Baron Cimetière
YZ_Rare_BaronCimetiere.effect: #{J}# If six or more cards are in your discard pile, create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition. #Otherwise, I gain 1 boost.#
YZ_Rare_BaronCimetiere.flavor: Need someone to slam the door in their faces?

YZ_Rare_Bastet.name: Bastet
YZ_Rare_Bastet.support: {D} : The next Character with Base Cost {3} or less you play this turn gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)

YZ_Rare_BeautySleep.name: Beauty Sleep
YZ_Rare_BeautySleep.effect: Target Character gains <ASLEEP>. (During Dusk, ignore its statistics. During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Asleep.)
YZ_Rare_BeautySleep.flavor: Yet beware of splinters of flax.

YZ_Rare_Belasenka.name: Belasenka
YZ_Rare_Belasenka.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. #Then, if there are two or more exhausted card in Reserve, I gain 1 boost.#
YZ_Rare_Belasenka.flavor: The cold snap they ride, like a shivering tide.

YZ_Rare_BessieColeman.name: Bessie Coleman
YZ_Rare_BessieColeman.effect: When you sacrifice a #Character# or Permanent — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Rare_BessieColeman.flavor: "I was destined to fly. I was born to fly." - Bessie

YZ_Rare_Blizzard.name: Blizzard
YZ_Rare_Blizzard.effect: <FLEETING>.  #I cost {1} less if there are two or more exhausted cards in Reserve.#  Send to Reserve each Character from target Expedition, then exhaust them ({T}).
YZ_Rare_Blizzard.flavor: The icy winds wrecked the army, despite months of preparation.

YZ_Rare_Boom.name: Boom!
YZ_Rare_Boom.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Sacrifice a Character. If you do, discard target Character or Permanent.
YZ_Rare_Boom.flavor: "Catastrophic failure? I prefer the term 'learning opportunity'."

YZ_Rare_Brainwash.name: Brainwash
YZ_Rare_Brainwash.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target a Character in any Reserve with Reserve Cost {2} or less. Play it for free. (Put it in one of your Expeditions.)
YZ_Rare_Brainwash.flavor: Like a worm in an apple, Silk squirmed into the Eidolon's mind to convert him to its Faction's interests.

YZ_Rare_BrassbugHive.name: Brassbug Hive
YZ_Rare_BrassbugHive.effect: {J} Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.  At Noon — Create a <BRASSBUG> Robot token in target Expedition.
YZ_Rare_BrassbugHive.flavor: What could possibly go wrong with an adorable little self-replicating autonomous robot?

YZ_Rare_BravosBladedancer.name: Bravos Bladedancer
YZ_Rare_BravosBladedancer.flavor: "It seems Thoth has never seen me duel."

YZ_Rare_BravosSignet.name: Bravos Signet
YZ_Rare_BravosSignet.effect: #<FLEETING>.#  Choose #two:#  • Target Character gains 3 boosts.  • Return target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less to its owner's hand.  • Put the top card of your deck in your Mana zone (as an exhausted Mana Orb).

YZ_Rare_Caladrius.name: Caladrius
YZ_Rare_Caladrius.effect: {H} You may send to Reserve target Character with #Hand Cost {1}# or less.
YZ_Rare_Caladrius.flavor: With a simple glance, it reveals your destination.

YZ_Rare_CelebrationDay.name: Celebration Day
YZ_Rare_CelebrationDay.flavor: Today, and for centuries to come, we will celebrate victory over the Kraken and revel in freedom regained!

YZ_Rare_CelestialBlast.name: Celestial Blast
YZ_Rare_CelestialBlast.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Discard up to two targets, Characters or Permanents.  #Draw a card.#
YZ_Rare_CelestialBlast.flavor: The sky cracked open in a thunderous wave as the dream was unleashed upon the world.

YZ_Rare_CheshireCat.name: Cheshire Cat
YZ_Rare_CheshireCat.effect: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may have target Character switch Expeditions. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

YZ_Rare_Chrysalis.name: Chrysalis
YZ_Rare_Chrysalis.effect: $<DEFENDER>.  When I leave the Expedition Zone — Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in my Expedition.
YZ_Rare_Chrysalis.support: #{D} : Exhaust target card in Reserve.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_Chrysalis.flavor: ...They build their ice cocoon to turn ethereal.

YZ_Rare_ConjuringSeal.name: Conjuring Seal
YZ_Rare_ConjuringSeal.flavor: The Imagination shapes our reality just as our beliefs shaped the Æther.

YZ_Rare_Conscription.name: Conscription
YZ_Rare_Conscription.effect: #<COOLDOWN>.# (If I go to Reserve after my effect resolves, exhaust me {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)  Target an Expedition. Create X <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in it, where X is the number of cards in target player's Reserve.

YZ_Rare_CorruptedBabaYaga.name: Corrupted Baba Yaga
YZ_Rare_CorruptedBabaYaga.effect: #I can't be played# unless six or more cards are in your discard pile.  {H} Draw a card.
YZ_Rare_CorruptedBabaYaga.flavor: "The Empyrean is flooded with Nightmare. It's spilling over." - Baba Yaga

YZ_Rare_CorruptedToothFairy.name: Corrupted Tooth Fairy
YZ_Rare_CorruptedToothFairy.effect: #I can't be played# unless six or more cards are in your discard pile.  {H} <SABOTAGE>.
YZ_Rare_CorruptedToothFairy.flavor: Why muzzle the wolf when you can remove it's fangs ?

YZ_Rare_CorruptedWoollyback.name: Corrupted Woollyback
YZ_Rare_CorruptedWoollyback.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless #six or more cards are in your discard pile.#  #When I leave the Expedition zone — Create a <WOOLLYBACK> Animal token in my Expedition.#
YZ_Rare_CorruptedWoollyback.flavor: There's a black sheep in the family.

YZ_Rare_CovertheRetreat.name: Cover the Retreat
YZ_Rare_CovertheRetreat.effect: {J} Create a #<MANA_MOTH> Illusion# token in each of your Expeditions.  #At Noon# — If #six or more cards are in your discard pile,# complete me.
YZ_Rare_CovertheRetreat.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When you create a token Character — You may exhaust me ({T}) to give it 1 boost.

YZ_Rare_DaringPorter.name: Daring Porter
YZ_Rare_DaringPorter.effect: #{J}# <EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>. (Put the top card of your deck in Reserve, then exhaust it {T}. Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
YZ_Rare_DaringPorter.flavor: Someone has to shoulder the heavy burden of responsibility.

YZ_Rare_Defect.name: Defect
YZ_Rare_Defect.effect: <FLEETING>.  Target Character #with Hand Cost {4} or less# defects. (It joins the Expedition facing it, changing controllers.)
YZ_Rare_Defect.flavor: Changing sides isn't always a matter of choice.

YZ_Rare_DemolitionExpert.name: Demolition Expert
YZ_Rare_DemolitionExpert.effect: {H} Create an <AEROLITH> token in #target player's# Landmarks.  {R} You may sacrifice a Permanent #to give 1 boost to target Character.#
YZ_Rare_DemolitionExpert.flavor: Mining aerolith is dangerous, but it's well worth the risk.

YZ_Rare_DorothyGale.name: Dorothy Gale
YZ_Rare_DorothyGale.effect: #{J}# You may send target Character to Reserve.
YZ_Rare_DorothyGale.flavor: "I’ve a feeling we’re not in Kansas anymore."

YZ_Rare_Evanescence.name: Evanescence
YZ_Rare_Evanescence.effect: #Do the following X+1 times,# where X is my number of Arcane counters:  • Send to Reserve target Character with #Hand Cost {2} or less#, then exhaust it ({T}). (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
YZ_Rare_Evanescence.support: {I} When you play another Spell — I gain 1 Arcane counter, up to a max of 3.
YZ_Rare_Evanescence.flavor: In the depths of the City, something seems to be devouring memories and thoughts.

YZ_Rare_FairFox.name: Fair Fox
YZ_Rare_FairFox.effect: {H} #You may pay {1} to discard target Permanent with Hand Cost {2} or less.# If you do, its controller <RESUPPLIES>.
YZ_Rare_FairFox.flavor: Should we practice our passing now?

YZ_Rare_FarFetch20.name: FarFetch 2.0
YZ_Rare_FarFetch20.effect: {J} You may sacrifice a #Character# or Permanent. If you do, target Character switches Expeditions.
YZ_Rare_FarFetch20.flavor: "I'm glad I got my hooks into this new version!" - Paju

YZ_Rare_FeastofThoughts.name: Feast of Thoughts
YZ_Rare_FeastofThoughts.effect: Choose X+1, where X is my number of Arcane counters. #You may pick the same option multiple times:#  • Draw a card.  • Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.  • Remove 3 counters from target card in play or in Reserve.  • <SABOTAGE>.
YZ_Rare_FeastofThoughts.support: {I} When you play another Spell — I gain 1 Arcane counter, up to a #max of 6.#
YZ_Rare_FeastofThoughts.flavor: When the Remanence strikes, ideas burst out of one's mind like water from a dam.

YZ_Rare_FieldReinforcements.name: Field Reinforcements
YZ_Rare_FieldReinforcements.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose one. If each of your Expeditions is behind or tied, you may choose both:  • Draw a card.  • Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.
YZ_Rare_FieldReinforcements.flavor: Supply lines can sometimes be the difference between failure and success.

YZ_Rare_Finisher.name: Finisher
YZ_Rare_Finisher.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose up to three, #you may choose the same option multiple times:#  • Discard target Character.  • Discard target Permanent.  • <SABOTAGE>.

YZ_Rare_Flamel.name: Flamel
YZ_Rare_Flamel.effect: {H} #$<RESUPPLY>.# Then, you may return a Spell from your Reserve to your hand.
YZ_Rare_Flamel.support: {D} : The next Spell you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_Flamel.flavor: Rubedo is the final stage of alchemy, where one's substance is reborn like a phoenix before returning to the world.

YZ_Rare_FlutterofMoths.name: Flutter of Moths
YZ_Rare_FlutterofMoths.effect: I cost {1} less #for each exhausted card in Reserve.#  Create three <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens, distributed as you choose among any number of target Expeditions.

YZ_Rare_FortheGreaterGood.name: For the Greater Good
YZ_Rare_FortheGreaterGood.effect: <FLEETING>.  Discard a card from your hand. If you do, discard target card in play with Base Cost #{5} or less#.

YZ_Rare_FoulFaker.name: Foul Faker
YZ_Rare_FoulFaker.effect: #{J}# If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)

YZ_Rare_Freeze.name: Freeze
YZ_Rare_Freeze.effect: $<COOLDOWN>.  Send target Character to Reserve, then exhaust it ({T}).

YZ_Rare_GiftofSelf.name: Gift of Self
YZ_Rare_GiftofSelf.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Sacrifice a Character. If you do, draw #three cards#.
YZ_Rare_GiftofSelf.flavor: Her being begins to disintegrate as she breaks all the Mana bridges linking the idea of who she is to physical matter.

YZ_Rare_GrandEndeavor.name: Grand Endeavor
YZ_Rare_GrandEndeavor.effect: At Noon — Target Expedition moves forward one region.
YZ_Rare_GrandEndeavor.flavor: The Ordis built a relay of lighthouses to light the way through the Tumult.

YZ_Rare_GrumpyImp.name: Grumpy Imp
YZ_Rare_GrumpyImp.effect: When you discard a card from your hand — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Rare_GrumpyImp.flavor: He will fight like the devil, despite his fear

YZ_Rare_HarryHoudini.name: Harry Houdini
YZ_Rare_HarryHoudini.effect: {H} Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in #target Expedition.# Then, #the controller of the Expedition facing that Illusion# draws a card.
YZ_Rare_HarryHoudini.flavor: The secret of illusion lies in misdirection.

YZ_Rare_Hathor.name: Hathor
YZ_Rare_Hathor.support: {D} : Return another card from your Reserve to your hand. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_Hathor.flavor: Dance is the language of the soul.

YZ_Rare_HavenTrainer.name: Haven Trainer
YZ_Rare_HavenTrainer.effect: #{J}# You may <RUSH>. If you would play a card from Reserve this way, you may pay its Hand Cost instead of its Reserve Cost.
YZ_Rare_HavenTrainer.flavor: "Yeah, you've still got a few things to learn…"

YZ_Rare_HealthInspector.name: Health Inspector
YZ_Rare_HealthInspector.effect: Cards in your opponent's Reserve can't gain counters.
YZ_Rare_HealthInspector.flavor: Using untested ingredients is a recipe for disaster.

YZ_Rare_HelpingHand.name: Helping Hand
YZ_Rare_HelpingHand.effect: Target Character gains 1 boost and loses <FLEETING_CHAR>.

YZ_Rare_HextagChaser.name: Hextag Chaser
YZ_Rare_HextagChaser.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. If #it's in your Reserve,# <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
YZ_Rare_HextagChaser.flavor: The element of surprise adds extra spice to any tactic.

YZ_Rare_Hippogriff.name: Hippogriff
YZ_Rare_Hippogriff.effect: #{J}# My Expedition <ASCENDS>.  When my Expedition #moves forward <DUE_TO_ASCENSION># — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in that Expedition after Rest.

YZ_Rare_HuaMulan.name: Hua Mulan
YZ_Rare_HuaMulan.flavor: Her determination has yet to meet its match in this world.

YZ_Rare_Icarus.name: Icarus
YZ_Rare_Icarus.effect: $<SCOUT_1> {1}.  {J} Ready all cards in your Reserve.
YZ_Rare_Icarus.flavor: This time, I hope the Sap wax will hold.

YZ_Rare_IceboundLake.name: Icebound Lake
YZ_Rare_IceboundLake.effect: When you play a Character — If its Expedition is behind, I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then target Character gains <ASLEEP>.
YZ_Rare_IceboundLake.flavor: With a voice like thunder or crackling ice it howls.

YZ_Rare_IceboundPass.name: Icebound Pass
YZ_Rare_IceboundPass.effect: When you exhaust a card in Reserve — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then draw a card.
YZ_Rare_IceboundPass.flavor: We can hear it roar in the snowy passes.

YZ_Rare_IceboundTundra.name: Icebound Tundra
YZ_Rare_IceboundTundra.effect: When you play a Character in a region type where its base statistic is 0 — I gain a Trial counter.  When I gain my third Trial counter — Sacrifice me. If you do, create a <DRAGON_SHADE> Illusion token in target Expedition, then return a card from your Reserve to your hand.
YZ_Rare_IceboundTundra.flavor: We can hear it, echoing in the vast expanses.

YZ_Rare_Intimidation.name: Intimidation
YZ_Rare_Intimidation.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Return target Character or Permanent with Hand Cost #{5} or less# to its owner's hand.
YZ_Rare_Intimidation.flavor: The terrible beast shrank and cowered before the might of the Bravos.

YZ_Rare_InvestigatetheCorruption.name: Investigate the Corruption
YZ_Rare_InvestigatetheCorruption.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Draw #three cards#, then discard a card from your hand.
YZ_Rare_InvestigatetheCorruption.flavor: \"By understanding the evil, we can pull it out at the root.\" - Zaj

YZ_Rare_Issitoq.name: Issitoq
YZ_Rare_Issitoq.effect: Your other Expedition and the Expedition facing it can't move forward.
YZ_Rare_Issitoq.support: {D} : Draw a card. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_Issitoq.flavor: No one can escape their gaze.

YZ_Rare_Janus.name: Janus
YZ_Rare_Janus.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  When you discard a card from your hand #or your Reserve# — I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Rare_Janus.flavor: "God of gates, it is time to close the Veil." — Sam

YZ_Rare_Joyride.name: Joyride
YZ_Rare_Joyride.effect: $<COOLDOWN>.  Discard another card from your Reserve. If you do, target Character gains 2 boosts.
YZ_Rare_Joyride.flavor: Everything fun is life is either forbidden or completely crazy.

YZ_Rare_KadigiranAlchemist.name: Kadigiran Alchemist
YZ_Rare_KadigiranAlchemist.flavor: Alchemy is not just a matter of turning lead to gold. It's about purifying yourself of imperfections to become your true self.

YZ_Rare_KadigiranMageDancer.name: Kadigiran Mage-Dancer
YZ_Rare_KadigiranMageDancer.effect: When you play a Spell — I gain 1 boost.  #At Dusk —  if I have 3 or more boosts, draw a card.#
YZ_Rare_KadigiranMageDancer.flavor: "Don't just wait for magic to happen. Go out and make your own!"

YZ_Rare_Kali.name: Kali
YZ_Rare_Kali.effect: {H} You may put a Spell from your hand in Reserve. If you don't, sacrifice #a Character.#

YZ_Rare_KelonicHeater.name: Kelonic Heater
YZ_Rare_KelonicHeater.effect: {J} $<EXHAUSTED_RESUPPLY>.  You may play exhausted Characters from your Reserve in my Expedition.
YZ_Rare_KelonicHeater.flavor: A bit of warmth goes a long way in brightening a cold day.

YZ_Rare_KrakensWrath.name: Kraken's Wrath
YZ_Rare_KrakensWrath.effect: $<FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve up to #four# target Characters with a total Hand Cost #{6} or less#.
YZ_Rare_KrakensWrath.flavor: The roaring waves crashed down over the charging armies, and countless soldiers vanished beneath the raging waters.

YZ_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.name: Kuraokami Unbound
YZ_Rare_KuraokamiUnbound.effect: {H} #Target opponent puts a card from their hand in Reserve. Then,# exhaust all cards in Reserve.

YZ_Rare_KuwattheDissenter.name: Kuwat, the Dissenter
YZ_Rare_KuwattheDissenter.flavor: "There are gates one should not open, there are seals one should not breach. And yet I will."

YZ_Rare_LadyoftheLake.name: Lady of the Lake
YZ_Rare_LadyoftheLake.support: #{D} : The next Spell you play this turn loses <FLEETING>.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_LadyoftheLake.flavor: "One day, I will show you the wonders of Avalon and the true might of the Fae realms."

YZ_Rare_Lakshmi.name: Lakshmi
YZ_Rare_Lakshmi.effect: When you #sacrifice a Character# — I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Rare_Lakshmi.flavor: Fortune smiles on those who give themselves over to it.

YZ_Rare_LeviathanSpotter.name: Leviathan Spotter
YZ_Rare_LeviathanSpotter.effect: {R} You may reveal a #Spell# with Hand Cost {4} or more from your hand. If you do, draw a card.
YZ_Rare_LeviathanSpotter.flavor: When the horn sounds, the hunters gather to track the Leviathan.

YZ_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.name: Leviathan Whisperer
YZ_Rare_LeviathanWhisperer.effect: {J} The next Leviathan you play this Afternoon costs {2} less #and gains 1 boost.#

YZ_Rare_LicenseWithdrawal.name: License Withdrawal
YZ_Rare_LicenseWithdrawal.effect: <FLEETING>.  Choose one:  • Discard target <BOOSTED> Character #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#  • Discard target Permanent #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#

YZ_Rare_LostintheRiptide.name: Lost in the Riptide
YZ_Rare_LostintheRiptide.effect: <FLEETING>.  You may play me for {1} less. If you do, I can only target a Character in {O}.  Return target Character to the top of its owner's deck.
YZ_Rare_LostintheRiptide.flavor: This is why you're supposed to read the map...

YZ_Rare_LyraSkald.name: Lyra Skald
YZ_Rare_LyraSkald.effect: #{H} You may discard a card from your Reserve to $<RESUPPLY_INF>.#
YZ_Rare_LyraSkald.support: #{D} : The next card you play this turn costs {1} less.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_LyraSkald.flavor: We're all stories, in the end.

YZ_Rare_MagicalTraining.name: Magical Training
YZ_Rare_MagicalTraining.flavor: Without practice, the gift of Alteration will come to nothing.

YZ_Rare_ManaFlare.name: Mana Flare
YZ_Rare_ManaFlare.flavor: He summons the mightiest beings just for the sake of an epic duel.

YZ_Rare_ManaSeamstress.name: Mana Seamstress
YZ_Rare_ManaSeamstress.effect: #{H} If six or more cards are in your discard pile, discard target Character with Base Cost {1} or less.#
YZ_Rare_ManaSeamstress.flavor: Stitching the fabric of reality back together to avoid another Confluence...

YZ_Rare_ManintheMaze.name: Man in the Maze
YZ_Rare_ManintheMaze.effect: {H} Remove all boosts from Characters in play and in Reserve. Then, depending on the number of boosts removed this way:  • 1-4: I gain 2 boosts.  • 5-8: Play a card with Hand Cost {3} or less for free.  • 9+: #The Expedition facing me moves backwards one region.#
YZ_Rare_ManintheMaze.flavor: Life is a maze, but our purpose is not to escape it. The purpose of life is the maze itself.

YZ_Rare_MarieCurie.name: Marie Curie
YZ_Rare_MarieCurie.effect: #{H} You may sacrifice a Character or Permanent. If you don't, I gain <FLEETING>.#
YZ_Rare_MarieCurie.flavor: "It is important to make a dream of life and of a dream reality."

YZ_Rare_MeditationTraining.name: Meditation Training
YZ_Rare_MeditationTraining.effect: Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (During Rest, it doesn't go to Reserve and it loses Anchored.)
YZ_Rare_MeditationTraining.flavor: Don't think you are, know you are.

YZ_Rare_Merlin.name: Merlin
YZ_Rare_Merlin.flavor: "You and I both know it has never been about the sword."

YZ_Rare_Metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
YZ_Rare_Metamorphosis.effect: <FLEETING>.  Discard target Character #with Hand Cost {5} or less#, then create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in its Expedition.
YZ_Rare_Metamorphosis.flavor: Every reality contains its share of illusions.

YZ_Rare_MiladydeWinter.name: Milady de Winter
YZ_Rare_MiladydeWinter.effect: {H} Take control of target Permanent #with Base Cost {2} or less,# putting it in my Expedition if it's an Expedition Permanent. (If it would move to your Reserve or any other personal zone, it goes to its owner's instead.)
YZ_Rare_MiladydeWinter.flavor: There's something so delectable about nabbing someone else's assets.

YZ_Rare_MobileArmory.name: Mobile Armory
YZ_Rare_MobileArmory.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.  #<DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent my Expedition from moving forward.#

YZ_Rare_MochizukiChiyome.name: Mochizuki Chiyome
YZ_Rare_MochizukiChiyome.effect: #{J} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, pay {1} less for the next Spell you play this Afternoon, down to a minimum of {1}.# (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region. Other effects may reduce the cost further.)
YZ_Rare_MochizukiChiyome.support: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next Spell you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}.
YZ_Rare_MochizukiChiyome.flavor: The art of surprise is showing up where you're not expected.

YZ_Rare_MoltingCrab.name: Molting Crab
YZ_Rare_MoltingCrab.effect: {J} Draw a card, then discard a card from your hand.
YZ_Rare_MoltingCrab.flavor: It's pincers grips the fabric of reality.

YZ_Rare_MonolithArchivist.name: Monolith Archivist
YZ_Rare_MonolithArchivist.flavor: "The form has been filled out incorrectly. Please make a new appointment tomorrow."

YZ_Rare_MonolithLegate.name: Monolith Legate
YZ_Rare_MonolithLegate.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — $<SABOTAGE> after Rest.
YZ_Rare_MonolithLegate.flavor: Your document has expired. Needless to say, that's not his problem.

YZ_Rare_MoonlightJellyfish.name: Moonlight Jellyfish
YZ_Rare_MoonlightJellyfish.effect: When I'm sacrificed, if I was not <FLEETING> — Put me in Reserve.  #When I'm sacrificed, if was <FLEETING> — Draw a card.#
YZ_Rare_MoonlightJellyfish.flavor: Theoretically, transdifferentiation can go on indefinitely, effectively rendering the jellyfish biologically immortal... and squishy.

YZ_Rare_MothCollision.name: Moth Collision
YZ_Rare_MothCollision.effect: <FLEETING>.  If you control an Illusion, I cost #{2} less.#  Discard target Character #with Hand Cost {3} or less.#
YZ_Rare_MothCollision.flavor: When two moths meet, there's always a spark.

YZ_Rare_MothDecoy.name: Moth Decoy
YZ_Rare_MothDecoy.effect: You may exhaust ({T}) a card from your Reserve to play me for {1} less.  Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Rare_MothDecoy.flavor: "You're not the only ones who can use substitution." — Moyo

YZ_Rare_MothLantern.name: Moth Lantern
YZ_Rare_MothLantern.effect: When you sacrifice a non-Illusion Character — Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in my Expedition.  {J} Sacrifice a Character in my Expedition.
YZ_Rare_MothLantern.flavor: In the tricks of its light, shed your skin to become an illusion.

YZ_Rare_MothLarva.name: Moth Larva
YZ_Rare_MothLarva.effect: #{J}# If there are two or more exhausted cards in Reserve, I gain 1 boost.
YZ_Rare_MothLarva.support: #{D} : Exhaust target card in Reserve.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_MothLarva.flavor: At the start of their short life, the larvae are corporeal...

YZ_Rare_MothcatcherWand.name: Mothcatcher Wand
YZ_Rare_MothcatcherWand.effect: {J} Exhaust target card in Reserve.  {T}, {X} : Create X <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens in my Expedition. X can't be higher than the total number of exhausted cards in Reserve and #other exhausted Permanents you control.#
YZ_Rare_MothcatcherWand.flavor: Moyo uses it to capture the essence of illusion.

YZ_Rare_MothtoaFlame.name: Moth to a Flame
YZ_Rare_MothtoaFlame.effect: $<COOLDOWN>.  Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token #in each of your Expeditions#.
YZ_Rare_MothtoaFlame.flavor: During the scant hours of their brief existence, the Moths flutter about, carrying only the idea of themselves.

YZ_Rare_MothtoaSpring.name: Moth to a Spring
YZ_Rare_MothtoaSpring.effect: <FLEETING>.  Create #two# <MANA_MOTH> Illusion tokens, distributed among any Expeditions.  Draw a card.
YZ_Rare_MothtoaSpring.flavor: A spring that will quench any thirst for magic.

YZ_Rare_MunaCaregiver.name: Muna Caregiver
YZ_Rare_MunaCaregiver.support: {D} : Target Character with Hand Cost {3} or less gains <ANCHORED>. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_MunaCaregiver.flavor: "We don’t inherit the earth from our ancestors, we borrow it from our children."

YZ_Rare_NightclubBouncer.name: Nightclub Bouncer
YZ_Rare_NightclubBouncer.effect: #{J}# If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, <SABOTAGE_LOW>. #Otherwise, you may exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve.# (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
YZ_Rare_NightclubBouncer.flavor: "What part of 'dress code' do you not understand?"

YZ_Rare_NilamSpires.name: Nilam Spires
YZ_Rare_NilamSpires.effect: When you play a Spell — I gain 1 Arcane counter. Then, you may exhaust me ({T}) and #spend 3# of my Arcane counters to create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Rare_NilamSpires.flavor: Observing the Tumult requires taking a high-level perspective on it, and mastering it requires knowledge.

YZ_Rare_NyalaGiftedConjurer.name: Nyala, Gifted Conjurer
YZ_Rare_NyalaGiftedConjurer.effect: {J} Exchange target card from your Reserve with a card from your Hand.
YZ_Rare_NyalaGiftedConjurer.flavor: "Of course I'm cheating. That's what magic is all about."

YZ_Rare_NyalaNightReveler.name: Nyala, Night Reveler
YZ_Rare_NyalaNightReveler.effect: {H} If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, you may exchange a card from your Reserve with a card from your hand. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
YZ_Rare_NyalaNightReveler.support: #{D} : Exchange another card from your Reserve with a card from your hand.#
YZ_Rare_NyalaNightReveler.flavor: "I can get in anywhere, VIP list or not."

YZ_Rare_OffYouGo.name: Off You Go!
YZ_Rare_OffYouGo.effect: Send to Reserve target Character with Hand Cost #{5} or less#.

YZ_Rare_OrdisAttorney.name: Ordis Attorney
YZ_Rare_OrdisAttorney.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Draw a card.

YZ_Rare_OrdisCadets.name: Ordis Cadets
YZ_Rare_OrdisCadets.effect: {J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.
YZ_Rare_OrdisCadets.support: #{D} : The next Spell you play this turn costs {1} less.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_OrdisCadets.flavor: Together they learn, and together they'll protect.

YZ_Rare_OrdisCarrier.name: Ordis Carrier
YZ_Rare_OrdisCarrier.effect: At Noon — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in your Companion Expedition.
YZ_Rare_OrdisCarrier.flavor: The flow of Ordis Recruits seems to go on forever.

YZ_Rare_OrdisCrier.name: Ordis Crier
YZ_Rare_OrdisCrier.effect: #{R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to ready two Mana Orbs.#
YZ_Rare_OrdisCrier.support: {I} When you #play a Spell# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
YZ_Rare_OrdisCrier.flavor: He's surprisingly happy for someone who cries all day.

YZ_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.name: Ordis Dispatcher
YZ_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.effect: {R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to create #two# <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier tokens in your other Expedition.
YZ_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.support: {I} When you #play a Spell# — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
YZ_Rare_OrdisDispatcher.flavor: She's in charge of every assignment within the garrison.

YZ_Rare_OrdisOverseer.name: Ordis Overseer
YZ_Rare_OrdisOverseer.effect: {J} If my Expedition is behind, create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in my Expedition.
YZ_Rare_OrdisOverseer.support: {D} : Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_OrdisOverseer.flavor: Proper resource allocation can help make up for lost ground.

YZ_Rare_OrdisTrooper.name: Ordis Trooper
YZ_Rare_OrdisTrooper.flavor: "Chin up and stand tall. You’re shieldbearers of the Aegis now!"

YZ_Rare_OrdisWarden.name: Ordis Warden
YZ_Rare_OrdisWarden.effect: {H} #You may have me# gain <ASLEEP>.  At Noon — Target player puts a card from their hand in Reserve.
YZ_Rare_OrdisWarden.flavor: You can't beat the clink for catching forty winks.

YZ_Rare_OutofaDarkSky.name: Out of a Dark Sky
YZ_Rare_OutofaDarkSky.effect: <FLEETING>.  Send to Reserve target Character with Base Cost #{2} or less.# Then, if both of your Expeditions are #behind or tied,# <RESUPPLY_LOW>.
YZ_Rare_OutofaDarkSky.flavor: Requests for assistance pour in at the sound of beating wings.

YZ_Rare_PajuAxiomPilot.name: Paju, Axiom Pilot
YZ_Rare_PajuAxiomPilot.effect: #When a Robot or a token joins my Expedition — If I have no boosts, I gain 1 boost, then create an <AEROLITH> token in your Landmarks.#
YZ_Rare_PajuAxiomPilot.support: {D} : Create an <AEROLITH> token in target player's Landmarks.
YZ_Rare_PajuAxiomPilot.flavor: "Look, Paju. Wandering unknown skies was our dream, and now we've achieved it." - Treyst

YZ_Rare_Pamola.name: Pamola
YZ_Rare_Pamola.support: {D} : Exhaust target card in Reserve. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_Pamola.flavor: Pamola is always angry with those who climb to the summit.

YZ_Rare_PartialReferee.name: Partial Referee
YZ_Rare_PartialReferee.effect: {H} Discard target Character #or Permanent.# If its Base Cost was {3} or more, its controller draws a card. (Its Base Cost is the Reserve Cost if Fleeting, or the Hand Cost if not.)

YZ_Rare_Pasiphae.name: Pasiphaë
YZ_Rare_Pasiphae.effect: {J} I gain 1 boost per Character target opponent controls.
YZ_Rare_Pasiphae.flavor: She won't let herself be bullied.

YZ_Rare_PastryChef.name: Pastry Chef
YZ_Rare_PastryChef.effect: #$<SEASONED>.#  {R} If I have 2 or more boosts, draw a card.
YZ_Rare_PastryChef.support: {I} When you play a #Spell# — I gain 1 boost, up to a #max of 2.#
YZ_Rare_PastryChef.flavor: Pioneers in more ways than one, the Bravos were the first to experiment with Sap in the culinary arts.

YZ_Rare_PushBacktheNight.name: Push Back the Night
YZ_Rare_PushBacktheNight.effect: {J} Draw a card, #then discard a card from your hand.#  At Noon — If six or more cards are in your discard pile, complete me.
YZ_Rare_PushBacktheNight.support: <COMPLETED_LOW>: When a card is discarded from your hand — You may exhaust me ({T}) to create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.

YZ_Rare_QorganExorcist.name: Qorgan Exorcist
YZ_Rare_QorganExorcist.effect: #{J} If six or more cards are in your discard pile, I gain 1 boost.# Otherwise, discard the top card of your deck.
YZ_Rare_QorganExorcist.flavor: Now we just need to cover Sam's back.

YZ_Rare_QorganInformant.name: Qorgan Informant
YZ_Rare_QorganInformant.effect: #$<SCOUT_1> {1}.#  {H} Remove up to 2 counters from target card in play or in Reserve. (This can't target Hero cards.)
YZ_Rare_QorganInformant.flavor: Shhh. This stays between you and me.

YZ_Rare_QorganOccultist.name: Qorgan Occultist
YZ_Rare_QorganOccultist.effect: {H} I gain <FLEETING> unless you discarded a card from your hand #or Reserve# this turn. (Not this Day.)
YZ_Rare_QorganOccultist.flavor: \"Be careful, the Nightare's darkness can taint any idea.\".

YZ_Rare_QorganPhantom.name: Qorgan Phantom
YZ_Rare_QorganPhantom.effect: #{H} You may pay {1}. If you do, I activate my {D} ability.#
YZ_Rare_QorganPhantom.support: {D} : Draw a card, then discard a card from your hand.
YZ_Rare_QorganPhantom.flavor: "Our role is to create a diversion so a small group can make it to the breach."

YZ_Rare_Rage.name: Rage
YZ_Rare_Rage.effect: Target non-Fleeting Character gains 2 boosts and <FLEETING>.
YZ_Rare_Rage.flavor: "If its fury does not wane, it will soon have a taste of my own!" - Sol

YZ_Rare_RekaBarmaid.name: Reka Barmaid
YZ_Rare_RekaBarmaid.effect: At Dusk — If I'm <IN_CONTACT>, I gain 1 boost. (I'm In Contact if another player's Expedition is in my region.)
YZ_Rare_RekaBarmaid.support: #{D} : The next Character you play this turn gains 1 boost.#
YZ_Rare_RekaBarmaid.flavor: "It's happy hour all the time here!"

YZ_Rare_RekaBioengineer.name: Reka Bioengineer
YZ_Rare_RekaBioengineer.effect: {J} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in #any player's# Reserve. If you do, create a <MANASEED> token in #that player's# Landmarks.
YZ_Rare_RekaBioengineer.flavor: In the wild rush to find new uses for Manaseeds, it seems the sky's the limit…

YZ_Rare_RekaPatron.name: Reka Patron
YZ_Rare_RekaPatron.effect: When my Expedition fails to move forward during Dusk — Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
YZ_Rare_RekaPatron.flavor: Art's value is in the eye of the beholder.

YZ_Rare_RekaSupporter.name: Reka Supporter
YZ_Rare_RekaSupporter.effect: {H} Create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
YZ_Rare_RekaSupporter.flavor: The energy of the crowd is what drives the greatest victories.

YZ_Rare_RekaThurifer.name: Reka Thurifer
YZ_Rare_RekaThurifer.effect: #Play me for {1} less if six or more cards are in your Discard Pile.# {H} $<SABOTAGE>.
YZ_Rare_RekaThurifer.support: {D} : Pay {1} less for the next #Spell# you play this turn, down to a minimum of {1}. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_RekaThurifer.flavor: Through drifting incense, we purge the darkness within.

YZ_Rare_RidetheBifrost.name: Ride the Bifröst

YZ_Rare_RidetheBifrost.flavor: The Lyra never play by the rules.

YZ_Rare_RimeFrost.name: Rime Frost
YZ_Rare_RimeFrost.effect: #Choose one:  • Discard target exhausted card from a Reserve.#  • Exhaust ({T}) target card in Reserve. (Exhausted cards can't be played and have no Support abilities.)
YZ_Rare_RimeFrost.flavor: A late frost delays the spring.

YZ_Rare_RocketPuffin.name: Rocket Puffin
YZ_Rare_RocketPuffin.effect: {J} You may ready an exhausted card in Reserve. #If you do, I gain 1 boost.#
YZ_Rare_RocketPuffin.flavor: Blasting off at the speed of light!

YZ_Rare_RomanticEncounter.name: Romantic Encounter

YZ_Rare_RomanticEncounter.flavor: "I've never felt this close to anyone."

YZ_Rare_RunesTestament.name: Rune's Testament
YZ_Rare_RunesTestament.effect: If my Expedition would move forward, you may discard me instead to draw two cards.
YZ_Rare_RunesTestament.flavor: The first High King of Asgartha urges us to venture forth!

YZ_Rare_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.name: Sagitta, Soaring Leviathan
YZ_Rare_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.effect: I cost #{2} less# if there's #a Spell with Reserve Cost {4} or more in your Reserve.#  $<GIGANTIC>.
YZ_Rare_SagittaSoaringLeviathan.flavor: We flew higher to escape the turbulence of its wings.

YZ_Rare_Sakarabru.name: Sakarabru
YZ_Rare_Sakarabru.effect: {H} Your opponent's Expedition facing me moves backwards one region.
YZ_Rare_Sakarabru.support: #{D} : Draw a card.# (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_Sakarabru.flavor: When such a terrifying being appears in your path, taking a step back is only natural.

YZ_Rare_SakarabrusFury.name: Sakarabru's Fury
YZ_Rare_SakarabrusFury.effect: <FLEETING>.  #Discard each Character from target Expedition,# then that Expedition moves backwards one region.
YZ_Rare_SakarabrusFury.flavor: With a single gesture, Sakarabru swept away days of progress.

YZ_Rare_SapExtractor.name: Sap Extractor

YZ_Rare_SapInfusion.name: Sap Infusion

YZ_Rare_SapInfusion.support: {I} When you play another Spell — I gain 1 Arcane counter, up to a max of 3.
YZ_Rare_SapInfusion.flavor: There are a thousand ways to use the Sap. The Yzmir seek to exploit its full potential.

YZ_Rare_ScholarsVault.name: Scholars' Vault

YZ_Rare_ScholarsVault.flavor: Within its currents swim ancient knowledge and forgotten memories.

YZ_Rare_ScienceFair.name: Science Fair
YZ_Rare_ScienceFair.effect: #{J} Exhaust me.#  {T} : Put a card from your hand in Reserve, #then exhaust it ({T}).# If you do, draw a card.
YZ_Rare_ScienceFair.flavor: At this convention, the Reka show off their scientific superiority.

YZ_Rare_ScribblingStarfish.name: Scribbling Starfish
YZ_Rare_ScribblingStarfish.effect: #{R} You may spend 1 of my boosts to draw a card.#
YZ_Rare_ScribblingStarfish.support: {I} When you play a Spell — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
YZ_Rare_ScribblingStarfish.flavor: A good Sigil starts with a good sketch.

YZ_Rare_SeaNymph.name: Sea Nymph
YZ_Rare_SeaNymph.effect: #{J}# If I'm facing an Expedition in {O}, <SABOTAGE_LOW>.
YZ_Rare_SeaNymph.flavor: From a thin trickle of water, she creates raging tides.

YZ_Rare_SeekerOwl.name: Seeker Owl
YZ_Rare_SeekerOwl.effect: When I leave the Expedition zone — #Each of your Expeditions# <ASCENDS>.
YZ_Rare_SeekerOwl.flavor: Its flight is silent and its talons sharp.

YZ_Rare_Sekhmet.name: Sekhmet
YZ_Rare_Sekhmet.effect: {H} You may return target Character facing me with Base Cost #{2} or less# to its owner's hand.  {R} I gain 2 boosts.
YZ_Rare_Sekhmet.flavor: Now that's what you call taking the lion's share.

YZ_Rare_ShiramunTechMonk.name: Shiramun, Tech Monk
YZ_Rare_ShiramunTechMonk.effect: {H} You may #discard a card from your Reserve# to <SABOTAGE_INF>.
YZ_Rare_ShiramunTechMonk.flavor: Building walls, to keep the monsters at bay.

YZ_Rare_Shiva.name: Shiva
YZ_Rare_Shiva.effect: {H} You may discard target Permanent. If you don't, I gain 2 boosts.
YZ_Rare_Shiva.flavor: Any creation begins with an act of destruction.

YZ_Rare_SleightofHand.name: Sleight of Hand
YZ_Rare_SleightofHand.effect: $<COOLDOWN>.  Exchange target #Spell# in your Reserve with a card from your Hand.
YZ_Rare_SleightofHand.flavor: "An old trick well done is far better than a new trick with no effect." - Houdini

YZ_Rare_SmallStepGiantLeap.name: Small Step, Giant Leap
