YZ_Rare_SmallStepGiantLeap.flavor: The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.

YZ_Rare_SneezerShroom.name: Sneezer Shroom
YZ_Rare_SneezerShroom.effect: {J} I gain $<ANCHORED>.  #At Noon — I gain 1 boost.#

YZ_Rare_SnowballCommando.name: Snowball Commando
YZ_Rare_SnowballCommando.effect: {H} You may exhaust ({T}) target card in an opponent's Reserve, then roll a die. When you roll a 1-3 this way — That opponent targets a card in your Reserve. Exhaust it.

YZ_Rare_SpindleHarvesters.name: Spindle Harvesters
YZ_Rare_SpindleHarvesters.flavor: Some say the harvesters are the caretakers of the world-trees.

YZ_Rare_SportsEncounter.name: Sports Encounter
YZ_Rare_SportsEncounter.effect: #$<COOLDOWN>.#  Distribute 2 boosts among any target Characters in play #or in Reserve.#
YZ_Rare_SportsEncounter.flavor: "Your victory is a victory for both our peoples!"

YZ_Rare_SpyCraft.name: Spy Craft
YZ_Rare_SpyCraft.flavor: This message will self-destruct in five seconds.

YZ_Rare_SternSentinel.name: Stern Sentinel
YZ_Rare_SternSentinel.effect: {H} #If you control a Feat, <SABOTAGE_LOW>.# Otherwise, <SABOTAGE_LOW> a card with Reserve Cost {2} or less.
YZ_Rare_SternSentinel.flavor: "Getting past me means going through hell—with no way back."

YZ_Rare_StigmaofCowardice.name: Stigma of Cowardice
YZ_Rare_StigmaofCowardice.effect: #<TOUGH_1>.#  {J} Pass.  When an opponent passes — You may play a #card.# (Paying its cost normally.)
YZ_Rare_StigmaofCowardice.flavor: Sometimes it's wiser to be afraid of your own shadow…

YZ_Rare_StigmaofFallacy.name: Stigma of Fallacy
YZ_Rare_StigmaofFallacy.effect: #{J}# Do this once #for each# \"Stigma of Fallacy\" in your discard pile:  - Create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Rare_StigmaofFallacy.flavor: Falsehoods behind the mask, hidden under the guise of truth…

YZ_Rare_StigmaofStagnation.name: Stigma of Stagnation
YZ_Rare_StigmaofStagnation.flavor: Fear of change leads to stagnation.

YZ_Rare_StudiousAcolyte.name: Studious Acolyte
YZ_Rare_StudiousAcolyte.effect: You may play Spells for #{2} less# if their Base Cost is #{7} or more.# (Reserve Cost if from Reserve, Hand Cost otherwise.)
YZ_Rare_StudiousAcolyte.flavor: Afanas' backing is beginning to bear fruit.

YZ_Rare_StudiousDisciple.name: Studious Disciple
YZ_Rare_StudiousDisciple.effect: #{R} The next Spell you play this Afternoon costs {1} less.#
YZ_Rare_StudiousDisciple.support: {D} : The next Spell you play this turn costs {1} less. (Discard me from Reserve to do this.)
YZ_Rare_StudiousDisciple.flavor: So far behind, and still so much to learn!

YZ_Rare_StudiousRookie.name: Studious Rookie
YZ_Rare_StudiousRookie.effect: When you play a Spell with Base Cost {4} or more — #I gain 1 boost.# (It's the Reserve Cost if played from Reserve, or the Hand Cost if not.)
YZ_Rare_StudiousRookie.flavor: Maleros should have been wary of the outsider.

YZ_Rare_SuhaQorganOperative.name: Suha, Qorgan Operative
YZ_Rare_SuhaQorganOperative.effect: {H} I gain #2 boosts.#  #When I go to Reserve from the Expedition zone — <SABOTAGE>.#
YZ_Rare_SuhaQorganOperative.flavor: By accepting the Qorgan's offer, Suha got to see what was down the rabbit hole.

YZ_Rare_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.name: Sunisa, Dedicated Ensign

YZ_Rare_SunisaDedicatedEnsign.flavor: Forward or hold. There is no going back.

YZ_Rare_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.name: Sunisa, Ordis Bodyguard
YZ_Rare_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.effect: <DEFENDER_FS>.  If there are two or more #Spells# in your #Reserve,# <DEFENDER_CHA_P> Characters don't prevent my Expedition from moving forward.  #{J} Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> Soldier token in target Expedition.#
YZ_Rare_SunisaOrdisBodyguard.flavor: "Behind the smiles and jubilation, I sense a growing tension…"

YZ_Rare_SylasCrypticWarlock.name: Sylas, Cryptic Warlock
YZ_Rare_SylasCrypticWarlock.effect: {H} Draw a card.  #{J} I gain 1 boost per card in your hand.#
YZ_Rare_SylasCrypticWarlock.support: {I} When you play a Spell — I gain 1 boost, up to a max of 2.
YZ_Rare_SylasCrypticWarlock.flavor: Knowledge is power, but secrets are paramount.

YZ_Rare_Tag.name: Tag!

YZ_Rare_TeamMascot.name: Team Mascot

YZ_Rare_TeamMascot.flavor: She gets the substitutes fired up so they're ready to take the field.

YZ_Rare_TechnologicalEncounter.name: Technological Encounter
YZ_Rare_TechnologicalEncounter.effect: <COOLDOWN>.  Draw a card, then create a <MANASEED> token in your Landmarks.
YZ_Rare_TechnologicalEncounter.flavor: "The fruit of our research will lead our peoples to new heights."

YZ_Rare_TerrifiedGhost.name: Terrified Ghost
YZ_Rare_TerrifiedGhost.flavor: A terror that even ghosts can feel...

YZ_Rare_TheBeastofGevaudan.name: The Beast of Gévaudan
YZ_Rare_TheBeastofGevaudan.effect: {H} You may target another Character with {V} less than or equal to mine. It switches Expeditions.
YZ_Rare_TheBeastofGevaudan.flavor: "When the wolf is at the door, the sheep are in danger."

YZ_Rare_TheHare.name: The Hare
YZ_Rare_TheHare.effect: {H} If you are first player, target player becomes first player.

YZ_Rare_TheHunger.name: The Hunger
YZ_Rare_TheHunger.effect: {H} Discard all other cards in play or in Reserve.  When a card goes to the discard pile — I gain 1 boost.  #If I'm <FLEETING>, I am <GIGANTIC>.#
YZ_Rare_TheHunger.flavor: The City has a soul, and it is famished.

YZ_Rare_TheInfirmary.name: The Infirmary
YZ_Rare_TheInfirmary.effect: #{J} <RESUPPLY>.#  {T}, Exhaust a card in your Reserve: <AFTER_YOU>.
YZ_Rare_TheInfirmary.flavor: "I told you it was a bad idea to drink all that Sap Cola…"

YZ_Rare_TheKadigirYzmirBastion.name: The Kadigir, Yzmir Bastion
YZ_Rare_TheKadigirYzmirBastion.effect: {T} : The next Spell you play this turn is free. #If you play it from your hand, it loses <FLEETING>.#
YZ_Rare_TheKadigirYzmirBastion.flavor: What dark, phantasmagorical secrets hide within Asgartha's College of Magic? Only madmen and the Yzmirs know for sure...

YZ_Rare_TheKraken.name: The Kraken
YZ_Rare_TheKraken.effect: $<GIGANTIC>.  {J} Sacrifice #one Character#.  All regions are {E} and lose their other types.
YZ_Rare_TheKraken.flavor: The Kraken tears open the surface, sending plumes of water crashing down on the troops in an apocalyptic deluge.

YZ_Rare_TheLectern.name: The Lectern
YZ_Rare_TheLectern.effect: {J} #If there's another card in your Landmarks, draw a card.# Otherwise, <RESUPPLY_LOW>.  When I'm sacrificed — Create an <ORDIS_RECRUIT> in a Hero Expedition.
YZ_Rare_TheLectern.flavor: Sol may have sounded the alarm, but her words seem to be falling on deaf ears.

YZ_Rare_TheMess.flavor: Every evening, the Mess overflows with laughter and shouting as explorers share their daily exploits.

YZ_Rare_TheNilamWitheredTree.name: The Nilam, Withered Tree
YZ_Rare_TheNilamWitheredTree.effect: When you exhaust a card in Reserve — You may exhaust me ({T}) to create a <MANA_MOTH> Illusion token in target Expedition.
YZ_Rare_TheNilamWitheredTree.flavor: Long after it died, the Nilam still held life as the nesting grounds for the Mana Moths.

YZ_Rare_TheSnowQueen.name: The Snow Queen
